# SP4 Session Extras Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Agent OS tells you when an agent needs you: a tab marker, a Home strip, a badge in the top bar, the Safety page and, in the desktop app, a notification while its window is hidden. It shows what a Claude Code session has used (model, context, plan, cost), shows two sessions side by side, lists the files a session changed with a read-only diff, types a hand-off note into Claude Code or Codex without ever pressing Enter, offers a separate git copy when two agents would share a folder, offers to keep going on OpenRouter when a plan runs out (only after your click and a confirm), and replays session recordings with their moments. Nothing is ever answered for you.

**Architecture:** Signals from every source (Claude Code's HTTP hooks and statusLine, the mirror's OSC 9/99/777 and BEL, Hermes's terminal title, Codex's OSC 9 text, the Claude and Codex limit text on screen, and the `claude agents --json` and `openclaw approvals pending --json` pollers) become one signal object (`server/runtime/sessions/signals.js`) and go to the session manager, which keeps each session's activity state and alert state in memory and sends both in `GET /api/sessions` and on the WebSocket (R22). `server/runtime/sessions/hooks.js` answers Claude's hooks outside the cookie-gated `/api/` prefix: a bearer token per session, 256 KB, 204 with an empty body at once, never a decision (H5). The per-session Claude settings file carries only the observe-only hooks, a statusLine wrapper that prints the person's own status line byte for byte (H6), and the brain keys. When packaged, the server prints one `AGENT_OS_ALERT:<json>` line per alert, and the Rust shell shows it with `tauri-plugin-notification` when the window is hidden or not focused. A small argv-only git runner feeds the changes panel and the worktree offer; the hand-off writes into a PTY only under the bracketed-paste write rules; keep going reuses `server/runtime/builders/continue.js`; the replay player plays the asciicast in a read-only xterm with markers from meta.json.

**Tech Stack:** As SP3: Node 24 + Express 4 (server), `node-pty` 1.2.0-beta.14, `@xterm/headless` 6.1.0-beta.303 + `@xterm/addon-serialize` 0.15.0-beta.301 + `@xterm/addon-unicode11` 0.10.0-beta.301 (mirror), `ws` 8.22.0, React 18 + Vite + TypeScript (UI), `@xterm/xterm` 6.1.0-beta.304 and its add-ons, Tauri 2.12.1 with `tauri-plugin-dialog` 2.8.3 and `@tauri-apps/api` 2.12.1. New in SP4: the Rust crate `tauri-plugin-notification` pinned `=2.7.0` (R20); no new npm package. The system `git` CLI (argv only) for the changes panel and worktrees. `node --test` under the no-real-agents watcher and the fake login shell; `cargo test` for the shell; the Playwright-core audit harness (`.superpowers/ui-audit/`).

**Spec:** `<worktree>/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-11-cobalt-redesign-and-real-terminals-design.md`, section "SP4 Session extras" (lines 610-712 at `548786d`), with the harness rules H1-H6, "Session activity states" (409-450), "WebSocket protocol" (452-468), "Desktop shell changes" (542-553), "Security" (555-575), "Testing and verification" and "Risks". The spec is binding; the orchestrator's rulings R1-R30 replace the spec lines they name (Task D1 writes them into the spec), and this plan argues from both.

**Prototype (owner-approved, the visual target):** `~/MediaStudio/runs/2026-10-10-agent-os-redesign/prototype/` (`sessions.html` incl. `info()`, `approvalCard()`, `limitBanner()` and `keepGoingDialog()`; `runs.html` replay; `index.html` Home strip; `safety.html` Pending approvals; `how-it-works.html`; `shared/cobalt.css`; `shots/*.png`). Build to match it with real data, never its sample data. To view it live: `cd ~/MediaStudio/runs/2026-10-10-agent-os-redesign/prototype && python3 -m http.server 4610 --bind 127.0.0.1`.

**Builds on:** SP1-SP3 and plan brains, released as v0.4.0 (PR #11, merge `5486c1a`), plus the side fixes `548786d` (the baseline). SP3 ledger: `.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-15-sp3-sessions-engine/progress.md`. SP4 ledger: `.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-29-sp4-session-extras/progress.md`. Research: the scratchpad's `sp4/rulings.md` (R1-R30), `sp4/agent-facts.md` (differences D1-D22), `sp4/code-map.md` (gaps G1-G14), `sp4/conventions.md`.

## Global Constraints

- **Authority:** the spec's "SP4 Session extras" is binding except where a ruling R1-R30 replaces a line; the K choices below fill gaps; where a task's text and "Shared names and shapes" differ, this contract is right and the task is fixed before dispatch.
- **H1, binaries and config:** run the person's own binary (path from `server/runtime/agents/detect.js`) with the real HOME; never set `HOME`, `USERPROFILE`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `CODEX_HOME`, `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, `HERMES_HOME` or any OpenClaw state or profile variable; never write an agent's own config files (no Hermes, Cursor or Codex hooks, and the "Richer Hermes alerts" helper is not built, R17/G14); Claude Code gets Agent OS's hooks only through the per-session `--settings` file inside `AGENT_OS_HOME`.
- **H1, reads:** Claude settings files are read only for `statusLine`, `disableAllHooks`, `allowManagedHooksOnly`, `allowedHttpHookUrls` and `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` (every other key is dropped at parse time and never logged or kept); transcripts are only `stat`ed for the re-link rule; `~/.claude.json` and every credential file are never read.
- **H2:** the session environment is SP3's, plus `AGENT_OS_HOOK_URL` and `AGENT_OS_HOOK_TOKEN` for Claude Code `agent` sessions only (never another agent, never an `update` or `setup` session); never `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB`; never `TERM_PROGRAM=vscode`; `CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1` only with the H4 opt-in.
- **H3:** additions only: Claude Code always gets `--settings <AGENT_OS_HOME>/sessions/<id>/claude-settings.json` once its hook is known; Codex's `tui.notifications` list gains `"plan-mode-prompt"` (R14); no other argv changes; never `--bare`, `--disable-slash-commands`, `--strict-mcp-config`, a replacing `--mcp-config`, `disableAllHooks`, `--accept-hooks`, `--dangerously-bypass-hook-trust`, `--yolo`, `--trust`, `--no-alt-screen`, a forced `--tui`, or any bypass, dangerous or full-access flag.
- **H3, snapshot test:** `test/sessions-profiles.test.js` keeps SP3 expectations (`hook: null`: no hook variables, `--settings` only with an OpenRouter or Local brain) and adds SP4 expectations (`hook` given: hook variables and `--settings` for Claude Code only), each with the H4 opt-in off and on.
- **H4:** unchanged; nothing in SP4 forces a display mode.
- **H5:** every hook reply for a good token is 204 with an empty body (target under 50 ms), never a decision, never `onFailure` (R5, R6); event hooks time out at 3 s and SessionEnd keeps Claude's own 1.5 s budget (R8, K9); with Agent OS down the hook fails fast and Claude carries on.
- **H6:** the statusLine wrapper runs the person's own command with `sh -c`, the same stdin bytes and the unchanged environment, prints its stdout byte for byte, exits with its exit code, prints nothing when there is none, copies `padding`, `refreshInterval` and `hideVimModeIndicator`, and forwards a copy of the JSON (R10).
- **Hook events are hints:** a re-link only to a UUID whose transcript exists under this session's Claude project folder (R1); one limit signal never holds a session (Limit rule per agent); every banner action needs the person's click plus a confirm dialog; OpenClaw approvals resolve only on the person's click (R16).
- **PTY writes:** the only bytes ever written into a PTY are the writer's input, the mirror's standard query replies while no writer is attached, and (new) the typed text of a hand-off, a Codex keep going or Cursor's hand-over, written only by `manager.typeInto` (?2004 on, target not waiting or in an approval, C0, C1, ESC and DEL removed except `\n`, wrapped in paste markers, never followed by Enter, never counted as user input); Stop still never types; E1's PTY-write grep gains exactly this one write.
- **Screen reading:** only the Claude and Codex limit texts (R13, R15) and the typed summaries (R24) read the mirror's screen, and each such line carries the comment `// SCREEN READING (spec SP4)`.
- **Files on disk:** `claude-settings.json`, `statusline.mjs` and `statusline.json` are 0600 in the 0700 session folder; `<AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees/<id>/` is 0700; the hook token, alert state, statusLine data and hand-off text live in memory only, never in meta.json, a log or a recording; a prompt's text is never stored anywhere (R23).
- **Local mode:** `/hooks/*` answers 403 outside local mode (R5); every new `/api/sessions/...` route sits behind the existing `requireLocalMode` and the cookie gate.
- **Packages:** no new npm package; the only new crate is `tauri-plugin-notification = "=2.7.0"`, added by Task X4 after it finds the ledger line `X4 packages: owner delegated (2026-10-29), tauri-plugin-notification =2.7.0`; the page gets no `@tauri-apps/plugin-notification` and no `notification:*` capability (R20).
- **CLI calls:** every agent or git CLI call is argv only through `runCli` (`server/runtime/sessions/soft-stop.js`) or the new `runGit`, with a time limit and the session's own environment (never `process.env`, which holds `AGENT_OS_TOKEN`); OpenClaw calls never add `--url` or `--token`; output is parsed for the named fields and then dropped.
- **Copy:** plain English, sentence case, no em dash in visible text; "—" means unknown and "…" means loading; spec sentences word for word; every other new sentence is marked NEW SENTENCE (Q32) here and in its task, and goes to the owner in one message at E1 (R28); SP4 removes the SP3 placeholders it replaces ("Replay arrives in a later update", the "—" Live meter rows it fills, "Working." on its own); no SP5 promises; D11 unchanged.
- **UI rules:** SP2/SP3 lessons in every UI task (time limit on every request, unmount guards, focus into a dialog and back to its opener, main action on screen at 1280×720, long text wraps or ends in "…", no sideways scroll); tokens from `src/ui/tokens.css` only; dark only; motion 120-200 ms with `var(--os-ease-out)`, off under reduced motion; no `window.confirm`, `alert` or `prompt`.
- **Signals scope:** signals, alerts, markers and the badge apply to `agent` sessions only; `update` and `setup` sessions never alert.
- **Owner rules, workers:** never commit, push, tag, stash or set `CI=true`; never start a real agent; never read `.env` files or `~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, `~/.cursor`, `~/.openclaw`, `~/.hermes`; never signal, inspect or kill a process the tests did not start; stay inside the brief's file list; retry until the listed checks are green and report anything that could not be done.
- **Owner rules, process:** Critical and Important findings are fixed per task, Minors are logged as `minor (deferred)` and swept once before E1 (R30); E1 sends the owner every new sentence and the screenshots in one non-blocking message (R28); E2 live checks run without asking except anything that spends money (S2 "Keep going on OpenRouter" is asked first, R29); every `git push` shows the owner a prompt, so the orchestrator says in chat what is pushed first; his sign-in clicks and the release stay his.
- **Owner rules, never:** never re-run the Hermes installer, never read `~/.tauri/agent-os.key`, never touch `/Applications`, never set `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` without the OpenRouter credential, keys only through the Keychain helper (never argv or env).
- **Tests:** fakes only (`test/fakes/tui-agent.mjs` through `makeFakeAgentBin`), the no-real-agents watcher, `SHELL` = `FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL`, `PATH` = the fake bin plus `/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin`, real-path temp `HOME`/`USERPROFILE`/`AGENT_OS_HOME`; real `git` only inside temp repos; a test that reads Claude settings layers uses a temp HOME and allows its own `.claude` paths in `spyOnFileAccess`.
- **Verify, full suite (baseline `548786d`):** `env -u HERMES_HOME npm test 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (tests|pass|fail|skipped)|^not ok|no-real-agents'` gave `# tests 1457`, `# pass 1453`, `# fail 0`, `# skipped 4`, "no-real-agents watcher: no real agent started (747 checks)"; every task ends with `# fail 0`, `# skipped 4`, the previous count plus its new tests, and the clean watcher line.
- **Verify, focused:** `env -u HERMES_HOME node --test test/<file>.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (tests|pass|fail|skipped)|^not ok'` while iterating (add `--test-reporter=tap` on Node 23+); reviewers add `--test-name-pattern "<name>"`.
- **Verify, UI:** `npx tsc -b; echo "tsc exit $?"` prints 0; `npm run build 2>&1 | tail -3` ends "✓ built in …"; the task's probe `node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/<name>.mjs` prints no `FAIL`; `lsof -nP -iTCP:8791 -sTCP:LISTEN | wc -l` prints 0 afterwards.
- **Verify, desktop (X4):** `cd desktop/src-tauri && cargo build --locked 2>&1 | tail -3 && cargo test --locked 2>&1 | grep -E "^test result"` (baseline "test result: ok. 19 passed; 0 failed"); X4 runs one `cargo build` without `--locked` to put the crate into `Cargo.lock`, then `--locked` from there on.
- **Verify, bundle (X2b):** `npm run build:server-bundle 2>&1 | tail -5` and `ls build/server/statusline-wrapper.mjs`; `env -u HERMES_HOME node --test test/portable.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (pass|fail)'` shows `# fail 0`.
- **Verify, leftovers:** `ps -axo pid,ppid,command | grep -E 'tui-agent.mjs|agent-os-team-src' | grep -v grep` prints nothing after a run; `pgrep -x claude | sort` is the same before and after.

## Review Focus

The five situations a person will meet that the spec implies but no task's main tests exercise, most likely first. Each one has a test in the task named after it.

1. **The person answers Claude's permission prompt within a few seconds.** Claude's backup `Notification` (`permission_prompt`) can still arrive just after the answer. The session must stay live: no stale "Waiting for you", no second "permission asked" marker, no notification. (Task X2a: PermissionRequest makes the session waiting; user input 1 s later makes it live; a `Notification` `permission_prompt` posted 500 ms after that input leaves it live, adds no marker and prints no `AGENT_OS_ALERT:` line.)
2. **The desktop app is quit and opened again, then a Claude session is resumed.** The app picks a new port at every launch, so the resumed session must post to the new address with a new token, and the old token must stop working. (Task X2a: start with port A, end, resume with port B; `claude-settings.json` now holds `http://127.0.0.1:<B>/hooks/sessions/<id>`, the env holds a new token, and a post with the first run's token is answered 401.)
3. **The Mac sleeps through the plan's reset time.** A held session must leave held when the person opens the lid, not hours later, because Node's timers pause during sleep. (Task X1a: held with a `resetAt`; the injected clock jumps two hours past `resetAt` without the reset timer firing; the next 60 s wall-clock check moves the session to idle, clears the alert and sends `{t:"alert", kind:"resolved"}`.)
4. **A big or slow git folder** (thousands of untracked files, a network disk). The changes panel must never pile up git processes or freeze the panel. (Task X7: an injected `runGit` that takes 8 s; polls never overlap, each run is cut at 5 s, the list is capped at 200 files with `total` giving the full count, and `GET /api/sessions/:id/changes` answers from the last result at once.)
5. **The person's own status line is slow or fails, or Agent OS is down.** Claude must show exactly what it shows in Terminal. (Task X2b: with `AGENT_OS_HOOK_URL` pointing at a closed port the wrapper finishes within 600 ms and reproduces the output byte for byte; a command that exits 1 makes the wrapper exit 1 with the same bytes; a command that prints nothing gives nothing.)

Why X1 and X2 are split: X1a is the state machine and its outputs (frames, summary, alert line), which a reviewer judges against the spec's transition table alone; X1b is per-agent parsing of terminal bytes and screen text, judged against the vendors' real output (agent-facts). X2a is the security surface (an HTTP endpoint outside the cookie gate, a token in the agent's environment, a settings file Claude obeys); X2b is fidelity (the person's own status line byte for byte) plus two read-only feeds. A reviewer can reject one half and approve the other.

## Decisions

### Orchestrator rulings R1-R30 (binding; summarised from `sp4/rulings.md`)

Each line: decision; why; cost if wrong.

- **R1** Re-link without SessionStart: from the `session_id` in every HTTP event and in the statusLine JSON (SessionEnd `clear`/`resume` is a hint), only to a UUID with a transcript under `<Claude config dir>/projects/<encoded folder>/`; SessionStart cannot be HTTP and a command hook would be a second helper; a `/clear` re-links one event later.
- **R2** Waiting comes from PermissionRequest (including `AskUserQuestion` and `ExitPlanMode`), Elicitation (MCP), and an observe-only Notification hook (`permission_prompt`, `elicitation_dialog`, `elicitation_url_dialog`) as a backup; Elicitation is MCP-only and Claude's own questions go through permissions; one more hook entry. `quota_auto_resume_*` is read with R4 as `quota_auto_resume_fired` only, the one that means work resumed.
- **R3** Every StopFailure is turn_done, and `rate_limit` / `billing_error` are also a limit hint; Stop does not fire on API errors, so the session would stay live; no cost.
- **R4** Held clears when a `rate_limits` window is absent, below 100 or past `resets_at`, on `quota_auto_resume_fired`, on user input, or when the reset time passes; Claude drops a window once its reset passes; held may clear a little early (K2 limits status-clearing to holds that status confirmed).
- **R5** A body over 256 KB with the right session's token is dropped and still answered 204; 401 only for a missing or bad token or another session's token; 404 for an unknown session; 403 outside local mode; any non-2xx shows "hook error" in the person's Claude transcript (H5); a huge real event (a Write of a big file) is lost.
- **R6** The reply is 204 with an empty body and the hook entries carry no `onFailure`; a 2xx JSON body would be a decision and `onFailure` needs Claude 2.1.295; no cost.
- **R7** The literal `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/hooks/sessions/<id>` is written into the settings file at every start and resume, never cached; only the header uses `$AGENT_OS_HOOK_TOKEN` through `allowedEnvVars`; `AGENT_OS_HOOK_URL` stays for the wrapper; Claude does not interpolate `url`, and the port changes each launch; a stale file would post to a dead port (fails fast).
- **R8** Timeouts: 3 s on every event hook, 1.5 s on SessionEnd; H5 says never slow; a stalled endpoint delays a prompt or dialog by at most 3 s.
- **R9** At session start, detect `allowedHttpHookUrls`, `httpHookAllowedEnvVars`, `disableAllHooks`, `allowManagedHooksOnly` and a managed `statusLine`, and say in the panel that alerts or the Live meter are off and why; never change the person's settings; otherwise alerts silently never come; a wrong detection shows an untrue note (owner reviews the sentences at E1).
- **R10** The wrapper copies `padding`, `refreshInterval`, `hideVimModeIndicator`; looks in local project, project, user and managed settings (managed wins, as in Claude); honours `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`; runs the command with `sh -c` and the unchanged env; prints nothing and exits 0 when there is none; never reads `~/.claude.json`; H6 byte for byte; a missed field changes the status line's look.
- **R11** The Live meter labels `cost.total_cost_usd` as an estimate, and shows "—" when `rate_limits` is absent (OpenRouter and Local brains); the cost is Claude's own list-price estimate; no cost.
- **R12** One poller runs `claude agents --json` every 10 s for all live Claude sessions together, only while one exists, mapping waiting / busy / idle as hints; it is switched off if S1 shows the call starts Claude's supervisor; OSC/BEL detection stays generic for every agent; hooks may be off or not yet trusted; one CLI start per 10 s while Claude sessions are open.
- **R13** The mirror's Claude limit texts are `You've hit your .+ limit` and `Usage limit reached`, a second signal for the limit rule, never alone; a limit sentence quoted in the conversation can count as one signal.
- **R14** Codex OSC 9 is classified by text prefix ("Approval requested: ", "Approval requested by ", "Codex wants to edit ", "Plan mode prompt: " mean waiting; any other OSC 9 is turn_done), and `plan-mode-prompt` joins the profile's `tui.notifications`; the payload is display text, not the type name; an answer that starts with a prefix reads as waiting (a hint).
- **R15** Codex's limit is confirmed only by "the limit text still on screen 5 s later, the process alive, no counted output since"; five limit texts; reset time from " Try again at <time>." or " or try again at <time>."; a failed turn sends no OSC 9; a quoted limit text left on screen 5 s can hold (user input clears it).
- **R16** OpenClaw approvals: `openclaw approvals pending --json` every 3 s while an OpenClaw session is open, one call at a time, 10 s limit each; every kind shown; only Allow once and Deny; resolve only on the click and show its error text; the card never names a folder; matched by `sessionKey` containing `agentos-<sessionId>`, otherwise shown on Safety and in every open OpenClaw session's panel as "from OpenClaw"; unmatched cards appear in every OpenClaw panel.
- **R17** Hermes: basic alerts from BEL and OSC 9/99/777 when the person turned Hermes's bells on, plus an OSC 0/1/2 title watcher (a title starting with "⚠" is waiting, the marker gone is resolved); no Hermes config change, no "Richer Hermes alerts" helper; Hermes alerts are silent unless bells are on or the Ink TUI is used.
- **R18** Cursor: basic alerts only (it normally sends nothing in Agent OS), idle by the 20 s rule, and the panel's line says its alerts are basic; Cursor rarely alerts.
- **R19** Any BEL or OSC 9/99/777 from Hermes or Cursor is waiting with the text "May need you", cleared by user input or a resolved signal; a turn-complete bell reads as "may need you".
- **R20** `tauri-plugin-notification` 2.7.0 as a Rust crate only (exact pin); no npm package and no page capability; the server's `AGENT_OS_ALERT` line reaches the shell; on desktop the page's permission call always answers granted, and macOS asks on the first notification; a bug in 2.7.0 means a later bump.
- **R21** `watch_server` reads stdout as bytes and decodes lossily, so a non-UTF-8 line never stops the reader; `AGENT_OS_ALERT` lines are single-line JSON with text cut to 200 characters; no cost.
- **R22** The server keeps each session's alert state and sends it in `GET /api/sessions` and in `{t:"alert", kind, text}`; only the selected tab is attached; an unattached tab shows an alert up to 5 s late.
- **R23** The prompt marker is label-only ("Prompt" and its time); the prompt text is never stored; recordings hold output only; the replay cannot show what was asked.
- **R24** Codex keep going and Cursor's hand-over type a summary built from the mirror's last screen (plain, sanitised, at most about 60 lines), the folder and a fixed one-line header; typed, never sent; sessions have no task or events; the summary is only what was on screen.
- **R25** meta.json stores `copyOf` and `branch` for a worktree; titles and the panel show the original folder's name and the branch; recent folders never list a worktree; no cost.
- **R26** `manager.create` and `manager.resume` take an internal brain override that only keep going passes; no route accepts it; no cost.
- **R27** The hooks router answers quietly (no error log), and `assertSafeClaudeSettings` gets a key allowlist (`hooks`, `statusLine`, `apiKeyHelper`, `env`); no cost.
- **R28** Every new user-facing sentence goes into one non-blocking owner review message at E1; spec sentences are used word for word.
- **R29** E2 live checks run without asking, except anything that spends money: S2 "Keep going on OpenRouter" is asked first.
- **R30** Critical and Important findings are fixed per task; Minors are logged and swept once before E1.

### Contract choices K1-K22 (this plan's; the orchestrator can overturn any before the first dispatch)

Each line: decision; why; cost if wrong. D1 writes the accepted ones into the spec next to the rulings.

- **K1** The signal object gains `source` and an optional `resetAt` next to the spec's `{sessionId, kind, text, at}`; the limit rule needs "a second, different signal"; none (additive).
- **K2** Claude limit evidence: a first signal (hook or text) counts for 120 s; text evidence counts only when the text appears (absent at the previous scan); the screen is scanned at most once a second after output; status evidence is a level, and status clearing (R4) ends only a hold that status confirmed; otherwise a lingering limit line or a plan without `rate_limits` would hold or clear at random; a slower confirmation when the two signals are more than 120 s apart.
- **K3** A held session with a known `resetAt` gets a timer at `resetAt` and a wall-clock check every 60 s; Node's timers pause while a Mac sleeps; one cheap check a minute.
- **K4** A turn_done while waiting moves the session to idle and clears the alert; the agent finished, so it no longer waits; none.
- **K5** A turn-done session also goes idle after 120 s without counted output (`idleBy: "timer"`); Codex sends nothing after a failed or interrupted turn and Claude's Stop does not fire on Esc (agent-facts D3, D16), so the session would stay "Working." forever; this adds a row to the spec's transition table, so the orchestrator confirms it at D1.
- **K6** A backup waiting from Claude's Notification hook is dropped when user input reached the session in the last 3 s, or when it is already waiting; Claude sends it about 6 s after the prompt, so it can land just after the answer (Review Focus 1); a real second prompt within 3 s of typing alerts only through PermissionRequest.
- **K7** `AGENT_OS_ALERT` lines are printed for the kinds waiting, approval and limit, limit only when the session becomes held, once per transition into an alert (not again for new text of the same kind); one notification per thing that needs the person; none.
- **K8** `{t:"alert", kind, text}` frames are sent on alert-state changes only: the new alert's kind, or `kind: "resolved"` with `text: ""` when it clears; turn_done travels in the state frame; the page mirrors one state; none.
- **K9** The SessionEnd hook entry has no `timeout` key, so Claude's own 1.5 s budget applies; a fractional `timeout` might fail Claude's settings validation and drop the whole file; satisfies R8.
- **K10** `allowedHttpHookUrls` or `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` count as "alerts off" only when the merged list does not allow our URL (with `*` as a wildcard) or `AGENT_OS_HOOK_TOKEN`; otherwise the note would be untrue; none.
- **K11** An unmatched OpenClaw approval sends an approval signal to every open OpenClaw session (usually one); its session cannot be told; two OpenClaw sessions both show waiting.
- **K12** Changes cover the whole repository, paths relative to its top level; the first poll after a start is a baseline (no marker); a "files changed" marker lists only files whose counts changed (at most 20, `more` counts the rest); the list is capped at 200 files; git runs with `--no-optional-locks`, `core.fsmonitor=false`, `--no-ext-diff`, `--no-textconv`; an agent edits outside a subfolder too, and git must never run the person's helpers or take the index lock; a monorepo shows changes outside the session's subfolder.
- **K13** A hand-off target is a live session of the other agent in the same real folder (a worktree session only matches the same worktree); a new target is waited for up to 60 s; typed text is capped at 32 KB; DEL (0x7F) is removed with the control characters; reviewing a worktree's changes needs that worktree; a slow start ends in the Copy fallback.
- **K14** A separate copy branches from HEAD; `<n>` is the smallest number not used by a local `refs/heads/agentos/<agent>-<n>`; a start that fails removes the fresh worktree and its branch; removing a copy keeps its branch; a worktree session gives its `copyOf` to recent folders; nothing the person made is ever deleted; a remote-only branch of the same name is not seen.
- **K15** Keep going for Claude is `stop(id, { by: "stop" })` then `resume(id, { brainOverride })`; for Codex the held session is left as it is and a new one opens; the estimate uses the statusLine's context tokens; same tab, same conversation; the person stops the old Codex session themselves.
- **K16** Resolving an approval needs its id in the latest pending list; a second resolve for the same id while one runs answers 409 `approval_busy`; two windows can click at once; none.
- **K17** The desktop app shows a one-time note on the Sessions page explaining notifications (macOS then asks by itself on the first one), dismissed per viewer in `localStorage`; R20 leaves the page no permission call, and the spec wants an explanation; the note may show before any alert.
- **K18** The wrapper waits for its forward at most 500 ms from its own start; Claude cancels a status line run when the next trigger comes, so a long wait would hide the person's status line; a slow server loses that one meter update.
- **K19** Poller mapping: waiting gives a waiting signal (text "Waiting for you"); busy gives a new turn, or resolves a waiting that the poller set; idle gives turn_done for a live session; each call is cut at 5 s; it backs up Esc and untrusted folders; a 10 s lag.
- **K20** meta.json keeps at most 500 markers per session (the oldest dropped); meta.json is rewritten whole on every change; a very long session loses its earliest moments.
- **K21** "Right after a turn_done signal" is read as "the idle state was entered by a turn_done signal" (`idleBy: "turn_done"`); deterministic; "Ready for the next message." can show for a long time.
- **K22** The top-bar badge counts agent sessions whose status is waiting ("Waiting for you (<n>)"); held shows on the tab marker and the Home strip; the badge's words stay true; a held session is not counted in the badge.

Every task uses these names, paths, signatures and shapes exactly. A task's Interfaces quote from this section. Line numbers are at HEAD `548786d`; tasks anchor edits on quoted text checked with `grep -cF` in Step 0, because earlier tasks move lines.

**Merged additions from the task briefs.** Every item of the task briefs' "Contract additions requested" sections is merged below, in the subsection it belongs to, and tagged with its source as `(<task> #<n>)`: the item's number in that brief (U5's list is unnumbered and is tagged `(U5)`). D1 requested nothing. An item that adds a name or settles a detail this contract leaves open is part of this section from now on. Where an item contradicts a line of this contract, the contract's line stands and the item is marked **Resolution: the contract stands**, with the reason, until the orchestrator decides. The proposed answers to every request, and the findings these items raise, are listed under "Minor review notes (not yet applied)" at the end of this plan.

### The signal object (`server/runtime/sessions/signals.js`, X1a)

```
{ sessionId: string,                    // Agent OS session id (v4 uuid)
  kind: "waiting" | "turn_done" | "limit" | "approval" | "resolved",
  text: string,                         // cleanAlertText(): control characters removed, spaces collapsed, at most 200 characters
  at: string,                           // ISO 8601 UTC
  source: "hook" | "status" | "poll" | "osc" | "bel" | "title" | "text" | "openclaw",   // K1
  resetAt?: string | null }             // limit only, ISO, when known (K1)
```

- Frozen. Built only by `makeSignal()`; an unknown `kind` or `source`, or an empty `sessionId`, throws `TypeError` (a caller's bug).
- `limit` signals never reach the activity reducer directly: limit evidence goes through the agent's limit rule (X1b), which calls `setHeld`.

### Activity record and transitions (`signals.js`, X1a)

```
Activity = { status: "starting" | "live" | "waiting" | "idle" | "held" | "exited",
             turnDone: boolean,                 // the session has a turn_done source and its first signal arrived
             idleBy: "turn_done" | "timer" | null,
             resetAt: string | null,            // held only
             alert: { kind: "waiting" | "approval" | "limit", text: string, at: string, source: string } | null }
```

`activityAfter(activity, event)` returns a new Activity and never mutates. Events:

| Event | Effect (statuses not listed are unchanged) |
|---|---|
| `{ type: "output" }` (first output of any kind) | starting → live |
| `{ type: "counted" }` | starting → live; idle → live only when `turnDone` is false |
| `{ type: "input" }` (user input; never a hand-off write) | starting, live, idle, waiting, held → live; `alert`, `resetAt`, `idleBy` → null |
| `{ type: "idle_timer" }` | live → idle, `idleBy: "timer"` |
| `{ type: "signal", kind: "turn_done", ... }` | `turnDone` → true; starting, live, waiting → idle (K4), `idleBy: "turn_done"`, `alert` → null; idle keeps idle with `idleBy: "turn_done"` |
| `{ type: "signal", kind: "waiting" \| "approval", text, source, at }` | starting, live, idle → waiting with `alert: { kind, text, at, source }`; waiting keeps waiting and replaces `alert` |
| `{ type: "signal", kind: "resolved", ... }` | waiting → live, `alert` → null |
| `{ type: "source_seen" }` (Claude's first hook event, Codex's first classified OSC 9) | `turnDone` → true (any status but exited) |
| `{ type: "new_turn" }` (UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse(Edit\|Write), poller busy) | starting, idle → live, `idleBy` → null (never clears waiting: a subagent's tool hook can fire while the main agent waits) |
| `{ type: "held", resetAt, text, source, at }` | any but exited → held, `resetAt`, `alert: { kind: "limit", text, at, source }`, `idleBy` → null |
| `{ type: "held_cleared" }` | held → idle, `idleBy`, `resetAt`, `alert` → null |
| `{ type: "exit" }` | → exited, `alert` and `resetAt` → null |

Manager effects, computed by comparing the old and new Activity (X1a):
- status changed: `stateSince` and `{t:"state", ...}` as today, with `resetAt` when the status is held and it is known;
- alert from null, or to a different kind: `{t:"alert", kind, text}` (queued like SP3's alert frames), a `permission` marker for waiting and approval, and `onAlertLine({ sessionId, agent: meta.agentLabel, kind, text })`;
- same kind, new text: `{t:"alert", kind, text}` only;
- alert to null: `{t:"alert", kind: "resolved", text: ""}`;
- the idle timer is armed whenever the new status is live: 20 s (`IDLE_AFTER_MS`, unchanged in `manager.js`) when `turnDone` is false, `TURN_DONE_BACKSTOP_MS` (K5) when true; counted output, input and a new turn re-arm it;
- held with a `resetAt`: a timer at `resetAt` (when it is under 24 days away) and a wall-clock check every `heldCheckMs` (K3); either one, once `now() >= resetAt`, applies `held_cleared`.
- `activityAfter` throws `TypeError` for an unknown event type, an unknown source, or a signal kind other than waiting, approval, turn_done and resolved (X1a #4).
- The same alert (same kind and text) arriving again keeps its first `at` and sends no frame (X1a #4).

### Server modules

#### `server/runtime/sessions/signals.js` (new, X1a)

- `export const SIGNAL_KINDS = Object.freeze(["waiting", "turn_done", "limit", "approval", "resolved"])`
- `export const ALERT_KINDS = Object.freeze(["waiting", "approval", "limit"])`
- `export const SIGNAL_SOURCES = Object.freeze(["hook", "status", "poll", "osc", "bel", "title", "text", "openclaw"])`
- `export const ALERT_TEXT_MAX = 200`; `export const BASIC_ALERT_TEXT = "May need you"` (R19); `export const TURN_DONE_BACKSTOP_MS = 120000` (K5); `export const HELD_CHECK_MS = 60000` (K3); `export const MARKERS_MAX = 500` (K20); `export const ALERT_LINE_PREFIX = "AGENT_OS_ALERT:"`
- `export function cleanAlertText(value, max = ALERT_TEXT_MAX)` → string: `String(value ?? "")`, every C0 (tab and newline become a space), DEL and C1 removed, runs of spaces collapsed, trimmed, cut to `max` code points (no "…" added).
- `export function makeSignal({ sessionId, kind, text = "", source, at = new Date().toISOString(), resetAt = null })` → frozen signal (above).
- `export function genericMirrorSignal(raw)` → `{ kind: "waiting", text: BASIC_ALERT_TEXT, source: "bel" | "osc" }` for `"bel"` and for `"9;…"`, `"99;…"`, `"777;…"` payloads; `null` for `"9;4;…"` progress reports and anything else.
- `export function freshActivity(status = "starting")` → `{ status, turnDone: false, idleBy: null, resetAt: null, alert: null }`.
- `export function activityAfter(activity, event)` → Activity (table above).
- `export function alertLine({ sessionId, agent, kind, text })` → `ALERT_LINE_PREFIX + JSON.stringify({ sessionId, agent, kind, text: cleanAlertText(text) })`, keys in exactly that order, no newline.
- `export function printAlertLine(payload, write = (line) => process.stdout.write(line))` → writes `alertLine(payload) + "\n"`; does nothing for a kind outside `ALERT_KINDS`; never throws.
- `export function makeMarker(input)` → a Marker (below) with `at` defaulted to now and text cleaned, or `null` for an unknown type.

After X1b there are exactly two labels (`manager.js` `readLimitLine`, `mirror-signals.js` `matchScreenLimit`); X10 adds its own for the typed summary (and its limit-line filter, X10 #1); E1's guard test expects at least three.

#### `server/runtime/sessions/mirror.js` (changes, X1b)

#### `server/runtime/sessions/hooks.js` (new, X2a)

- `export const HOOK_BODY_LIMIT = 256 * 1024`; `export const BACKUP_WAITING_QUIET_MS = 3000` (K6)
- `export function bearerToken(header)` → the token after `Bearer ` (case-insensitive scheme, one space), or null.
- `export function createHooksRouter({ manager, isLocal = isLocalMode })` → an Express router mounted at `/hooks` (Routes, below). It reads the body itself (never `express.json`), answers before processing, processes on `setImmediate`, and has its own quiet error middleware (R27).
- `export function mapHookEvent(body)` → `MappedHook`:

```
MappedHook = {
  event: string,                         // body.hook_event_name, "" when missing
  claudeSessionId: string | null,        // body.session_id when it is a UUID (any version), lower-cased
  signals: Array<{ kind: "waiting" | "turn_done", text: string, backup: boolean }>,
  limit: { text: string } | null,        // StopFailure with error rate_limit or billing_error (R3)
  newTurn: boolean,                      // UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse
  promptMarker: boolean,                 // UserPromptSubmit (body.prompt is never copied, R23)
  refreshChanges: boolean,               // PostToolUse
  heldCleared: boolean,                  // Notification quota_auto_resume_fired (R4)
  relinkHint: boolean                    // SessionEnd with reason clear or resume (R1)
}
```

  | Event | signals | other fields |
  |---|---|---|
  | PermissionRequest, `tool_name` `AskUserQuestion` | waiting "Has a question for you" | |
  | PermissionRequest, `tool_name` `ExitPlanMode` | waiting "Has a plan for you to approve" | |
  | PermissionRequest, other tools | waiting "Wants to use <tool_name>" (tool name cleaned, at most 60 characters) | |
  | Elicitation | waiting "<mcp_server_name> asks for input" | |
  | Notification `permission_prompt`, `elicitation_dialog`, `elicitation_url_dialog` | waiting with the notification's `message` (cleaned), `backup: true` | |
  | Notification `quota_auto_resume_fired` | none | `heldCleared` |
  | Stop | turn_done "" | |
  | StopFailure | turn_done "" | `limit` for `rate_limit` / `billing_error` |
  | UserPromptSubmit | none | `newTurn`, `promptMarker` |
  | PostToolUse | none | `newTurn`, `refreshChanges` |
  | SessionEnd `clear` / `resume` | none | `relinkHint` |
  | anything else | none | |

- `manager.onHook(id, mapped)` (X2a) does, in order: `markSourceSeen`; `trustNeeded` → false; the re-link check (when `claudeSessionId` differs from `meta.agentSessionId` and `transcriptExists({ uuid, folder: meta.folder, env: profile.env })`, set and persist `meta.agentSessionId`); each signal through `applySignal` with `source: "hook"` (a backup is dropped when the session is waiting or `now() - lastInputAt < BACKUP_WAITING_QUIET_MS`); `limit` → `noteLimit(id, { source: "hook", text })`; `newTurn` → `markNewTurn`; `promptMarker` → `addMarker(id, { type: "prompt" })`; `heldCleared` → `clearHeld`; `refreshChanges` → `refreshChangesSoon(id)` (X7).
- `/status` delivery (X2a #2, X2b #6): `createHooksRouter` passes a good `/status` body to `manager.onStatusLine(id, json)` whenever the manager has that method. X2b adds only the method (which also sets `state.trustNeeded = false`) and needs no edit to `hooks.js`'s routing.
- Unknown event names (X2a #3): `manager.onHook` ignores a `MappedHook` whose `event` is not one of `CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENTS`, checked before `markSourceSeen`, so a forged post cannot turn on full alerts or end `trustNeeded`.
- Fallback texts and limit evidence (X2a #5): an empty or missing tool name, server name or backup Notification message gives the text "Waiting for you" (spec words); a server name is cut to 60 characters like a tool name; `MappedHook.limit.text` is the StopFailure `error` value (`rate_limit` or `billing_error`), evidence only.
- The quiet error handler (E1 #6, R27): an Express error handler with four parameters, the first named `err` or `error` (`_` prefixes allowed). It logs nothing, and `hooks.js` holds no `console.` call at all.

#### `server/runtime/sessions/statusline-wrapper.mjs` (new, X2b; copied per session)

- No exports. Run as `<bundled node> <AGENT_OS_HOME>/sessions/<id>/statusline.mjs` (Claude runs `statusLine.command` through its shell).
- Reads all of stdin as bytes; reads `statusline.json` next to itself.
- With a `command`: spawns `/bin/sh -c <command>` (Windows: `cmd.exe /d /s /c <command>`) with those stdin bytes, `process.env` unchanged and the current folder; pipes the child's stdout to its own stdout chunk by chunk, unchanged; stderr inherited; SIGTERM, SIGINT and SIGHUP are passed on to the child.
- At the same time, when `AGENT_OS_HOOK_URL` starts with `http://127.0.0.1:` and `AGENT_OS_HOOK_TOKEN` is set: `POST <AGENT_OS_HOOK_URL>/status` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `Content-Type: application/json` and the stdin bytes (`node:http`, no fetch).
- `STATUS_POST_LIMIT_MS = 500` (K18): exits once the child has ended and the post settled or 500 ms passed since start; exit code = the child's code (1 when it ended by a signal); with no command, prints nothing and exits 0 the same way. It never prints anything of its own on stdout.

#### `server/runtime/sessions/claude-agents-poll.js` (new, X2b)

- `export const CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_ON = true` (R12: E2's S1 sets it to `false` if the call starts Claude's supervisor)
- `export const CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_MS = 10000`; `export const CLAUDE_AGENTS_CALL_LIMIT_MS = 5000` (K19)
- `export function mapClaudeAgents(text, sessions)` → `Array<{ id, status: "waiting" | "busy" | "idle", waitingFor: string | null }>`; `sessions` are `liveAgentSessions("claude")`; an entry matches by `sessionId === agentSessionId` or `pid === pid`; malformed JSON → `[]`.
- `export function createClaudeAgentsPoller({ manager, runCli = defaultRunCli, intervalMs = CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_MS, enabled = CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_ON })` → `{ stop() }`: one `claude agents --json` (argv `["agents", "--json"]`, command, env and cwd of the first live Claude session) at a time, the next one `intervalMs` after the last ended, only while `liveAgentSessions("claude")` is not empty (driven by `onLiveChange`); K19 mapping with `source: "poll"`.
- `createClaudeAgentsPoller` also takes `limitMs = CLAUDE_AGENTS_CALL_LIMIT_MS`, so that a test can cut a slow call without waiting 5 s; the product never passes it (X2b #1).
- Turning the poller off (E2 #7): E2-F1's change makes `CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_ON` `false`, and because X2b's tests rely on the default being true, seven poller test calls would also gain `enabled: true`. **Resolution: the contract stands**: R12's switch is the one constant above. Whether X2b's tests pass `enabled: true` from the start, so that E2-F1 stays a one-line change, is in Minor review notes.

#### `server/runtime/sessions/openclaw-approvals.js` (new, X3)

- `export const APPROVALS_POLL_MS = 3000`; `export const APPROVALS_CALL_LIMIT_MS = 10000`; `export const APPROVAL_DECISIONS = Object.freeze(["allow-once", "deny"])`; `export const APPROVAL_SUMMARY_MAX = 300`
- `export function parsePendingApprovals(text, now = Date.now())` → `ApprovalCard[]` with `sessionId: null`, newest first; entries without a string `id`, a known `kind` or numeric times, and expired ones (`expiresAtMs <= now`), are dropped; `summary` cleaned to at most 300 characters.
- `export function matchApprovalSession(sessionKey, openSessions)` → the `id` of the open OpenClaw session whose `agentos-<id>` appears in `sessionKey`, else null.
- `export function createOpenclawApprovals({ manager, runCli = defaultRunCli, intervalMs = APPROVALS_POLL_MS, limitMs = APPROVALS_CALL_LIMIT_MS, now = Date.now })` → `{ snapshot(), resolve(id, decision), stop() }`:
  - polls `openclaw approvals pending --json` (argv `["approvals", "pending", "--json"]`, command, env and cwd of an open OpenClaw session) one at a time, the next `intervalMs` after the last ended, only while `liveAgentSessions("openclaw")` is not empty;
  - after each poll: a session with a matched approval, or every open OpenClaw session when one is unmatched (K11), gets `applySignal(id, { kind: "approval", text: <newest summary>, source: "openclaw" })` unless its alert is already that approval; a session whose alert kind is approval and that has nothing pending gets `resolved`;
  - `snapshot()` → `{ approvals: ApprovalCard[], error: string | null }` (error: the poll-failed sentence below; cleared by the next good poll);
  - `resolve(id, decision)` → `Promise<{ message: string | null }>`: `decision` must be in `APPROVAL_DECISIONS` (400 `invalid_decision`), `id` in the latest snapshot (404 `approval_missing`), no other resolve of `id` running (409 `approval_busy`, K16); runs `["approvals", "resolve", id, decision]` with `limitMs`; exit 0 → `{ message: null }` and an immediate re-poll; non-zero → 409 `approval_failed` with the CLI's stderr (else stdout), cleaned, at most 300 characters, in the message.
- `parsePendingApprovals` entries are `ApprovalCard & { sessionKey: string | null }`, where `sessionKey` is OpenClaw's own key, read for matching; `snapshot()` and `GET /api/sessions/approvals` send only the six `ApprovalCard` keys (X3 #2). The cards the page sees keep the contract's shape.
- "Unless its alert is already that approval" is a per-session memory of the approval ids already signalled: a session gets one approval signal per batch of new approvals, and the same approval does not alert again after user input cleared the alert (X3 #4).
- The re-poll runs after every resolve that ran the CLI, not only after exit 0 (X3 #5).
- `stop()` returns `Promise<void>`, which settles once a running call has been cut off, so the `"openclaw-approvals"` shutdown task can await it; the returned object is frozen (X3 #7).

#### `server/runtime/sessions/git.js` (new, X7; reused by X9)

- `export const GIT_LIMIT_MS = 5000`
- `export const GIT_BASE_ARGS = Object.freeze(["--no-optional-locks", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false", "-c", "core.quotepath=false"])`
- `export function gitEnv(baseEnv)` → a copy without `AGENT_OS_*`, plus `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0`, `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`, `LC_ALL=C`.
- `export async function runGit(folder, args, { env, timeoutMs = GIT_LIMIT_MS, okCodes = [0] } = {})` → `{ code, stdout, stderr, timedOut, ok }` (command `git`, argv `["-C", folder, ...GIT_BASE_ARGS, ...args]`, through `runCli` with an AbortSignal; never throws).
- `export async function gitTopLevel(folder, { env, run = runGit } = {})` → the work tree's top level, or null when the folder is not inside a git work tree.
- `runGit` calls `runCli` with X3's `captureStderr: true` (under "Other server files") instead of changing `runCli` a second time, and cuts `stderr` to 4096 characters itself, because X3 caps it only at `maxChars` (X7 #1).
- `runGit`'s options also take `maxChars = 1048576` (passed to `runCli`; status and numstat ask for 8 MB, a diff for `DIFF_MAX_BYTES + 1`) and `run = runCli` (injectable for tests) (X7 #2).
- `gitEnv` also drops `HERMES_AGENT_OS_*`, as `sessionEnv` does (X7 #7).

#### `server/runtime/sessions/changes.js` (new, X7)

- `export const CHANGES_POLL_MS = 3000`; `export const CHANGES_MAX_FILES = 200`; `export const DIFF_MAX_BYTES = 256 * 1024`; `export const FILES_MARKER_MAX = 20`; `export const CHANGES_REFRESH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300`
- `export function parsePorcelainV2(text)` → `Array<{ path, status, oldPath? }>` (input from `status --porcelain=v2 -z --untracked-files=all`).
- `export function parseNumstat(text)` → `Map<path, { added: number | null, removed: number | null }>` (input from `diff --numstat -z`; `-` counts are null, a binary file).
- `export async function readChanges(folder, { env, run = runGit })` → `ChangesResult` (`diff --numstat -z HEAD`, or `diff --cached` plus `diff` when there is no HEAD; untracked text files up to 512 KB get their line count as `added`, others null).
- `export function filesMarker(previous, next)` → a `files` Marker or null (K12).
- `export async function readDiff(folder, file, { env, run = runGit })` → `DiffResult` (`diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv HEAD -- <path>`; untracked: `diff --no-index --no-color -- /dev/null <path>`, exit 1 counted as ok; cut at `DIFF_MAX_BYTES`).
- Manager (X7): polls every `CHANGES_POLL_MS` while the session is not exited, one run at a time; `refreshChangesSoon(id)` debounced; a `files` marker through `addMarker` whenever `filesMarker` returns one (never for the first poll).
- `export const CHANGE_MISSING_MESSAGE = "That file isn't in this session's changes anymore."`, because the manager answers `change_missing` before git runs (X7 #3).
- `readChanges(folder, { env, run, now = Date.now })`: `now` stamps `at`. Git's exit 128 answers `{ git: false, … }`. Otherwise a failure throws an internal Error whose `code` is `git_unavailable` (git never started, or `rev-parse` answered a code other than 0 and 128), `git_timeout` (a call hit 5 s) or `git_failed` (status or numstat failed); these codes never reach an HTTP answer (X7 #4).
- `readDiff(folder, file, …)`: `file` is a `ChangedFile` (`path`, `status`, `oldPath?`) from the session's current changes, not a bare path, because the untracked, renamed and no-commit cases need the status and the old path (X7 #5).
- The status call adds `--branch` (to see `# branch.oid (initial)` without another git call); `parsePorcelainV2` skips the `#` header records (X7 #6).
- Sessions that are never read (X7 #9): `update` sessions, OpenClaw sessions with `folderShown: false`, and sessions where git can't start answer `{ git: false, files: [], total: 0, at: null }` (where git can't start, `at` is when it was tried); an ended session whose one read is cut answers `{ git: null, files: [], total: 0, at: null }`. The page (U7) hides "Files changed" when `folderShown` is false and for non-`agent` kinds, where "Changes appear when this folder is a git project" would be untrue (X7 #9, U7 #7). Because X7 never reads an OpenClaw folder with `folderShown: false`, U7 #7's suggestion that X7 skip those sessions is already met.

#### `server/runtime/sessions/handoff.js` (new, X8; reused by X10)

- `export const TYPED_MAX_BYTES = 32 * 1024`; `export const HANDOFF_WAIT_MS = 60000` (K13); `export const PASTE_START = "\x1b[200~"`; `export const PASTE_END = "\x1b[201~"`
- `export function cleanTypedText(text)` → every C0 except `\n`, ESC, DEL and C1 removed (`\r\n` and lone `\r` simply lose the `\r`), cut to `TYPED_MAX_BYTES` UTF-8 bytes without splitting a character.
- `export function pasteBody(text)` → `PASTE_START + cleanTypedText(text) + PASTE_END` (never followed by `\r` or `\n`).
- `export function buildReviewNote({ fromLabel, files })` → the note (sentence under "User-visible sentences").
- `export function findHandoffTarget(sessions, { agentId, folder })` → the newest live `agent` session of `agentId` whose real `folder` equals `folder`, or null (K13).
- `export async function sendTo(manager, fromId, to)` → `HandoffResult`; `export async function deliverTyped(manager, targetId, text, { fromId = null, waitMs = HANDOFF_WAIT_MS } = {})` → `"typed" | "copy"` (sets the target's `handoff` to pending, then typed or copy; `waitMs: 0` checks once, now, with no wait).
- `export const INVALID_TARGET_MESSAGE = "Agent OS can hand this only to Claude Code or Codex."` (the 400 `invalid_target` sentence; X10's `keep-going.js` imports it, so it exists once).
- No server module builds the Copy fallback sentence: only the page's `handoffCopyReason(agentLabel)` (`src/ui/handoffShared.ts`) does. A "copy" answer whose target missed its moment (X10's `handOver`) carries `reason: null`, and the page fills that sentence in for the chosen agent.
- `sendTo` details (X8 #5): `invalid_target` covers any pair other than claude→codex and codex→claude, including a same-agent send and a Cursor session posting to `/send` (Cursor has its own `/hand-over`, X10; the message reads oddly there, but only a bug can reach it); a second Send while the found target's `handoff` is `pending` answers `opening` for that target; a failed start becomes "copy" with the refusal's own sentence (a `sessionError`, or a brain error that `builderErrorResponse` recognises); any other error is thrown.
- Confirmed by X8 #7 and X10 #6 (already in this section): the Copy fallback sentence is built only by `handoffCopyReason(agentLabel)` (there is no `copyFallbackReason` in `handoff.js`; a synchronous "copy" from `/send` carries the start refusal's own sentence); `INVALID_TARGET_MESSAGE` exists once, in `handoff.js`; `deliverTyped(…, { waitMs: 0 })` answers at once (`"typed"` when the target can take typed text now, else `"copy"`; `whenReadyForTyping` turns 0 into a 0 ms limit after its first check), so X10 needs no change there; `findHandoffTarget` accepts `manager.liveAgentSessions()` entries. No shared open-or-new step (`handTextTo`) is exported: `sendTo` and X10's `handOver` differ on a target that misses its moment (`sendTo` opens a new session, `handOver` answers "copy") and on a refused start (`sendTo` answers "copy", `handOver` throws), and a shared step would change one of them.

#### `server/runtime/sessions/worktrees.js` (new, X9)

- `export const BRANCH_PREFIX = "agentos/"`
- `export function branchName(agentId, n)` → `` `agentos/${agentId}-${n}` `` (agentId one of claude, codex, cursor, hermes, openclaw)
- `export async function nextBranch(folder, agentId, { env, run = runGit })` → the smallest unused `agentos/<agent>-<n>` (n ≥ 1, from `for-each-ref --format=%(refname) refs/heads/agentos/`), or null when not a git project.
- `export async function createWorktree({ folder, agentId, sessionId, env, run = runGit })` → `{ path: <AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees/<sessionId>, branch, copyOf: folder }` (`worktree add <path> -b <branch>`, then chmod 0700).
- `export async function removeWorktree({ path, copyOf, env, run = runGit })` → void; throws `worktree_dirty` when `status --porcelain` in the copy is not empty; otherwise `worktree remove <path>` (the branch is kept, K14).
- More exports (X9 #2): `copyAllowed(agentId)`, `worktreePath(sessionId)`, `copyPlan(folder, agentId, { env, run })`, `discardFreshWorktree({ path, copyOf, branch, env, run })`, `worktreeIdOf(folder)`; `WORKTREE_ADD_LIMIT_MS` (120 s), `WORKTREE_REMOVE_LIMIT_MS` (60 s), `GIT_SAID_MAX` (300). `createWorktree` also returns `folder` (where the session runs inside the copy; equal to `path` for a project's top folder), and its argv names `HEAD` as the start point (K14).
- `FolderCheck.branch` is the branch a separate copy would get for the agent named in the request (`agentos/<agent>-<n>`); it is null when the folder isn't a git project or that agent can't use a copy (OpenClaw) (X9 #7).

#### `server/runtime/sessions/keep-going.js` (new, X10)

- `export const SUMMARY_MAX_LINES = 60`
- `export function summaryHeader(agentLabel, folder)` → the header sentence (below).
- `export function buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel, folder, screenText })` → the header line, then the last `SUMMARY_MAX_LINES` lines of `screenText` with leading and trailing blank lines dropped (each line at most 500 characters), through `cleanTypedText`.
- `export async function keepGoingInfo(manager, id, deps)` → `KeepGoingInfo`; `export async function keepGoing(manager, id, deps)` → `{ result: "resumed" | "opening", targetId }`; `export async function handOver(manager, id, to, deps)` → `HandoffResult` ("copy" carries `targetId: null` and `reason: null`).
- `server/runtime/builders/continue.js`: `claudeOpenRouterOption` and `codexOpenRouterOption` become exported, bodies unchanged. Claude is called with `run = { agentId: "claude", sessionId: meta.agentSessionId, usage: { lastInputTokens: meter?.contextTokens ?? null } }`, Codex with `run = { agentId: "codex" }` and `handoffTokens = Math.ceil(summary.length / 4)`.
- `buildTypedSummary` leaves out every screen line that matches `CLAUDE_SCREEN_LIMIT` or `CODEX_SCREEN_LIMIT`: typed into the new session's input, such a line would sit on that session's screen, and X1b's Codex rule (still on screen 5 s later, process alive, no counted output) would make a fresh session look held. The filter line carries `// SCREEN READING (spec SP4)`. New export `SUMMARY_LINE_MAX = 500` (the "each line at most 500 characters" above) (X10 #1).
- More exports (X10 #5): `NOT_HELD_MESSAGE`, `NOT_ON_PLAN_MESSAGE` ("This session isn't using your plan, so there's no plan limit to get past.", NEW SENTENCE (Q32)), `HAND_OVER_NOT_AVAILABLE_MESSAGE`, `HAND_OVER_ENDED_MESSAGE`, `KEEP_GOING_DEFAULTS`. `KeepGoingInfo.reason` may also be `NOT_ON_PLAN_MESSAGE`, profiles.js's "This Claude Code conversation can't be resumed." (no conversation id) or continue.js's "That way of continuing isn't available." (an option unavailable without a reason).
- `handOver`'s "copy" carries `targetId: null` (no session took the text) and `reason: null` (the target missed its moment; `HandOverButton` shows `handoffCopyReason` for the chosen agent), and the hand-over's new session uses that agent's saved brain, with no override (X10 #9, decision X10-d).

#### Other server files

- `server/runtime/local-session.js` (X2a): `timingSafeEqualStrings(a, b)` becomes exported, body unchanged.
- `server/runtime/builders/brain-launch.js` (X2a): `export const CLAUDE_SETTINGS_KEYS = Object.freeze(["hooks", "statusLine", "apiKeyHelper", "env"])`; `assertSafeClaudeSettings` first throws `brainError("unsafe_settings", <sentence below>)` for any other top-level key (R27), then its base-URL rule as today.
- `server/runtime/sessions/folders.js` (X9): `recentSessionFolders` uses `meta.copyOf` in place of `meta.folder` for a worktree session (R25, K14).
- `server/runtime/sessions/routes.js`: `createSessionsRouter({ manager, approvals = null })` (X3 adds `approvals`); new fixed paths are registered before `/:id`.
- `server/index.js`: X2a mounts `app.use("/hooks", createHooksRouter({ manager: getSessionManager() }))` right after `app.use(securityHeadersMiddleware());` and before `app.use(express.json({ limit: "2mb" }));`. X2b adds `const claudeAgentsPoller = createClaudeAgentsPoller({ manager: sessionManager }); registerShutdownTask("claude-agents-poll", () => claudeAgentsPoller.stop());`. X3 adds `const openclawApprovals = createOpenclawApprovals({ manager: sessionManager }); registerShutdownTask("openclaw-approvals", () => openclawApprovals.stop());` and passes `approvals: openclawApprovals` to `createSessionsRouter`.
- `scripts/build-server-bundle.mjs` (X2b): copies `server/runtime/sessions/statusline-wrapper.mjs` to `<outDir>/statusline-wrapper.mjs`.
- `server/runtime/sessions/soft-stop.js` (X3): `runCli(command, args, { env, cwd, signal, onSpawn, spawn, maxChars, captureStderr = false })`. With `captureStderr: true`, stderr is piped and every answer gains `stderr: string`, capped at `maxChars` like stdout. Without it, the stdio (`["ignore", "pipe", "ignore"]`) and the answer `{ ok, code, aborted, stdout }` stay exactly as in SP3. X3 needs it for "the CLI's stderr" in `approval_failed`, and X7's `runGit` uses the same option for its `stderr` (X3 #1, X7 #1).
- `server/runtime/builders/resolve.js` (X2a): `STATUS` gains `unsafe_settings: 500`, which "answered like the other brain errors" needs; without it `builderErrorResponse` returns null and the route answers the generic 500 with a log line (X2a #4).
- `routes.js`: `createSessionsRouter({ manager, approvals = null, keepGoingDeps = undefined })`. X10 adds `keepGoingDeps`, passed to `keepGoingInfo`, `keepGoing` and `handOver`; production passes nothing (`KEEP_GOING_DEFAULTS`), and tests pass fakes, so route tests need no network and no key (X10 #3). With `approvals` null, GET answers `{ approvals: [], error: null }`, and POST goes through an approvals source that never sees an open session, so it answers 400 `invalid_decision` or 404 `approval_missing` with the same words (X3 #6).

### The per-session Claude settings file (X2a, X2b)

`<AGENT_OS_HOME>/sessions/<id>/claude-settings.json`, written from `buildSessionClaudeSettings`, keys in this order (`HTTP` and `HTTP_END` below):

```json
{
  "hooks": {
    "PermissionRequest": [{ "hooks": [HTTP] }],
    "Elicitation": [{ "hooks": [HTTP] }],
    "Notification": [{ "matcher": "permission_prompt|elicitation_dialog|elicitation_url_dialog|quota_auto_resume_fired", "hooks": [HTTP] }],
    "Stop": [{ "hooks": [HTTP] }],
    "StopFailure": [{ "hooks": [HTTP] }],
    "UserPromptSubmit": [{ "hooks": [HTTP] }],
    "PostToolUse": [{ "matcher": "Edit|Write", "hooks": [HTTP] }],
    "SessionEnd": [{ "matcher": "clear|resume", "hooks": [HTTP_END] }]
  },
  "statusLine": { "type": "command", "command": "<statusLineCommand(script)>", "padding": 0, "refreshInterval": 5, "hideVimModeIndicator": true },
  "apiKeyHelper": "<only with an OpenRouter brain, from buildClaudeSettings>",
  "env": { "<only with an OpenRouter or Local brain, from buildClaudeSettings(..., { forSession: true })>": "" }
}
```

- `HTTP` = `{ "type": "http", "url": "<claudeHookUrl(port, id)>", "timeout": 3, "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer $AGENT_OS_HOOK_TOKEN" }, "allowedEnvVars": ["AGENT_OS_HOOK_TOKEN"] }`; `HTTP_END` is the same without `"timeout"` (K9). No `onFailure` (R6). The token itself is never in the file.
- `statusLine` is written by X2b on every Claude `agent` start with a hook (with or without a user status line: the wrapper prints nothing when there is none); `padding`, `refreshInterval` and `hideVimModeIndicator` appear only when the person's own statusLine has them, copied unchanged (the values above are examples).
- `apiKeyHelper` and `env` appear only as `buildClaudeSettings` gives them today.

### The `AGENT_OS_ALERT` line (X1a prints, X4 reads)

```
AGENT_OS_ALERT:{"sessionId":"<uuid>","agent":"<SESSION_AGENT_LABEL>","kind":"waiting|approval|limit","text":"<cleaned, at most 200 characters>"}\n
```

- Printed on the server's stdout only when `AGENT_OS_PACKAGED=1`, by `printAlertLine`, for `agent` sessions, once per transition into an alert (K7). `JSON.stringify` keeps it on one line; text is cut by code points.
- `agent` is the short name ("Claude Code", "Codex", "Cursor", "Hermes", "OpenClaw"). No folder, no path, no id other than the session id.

### SessionSummary additions (server `toSummary`, client `SessionSummary`)

X1a sends every key below from its first commit, with the defaults shown, so the shape never changes again; later tasks fill them.

| Field | Type | Default | Filled by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alert` | `{ kind: "waiting" \| "approval" \| "limit"; text: string; at: string } \| null` | null | X1a |
| `alerts` | `"full" \| "basic"` (replaces SP3's constant `"basic"`; `"full"` = a turn-done session) | `"basic"` | X1a |
| `idleBy` | `"turn_done" \| "timer" \| null` | null | X1a |
| `resetAt` | `string \| null` (held only) | null | X1a |
| `trustNeeded` | `boolean` (a Claude `agent` session with a hook whose first hook event or status post has not arrived) | false | X2a |
| `hooksOff` | `{ alerts: HooksOffCode \| null; meter: HooksOffCode \| null }` | `{ alerts: null, meter: null }` | X2b |
| `meter` | `SessionMeter \| null` | null | X2b |
| `copyOf` | `string \| null` (the original folder of a worktree session) | null (from meta) | X9 |
| `handoff` | `SessionHandoff \| null` | null | X8 |

```ts
type HooksOffCode = "managed_hooks_only" | "all_hooks_disabled" | "http_hook_urls" | "http_hook_env_vars" | "managed_status_line";
interface SessionMeter {
  model: string | null;            // model.display_name, at most 80 characters
  contextPercent: number | null;   // context_window.used_percentage, 0-100
  contextTokens: number | null;    // input + cache_creation_input + cache_read_input tokens of context_window.current_usage
  plan: { usedPercent: number; resetsAt: string | null } | null;     // rate_limits.five_hour
  weekly: { usedPercent: number; resetsAt: string | null } | null;   // rate_limits.seven_day
  costUsd: number | null;          // cost.total_cost_usd, Claude's own estimate (R11)
  at: string;
}
interface SessionHandoff { state: "pending" | "typed" | "copy"; text: string; fromId: string | null; at: string }
```

- An ended session sends `alert: null`, `meter: null`, `handoff: null`, `trustNeeded: false`, `idleBy: null`, `resetAt: null`.
- `folderName` of a worktree session is `path.basename(copyOf)`; `branch` is the new branch (R25).
- An ended session's summary also sends `hooksOff: { alerts: null, meter: null }` (X1a #4).
- `copyOf` in the summary is meta.json's `copyOf` while the copy is there, and `null` once the copy was removed (meta.json keeps `copyOf` and gains `worktreeRemovedAt`). No summary key is added, so X1a's key lists and `setup-session-kind.test.js` stay as they are. The panel then hides the copy line and "Remove separate copy" for a removed copy, and Resume says why (X9 #1, X9 #5).

### meta.json additions

- `markers: Marker[]` (X1a; at most `MARKERS_MAX`, oldest dropped; missing means `[]`):

```
{ at: string, type: "prompt" }                                                         // X2a, label only (R23)
{ at: string, type: "permission", text: string }                                        // X1a, when the alert becomes waiting or approval
{ at: string, type: "files", files: Array<{ path: string, added: number | null, removed: number | null }>, more: number }   // X7
```

- `copyOf: string | null` (X9; the original folder's real path), `worktreeRemovedAt: string | null` (X9). `branch` already exists.
- `version` stays 1 (every addition is optional to readers). Never stored: the hook token, the alert, the meter, hook bodies, prompts, hand-off text.
- Delete recording empties `markers` (U11 #4). After a copy is removed, `copyOf` stays in meta.json next to the new `worktreeRemovedAt` (X9 #1).

| Frame | When | Task |

| `{ t: "state", status, exitCode?, signal?, endedBy?, resetAt? }` | as SP3; `resetAt` only with held, when known | X1a |
| `{ t: "alert", kind: "waiting" \| "approval" \| "limit", text }` | the alert was set, or changed kind or text | X1a |

### Routes

#### Hooks (outside `/api/`, X2a; `/status` processing X2b)

| Method | Path | Request | Reply |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/hooks/sessions/:id` | `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; body: Claude's hook event JSON | 204, empty body |
| POST | `/hooks/sessions/:id/status` | `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; body: the statusLine JSON | 204, empty body |
| any | any other path under `/hooks` | | 404, empty body |

- Checks, in this order: not local mode → 403; `:id` not a v4 uuid, or not a live Claude Code `agent` session → 404; missing or bad `Authorization`, or another session's token → 401; then the body is read: up to 256 KB it is kept, replied 204, and processed on `setImmediate` (broken JSON or a non-object is dropped silently); past 256 KB the reply is 204 with `Connection: close` at once, the rest is read and thrown away (`req.resume()`), nothing is processed (R5).
- Every reply has an empty body and `Cache-Control: no-store`; nothing is logged.
- When hook answers are sent (X2a #1): X2a sends every `/hooks` answer (204, 401, 403, 404) as soon as the request's body has been read, the part past 256 KB thrown away as it arrives, and adds `Connection: close` to the refusals (401, 403, 404). Its reason: Node's `resOnFinish` calls `socket.destroySoon()` for a `Connection: close` answer, so an answer written while Claude is still uploading arrives as a connection reset, which Claude shows as "hook error" (the thing R5 avoids). **Resolution: the contract stands** ("past 256 KB the reply is 204 with `Connection: close` at once") until the orchestrator accepts X2a #1. If it is accepted, the checks line above changes to match, and the change also goes into D1's Appendix A3 or E1's ledger (see Minor review notes).

#### Sessions REST additions (under `/api/sessions`, local mode and cookie gate)

| Method | Path | Body | Reply | Task |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/sessions` | | as SP3; each summary has the new fields | X1a |
| GET | `/api/sessions/:id/markers` | | 200 `{ markers: Marker[] }` | X1a |
| GET | `/api/sessions/approvals` | | 200 `{ approvals: ApprovalCard[], error: string \| null }` (`{ approvals: [], error: null }` with no OpenClaw session open) | X3 |
| POST | `/api/sessions/approvals/resolve` | `{ id: string, decision: "allow-once" \| "deny" }` | 200 `{ ok: true, message: string \| null }` | X3 |
| GET | `/api/sessions/:id/changes` | | 200 `ChangesResult` (live: the last poll; ended: one fresh read) | X7 |
| GET | `/api/sessions/:id/changes/diff?path=<repo-relative path>` | | 200 `DiffResult` | X7 |
| POST | `/api/sessions/:id/send` | `{ to: "claude" \| "codex" }` | 200 `HandoffResult` | X8 |
| POST | `/api/sessions/folder-check` | `{ folder: string, agentId: string }` | 200 `FolderCheck` | X9 |
| POST | `/api/sessions` | `{ agentId, folder, copy?: boolean }` (`copy === true` only) | as SP3 | X9 |
| DELETE | `/api/sessions/:id/worktree` | | 200 `{ removed: true }` | X9 |
| GET | `/api/sessions/:id/keep-going` | | 200 `KeepGoingInfo` | X10 |
| POST | `/api/sessions/:id/keep-going` | `{}` | 200 `{ result: "resumed" \| "opening", targetId: string }` | X10 |
| POST | `/api/sessions/:id/hand-over` | `{ to: "claude" \| "codex" }` (Cursor sessions only) | 200 `HandoffResult` | X10 |

```ts
interface ApprovalCard { id: string; kind: "exec" | "plugin" | "system-agent"; summary: string; createdAt: string; expiresAt: string; sessionId: string | null }
type Marker = { at: string; type: "prompt" } | { at: string; type: "permission"; text: string }
  | { at: string; type: "files"; files: Array<{ path: string; added: number | null; removed: number | null }>; more: number };
interface ChangedFile { path: string; status: "modified" | "added" | "deleted" | "renamed" | "untracked" | "conflicted" | "other"; added: number | null; removed: number | null; oldPath?: string }
interface ChangesResult { git: boolean | null; files: ChangedFile[]; total: number; at: string | null }   // git null: not read yet
interface DiffResult { path: string; diff: string; binary: boolean; cut: boolean }
interface HandoffResult { result: "typed" | "opening" | "copy"; targetId: string | null; text: string; reason: string | null }
interface FolderCheck { path: string; name: string; git: boolean; branch: string | null; inUse: Array<{ id: string; agentLabel: string; title: string }> }
interface KeepGoingInfo { agentId: "claude" | "codex"; approach: "resume" | "new"; available: boolean; reason: string | null; model: string | null;
  estimateUsd: number | null; estimateTokens: number | null; estimateNote: string; warnings: string[]; needsKey: boolean }
```

- `HandoffResult`: "typed" (an open target passed the write rules and was written), "opening" (a new session started; it is typed once ready, and the target's `handoff` shows the end state), "copy" (no target could take it; `text` is shown with a Copy button and `reason` says why, or is null when the target missed its moment and the page shows the Copy fallback sentence).
- `DELETE /api/sessions/:id/recording` (an SP3 route) answers through `manager.deleteRecording(id)`: SP3's answers, plus 409 `session_busy`; the moments go with the files (U11 #4).
- Both changes routes answer `Cache-Control: no-store` (a diff holds file contents), as the recording stream does (X7 #10).
