- [ ] **Step 12: Create the poller.** Create `server/runtime/sessions/claude-agents-poll.js` with exactly this content:

```js
// Claude Code's own list of its sessions, `claude agents --json`, as the fallback signal source
// (spec SP4 Signals, Claude Code row: "Fallback: ... `claude agents --json` polling every 10 s";
// rulings R12 and K19). It backs up Claude's hooks when they are kept out, not trusted yet, or
// silent (Esc sends no Stop hook). One poller serves every live Claude Code session together:
//   - one call at a time, the next CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_MS after the last one ended, and only while
//     at least one Claude Code agent session is live (the manager's onLiveChange wakes it again);
//   - each call is argv only (runCli, never a shell), with the command, folder and environment of
//     a live Claude Code session minus Agent OS's own variables (never the server's environment,
//     which holds AGENT_OS_TOKEN), and is cut at CLAUDE_AGENTS_CALL_LIMIT_MS;
//   - the answer is read for each session's status and then dropped. Its signals are hints
//     (source "poll"): waiting raises "Waiting for you", busy shows a new turn (or ends a waiting
//     this poller raised), idle ends a live turn.
// Spike S1 checks that the call never starts Claude's supervisor. If it would, CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_ON
// becomes false and nothing here runs (OSC and BEL on the mirror stay on for every agent).
import { cleanAlertText } from "./signals.js";
import { runCli as defaultRunCli } from "./soft-stop.js";

export const CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_ON = true;
export const CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_MS = 10000;
export const CLAUDE_AGENTS_CALL_LIMIT_MS = 5000;

// The spec's own words for a session that waits (K19).
const POLL_WAITING_TEXT = "Waiting for you";
const STATUSES = new Set(["waiting", "busy", "idle"]);
const WAITING_FOR_MAX = 60;
// A waiting answer is dropped for a session the person typed into from this long before the call
// started: the answer can be older than their reply (the rule of Claude's backup Notification
// hook, K6 and BACKUP_WAITING_QUIET_MS in hooks.js).
const INPUT_QUIET_MS = 3000;

function isPlainObject(value) {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

// The list `claude agents --json` prints: an array (agent-view docs), or one inside { sessions }
// or { agents }, as findBackgroundAgent in soft-stop.js also accepts. Interactive sessions only:
// a background task (/bg) of the same conversation is not the terminal.
function entriesOf(text) {
  let parsed;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(String(text ?? ""));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
  const list = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : Array.isArray(parsed?.sessions) ? parsed.sessions : Array.isArray(parsed?.agents) ? parsed.agents : [];
  return list.filter((entry) => isPlainObject(entry) && entry.kind !== "background" && STATUSES.has(entry.status));
}

function sameSession(entry, session) {
  const id = typeof session.agentSessionId === "string" ? session.agentSessionId.toLowerCase() : "";
  if (id && typeof entry.sessionId === "string" && entry.sessionId.toLowerCase() === id) return true;
  return Number.isInteger(session.pid) && session.pid > 0 && Number(entry.pid) === session.pid;
}

export function mapClaudeAgents(text, sessions) {
  const entries = entriesOf(text);
  const out = [];
  for (const session of Array.isArray(sessions) ? sessions : []) {
    const entry = entries.find((candidate) => sameSession(candidate, session));
    if (!entry) continue;
    const waitingFor = entry.status === "waiting" && typeof entry.waitingFor === "string" ? cleanAlertText(entry.waitingFor, WAITING_FOR_MAX) : "";
    out.push({ id: session.id, status: entry.status, waitingFor: waitingFor || null });
  }
  return out;
}

// The session's own environment without Agent OS's own names: the hook address, token and
// session id belong to one session, and this call is for all of them.
function callEnv(env) {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(env || {}).filter(([key]) => !key.startsWith("AGENT_OS_")));
}

export function createClaudeAgentsPoller({
  manager,
  runCli = defaultRunCli,
  intervalMs = CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_MS,
  limitMs = CLAUDE_AGENTS_CALL_LIMIT_MS,
  enabled = CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_ON
} = {}) {
  if (!enabled) return { stop() {} };
  let stopped = false;
  let timer = null;
  let polling = false;
  let inFlight = null;

  const liveClaude = () => manager.liveAgentSessions("claude").filter((session) => session.status !== "exited");

  function schedule() {
    if (stopped || polling || timer || liveClaude().length === 0) return;
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timer = null;
      void pollOnce();
    }, intervalMs);
    timer.unref?.();
  }

  // K19, for each session the answer names (the table in Task X2b's Interfaces).
  function apply(results, sessions, startedAt) {
    for (const { id, status } of results) {
      const session = sessions.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
      if (!session) continue;
      const ownWaiting = session.status === "waiting" && session.alert?.source === "poll";
      if (status === "waiting") {
        // Never over a waiting already shown (its words are better), never on a held session, and
        // never just after the person typed there.
        if (session.status === "waiting" || session.status === "held") continue;
        if (Number.isFinite(session.lastInputAt) && session.lastInputAt >= startedAt - INPUT_QUIET_MS) continue;
        manager.applySignal(id, { kind: "waiting", text: POLL_WAITING_TEXT, source: "poll" });
      } else if (status === "busy") {
        if (ownWaiting) manager.applySignal(id, { kind: "resolved", source: "poll" });
        else manager.markNewTurn(id);
      } else if (session.status === "live" || ownWaiting) {
        manager.applySignal(id, { kind: "turn_done", source: "poll" });
      }
    }
  }

  async function pollOnce() {
    if (stopped) return;
    const first = liveClaude()[0];
    if (!first?.profile?.command) {
      schedule();
      return;
    }
    polling = true;
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    const limit = new AbortController();
    inFlight = limit;
    const cut = setTimeout(() => limit.abort(), limitMs);
    try {
      const result = await runCli(first.profile.command, ["agents", "--json"], {
        env: callEnv(first.profile.env),
        cwd: first.profile.cwd,
        signal: limit.signal
      });
      if (!stopped && result?.ok) {
        const sessions = liveClaude();
        apply(mapClaudeAgents(result.stdout, sessions), sessions, startedAt);
      }
    } catch {
      // runCli never rejects; an injected one that does loses only this poll
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(cut);
      inFlight = null;
      polling = false;
      schedule();
    }
  }

  const unsubscribe = manager.onLiveChange(() => schedule());
  schedule();
  return {
    stop() {
      stopped = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      timer = null;
      inFlight?.abort();
      unsubscribe?.();
    }
  };
}
```

3. **Decisions this task makes** (the orchestrator can overturn any):
   - a) `onStatusLine` never calls `markSourceSeen`: the status line runs even when `allowedHttpHookUrls` keeps the hooks out, and a session made "turn-done" would wait for a Stop hook that never comes ("Working." up to the 120 s backstop each turn). It does clear `trustNeeded`, because Claude runs a status line only after its trust dialog.
   - b) A `rate_limits` window whose `resets_at` has passed is dropped from the meter as well as from the limit (R4); with both windows spent, the hold's reset is the later one; a window at 100 % without a reset time is shown but is not "at the limit" (the contract's rule).
   - c) The person's `padding`, `refreshInterval` and `hideVimModeIndicator` are copied only when they have their JSON type: a wrong type in Agent OS's file could make Claude refuse the whole file, and the hooks with it.
   - d) The poller skips `kind: "background"` entries (a `/bg` task of the same conversation is not the terminal); a poll's waiting never replaces a waiting already shown (the hook's words are better), never applies to a held session, and is dropped when the person typed within 3 s before the call started or during it (the K6 rule, Review Focus 1's situation for the poller); a poll's `idle` also ends a waiting the poller itself raised (K4).
   - e) The poller's call drops every `AGENT_OS_*` name from the session's environment: the hook address, token and session id belong to one session.
   - f) The first poll runs one interval after the first Claude session appears (Claude is still starting before that).
   - g) The wrapper does not post an empty body or one over 256 KB (the endpoint would drop it, R5); it waits for the command's output to close, as Claude does; after it is done it lets Node exit by itself once stdout is written, with a 2 s backstop.
   - h) The wrapper posts only to `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` (prefix and parsed host both checked, so `http://127.0.0.1:1@other.host/` is refused).
   - i) On Windows the wrapper runs `cmd.exe /d /s /c "<command>"` as the contract says; nothing here tests it (Windows CI skips the POSIX tests, as for every other sh-based test).

5. **Risks.**
   - Managed settings that arrive another way (a macOS configuration profile, server-delivered settings, a drop-in folder) are not read: a managed statusLine delivered that way leaves the Live meter empty without a note, and an `allowManagedHooksOnly` delivered that way leaves alerts silent without a note. S1 on the owner's Mac shows no managed settings; a company Mac could.
   - Project settings are read from the session folder only, as Claude reads them from where it starts; if Claude also looked in a parent folder, a status line there would be missed (the person would see the user-level one or none).
   - `claude agents --json` is read for `kind`, `sessionId`, `pid`, `status` and `waitingFor` from the docs (agent-facts 1.5); E2's shape-only read confirms them, and S1 decides `CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_ON`.
   - A "busy" answer that is up to 5 s old can wake a turn-done session after its Stop hook; the next poll's "idle" (10 s later) or the 120 s backstop puts it back.
   - A trusted project's own settings could set `AGENT_OS_HOOK_URL` in their `env` and send the status JSON and token to another local port; a trusted project can already run any command through its own hooks, and hook events are hints only.
   - Test timing: the wrapper's two timing tests compare against Node's own start time measured in the same test, so a slow machine does not fail them; on a very loaded machine "Review Focus 5" could still pass the 600 ms budget late. Report, do not widen.

### Task X3: OpenClaw approvals (server): `openclaw-approvals.js` poller, matching, approval signals, `/api/sessions/approvals` routes, fake CLI answers

Today Agent OS has no approvals code at all (`grep approvals server` finds only Hermes's `approvals.mode` checks). The Safety page shows an empty "Pending approvals" state and a disabled ghost card (`src/ui/components/SafetyApprovals.tsx`). W1's fake `openclaw` (`test/fakes/tui-agent.mjs`) has no answer for `approvals pending` or `approvals resolve`, and `runCli` (`server/runtime/sessions/soft-stop.js`) ignores a program's stderr.

This task builds the server half of OpenClaw approvals (spec "SP4 Session extras", the OpenClaw row of "Signals"; ruling R16):
- **The poller.** A new module, `server/runtime/sessions/openclaw-approvals.js`, runs `openclaw approvals pending --json` every 3 s, and only while at least one OpenClaw session is open. It runs one call at a time, starts the next call 3 s after the last one ended, and cuts each call off at 10 s. Every kind OpenClaw lists (exec, plugin, system-agent) becomes a card.
- **Matching.** Agent OS starts OpenClaw as `openclaw tui --session agentos-<id>`, so an approval whose `sessionKey` holds `agentos-<sessionId>` belongs to that session. Any other approval belongs to every open OpenClaw session, and its card says "from OpenClaw" (`sessionId: null`, K11).
- **Signals.** New approvals become approval signals through X1a's `manager.applySignal`. The session then becomes waiting and gets the alert, the tab marker, a "permission asked" marker and, in the packaged app, the `AGENT_OS_ALERT` line. Once nothing is pending for that session, it gets a resolved signal.
- **Two routes** under `/api/sessions`. `GET /approvals` lists the cards. `POST /approvals/resolve` answers one approval with `allow-once` or `deny` only, never with the third decision OpenClaw offers. Only that POST resolves anything, and only the person's click sends it. A refusal comes back as OpenClaw's own words in plain text.
- **Support changes.** `runCli` gains an opt-in `captureStderr` option, and the fake `openclaw` answers both approvals commands, driven by two knobs.

It owns these spec items:
- the OpenClaw row ("Allow once / Deny call `openclaw approvals resolve <id> allow-once|deny` **only on the user's click**");
- the done-when line "the OpenClaw approval flow passes with a fake CLI (resolve only on click)";
- the OpenClaw part of Security 3 (argv only) and Security 6 (no auto-answers).

Its tests never start a real agent, never reach a real OpenClaw Gateway, never open a Terminal window, and never answer an approval except through the resolve call under test.

     - "Local mode";

     - "Copy";

2. **Decisions this task makes.** The orchestrator can overturn any of them.
   - (a) The contract says a session gets the approval signal "unless its alert is already that approval". This task reads that as a per-session memory of the approval ids the session was already told about.
     - A session gets one approval signal each time approvals it was not told about appear. The text is the newest new approval's summary.
     - User input clears the session's alert, as it clears every alert, and the same approval does not alert again. The card stays on the panel and on Safety until OpenClaw stops listing it.
     - The other reading (signal again on every poll while the alert is gone) would add a "permission asked" marker, and possibly a notification, every 3 s after the person clicks into the terminal.
   - (b) The first poll runs at once when the first OpenClaw session opens, not 3 s later.
   - (c) A failed, cut-off or unreadable poll keeps the last good list so cards do not flicker. It changes no alert and sets the poll-failed note. Expired cards drop out at read time by their own `expiresAt`.
   - (d) Approval ids must match `/^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._:@+=\/-]{0,199}$/`, so an id can never read as an option of `approvals resolve`. Entries with other ids are dropped.
   - (e) When parsing fails, the parser tries once more from the first line that starts with `{`, in case the CLI printed a log line before the JSON.
   - (f) `resolve` runs with the matched session's command, environment and folder, or else with the first open OpenClaw session's.
   - (g) Every resolve that ran the CLI polls again at once, also after a refusal, so a missing or expired approval leaves the list at once. The contract names this only for exit 0.
   - (h) `runCli` gets an opt-in `captureStderr`, and its default stays byte-identical, because SP3's tests deep-compare the old answer shape.
   - (i) When `approvals` is null, the router's stand-in is `createOpenclawApprovals({ manager: NO_OPEN_SESSIONS })`. It reuses the real checks and sentences, so no sentence is written twice, and it never starts a timer.
   - (j) Terminal colour and title sequences are stripped from error text before `cleanAlertText`.
   - (k) The resolve call's time limit is the same `limitMs` as a poll's (10 s).
3. **Copy for the owner's review at E1.** These server sentences reach the page (R28):
   - "Agent OS couldn't read OpenClaw's approvals. Check that the OpenClaw Gateway is running on Agents." NEW SENTENCE (Q32) (contract)
   - "Agent OS only sends Allow once or Deny." NEW SENTENCE (Q32) (contract)
   - "That approval isn't waiting anymore." NEW SENTENCE (Q32) (contract)
   - "Agent OS is already sending your answer to this approval." NEW SENTENCE (Q32) (contract)
   - "OpenClaw didn't take that answer: <its text>" NEW SENTENCE (Q32) (contract)
   - "OpenClaw didn't take that answer and gave no reason." NEW SENTENCE (Q32) (contract addition 3)
   - "OpenClaw didn't answer in time, so Agent OS can't tell whether your answer arrived." NEW SENTENCE (Q32) (contract addition 3)
   - An approval's alert text is OpenClaw's own `summary`, not Agent OS's words. No developer-only error text in this task reaches a person.

```js
// The approvals of the fake `openclaw` (test/fakes/tui-agent.mjs; SP4, Task
// X3): rows in the shape `openclaw approvals pending --json` prints (OpenClaw
// 2026.10.4: id, kind, agentId, sessionKey, createdAtMs, expiresAtMs, summary;
// every value made up), and the two knobs that pick what the fake's `approvals
// pending --json` and `approvals resolve <id> <decision>` do. The knobs are
// files under $HOME/.fake-knobs (test/helpers/fake-knobs.js), because a
// session's environment is the login shell's, not the test's.
// A helper, not a test file: the runner only runs test/*.test.js.
import { setFakeKnob } from "./fake-knobs.js";

let counter = 0;

// One pending approval: an exec approval created now that expires in five
// minutes, unless `extra` says otherwise.
export function fakeApproval(extra = {}) {
  counter += 1;
  const createdAtMs = Date.now();
  return {
    id: `appr-${counter}`,
    kind: "exec",
    agentId: "main",
    sessionKey: null,
    createdAtMs,
    expiresAtMs: createdAtMs + 5 * 60 * 1000,
    summary: "npm run build",
    ...extra
  };
}

export function pendingJson(rows) {
  return JSON.stringify({ approvals: rows });
}

// FAKE_OPENCLAW_APPROVALS: rows (printed as pendingJson), a string as it is
// ("fail", "slow" or any text), or null for the default ({"approvals":[]}).
export async function setFakeApprovals(home, value) {
  await setFakeKnob(home, "FAKE_OPENCLAW_APPROVALS", Array.isArray(value) ? pendingJson(value) : value);
}

// FAKE_OPENCLAW_RESOLVE: "fail", "slow", or null (exit 0).
export async function setFakeResolve(home, value) {
  await setFakeKnob(home, "FAKE_OPENCLAW_RESOLVE", value);
}
```

```js
// OpenClaw approvals (SP4, Task X3; spec "SP4 Session extras", the OpenClaw
// row of "Signals"; ruling R16; contract K11 and K16). What is tested:
//   - parsePendingApprovals and matchApprovalSession (pure);
//   - the poller, with a fake session manager and a fake CLI runner: only
//     while an OpenClaw session is open, one call at a time, an interval after
//     the last one ended, the 10 s limit, the poll-failed note, the approval
//     and resolved signals;
//   - resolve() only from a click: Allow once or Deny only, only an approval in
//     the latest list, one at a time, OpenClaw's own error text;
//   - runCli's captureStderr, and W1's fake `openclaw` answering the two
//     approvals commands;
//   - the two routes (fixed paths, local mode only) and the server wiring;
//   - end to end in process: the real session manager, a real fake-OpenClaw
//     session in a PTY, the real poller and router and the fake CLI ("the
//     OpenClaw approval flow passes with a fake CLI (resolve only on click)").
// Temp HOME and AGENT_OS_HOME only (real paths), W1's stand-in login shell;
// never a real agent, never a real Gateway.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { mkdtemp, readFile, realpath, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { setTimeout as delay } from "node:timers/promises";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import express from "express";
import { clearDetectCaches } from "../server/runtime/agents/detect.js";
import { setExecutionGateStatus } from "../server/runtime/execution-gate.js";
import { requireLocalMode } from "../server/runtime/local-session.js";
import { sessionError } from "../server/runtime/sessions/errors.js";
import { createSessionManager } from "../server/runtime/sessions/manager.js";
import {
  APPROVALS_CALL_LIMIT_MS,
  APPROVALS_POLL_MS,
  APPROVAL_DECISIONS,
  APPROVAL_SUMMARY_MAX,
  createOpenclawApprovals,
  matchApprovalSession,
  parsePendingApprovals
} from "../server/runtime/sessions/openclaw-approvals.js";
import { createSessionsRouter } from "../server/runtime/sessions/routes.js";
import { resetLoginShellEnvForTests } from "../server/runtime/sessions/shell-env.js";
import { runCli } from "../server/runtime/sessions/soft-stop.js";
import { FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL, makeFakeAgentBin } from "./helpers/fake-agents.js";
import { fakeApproval, pendingJson, setFakeApprovals, setFakeResolve } from "./helpers/fake-approvals.js";
import { sourceProblems } from "./helpers/plan-brains-safety.js";

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const isWindows = process.platform === "win32";
const SKIP_POSIX = { skip: isWindows ? "POSIX only: the fake agents are sh shims, and runCli kills process groups" : false };
const SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS = ["/usr/bin", "/bin", "/usr/sbin", "/sbin"];
const S1 = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
const S2 = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222";
const S3 = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333";
const HOME = "/Users/someone";
const POLL_FAILED = "Agent OS couldn't read OpenClaw's approvals. Check that the OpenClaw Gateway is running on Agents.";
const INVALID_DECISION = { error: "invalid_decision", message: "Agent OS only sends Allow once or Deny." };
const APPROVAL_MISSING = { error: "approval_missing", message: "That approval isn't waiting anymore." };
const NOT_LOCAL = {
  DEMO_PUBLIC: "1",
  HERMES_AGENT_OS_DEMO_PUBLIC: undefined,
  HERMES_AGENT_OS_REQUIRE_AUTH: undefined,
  HERMES_AGENT_OS_PUBLIC_MODE: undefined
};
const keyOf = (id) => `agent:main:agentos-${id}`;
const listed = (rows) => ({ ok: true, code: 0, aborted: false, stdout: pendingJson(rows) });
const cardOf = (row, sessionId) => ({
  id: row.id,
  kind: row.kind,
  summary: row.summary,
  createdAt: new Date(row.createdAtMs).toISOString(),
  expiresAt: new Date(row.expiresAtMs).toISOString(),
  sessionId
});

async function withEnv(vars, fn) {
  const previous = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(vars)) previous[key] = process.env[key];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(vars)) {
    if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
    else process.env[key] = String(value);
  }
  try {
    return await fn();
  } finally {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(previous)) {
      if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = value;
    }
  }
}

async function waitFor(predicate, { timeoutMs = 15000, intervalMs = 20 } = {}) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (await predicate()) return;
    await delay(intervalMs);
  }
  throw new Error("timed out waiting for condition");
}

function isAlive(pid) {
  try {
    process.kill(pid, 0);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    return error.code === "EPERM";
  }
}

// The fakes' event log (W1): one JSON line per event.
async function readFakeLog(file) {
  const text = await readFile(file, "utf8").catch((error) => {
    if (error.code === "ENOENT") return "";
    throw error;
  });
  return text
    .split("\n")
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((line) => JSON.parse(line));
}

async function request(base, method, url, body) {
  const response = await fetch(`${base}${url}`, {
    method,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  const text = await response.text();
  let parsed = null;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    parsed = null;
  }
  return { status: response.status, body: parsed };
}

// The sessions router on a real port, mounted the way server/index.js mounts
// it. The manager is a stand-in: these routes never ask it.
async function withRouterApp(approvals, fn) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use("/api/sessions", requireLocalMode, createSessionsRouter({ manager: { maxLive: 8 }, approvals }));
  const server = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const listening = app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve(listening));
  });
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
  try {
    return await fn((method, url, body) => request(base, method, url, body));
  } finally {
    server.closeAllConnections?.();
    await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve));
  }
}

// The part of the session manager the poller uses (X1a: liveAgentSessions,
// onLiveChange, applySignal), in memory. applySignal records every signal and
// keeps the alert as the activity reducer does for these two kinds; input(id)
// is the person typing in that terminal (it clears the alert).
function fakeManager() {
  const sessions = new Map();
  const listeners = new Set();
  const signals = [];
  const changed = () => {
    for (const listener of [...listeners]) listener();
  };
  return {
    signals,
    liveAgentSessions(agentId = null) {
      return [...sessions.values()]
        .filter((session) => agentId === null || session.agentId === agentId)
        .map((session) => ({
          ...session,
          alert: session.alert ? { ...session.alert } : null,
          profile: { ...session.profile, env: { ...session.profile.env } }
        }));
    },
    onLiveChange(listener) {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener);
      };
    },
    applySignal(id, { kind, text = "", source }) {
      const session = sessions.get(id);
      if (!session) return false;
      signals.push({ id, kind, text, source });
      if (kind === "approval") session.alert = { kind, text, at: new Date().toISOString(), source };
      if (kind === "resolved") session.alert = null;
      return true;
    },
    open(id, { agentId = "openclaw" } = {}) {
      sessions.set(id, {
        id,
        agentId,
        agentSessionId: agentId === "openclaw" ? `agentos-${id}` : null,
        folder: HOME,
        status: "live",
        alert: null,
        pid: 4242,
        profile: {
          command: `/fake/bin/${agentId}`,
          args: ["tui", "--session", `agentos-${id}`],
          cwd: HOME,
          env: { PATH: "/usr/bin:/bin", HOME, AGENT_OS_SESSION_ID: id }
        }
      });
      changed();
    },
    close(id) {
      sessions.delete(id);
      changed();
    },
    input(id) {
      const session = sessions.get(id);
      if (session) session.alert = null;
    },
    profileOf(id) {
      return sessions.get(id).profile;
    },
    listenerCount() {
      return listeners.size;
    }
  };
}

// A CLI runner that records every call (argv, options, start and end times)
// and how many ran at once; `answer(args, options, call)` gives the answer.
function fakeCli(answer) {
  const calls = [];
  let running = 0;
  let most = 0;
  async function run(command, args, options = {}) {
    const call = { command, args: [...args], options, startedAt: Date.now(), endedAt: null };
    calls.push(call);
    running += 1;
    most = Math.max(most, running);
    try {
      return await answer(args, options, call);
    } finally {
      running -= 1;
      call.endedAt = Date.now();
    }
  }
  return {
    run,
    calls,
    maxRunning: () => most,
    pending: () => calls.filter((call) => call.args[1] === "pending"),
    resolves: () => calls.filter((call) => call.args[1] === "resolve")
  };
}

// A call that never answers by itself: it ends only when its signal aborts, as runCli does.
function cutOff(_args, { signal }) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    signal.addEventListener("abort", () => resolve({ ok: false, code: null, aborted: true, stdout: "", stderr: "" }), { once: true });
  });
}

test("parsePendingApprovals keeps OpenClaw's fields for every kind, newest first, and drops what Agent OS can't use", () => {
  const now = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 29, 10, 0, 0);
  const row = (extra) => ({ id: "x", kind: "exec", agentId: "main", sessionKey: null, createdAtMs: now - 60000, expiresAtMs: now + 240000, summary: "npm test", ...extra });
  const text = JSON.stringify({
    approvals: [
      row({ id: "appr-old", createdAtMs: now - 120000, sessionKey: keyOf(S1) }),
      row({ id: "appr-new", kind: "plugin", createdAtMs: now - 1000, summary: `Deploy:\tpush\u0007 the site\n${"x".repeat(400)}` }),
      row({ id: "appr-sys", kind: "system-agent", summary: undefined }),
      row({ id: "appr-other", kind: "allowlist" }),
      row({ id: "--help" }),
      row({ id: "has space" }),
      row({ id: 42 }),
      row({ id: "appr-time", createdAtMs: "yesterday" }),
      row({ id: "appr-huge", expiresAtMs: 1e20 }),
      row({ id: "appr-expired", expiresAtMs: now }),
      row({ id: "appr-old", summary: "a second entry with the same id" }),
      null,
      "appr-string"
    ]
  });
  const cards = parsePendingApprovals(text, now);
  assert.deepEqual(cards.map((card) => card.id), ["appr-new", "appr-sys", "appr-old"]);
  assert.deepEqual(cards[0], {
    id: "appr-new",
    kind: "plugin",
    summary: `Deploy: push the site ${"x".repeat(400)}`.slice(0, APPROVAL_SUMMARY_MAX),
    createdAt: new Date(now - 1000).toISOString(),
    expiresAt: new Date(now + 240000).toISOString(),
    sessionId: null,
    sessionKey: null
  });
  assert.equal(cards[0].summary.length, 300);
  assert.equal(cards[1].summary, "", "no summary is an empty one");
  assert.equal(cards[2].summary, "npm test", "the first entry with an id wins");
  assert.equal(cards[2].sessionKey, keyOf(S1), "kept for matching");
  assert.equal(cards[2].sessionId, null, "matched later, against the sessions open then");

  for (const bad of ["", "not json", "[]", "{}", "null", '{"approvals":{}}', '{"approvals":"none"}']) {
    assert.deepEqual(parsePendingApprovals(bad, now), [], bad);
  }
  const afterLogLine = `[plugins] loaded 3\n${JSON.stringify({ approvals: [row({ id: "appr-1" })] })}\n`;
  assert.deepEqual(parsePendingApprovals(afterLogLine, now).map((card) => card.id), ["appr-1"], "a log line before the JSON");
  assert.deepEqual(parsePendingApprovals(pendingJson([fakeApproval({ id: "appr-now" })])).map((card) => card.id), ["appr-now"], "now defaults to the clock");
});

test("matchApprovalSession: the open OpenClaw session whose agentos-<id> is in the sessionKey, else null", () => {
  const open = [{ id: S1 }, { id: S2 }];
  assert.equal(matchApprovalSession(keyOf(S2), open), S2);
  assert.equal(matchApprovalSession(`agentos-${S1}`, open), S1);
  assert.equal(matchApprovalSession(keyOf(S1).toUpperCase(), open), S1, "OpenClaw may spell the key in capitals");
  assert.equal(matchApprovalSession(keyOf(S3), open), null, "an Agent OS session that is not open");
  assert.equal(matchApprovalSession("agent:main:telegram:4711", open), null);
  for (const key of [null, undefined, "", 42]) assert.equal(matchApprovalSession(key, open), null);
  assert.equal(matchApprovalSession(keyOf(S1), []), null);
  assert.equal(matchApprovalSession(keyOf(S1), null), null);
});

test("OpenClaw is asked only while an OpenClaw session is open: one call at a time, with that session's own command, environment and folder, the next call an interval after the last one ended", async () => {
  const manager = fakeManager();
  const cli = fakeCli(async () => {
    await delay(60);
    return listed([]);
  });
  const approvals = createOpenclawApprovals({ manager, runCli: cli.run, intervalMs: 40 });
  try {
    manager.open(S3, { agentId: "codex" });
    await delay(200);
    assert.equal(cli.calls.length, 0, "no OpenClaw session open (a Codex session does not count): no call at all");
    assert.deepEqual(approvals.snapshot(), { approvals: [], error: null });

    manager.open(S1);
    await waitFor(() => cli.calls.filter((call) => call.endedAt).length >= 4);
    manager.open(S2);
    await waitFor(() => cli.calls.filter((call) => call.endedAt).length >= 7);
    assert.equal(cli.maxRunning(), 1, "never two calls at once, also with two OpenClaw sessions open");
    for (const call of cli.calls) {
      assert.equal(call.command, "/fake/bin/openclaw");
      assert.deepEqual(call.args, ["approvals", "pending", "--json"], "never a Gateway address or token");
      assert.deepEqual(call.options.env, manager.profileOf(S1).env, "the session's own environment, never the server's");
      assert.equal(call.options.cwd, HOME);
      assert.ok(call.options.signal instanceof AbortSignal, "every call can be cut off");
    }
    const ended = cli.calls.filter((call) => call.endedAt);
    for (let index = 1; index < ended.length; index += 1) {
      const gap = ended[index].startedAt - ended[index - 1].endedAt;
      assert.ok(gap >= 38, `call ${index} started ${gap} ms after the one before it ended`);
    }

    manager.close(S1);
    manager.close(S2);
    await delay(120);
    const count = cli.calls.length;
    await delay(300);
    assert.equal(cli.calls.length, count, "the last OpenClaw session ended: no more calls");
    assert.deepEqual(approvals.snapshot(), { approvals: [], error: null });
  } finally {
    await approvals.stop();
  }
  assert.deepEqual([APPROVALS_POLL_MS, APPROVALS_CALL_LIMIT_MS], [3000, 10000], "the defaults: every 3 s, 10 s each (R16)");
});

test("each call is cut off at its limit; a poll that fails, is cut off or prints something else shows the poll-failed note, keeps the last good list and changes no alert, and the next good poll clears the note", async () => {
  const manager = fakeManager();
  manager.open(S1);
  const row = fakeApproval({ id: "appr-a", sessionKey: keyOf(S1), summary: "rm -rf build" });
  const script = [
    () => listed([row]),
    cutOff,
    () => ({ ok: false, code: 1, aborted: false, stdout: "" }),
    () => ({ ok: true, code: 0, aborted: false, stdout: "Gateway: hello" }),
    () => listed([row])
  ];
  // The list at the start of each call: what the call before it left.
  const seen = [];
  let approvals = null;
  const cli = fakeCli(async (args, options, call) => {
    const index = cli.calls.indexOf(call);
    seen.push(approvals.snapshot());
    return (script[index] ?? script.at(-1))(args, options);
  });
  approvals = createOpenclawApprovals({ manager, runCli: cli.run, intervalMs: 20, limitMs: 60 });
  try {
    await waitFor(() => seen.length >= 6);
    const card = cardOf(row, S1);
    assert.deepEqual(seen.slice(0, 6), [
      { approvals: [], error: null },
      { approvals: [card], error: null },
      { approvals: [card], error: POLL_FAILED },
      { approvals: [card], error: POLL_FAILED },
      { approvals: [card], error: POLL_FAILED },
      { approvals: [card], error: null }
    ]);
    const cut = cli.calls[1];
    assert.equal(cut.options.signal.aborted, true, "the call was cut off");
    const took = cut.endedAt - cut.startedAt;
    assert.ok(took >= 50 && took < 1000, `${took} ms`);
    assert.deepEqual(manager.signals, [{ id: S1, kind: "approval", text: "rm -rf build", source: "openclaw" }], "a failed poll neither resolves nor repeats the alert");
  } finally {
    await approvals.stop();
  }
});

test("a matched approval alerts only its own session and an unmatched one every open OpenClaw session (its card has no session); each approval alerts a session once, and the alert resolves when nothing is pending for it", async () => {
  const manager = fakeManager();
  manager.open(S1);
  manager.open(S2);
  const t = Date.now();
  const a = fakeApproval({ id: "appr-a", sessionKey: keyOf(S1), summary: "npm run deploy", createdAtMs: t - 2000, expiresAtMs: t + 300000 });
  const b = fakeApproval({ id: "appr-b", kind: "plugin", sessionKey: "agent:main:telegram:4711", summary: "Browser: open example.com", createdAtMs: t - 1000, expiresAtMs: t + 300000 });
  const polls = [[a], [a], [b, a], [b, a], [], []];
  // At the start of each call: the signals so far and the list, as the poll before it left them.
  const before = [];
  let approvals = null;
  const cli = fakeCli(async (_args, _options, call) => {
    const index = cli.calls.indexOf(call);
    if (index === 3) manager.input(S1); // the person types in S1's terminal
    before.push({ signals: manager.signals.length, cards: approvals.snapshot().approvals });
    return listed(polls[Math.min(index, polls.length - 1)]);
  });
  approvals = createOpenclawApprovals({ manager, runCli: cli.run, intervalMs: 20 });
  try {
    await waitFor(() => before.length >= polls.length + 1);
    assert.deepEqual(manager.signals, [
      { id: S1, kind: "approval", text: "npm run deploy", source: "openclaw" },
      { id: S1, kind: "approval", text: "Browser: open example.com", source: "openclaw" },
      { id: S2, kind: "approval", text: "Browser: open example.com", source: "openclaw" },
      { id: S2, kind: "resolved", text: "", source: "openclaw" }
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(
      before.slice(0, 7).map((entry) => entry.signals),
      [0, 1, 1, 3, 3, 4, 4],
      "poll 1: S1; poll 3: the new unmatched one for both; poll 4 after S1's input: nothing again; poll 5: S2 resolves (S1's alert is already gone)"
    );
    assert.deepEqual(before[3].cards, [cardOf(b, null), cardOf(a, S1)], "newest first; the unmatched card has no session");
    assert.deepEqual(before[6].cards, []);
    assert.deepEqual(cli.resolves(), [], "nothing was answered");
  } finally {
    await approvals.stop();
  }
});

test("resolve sends only Allow once or Deny, only for an approval in the latest list and one at a time; it runs `openclaw approvals resolve <id> <decision>` once and asks for the list again at once", async () => {
  const manager = fakeManager();
  manager.open(S1);
  const row = fakeApproval({ id: "appr-r1", sessionKey: keyOf(S1) });
  const expiring = fakeApproval({ id: "appr-old", expiresAtMs: Date.now() + 600 });
  let release = null;
  const cli = fakeCli(async (args) => {
    if (args[1] === "pending") return listed([row, expiring]);
    if (args[3] === "deny") await new Promise((resolve) => (release = resolve));
    return { ok: true, code: 0, aborted: false, stdout: `resolved ${args[2]} ${args[3]}\n`, stderr: "" };
  });
  const approvals = createOpenclawApprovals({ manager, runCli: cli.run, intervalMs: 60000 });
  try {
    await waitFor(() => approvals.snapshot().approvals.length === 2);
    assert.equal(cli.pending().length, 1, "one poll so far: the next one is a minute away");

    for (const decision of ["allow-always", "Allow once", "", undefined, null, 1, ["deny"]]) {
      await assert.rejects(approvals.resolve("appr-r1", decision), { status: 400, code: INVALID_DECISION.error, message: INVALID_DECISION.message });
    }
    for (const id of ["appr-nope", "", undefined, 42, { id: "appr-r1" }]) {
      await assert.rejects(approvals.resolve(id, "allow-once"), { status: 404, code: APPROVAL_MISSING.error, message: APPROVAL_MISSING.message });
    }
    assert.equal(cli.resolves().length, 0, "nothing was sent for a refused answer");

    assert.deepEqual(await approvals.resolve("appr-r1", "allow-once"), { message: null });
    const [sent] = cli.resolves();
    assert.equal(sent.command, "/fake/bin/openclaw");
    assert.deepEqual(sent.args, ["approvals", "resolve", "appr-r1", "allow-once"]);
    assert.deepEqual(sent.options.env, manager.profileOf(S1).env);
    assert.equal(sent.options.cwd, HOME);
    assert.equal(sent.options.captureStderr, true);
    assert.ok(sent.options.signal instanceof AbortSignal);
    await waitFor(() => cli.pending().length === 2, { timeoutMs: 1000 });

    // One at a time per approval (K16).
    const first = approvals.resolve("appr-r1", "deny");
    await waitFor(() => release !== null);
    await assert.rejects(approvals.resolve("appr-r1", "allow-once"), {
      status: 409,
      code: "approval_busy",
      message: "Agent OS is already sending your answer to this approval."
    });
    release();
    assert.deepEqual(await first, { message: null });

    // An approval past its expiry is not waiting any more.
    await waitFor(() => approvals.snapshot().approvals.length === 1);
    assert.deepEqual(approvals.snapshot().approvals.map((card) => card.id), ["appr-r1"]);
    await assert.rejects(approvals.resolve("appr-old", "deny"), { status: 404, code: "approval_missing" });
    // No OpenClaw session open: nothing is waiting.
    manager.close(S1);
    await assert.rejects(approvals.resolve("appr-r1", "deny"), { status: 404, code: "approval_missing" });
    assert.deepEqual(cli.resolves().map((call) => call.args[3]), ["allow-once", "deny"], "only the two clicks were sent");
  } finally {
    await approvals.stop();
  }
});

test("a refused answer comes back as plain text: OpenClaw's own words from stderr, else stdout, without colour codes and cut to 300 characters; no words, or no answer in time, get their own sentence", async () => {
  const manager = fakeManager();
  manager.open(S1);
  const row = fakeApproval({ id: "appr-e1", sessionKey: keyOf(S1) });
  let next = null;
  const cli = fakeCli(async (args, options) => (args[1] === "pending" ? listed([row]) : next(args, options)));
  const approvals = createOpenclawApprovals({ manager, runCli: cli.run, intervalMs: 60000, limitMs: 80 });
  const refusal = (fields) => () => ({ ok: false, code: 1, aborted: false, stdout: "", stderr: "", ...fields });
  try {
    await waitFor(() => approvals.snapshot().approvals.length === 1);
    const cases = [
      [refusal({ stderr: "\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m approval expired\n" }), "OpenClaw didn't take that answer: Error: approval expired"],
      [refusal({ stderr: "not allowed for this approval", stdout: "ignored" }), "OpenClaw didn't take that answer: not allowed for this approval"],
      [refusal({ stdout: "conflicting decision\r\n" }), "OpenClaw didn't take that answer: conflicting decision"],
      [refusal({ stderr: "  \n" }), "OpenClaw didn't take that answer and gave no reason."],
      [refusal({ stderr: "x".repeat(1000) }), `OpenClaw didn't take that answer: ${"x".repeat(300)}`],
      [
        () => {
          throw new Error("spawn EAGAIN");
        },
        "OpenClaw didn't take that answer and gave no reason."
      ],
      [cutOff, "OpenClaw didn't answer in time, so Agent OS can't tell whether your answer arrived."]
    ];
    for (const [answer, message] of cases) {
      next = answer;
      await assert.rejects(approvals.resolve("appr-e1", "deny"), { status: 409, code: "approval_failed", message });
    }
    assert.equal(cli.resolves().length, cases.length, "each answer ran once, and a refused one never leaves the approval busy");
  } finally {
    await approvals.stop();
  }
});

test("stop() ends polling: the running call is cut off, no call follows, the list empties and sessions opened later start nothing", async () => {
  const manager = fakeManager();
  manager.open(S1);
  const cli = fakeCli(cutOff);
  const approvals = createOpenclawApprovals({ manager, runCli: cli.run, intervalMs: 20 });
  await waitFor(() => cli.calls.length === 1);
  await approvals.stop();
  assert.equal(cli.calls[0].options.signal.aborted, true);
  await delay(150);
  assert.equal(cli.calls.length, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(approvals.snapshot(), { approvals: [], error: null });
  assert.equal(manager.listenerCount(), 0, "it no longer follows the sessions");
  manager.open(S2);
  await delay(100);
  assert.equal(cli.calls.length, 1);
});

test("source: the approvals module never sends the third decision, never adds a Gateway address or token, never reads the server's environment, and has one resolve command line", async () => {
  const source = await readFile(path.join(root, "server", "runtime", "sessions", "openclaw-approvals.js"), "utf8");

    .replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "")
    .replace(/^\s*\/\/.*$/gm, "")

test("runCli with captureStderr also collects stderr; without it the answer keeps its SP3 shape", SKIP_POSIX, async () => {
  const program = "process.stdout.write('out'); process.stderr.write('err text'); process.exitCode = 3;";
  const options = { env: { PATH: "/usr/bin:/bin" }, cwd: os.tmpdir() };
  assert.deepEqual(await runCli(process.execPath, ["-e", program], { ...options, captureStderr: true }), {
    ok: false,
    code: 3,
    aborted: false,
    stdout: "out",
    stderr: "err text"
  });
  assert.deepEqual(await runCli(process.execPath, ["-e", program], options), { ok: false, code: 3, aborted: false, stdout: "out" });
  const thrown = await runCli("/fake/bin/openclaw", ["approvals"], {
    ...options,
    captureStderr: true,
    spawn: () => {
      throw new Error("spawn EAGAIN");
    }
  });
  assert.deepEqual(thrown, { ok: false, code: null, aborted: false, stdout: "", stderr: "" });
  const controller = new AbortController();
  controller.abort();
  assert.deepEqual(await runCli(process.execPath, ["-e", program], { ...options, signal: controller.signal, captureStderr: true }), {
    ok: false,
    code: null,
    aborted: true,
    stdout: "",
    stderr: ""
  });
});

test("the fake openclaw answers `approvals pending --json` and `approvals resolve` by its two knobs and logs every call", SKIP_POSIX, async () => {
  const home = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-approvals-fake-")));
  try {
    const bin = path.join(home, "fake-bin");
    const logFile = path.join(home, "fake.log");
    await makeFakeAgentBin(bin, { names: ["openclaw"] });
    const env = { PATH: [bin, ...SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS].join(path.delimiter), HOME: home, FAKE_AGENT_LOG: logFile };
    const openclaw = path.join(bin, "openclaw");
    const call = (args, extra = {}) => runCli(openclaw, args, { env, cwd: home, captureStderr: true, ...extra });

    assert.deepEqual(await call(["approvals", "pending", "--json"]), { ok: true, code: 0, aborted: false, stdout: '{"approvals":[]}\n', stderr: "" });
    await setFakeApprovals(home, [fakeApproval({ id: "appr-f1" })]);
    const answered = await call(["approvals", "pending", "--json"]);
    assert.deepEqual(parsePendingApprovals(answered.stdout).map((card) => card.id), ["appr-f1"]);
    await setFakeApprovals(home, "fail");
    assert.deepEqual(await call(["approvals", "pending", "--json"]), { ok: false, code: 1, aborted: false, stdout: "", stderr: "gateway not running\n" });

    assert.deepEqual(await call(["approvals", "resolve", "appr-f1", "deny"]), { ok: true, code: 0, aborted: false, stdout: "resolved appr-f1 deny\n", stderr: "" });
    await setFakeResolve(home, "fail");
    assert.deepEqual(await call(["approvals", "resolve", "appr-f1", "allow-once"]), { ok: false, code: 1, aborted: false, stdout: "", stderr: "approval expired\n" });

    // "slow" never answers in time: cutting the call off ends the fake.
    await setFakeApprovals(home, "slow");
    const controller = new AbortController();
    let pid = null;
    const slow = call(["approvals", "pending", "--json"], { signal: controller.signal, onSpawn: (spawned) => (pid = spawned) });
    await waitFor(() => pid !== null);
    setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 300);
    assert.equal((await slow).aborted, true);
    await waitFor(() => !isAlive(pid), { timeoutMs: 3000 });

    const entries = await readFakeLog(logFile);
    assert.deepEqual(entries.map((entry) => entry.event), ["approvals-pending", "approvals-pending", "approvals-pending", "approvals-resolve", "approvals-resolve", "approvals-pending"]);
    assert.deepEqual(
      entries.filter((entry) => entry.event === "approvals-resolve").map((entry) => [entry.id, entry.decision, entry.argv]),
      [
        ["appr-f1", "deny", ["approvals", "resolve", "appr-f1", "deny"]],
        ["appr-f1", "allow-once", ["approvals", "resolve", "appr-f1", "allow-once"]]
      ]
    );
  } finally {
    await rm(home, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 5, retryDelay: 100 });
  }
});

test("GET /api/sessions/approvals and POST /api/sessions/approvals/resolve: fixed paths ahead of :id, the contract's answers, nothing answerable without the poller, and neither address outside local mode", async () => {
  const card = { id: "appr-1", kind: "exec", summary: "npm test", createdAt: "2026-10-29T10:00:00.000Z", expiresAt: "2026-10-29T10:05:00.000Z", sessionId: null };
  const calls = [];
  const approvals = {
    snapshot: () => ({ approvals: [card], error: POLL_FAILED }),
    async resolve(id, decision) {
      calls.push([id, decision]);
      if (decision === "deny") return { message: null };
      throw sessionError(409, "approval_failed", "OpenClaw didn't take that answer: approval expired");
    },
    stop: async () => {}
  };
  await withRouterApp(approvals, async (api) => {
    assert.deepEqual(await api("GET", "/api/sessions/approvals"), { status: 200, body: { approvals: [card], error: POLL_FAILED } });
    assert.deepEqual(await api("POST", "/api/sessions/approvals/resolve", { id: "appr-1", decision: "deny" }), { status: 200, body: { ok: true, message: null } });
    assert.deepEqual(await api("POST", "/api/sessions/approvals/resolve", { id: "appr-1", decision: "allow-once" }), {
      status: 409,
      body: { error: "approval_failed", message: "OpenClaw didn't take that answer: approval expired" }
    });
    await api("POST", "/api/sessions/approvals/resolve", ["appr-1", "deny"]);
    assert.equal((await api("GET", "/api/sessions/approvals/resolve")).status, 404, "only a POST answers");
    assert.deepEqual(calls, [["appr-1", "deny"], ["appr-1", "allow-once"], [undefined, undefined]], "only the body's two fields reach it");
  });
  await withRouterApp(null, async (api) => {
    assert.deepEqual(await api("GET", "/api/sessions/approvals"), { status: 200, body: { approvals: [], error: null } });
    assert.deepEqual(await api("POST", "/api/sessions/approvals/resolve", { id: "appr-1", decision: "deny" }), { status: 404, body: APPROVAL_MISSING });
    assert.deepEqual(await api("POST", "/api/sessions/approvals/resolve", { id: "appr-1", decision: "allow-always" }), { status: 400, body: INVALID_DECISION });
  });
  await withEnv(NOT_LOCAL, () =>
    withRouterApp(approvals, async (api) => {
      assert.deepEqual(await api("GET", "/api/sessions/approvals"), { status: 404, body: { error: "not_available" } });
      assert.deepEqual(await api("POST", "/api/sessions/approvals/resolve", { id: "appr-1", decision: "deny" }), { status: 404, body: { error: "not_available" } });
    })
  );
  assert.equal(calls.length, 3, "outside local mode the poller is never asked");
});

test("end to end with the fake OpenClaw CLI: an approval for this session makes it wait and shows on its card, nothing is answered before the click, Allow once sends `approvals resolve <id> allow-once` once, the alert clears when OpenClaw stops listing it, and polling ends with the session", SKIP_POSIX, async () => {
  const home = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-approvals-home-")));
  const agentOsHome = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-approvals-data-")));
  const bin = path.join(home, "fake-bin");
  const logFile = path.join(home, "fake.log");
  const pendingCalls = async () => (await readFakeLog(logFile)).filter((entry) => entry.event === "approvals-pending");
  const resolveCalls = async () => (await readFakeLog(logFile)).filter((entry) => entry.event === "approvals-resolve");
  try {
    await makeFakeAgentBin(bin);
    await withEnv(
      {
        HOME: home,
        USERPROFILE: home,
        AGENT_OS_HOME: agentOsHome,
        HERMES_AGENT_OS_HOME: undefined,
        AGENT_OS_MANAGED_ROOT: path.join(home, ".agent-os"),
        SHELL: FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL,
        PATH: [bin, ...SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS].join(path.delimiter),
        HERMES_AGENT_OS_EXECUTABLE_PATHS: undefined,
        FAKE_AGENT_LOG: logFile,
        FAKE_AGENT_MODE: undefined,
        HERMES_HOME: undefined,
        HERMES_AGENT_OS_ENABLE_EXEC: undefined,
        DEMO_PUBLIC: undefined,
        HERMES_AGENT_OS_DEMO_PUBLIC: undefined,
        HERMES_AGENT_OS_PUBLIC_MODE: undefined,
        HERMES_AGENT_OS_REQUIRE_AUTH: undefined,
        // The server's own token: it must never reach OpenClaw.
        AGENT_OS_TOKEN: "must-not-reach-openclaw"
      },
      async () => {
        assert.equal(os.homedir(), home, "tests must never see the real home folder");
        clearDetectCaches();
        resetLoginShellEnvForTests();
        await setExecutionGateStatus({ enabled: true, reason: "approvals test" });
        const manager = createSessionManager();
        const approvals = createOpenclawApprovals({ manager, intervalMs: 150 });
        const app = express();
        app.use(express.json());
        app.use("/api/sessions", requireLocalMode, createSessionsRouter({ manager, approvals }));
        const server = await new Promise((resolve) => {
          const listening = app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve(listening));
        });
        const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
        const api = (method, url, body) => request(base, method, url, body);
        let id = null;
        try {
          await delay(450);
          assert.equal((await pendingCalls()).length, 0, "no OpenClaw session open: OpenClaw is never asked");

          id = (await manager.create({ agentId: "openclaw", folder: null })).id;
          await waitFor(async () => (await pendingCalls()).length >= 1);
          assert.deepEqual((await api("GET", "/api/sessions/approvals")).body, { approvals: [], error: null });

          const row = fakeApproval({ id: "appr-e2e-1", kind: "plugin", sessionKey: keyOf(id), summary: "Deploy:\u0007 push the site" });
          await setFakeApprovals(home, [row]);
          await waitFor(async () => (await manager.get(id)).alert?.kind === "approval");
          const waiting = await manager.get(id);
          assert.equal(waiting.status, "waiting");
          assert.equal(waiting.alert.text, "Deploy: push the site");
          assert.deepEqual((await api("GET", "/api/sessions/approvals")).body, {
            approvals: [{ ...cardOf(row, id), summary: "Deploy: push the site" }],
            error: null
          });

          // Resolve only on the click: three more polls, and still nothing was answered.
          const soFar = (await pendingCalls()).length;
          await waitFor(async () => (await pendingCalls()).length >= soFar + 3);
          assert.deepEqual(await resolveCalls(), []);
          assert.equal((await manager.get(id)).status, "waiting", "the alert stays while the approval waits");

          // The third decision never reaches OpenClaw.
          assert.deepEqual(await api("POST", "/api/sessions/approvals/resolve", { id: "appr-e2e-1", decision: "allow-always" }), { status: 400, body: INVALID_DECISION });
          assert.deepEqual(await resolveCalls(), []);

          // The click.
          assert.deepEqual(await api("POST", "/api/sessions/approvals/resolve", { id: "appr-e2e-1", decision: "allow-once" }), { status: 200, body: { ok: true, message: null } });
          assert.deepEqual(
            (await resolveCalls()).map((entry) => [entry.id, entry.decision, entry.argv]),
            [["appr-e2e-1", "allow-once", ["approvals", "resolve", "appr-e2e-1", "allow-once"]]]
          );

          // OpenClaw stops listing it: the alert clears and the card goes.
          await setFakeApprovals(home, []);
          await waitFor(async () => (await manager.get(id)).alert === null);
          assert.notEqual((await manager.get(id)).status, "waiting");
          await waitFor(async () => (await api("GET", "/api/sessions/approvals")).body.approvals.length === 0);

          // A refused answer comes back in OpenClaw's own words.
          await setFakeApprovals(home, [fakeApproval({ id: "appr-e2e-2", sessionKey: keyOf(id) })]);
          await setFakeResolve(home, "fail");
          await waitFor(async () => (await api("GET", "/api/sessions/approvals")).body.approvals.some((card) => card.id === "appr-e2e-2"));
          assert.deepEqual(await api("POST", "/api/sessions/approvals/resolve", { id: "appr-e2e-2", decision: "deny" }), {
            status: 409,
            body: { error: "approval_failed", message: "OpenClaw didn't take that answer: approval expired" }
          });

          // The Gateway is down: the note, and the last list stays.
          await setFakeApprovals(home, "fail");
          await waitFor(async () => (await api("GET", "/api/sessions/approvals")).body.error !== null);
          const down = (await api("GET", "/api/sessions/approvals")).body;
          assert.equal(down.error, POLL_FAILED);
          assert.deepEqual(down.approvals.map((card) => card.id), ["appr-e2e-2"]);

          // Every call had the session's own environment (never the server's token), its folder, and no Gateway address or token.
          for (const entry of [...(await pendingCalls()), ...(await resolveCalls())]) {
            assert.deepEqual(entry.agentOsKeys, ["AGENT_OS_SESSION_ID"], "the session's environment, not the server's");
            assert.equal(entry.cwd, home);
            assert.ok(!entry.argv.some((arg) => arg.startsWith("--url") || arg.startsWith("--token")), entry.argv.join(" "));
          }

          // The session ends: polling stops and the list empties.
          await manager.stop(id, { by: "stop" });
          await waitFor(() => manager.liveAgentSessions("openclaw").length === 0);

          assert.deepEqual((await api("GET", "/api/sessions/approvals")).body, { approvals: [], error: null });
        } finally {
          await approvals.stop();
          await manager.shutdownAll({ reason: "quit" });
          if (id) {

              async () => {

                  return JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(agentOsHome, "sessions", id, "meta.json"), "utf8")).status === "exited";

                  return false;
                }
              },
              { timeoutMs: 5000 }
            ).catch(() => {});
          }
          server.closeAllConnections?.();
          await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve));
          resetLoginShellEnvForTests();
          clearDetectCaches();
        }
      }
    );
  } finally {
    await rm(home, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 5, retryDelay: 100 });
    await rm(agentOsHome, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 5, retryDelay: 100 });
  }
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the approvals module.** Create `server/runtime/sessions/openclaw-approvals.js` with exactly this content:

```js
// OpenClaw approvals (spec "SP4 Session extras", the OpenClaw row of
// "Signals"; ruling R16; contract K11 and K16). While at least one OpenClaw
// session is open, Agent OS asks OpenClaw's own CLI which approvals wait at
// its Gateway: `openclaw approvals pending --json`, one call at a time, the
// next one APPROVALS_POLL_MS after the last one ended, each cut off after
// APPROVALS_CALL_LIMIT_MS. Every kind OpenClaw lists (exec, plugin,
// system-agent) becomes a card on the Safety page and in the session panel.
// The card never names a folder: OpenClaw's list has none (R16).
//
// - Matching: Agent OS starts OpenClaw as `openclaw tui --session
//   agentos-<id>`, so an approval whose sessionKey holds "agentos-<id>" of an
//   open OpenClaw session belongs to that session. Any other approval cannot
//   be told apart: it belongs to every open OpenClaw session, and its card has
//   sessionId null (the page says "from OpenClaw"; K11).
// - Signals: a session gets one approval signal when approvals it was not
//   told about appear (the text is the newest one's summary), and a resolved
//   signal once nothing is pending for it while its alert is an approval.
//   User input clears the alert as it clears every alert (Session activity
//   states); the card stays until OpenClaw stops listing the approval.
// - Answers: only the person's click reaches resolve() (POST
//   /api/sessions/approvals/resolve), and only Allow once or Deny is ever
//   sent. Nothing here answers by itself (spec Security 6).
//
// Every call is argv only through runCli, with an open OpenClaw session's own
// command, environment and folder, never the server's environment (which
// holds AGENT_OS_TOKEN), and never with a Gateway address or token of Agent
// OS's own: OpenClaw finds its Gateway as it does in Terminal. The output is
// read for the named fields and then dropped.
import { sessionError } from "./errors.js";
import { cleanAlertText } from "./signals.js";
import { runCli as defaultRunCli } from "./soft-stop.js";

export const APPROVALS_POLL_MS = 3000;
export const APPROVALS_CALL_LIMIT_MS = 10000;
export const APPROVAL_DECISIONS = Object.freeze(["allow-once", "deny"]);
export const APPROVAL_SUMMARY_MAX = 300;

// The kinds `approvals pending` lists (OpenClaw 2026.10.4).
const APPROVAL_KINDS = new Set(["exec", "plugin", "system-agent"]);
// An id Agent OS passes back to `approvals resolve`: OpenClaw's own, never
// one that could read as an option or holds a space or a control character.
const APPROVAL_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._:@+=\/-]{0,199}$/;
// The range of a JavaScript date: toISOString throws outside it.
const MAX_DATE_MS = 8.64e15;
// Colour and title sequences a CLI may print around its error text.
const TERMINAL_SEQUENCE = /\x1b(?:\[[0-?]*[ -\/]*[@-~]|\][^\x07\x1b]*(?:\x07|\x1b\\)?)/g;

const POLL_FAILED = "Agent OS couldn't read OpenClaw's approvals. Check that the OpenClaw Gateway is running on Agents.";
const INVALID_DECISION = "Agent OS only sends Allow once or Deny.";
const APPROVAL_MISSING = "That approval isn't waiting anymore.";
const APPROVAL_BUSY = "Agent OS is already sending your answer to this approval.";
const RESOLVE_NO_REASON = "OpenClaw didn't take that answer and gave no reason.";
const RESOLVE_TIMED_OUT = "OpenClaw didn't answer in time, so Agent OS can't tell whether your answer arrived.";

// The list in `openclaw approvals pending --json`, or null when the output is
// not that JSON. A CLI may print a log line before it, so a parse that fails
// is tried once more from the first line that starts with "{".
function approvalEntries(text) {
  const raw = String(text ?? "").trim();
  let parsed = null;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    const start = raw.search(/^\{/m);
    if (start > 0) {
      try {
        parsed = JSON.parse(raw.slice(start));
      } catch {
        parsed = null;
      }
    }
  }
  return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && Array.isArray(parsed.approvals) ? parsed.approvals : null;
}

function isoFromMs(value) {
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && Math.abs(value) <= MAX_DATE_MS ? new Date(value).toISOString() : null;
}

// Cards in OpenClaw's own words, newest first. An entry without a usable id,
// a known kind or numeric times, an expired one and a second entry with the
// same id are left out. sessionKey is kept for matching only.
function cardsFrom(entries, now) {
  const ids = new Set();
  const cards = [];
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object" || Array.isArray(entry)) continue;
    const { id, kind, createdAtMs, expiresAtMs } = entry;
    if (typeof id !== "string" || !APPROVAL_ID.test(id) || ids.has(id) || !APPROVAL_KINDS.has(kind)) continue;
    const createdAt = isoFromMs(createdAtMs);
    const expiresAt = isoFromMs(expiresAtMs);
    if (!createdAt || !expiresAt || expiresAtMs <= now) continue;
    ids.add(id);
    cards.push({
      id,
      kind,
      summary: cleanAlertText(typeof entry.summary === "string" ? entry.summary : "", APPROVAL_SUMMARY_MAX),
      createdAt,
      expiresAt,
      sessionId: null,
      sessionKey: typeof entry.sessionKey === "string" ? entry.sessionKey : null
    });
  }
  return cards.sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.createdAt) - Date.parse(a.createdAt));
}

export function parsePendingApprovals(text, now = Date.now()) {
  return cardsFrom(approvalEntries(text) ?? [], now);
}

export function matchApprovalSession(sessionKey, openSessions) {
  if (typeof sessionKey !== "string" || !sessionKey) return null;
  const key = sessionKey.toLowerCase();
  for (const session of Array.isArray(openSessions) ? openSessions : []) {
    if (typeof session?.id === "string" && session.id && key.includes(`agentos-${session.id}`)) return session.id;
  }
  return null;
}

// The card as the page gets it (ApprovalCard): matched against the sessions
// open now, without the sessionKey.
function publicCard(card, sessions) {
  return {
    id: card.id,
    kind: card.kind,
    summary: card.summary,
    createdAt: card.createdAt,
    expiresAt: card.expiresAt,
    sessionId: matchApprovalSession(card.sessionKey, sessions)
  };
}

function cliText(value) {
  return cleanAlertText(String(value ?? "").replace(TERMINAL_SEQUENCE, ""), APPROVAL_SUMMARY_MAX);
}

// The words of a refused answer (409 approval_failed): OpenClaw's own error
// text from stderr, else stdout; a call cut off at the limit, or one with no
// words, gets its own sentence.
function resolveFailure(result) {
  if (result?.aborted) return RESOLVE_TIMED_OUT;
  const text = cliText(result?.stderr) || cliText(result?.stdout);
  return text ? `OpenClaw didn't take that answer: ${text}` : RESOLVE_NO_REASON;
}

export function createOpenclawApprovals({
  manager,
  runCli = defaultRunCli,
  intervalMs = APPROVALS_POLL_MS,
  limitMs = APPROVALS_CALL_LIMIT_MS,
  now = Date.now
} = {}) {
  let latest = []; // the last good poll's cards, with their sessionKey
  let error = null; // POLL_FAILED after a poll that failed, until the next good one
  let timer = null;
  let inFlight = null; // the poll running now: { controller, done }
  let pollAgain = false; // a resolve asked for a poll as soon as the running one ends
  let stopped = false;
  // Session id -> the ids of the approvals that session was already told about.
  const told = new Map();
  // Approval ids with a resolve running (K16).
  const resolving = new Set();

  function openSessions() {
    let sessions = [];
    try {
      sessions = manager?.liveAgentSessions?.("openclaw");
    } catch {
      sessions = [];
    }
    return Array.isArray(sessions)
      ? sessions.filter((session) => typeof session?.id === "string" && session.id && session.status !== "exited")
      : [];
  }

  function currentCards(sessions) {
    const at = now();
    return latest.filter((card) => Date.parse(card.expiresAt) > at).map((card) => publicCard(card, sessions));
  }

  function forget() {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = null;
    pollAgain = false;
    latest = [];
    error = null;
    told.clear();
  }

  function schedule(delayMs) {
    if (stopped || timer || inFlight) return;
    if (openSessions().length === 0) {
      forget();
      return;
    }
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timer = null;
      poll().catch(() => {});
    }, delayMs);
    timer.unref?.();
  }

  function pollSoon() {
    if (stopped) return;
    if (inFlight) {
      pollAgain = true;
      return;
    }
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = null;
    schedule(0);
  }

  // One CLI call through the session's own command, environment and folder,
  // cut off after limitMs. Never rejects: null when the runner threw.
  async function callOpenclaw(session, args, controller, extra = {}) {
    const { command, env, cwd } = session.profile ?? {};
    const limit = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), limitMs);
    // Kept referenced: at most limitMs, and it is what ends a call that never answers (as X8's whenReadyForTyping).
    try {
      return await runCli(command, args, { env, cwd, signal: controller.signal, ...extra });
    } catch {
      return null;
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(limit);
    }
  }

  function apply(id, signal) {
    try {
      return manager.applySignal(id, signal) === true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // After a good poll: an approval signal for each session that has
  // approvals it was not told about (the newest one's summary), and a
  // resolved signal for a session whose alert is an approval while nothing
  // is pending for it any more.
  function signalSessions(sessions) {
    const cards = currentCards(sessions);
    const open = new Set(sessions.map((session) => session.id));
    for (const id of [...told.keys()]) if (!open.has(id)) told.delete(id);
    for (const session of sessions) {
      const mine = cards.filter((card) => card.sessionId === session.id || card.sessionId === null);
      const pendingIds = new Set(mine.map((card) => card.id));
      const known = new Set([...(told.get(session.id) ?? [])].filter((approvalId) => pendingIds.has(approvalId)));
      const fresh = mine.filter((card) => !known.has(card.id));
      if (fresh.length > 0) {
        if (apply(session.id, { kind: "approval", text: fresh[0].summary, source: "openclaw" })) {
          for (const card of fresh) known.add(card.id);
        }
      } else if (mine.length === 0 && session.alert?.kind === "approval") {
        apply(session.id, { kind: "resolved", text: "", source: "openclaw" });
      }
      if (known.size > 0) told.set(session.id, known);
      else told.delete(session.id);
    }
  }

  async function poll() {
    const sessions = openSessions();
    if (stopped || sessions.length === 0) {
      forget();
      return;
    }
    const controller = new AbortController();
    let finished = () => {};
    inFlight = { controller, done: new Promise((resolve) => (finished = resolve)) };
    const result = await callOpenclaw(sessions[0], ["approvals", "pending", "--json"], controller);
    inFlight = null;
    finished();
    if (stopped) return;
    try {
      const stillOpen = openSessions();
      if (stillOpen.length === 0) {
        forget();
        return;
      }
      const entries = result?.ok ? approvalEntries(result.stdout) : null;
      if (entries) {
        latest = cardsFrom(entries, now());
        error = null;
        signalSessions(stillOpen);
      } else {
        error = POLL_FAILED;
      }
    } catch {
      error = POLL_FAILED;
    }
    const soon = pollAgain;
    pollAgain = false;
    schedule(soon ? 0 : intervalMs);
  }

  function snapshot() {
    const sessions = openSessions();
    if (sessions.length === 0) return { approvals: [], error: null };
    return { approvals: currentCards(sessions), error };
  }

  async function resolve(id, decision) {
    if (!APPROVAL_DECISIONS.includes(decision)) throw sessionError(400, "invalid_decision", INVALID_DECISION);
    const sessions = openSessions();
    const card = typeof id === "string" ? currentCards(sessions).find((entry) => entry.id === id) : undefined;
    if (!card || sessions.length === 0) throw sessionError(404, "approval_missing", APPROVAL_MISSING);
    if (resolving.has(id)) throw sessionError(409, "approval_busy", APPROVAL_BUSY);
    resolving.add(id);
    const session = sessions.find((entry) => entry.id === card.sessionId) ?? sessions[0];
    let result = null;
    try {
      result = await callOpenclaw(session, ["approvals", "resolve", id, decision], new AbortController(), { captureStderr: true });
    } finally {
      resolving.delete(id);
      pollSoon();
    }
    if (result?.ok) return { message: null };
    throw sessionError(409, "approval_failed", resolveFailure(result));
  }

  function stop() {
    stopped = true;
    unsubscribe?.();
    const running = inFlight;
    running?.controller.abort();
    forget();
    return running ? running.done : Promise.resolve();
  }

  // Polling starts when the first OpenClaw session opens and ends with the
  // last one (schedule() keeps a timer or a running poll as it is).
  function sync() {
    if (!stopped) schedule(0);
  }

  const unsubscribe = typeof manager?.onLiveChange === "function" ? manager.onLiveChange(sync) : null;
  sync();
  return Object.freeze({ snapshot, resolve, stop });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Let runCli collect stderr when asked.** In `server/runtime/sessions/soft-stop.js`, replace the whole `runCli` function with exactly the code below. Replace from the comment line `// Runs one CLI call (argv only, never a shell, no input) with exactly the` down to the function's closing `}`, which sits right before `export async function runSoftStop({` (lines 57-119 at `548786d`):

```js
// Runs one CLI call (argv only, never a shell, no input) with exactly the
// environment it is handed. Never rejects: { ok, code, aborted, stdout }, plus
// `stderr` when `captureStderr` is true (SP4: OpenClaw's `approvals resolve`
// shows OpenClaw's own error text). Without it the program's stderr is
// ignored and the answer is exactly as before.
// When `signal` aborts, the call's whole process tree is killed, unless the
// call has already been seen exiting (its pid may belong to another process by
// then). The call is answered when the program EXITS (with the output
// collected so far, after a short tick for the last bytes to arrive), not only
// when its output closes: a helper the program left behind can hold the output
// open long after the program itself is gone. `spawn` is injectable for tests.
// `maxChars` stops collecting output once that many characters have arrived
// (the last chunk may run over), for a caller that only wants a short answer;
// it applies to stdout and stderr each.
export function runCli(
  command,
  args,
  { env, cwd, signal, onSpawn, spawn = spawnTracked, maxChars = MAX_CLI_OUTPUT_CHARS, captureStderr = false } = {}
) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let stderr = "";
    const answer = (result) => (captureStderr ? { ...result, stderr } : result);
    if (signal?.aborted) {
      resolve(answer({ ok: false, code: null, aborted: true, stdout: "" }));
      return;
    }
    let child;
    try {
      child = spawn(command, args, {
        cwd,
        env: env || {},
        stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", captureStderr ? "pipe" : "ignore"],
        windowsHide: true
      });
    } catch {
      resolve(answer({ ok: false, code: null, aborted: false, stdout: "" }));
      return;
    }
    let stdout = "";
    let settled = false;
    let exited = false;
    let flushTimer = null;
    const finish = (result) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      clearTimeout(flushTimer);
      signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
      // Let go of the output pipes: a helper that still holds the other end
      // must not keep this server's side open.
      child.stdout?.destroy();
      child.stderr?.destroy();
      resolve(answer(result));
    };
    function onAbort() {
      if (child.pid && !exited) killProcessTree(child.pid, { graceMs: CLI_KILL_GRACE_MS }).catch(() => {});
      finish({ ok: false, code: null, aborted: true, stdout });
    }
    // First, so that an 'error' (also one that comes later) is always handled.
    child.on("error", () => finish({ ok: false, code: null, aborted: false, stdout }));
    // Out of file handles (EMFILE, ENFILE): node reports the failure with an
    // 'error' event and makes no output stream at all.
    if (!child.stdout) {
      finish({ ok: false, code: null, aborted: false, stdout: "" });
      return;
    }
    if (child.pid) onSpawn?.(child.pid);
    signal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
    child.stdout.setEncoding("utf8");
    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
      if (stdout.length < maxChars) stdout += chunk;
    });
    if (captureStderr && child.stderr) {
      child.stderr.setEncoding("utf8");
      child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
        if (stderr.length < maxChars) stderr += chunk;
      });
    }
    child.once("exit", (code) => {
      exited = true;
      if (settled) return;
      flushTimer = setTimeout(() => finish({ ok: code === 0, code, aborted: false, stdout }), CLI_FLUSH_MS);
    });
    child.once("close", (code) => finish({ ok: code === 0, code, aborted: false, stdout }));
  });
}
```

```js
//                                        "resolved <id> <decision>" and exits 0; "fail" prints "approval
//                                        expired" on stderr and exits 1; "slow" waits 30 s, then exits 0
```

(b) Insert this right before the comment line `// The quick, non-interactive questions that agent detection and the Stop`:

```js
// OpenClaw's approvals (SP4, Task X3): `approvals pending --json` and `approvals resolve <id>
// <decision>`, picked by the two knobs in the header. Each call is logged first, never as a "probe"
// record (those are agent detection's questions).
const SLOW_APPROVALS_MS = 30 * 1000;

function finishWith(code, { stdoutText = "", stderrText = "" } = {}) {
  const exit = () => process.exit(code);
  const toStdout = () => (stdoutText ? process.stdout.write(`${stdoutText}\n`, exit) : exit());
  if (stderrText) process.stderr.write(`${stderrText}\n`, toStdout);
  else toStdout();
  return true;
}

function approvals() {
  if (args[1] === "pending") {
    const behaviour = knob("FAKE_OPENCLAW_APPROVALS");
    log({ event: "approvals-pending", ...argvRecord() });
    if (behaviour === "fail") return finishWith(1, { stderrText: "gateway not running" });
    const listedText = behaviour && behaviour !== "slow" ? behaviour : '{"approvals":[]}';
    if (behaviour === "slow") {
      setTimeout(() => finishWith(0, { stdoutText: listedText }), SLOW_APPROVALS_MS);
      return true;
    }
    return finishWith(0, { stdoutText: listedText });
  }
  if (args[1] === "resolve") {
    const behaviour = knob("FAKE_OPENCLAW_RESOLVE");
    const id = args[2] ?? null;
    const decision = args[3] ?? null;
    log({ event: "approvals-resolve", ...argvRecord(), id, decision });
    if (behaviour === "fail") return finishWith(1, { stderrText: "approval expired" });
    const done = () => finishWith(0, { stdoutText: `resolved ${id} ${decision}` });
    if (behaviour === "slow") {
      setTimeout(done, SLOW_APPROVALS_MS);
      return true;
    }
    return done();
  }
  return finishWith(1, { stderrText: `unknown approvals command: ${args.slice(1).join(" ")}` });
}
```
