```js
// Task U7 (SP4): the changes panel's pure logic (src/ui/changesShared.ts) and its wiring: which sessions show Files
// changed, how often the panel asks, the section's words in every state, one row's words, how a diff's lines are told
// apart, and that the diff dialog is read-only. Node strips the TypeScript types itself (decision P14), so the .ts file
// is imported directly; it keeps only `import type` imports. No server, no browser: the section and the dialog are
// checked on the page by the changes probe (.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/changes.mjs), the server's git reads by Task
// X7's test/sessions-changes.test.js, and getChanges / getDiff by test/sessions-api.test.js.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { test } from "node:test";
import * as ch from "../src/ui/changesShared.ts";

const read = (file) => readFileSync(new URL(`../${file}`, import.meta.url), "utf8");
const SPEC = read("docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-11-cobalt-redesign-and-real-terminals-design.md");
const AT = "2026-10-29T12:00:00.000Z";
const MINUS = "−";
const file = (over = {}) => ({ path: "src/app.ts", status: "modified", added: 12, removed: 3, ...over });
const result = (over = {}) => ({ git: true, files: [file()], total: 1, at: AT, ...over });
const ok = (data, stale = false) => (stale ? { state: "ok", data, stale: true } : { state: "ok", data });
const session = (over = {}) => ({ kind: "agent", status: "live", folderShown: true, ...over });

test("the not-git line is the spec's sentence, word for word; the other words are the decided ones and stay true", () => {
  assert.equal(ch.NOT_GIT_LINE, "Changes appear when this folder is a git project");
  assert.ok(SPEC.includes(`- not a git folder: "${ch.NOT_GIT_LINE}".`), "the spec's Changes panel line");
  // The prototype's words for an empty list (sessions.html), owner review at E1 (Q32).
  assert.equal(ch.NO_CHANGES_LINE, "No files changed in this session.");
  assert.equal(ch.NO_CHANGES_COPY_LINE, "No files changed in this copy yet.");
  // The Sessions page's own stale words, reused.
  assert.equal(ch.STALE_LINE, "Showing what was last known.");
  assert.ok(read("src/pages/SessionsPage.tsx").includes(ch.STALE_LINE), "the same words as the page's stale banner");
  // New sentences (Q32).
  assert.equal(ch.DIFF_LOADING, "Loading…");
  assert.equal(ch.DIFF_BINARY_LINE, "This is a binary file, so there is no text to show.");
  assert.equal(ch.DIFF_EMPTY_LINE, "There is no text difference to show for this file.");
  assert.equal(ch.DIFF_CUT_LINE, "This diff is long, so only its first 256 KB is shown.");
  // The cut sentence names the server's limit (Task X7), so the two must agree.
  assert.match(read("server/runtime/sessions/changes.js"), /export const DIFF_MAX_BYTES = 256 \* 1024\b/);
  for (const line of [ch.NOT_GIT_LINE, ch.NO_CHANGES_LINE, ch.NO_CHANGES_COPY_LINE, ch.STALE_LINE, ch.DIFF_BINARY_LINE, ch.DIFF_EMPTY_LINE, ch.DIFF_CUT_LINE]) {
    assert.doesNotMatch(line, /—/, `no em dash in "${line}"`);
  }
});

test("which sessions show Files changed, and how often the panel asks: every 3 s while it runs, never again once it has ended", () => {
  assert.equal(ch.CHANGES_UI_POLL_MS, 3000);
  assert.match(read("server/runtime/sessions/changes.js"), /export const CHANGES_POLL_MS = 3000\b/, "the panel asks as often as the server reads git");
  assert.equal(ch.showsChanges(session()), true);
  assert.equal(ch.showsChanges(session({ folderShown: false })), false, "OpenClaw picks its own folder: Agent OS can't say which files it changed");
  assert.equal(ch.showsChanges(session({ kind: "update" })), false);
  assert.equal(ch.showsChanges(session({ kind: "setup" })), false);
  assert.equal(ch.showsChanges(session({ status: "exited" })), true, "an ended session still shows what it changed");
  for (const status of ["starting", "live", "waiting", "idle", "held"]) assert.equal(ch.changesPollMs({ status }), 3000, status);
  assert.equal(ch.changesPollMs({ status: "exited" }), null, "ended: read once, no polling");
});

test("the section's words: loading, a first read that failed, not a git project, nothing changed (a copy says so), the files, more than 200, a failed read after a good one", () => {
  const waiting = { count: "…", line: null, files: [], more: null, stale: false };
  assert.deepEqual(ch.changesView({ state: "loading" }, { copy: false }), waiting);
  assert.deepEqual(ch.changesView(ok(result({ git: null, files: [], total: 0, at: null })), { copy: false }), waiting, "the server has not read git yet");
  assert.deepEqual(ch.changesView({ state: "error", message: "Couldn't reach Agent OS." }, { copy: false }), { ...waiting, line: "Couldn't reach Agent OS." });
  assert.deepEqual(ch.changesView(ok(result({ git: false, files: [], total: 0 })), { copy: false }), { count: null, line: ch.NOT_GIT_LINE, files: [], more: null, stale: false }, "not git: the line, and no count");
  assert.deepEqual(ch.changesView(ok(result({ files: [], total: 0 })), { copy: false }), { count: "0", line: ch.NO_CHANGES_LINE, files: [], more: null, stale: false });
  assert.equal(ch.changesView(ok(result({ files: [], total: 0 })), { copy: true }).line, ch.NO_CHANGES_COPY_LINE, "a separate copy (Task X9's copyOf)");
  const two = [file(), file({ path: "README.md", added: 1, removed: 0 })];
  assert.deepEqual(ch.changesView(ok(result({ files: two, total: 2 })), { copy: false }), { count: "2", line: null, files: two, more: null, stale: false });
  const capped = Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, i) => file({ path: `f${i}.ts` }));
  const big = ch.changesView(ok(result({ files: capped, total: 1234 })), { copy: false });
  assert.equal(big.count, "1234", "the count is every changed file");
  assert.equal(big.files.length, 200);
  assert.equal(big.more, "Showing 200 of 1234 files.");
  assert.equal(ch.changesView(ok({ git: true, files: two, at: AT }), { copy: false }).count, "2", "no total: the list's own length");
  assert.equal(ch.changesView(ok(result({ files: two, total: 1 })), { copy: false }).more, null, "a total below the list's length is not believed");
  const stale = ch.changesView(ok(result({ files: two, total: 2 }), true), { copy: false });
  assert.equal(stale.stale, true);
  assert.deepEqual(stale.files, two, "the last good list stays");
  assert.equal(ch.changesView(ok(result({ git: false, files: [], total: 0 }), true), { copy: false }).stale, true);
});

test("a row: the folder part and the name, + and − counts (a real minus sign), — when git can't count, the full path as its tooltip (a rename shows both), and its accessible name", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(ch.splitPath("src/ui/app.ts"), { dir: "src/ui/", name: "app.ts" });
  assert.deepEqual(ch.splitPath("README.md"), { dir: "", name: "README.md" });
  assert.deepEqual(ch.fileCounts(file()), { add: "+12", del: `${MINUS}3`, delZero: false });
  assert.deepEqual(ch.fileCounts(file({ added: 0, removed: 0 })), { add: "+0", del: `${MINUS}0`, delZero: true });
  assert.equal(ch.fileCounts(file({ added: null, removed: null })), null, "a binary file: git can't count its lines, the row shows —");
  assert.deepEqual(ch.fileCounts(file({ added: 3, removed: null })), { add: "+3", del: null, delZero: false }, "a count git didn't give is left out, never shown as 0");
  assert.equal(ch.fileCounts(file()).del.codePointAt(0), 0x2212, "a real minus sign, as in the prototype");
  assert.equal(ch.fileRowLabel(file()), "src/app.ts, 12 added, 3 removed");
  assert.equal(ch.fileRowLabel(file({ path: "notes/todo.txt", added: 3, removed: null })), "notes/todo.txt, 3 added");
  assert.equal(ch.fileRowLabel(file({ path: "logo.png", added: null, removed: null })), "logo.png, line counts unknown");
  assert.equal(ch.fileRowTitle(file()), "src/app.ts");
  assert.equal(ch.fileRowTitle(file({ status: "renamed", oldPath: "src/old.ts" })), "src/old.ts → src/app.ts");
});

test("diff lines: the header, hunk headers, added, removed and unchanged lines; a removed line that starts with -- stays removed; the next file starts a new header", () => {
  const diff = [
    "diff --git a/src/app.ts b/src/app.ts",
    "index 83db48f..bf269f4 100644",
    "--- a/src/app.ts",
    "+++ b/src/app.ts",
    "@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@",
    " const a = 1;",
    "-const b = 2;",
    "--- not a header, a removed line",
    "+const b = 3;\r",
    "+++ not a header, an added line",
    "\\ No newline at end of file",
    "diff --git a/README.md b/README.md",
    "--- a/README.md",
    "+++ b/README.md",
    "@@ -1 +1 @@",
    "-old",
    "+new",
    ""
  ].join("\n");
  const lines = ch.diffLines(diff);
  assert.deepEqual(
    lines.map((line) => line.kind),
    ["meta", "meta", "meta", "meta", "hunk", "context", "del", "del", "add", "add", "meta", "meta", "meta", "meta", "hunk", "del", "add"]
  );
  assert.equal(lines[8].text, "+const b = 3;", "a Windows line ending is not shown");
  assert.equal(lines.length, 17, "the final newline adds no empty line");
  assert.deepEqual(ch.diffLines(""), []);
});

test("a diff's notes: binary (no text at all), nothing to show, cut at the server's limit", () => {
  const text = "diff --git a/a b/a\n--- a/a\n+++ b/a\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-x\n+y\n";
  assert.deepEqual(ch.diffView({ diff: text, binary: false, cut: false }).notes, []);
  assert.equal(ch.diffView({ diff: text, binary: false, cut: false }).lines.length, 6);
  assert.deepEqual(ch.diffView({ diff: "Binary files a/logo.png and b/logo.png differ\n", binary: true, cut: false }), { lines: [], notes: [ch.DIFF_BINARY_LINE] });
  assert.deepEqual(ch.diffView({ diff: "", binary: false, cut: false }), { lines: [], notes: [ch.DIFF_EMPTY_LINE] });
  const cut = ch.diffView({ diff: text, binary: false, cut: true });
  assert.deepEqual(cut.notes, [ch.DIFF_CUT_LINE]);
  assert.equal(cut.lines.length, 6, "a cut diff still shows what came");
});

    assert.deepEqual(await api.getDiff(SID, "docs/a b#1.md"), answer);
    assert.deepEqual(calls, [{ url: `/api/sessions/${SID}/changes/diff?path=docs%2Fa%20b%231.md`, method: "GET" }], "the repo-relative path, encoded, in the query");
    fakeFetch(() => jsonAnswer(200, { path: "x", binary: false, cut: false }));
    await assert.rejects(api.getDiff(SID, "x"), /could not be read/, "no diff text: not an answer the dialog can show");
    fakeFetch(() => jsonAnswer(404, { error: "change_missing", message: MISSING }));
    const missing = await api.getDiff(SID, "x").catch((error) => error);
    assert.equal(api.changeMissing(missing), true);
    assert.equal(api.sessionProblem(missing), MISSING, "the server's own sentence");
    fakeFetch(() => jsonAnswer(404, { error: "unknown_session", message: "" }));
    assert.equal(api.changeMissing(await api.getDiff(SID, "x").catch((error) => error)), false, "only change_missing means the file left the list");
    assert.equal(api.changeMissing(new Error("change_missing")), false, "a plain error is not the server's answer");
  } finally {
    removeFakes();
  }

  assert.equal(api.SESSION_LIMITS_MS.diff, 25000);
  const clock = fakeClock();
  try {
    globalThis.fetch = () => new Promise(() => {});
    let outcome = null;
    void api.getDiff(SID, "src/app.ts").then(
      () => {
        outcome = "answered";
      },
      (error) => {
        outcome = error.message;
      }
    );
    clock.tick(24999);
    await flush();
    assert.equal(outcome, null, "still waiting just before 25 s");
    clock.tick(1);
    await flush();
    assert.equal(outcome, "Agent OS did not answer in time.");
  } finally {
    clock.restore();
    removeFakes();
  }
});
```

  total: number;
  // When git was read (ISO time); null before the first read.
  at: string | null;
}

export interface DiffResult {
  path: string;
  // The file's `git diff` as plain text (no colour); when `cut` is true, only its first 256 KB (DIFF_MAX_BYTES).

  binary: boolean;
  cut: boolean;

- [ ] **Step 5: Create `src/ui/changesShared.ts`** with exactly this content:

```ts
// The side panel's Files changed section and its read-only diff (spec "SP4 Session extras", Changes panel; Task U7):
// which sessions show the section, how often the panel asks, what the section says in each state, one row's words,
// and how a diff's lines are told apart for colour. The server reads git (server/runtime/sessions/changes.js, Task
// X7); the panel only shows its answer. `import type` only (decision P14): test/sessions-changes-ui-logic.test.js
// loads this file straight from src/.
import type { ChangedFile, ChangesResult, DiffResult, SessionSummary } from "../types";
import type { Source } from "./homeShared";

// The server reads git every 3 s while a session runs (CHANGES_POLL_MS, Task X7) and answers the route from its last
// read at once, so the panel asks at the same pace.
export const CHANGES_UI_POLL_MS = 3000;

// The spec's sentence, word for word ("not a git folder").
export const NOT_GIT_LINE = "Changes appear when this folder is a git project";
// The prototype's words for an empty list (sessions.html); owner review at E1 (Q32).
export const NO_CHANGES_LINE = "No files changed in this session.";
export const NO_CHANGES_COPY_LINE = "No files changed in this copy yet.";
// The Sessions page's own words for data kept after a failed read (its stale banner, SessionsPage.tsx).
export const STALE_LINE = "Showing what was last known.";
// The diff dialog's words; owner review at E1 (Q32). "Loading…" is the app's existing word (ModelPicker).
export const DIFF_LOADING = "Loading…";
export const DIFF_BINARY_LINE = "This is a binary file, so there is no text to show.";
export const DIFF_EMPTY_LINE = "There is no text difference to show for this file.";
// "256 KB" is the server's DIFF_MAX_BYTES (Task X7); the logic test keeps the two together.
export const DIFF_CUT_LINE = "This diff is long, so only its first 256 KB is shown.";

const MINUS = "−";

// Agent sessions only (update and setup sessions never reach the panel), and never while OpenClaw picks its own
// folder (the panel reads "Set by OpenClaw"): Agent OS can't say which files that session changed.
export function showsChanges(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "kind" | "folderShown">): boolean {
  return s.kind === "agent" && s.folderShown !== false;
}

// Every 3 s while the session runs; an ended session is read once, when its section appears (and once more right
// as it ends), and never again.
export function changesPollMs(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "status">): number | null {
  return s.status === "exited" ? null : CHANGES_UI_POLL_MS;
}

export interface ChangesView {
  // After "Files changed": the number of changed files, "…" while it is not known yet, null when not a git project.
  count: string | null;
  // The one line shown instead of rows: why the first read failed, not a git project, or nothing changed.
  line: string | null;
  // At most 200 rows (the server's cap).
  files: ChangedFile[];
  // "Showing 200 of 1234 files." when the server left files out; owner review at E1 (Q32).
  more: string | null;
  // A read failed after a good one: the last good list stays, under STALE_LINE.
  stale: boolean;
}

export function changesView(source: Source<ChangesResult>, { copy }: { copy: boolean }): ChangesView {
  const waiting: ChangesView = { count: "…", line: null, files: [], more: null, stale: false };
  if (source.state === "loading") return waiting;
  // No good read yet: the reason, in the words sessionProblem gave it. The panel keeps asking.
  if (source.state === "error") return { ...waiting, line: source.message };
  const stale = Boolean(source.stale);
  const { git, files } = source.data;
  if (git === null) return { ...waiting, stale };
  if (git === false) return { count: null, line: NOT_GIT_LINE, files: [], more: null, stale };
  // A server that leaves `total` out, or sends less than the list holds: the list's own length.
  const total = Number.isInteger(source.data.total) && source.data.total > files.length ? source.data.total : files.length;
  if (total === 0) return { count: "0", line: copy ? NO_CHANGES_COPY_LINE : NO_CHANGES_LINE, files: [], more: null, stale };
  const more = total > files.length ? `Showing ${files.length} of ${total} files.` : null;
  return { count: String(total), line: null, files, more, stale };
}

// "src/ui/app.ts" → the folder part "src/ui/" (drawn dimmer) and the name "app.ts".
export function splitPath(path: string): { dir: string; name: string } {
  const cut = path.lastIndexOf("/") + 1;
  return { dir: path.slice(0, cut), name: path.slice(cut) };
}

// A line count git gave, or null (git can't count a binary file's lines; a count that is not a whole number is not
// one either).
function lineCount(n: number | null | undefined): number | null {
  return typeof n === "number" && Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 0 ? n : null;
}

export interface FileCounts {
  // "+12", or null when git gave no added count.
  add: string | null;
  // "−3" with a real minus sign (U+2212), or null when git gave no removed count.
  del: string | null;
  // "−0" is drawn faint, as in the prototype.
  delZero: boolean;
}

// The row's + and − counts. null when git gave neither (a binary file): the row shows "—", the panel's word for
// unknown. A count git didn't give is left out, never shown as 0.
export function fileCounts(file: Pick<ChangedFile, "added" | "removed">): FileCounts | null {
  const added = lineCount(file.added);
  const removed = lineCount(file.removed);
  if (added === null && removed === null) return null;
  return { add: added === null ? null : `+${added}`, del: removed === null ? null : `${MINUS}${removed}`, delZero: removed === 0 };
}

// The row's accessible name (screen readers read words, not "+12 −3"); owner review at E1 (Q32).
export function fileRowLabel(file: Pick<ChangedFile, "path" | "added" | "removed">): string {
  const added = lineCount(file.added);
  const removed = lineCount(file.removed);
  if (added === null && removed === null) return `${file.path}, line counts unknown`;
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (added !== null) parts.push(`${added} added`);
  if (removed !== null) parts.push(`${removed} removed`);
  return `${file.path}, ${parts.join(", ")}`;
}

// The row's tooltip: the full path, since a long one ends in "…" on the row. A renamed file shows where it came from.
export function fileRowTitle(file: Pick<ChangedFile, "path" | "oldPath">): string {
  return file.oldPath ? `${file.oldPath} → ${file.path}` : file.path;
}

export type DiffLineKind = "meta" | "hunk" | "add" | "del" | "context";

export interface DiffLine {
  text: string;
  kind: DiffLineKind;
}

// One `git diff` split into lines, each with its kind for colour. Lines before a file's first "@@" are its header
// (meta), even one that starts with "---" or "+++"; inside a hunk the first character decides, so a removed line
// whose text starts with "--" stays a removed line. "diff --git" starts the next file's header. A line's Windows
// "\r" is not shown, and the final newline adds no empty line.
export function diffLines(diff: string): DiffLine[] {
  if (!diff) return [];
  const raw = diff.split("\n");
  if (raw[raw.length - 1] === "") raw.pop();
  let inHunk = false;
  return raw.map((line): DiffLine => {
    const text = line.endsWith("\r") ? line.slice(0, -1) : line;
    if (text.startsWith("diff --git ")) {
      inHunk = false;
      return { text, kind: "meta" };
    }
    if (text.startsWith("@@")) {
      inHunk = true;
      return { text, kind: "hunk" };
    }
    if (!inHunk || text.startsWith("\\")) return { text, kind: "meta" };
    if (text.startsWith("+")) return { text, kind: "add" };
    if (text.startsWith("-")) return { text, kind: "del" };
    return { text, kind: "context" };
  });
}

// What the dialog shows for an answer: the lines, and the notes above them (binary, nothing to show, cut).
export function diffView(result: Pick<DiffResult, "diff" | "binary" | "cut">): { lines: DiffLine[]; notes: string[] } {
  if (result.binary) return { lines: [], notes: [DIFF_BINARY_LINE] };
  const lines = diffLines(result.diff);
  const notes: string[] = [];
  if (lines.length === 0) notes.push(DIFF_EMPTY_LINE);
  if (result.cut) notes.push(DIFF_CUT_LINE);
  return { lines, notes };
}
```

export function deleteRecording(sessionId: string): Promise<{ ok: true }> {

}

// Files changed (SP4, Task U7): the server's last read of git in the session's folder (Task X7). The section asks every
// 3 s while the session runs; an ended session's list is read fresh by the server.
export async function getChanges(sessionId: string): Promise<ChangesResult> {
  const body = await withTimeout(request<ChangesResult>(sessionPath(sessionId, "/changes")), SESSION_LIMITS_MS.changes);
  if (!body || !Array.isArray(body.files)) throw new Error(UNREADABLE);
  return body;
}

// One changed file's diff, read-only. `path` is relative to the repository's top level, as the list gave it.
export async function getDiff(sessionId: string, path: string): Promise<DiffResult> {
  const body = await withTimeout(request<DiffResult>(sessionPath(sessionId, `/changes/diff?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`)), SESSION_LIMITS_MS.diff);
  if (!body || typeof body.diff !== "string") throw new Error(UNREADABLE);
  return body;
}

// The diff route's answer for a file that left the session's changes after the list was read (404 change_missing):
// the section then reads the list again.
export function changeMissing(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 404 && error.message === "change_missing";
}

- [ ] **Step 9: Create `src/ui/components/DiffDialog.tsx`** with exactly this content:

```tsx
// The changes panel's read-only diff (spec "SP4 Session extras", Changes panel: "click a file for a read-only diff";
// Task U7). It shows one file's `git diff` as the server read it (Task X7): added lines green, removed lines red, and
// every line keeps its own + or - so the colour is never the only sign. Nothing here can change a file: the diff is
// text in a box (focusable, so the keyboard can scroll it) and Close is the only button. It is AgentConfirmModal
// without a confirm button: Escape, Close or a click outside shuts it, Tab stays inside, and the focus goes back to
// the file's row. The diff is read once, when the dialog opens; it does not follow later edits.
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { changeMissing, getDiff, sessionProblem } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { ChangedFile, DiffResult } from "../../types";
import { DIFF_LOADING, diffView, splitPath } from "../changesShared";
import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";

type DiffState = { state: "loading" } | { state: "ok"; result: DiffResult } | { state: "error"; message: string };

export default function DiffDialog({
  sessionId,
  file,
  onClose,
  onGone
}: {
  sessionId: string;
  file: ChangedFile;
  onClose: () => void;
  // The file left the session's changes after the list was read (404 change_missing): the panel reads the list again.
  onGone: () => void;
}) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<DiffState>({ state: "loading" });
  const pathId = useId();
  const gone = useRef(onGone);
  gone.current = onGone;
  useEffect(() => {
    // The dialog can close before the answer comes: then nothing is updated.
    let alive = true;
    getDiff(sessionId, file.path).then(
      (result) => {
        if (alive) setValue({ state: "ok", result });
      },
      (error: unknown) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        setValue({ state: "error", message: sessionProblem(error) });
        if (changeMissing(error)) gone.current();
      }
    );
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [sessionId, file.path]);
  const view = value.state === "ok" ? diffView(value.result) : null;
  return (
    <AgentConfirmModal title={splitPath(file.path).name || file.path} onClose={onClose} cancelLabel="Close">
      <div className="os-diff-view">
        <p id={pathId} className="os-diff-view__path os-mono">
          {file.path}
        </p>
        {value.state === "loading" ? (
          <p className="os-diff-view__state" role="status">
            {DIFF_LOADING}
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {value.state === "error" ? (
          <p className="os-diff-view__state" role="alert">
            {value.message}
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {view?.notes.map((note) => (
          <p key={note} className="os-diff-view__note">
            {note}
          </p>
        ))}
        {view && view.lines.length ? (
          <pre className="os-diff" tabIndex={0} aria-labelledby={pathId}>
            {view.lines.map((line, index) => (
              <span key={index} className={`os-diff__line os-diff__line--${line.kind}`}>
                {line.text}
              </span>
            ))}
          </pre>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </AgentConfirmModal>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Create `src/ui/components/SessionChanges.tsx`** with exactly this content:

```tsx
// The side panel's Files changed section (spec "SP4 Session extras", Changes panel, and the side panel table's "Files
// changed | files with +/−"; Task U7). The server reads git in the session's folder (Task X7); this section shows its
// answer: one row per file with its + and − line counts, a click on a row opens that file's read-only diff
// (DiffDialog), and a folder that is not a git project gets the spec's one line. It asks every 3 s while the session
// runs (paused while the window is hidden, useInterval) and once when the session has ended, one read at a time with
// the newest answer winning (latestRead.ts), each read with a time limit (sessionsApi.ts). After a good read, a failed
// one keeps the list under the page's own stale words (SP2 lessons). The panel gives it key={session.id}, so another
// session never shows this one's list, even for a moment.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { File as FileIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { getChanges, sessionProblem } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { ChangedFile, ChangesResult, SessionSummary } from "../../types";
import { changesPollMs, changesView, fileCounts, fileRowLabel, fileRowTitle, showsChanges, splitPath, STALE_LINE } from "../changesShared";
import { failedLoad, loaded } from "../homeShared";
import type { Source } from "../homeShared";
import { createLatestRead } from "../latestRead";
import DiffDialog from "./DiffDialog";
import { useInterval } from "./useInterval";

export default function SessionChanges({ session }: { session: SessionSummary }) {
  if (!showsChanges(session)) return null;
  return <ChangesList session={session} />;
}

function ChangesList({ session }: { session: SessionSummary }) {
  const ended = session.status === "exited";
  const [source, setSource] = useState<Source<ChangesResult>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [reads] = useState(createLatestRead);
  // The file whose diff is open, or null.
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<ChangedFile | null>(null);
  const load = useCallback(
    (fresh: boolean) => {
      if (fresh) reads.cancel();
      void reads.run(
        () => getChanges(session.id),
        (outcome) => {
          if (outcome.ok) setSource(loaded(outcome.value));
          else setSource((prev) => failedLoad(prev, sessionProblem(outcome.error)));
        }
      );
    },
    [reads, session.id]
  );
  // A fresh read when the section appears, and again when the session ends (the list as the agent left it). A read
  // still waiting when the section goes away (another tab, a closed page) no longer counts.
  useEffect(() => {
    load(true);
    return () => reads.cancel();
  }, [load, reads, ended]);
  useInterval(() => load(false), changesPollMs(session));
  const view = changesView(source, { copy: Boolean(session.copyOf) });
  return (
    <section className="os-sess-panel__sec" aria-label="Files changed">
      <div className="os-sess-panel__rh">
        Files changed
        {view.count === null ? null : (
          <span className="os-sess-panel__hint os-mono">
            {view.count === "…" ? (
              <>
                <span aria-hidden="true">…</span>
                <span className="os-visually-hidden">loading</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              view.count
            )}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      {view.stale ? (
        <p className="os-sess-panel__note" role="status">
          {STALE_LINE}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {view.line ? <p className="os-sess-changes__line">{view.line}</p> : null}
      {view.files.length ? (
        <ul className="os-sess-changes" role="list">
          {view.files.map((file) => (
            <li key={file.path}>
              <FileRow file={file} onOpen={() => setOpen(file)} />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
      {view.more ? <p className="os-sess-changes__more">{view.more}</p> : null}
      {open ? <DiffDialog sessionId={session.id} file={open} onClose={() => setOpen(null)} onGone={() => load(true)} /> : null}
    </section>
  );
}

// One changed file: its icon, the path (the folder part dimmer; a long path ends in "…" and the tooltip has it all)
// and the + and − counts ("—" when git can't count, a binary file). The row's name says the counts in words.
function FileRow({ file, onOpen }: { file: ChangedFile; onOpen: () => void }) {
  const { dir, name } = splitPath(file.path);
  const counts = fileCounts(file);
  return (
    <button type="button" className="os-sess-file" onClick={onOpen} aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label={fileRowLabel(file)} title={fileRowTitle(file)}>
      <FileIcon size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
      <span className="os-sess-file__path">
        {dir ? <span className="os-sess-file__dir">{dir}</span> : null}
        {name}
      </span>
      <span className="os-sess-file__counts">
        {counts === null ? <span className="os-sess-file__zero">—</span> : null}
        {counts?.add ? <span className="os-sess-file__add">{counts.add}</span> : null}
        {counts?.del ? <span className={counts.delZero ? "os-sess-file__zero" : "os-sess-file__del"}>{counts.del}</span> : null}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 14: Write the probe.** Create `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/changes.mjs` (git-ignored) with exactly this content:

```js
// Task U7 (SP4): the side panel's Files changed section and its read-only diff, on the throwaway server, against real
// fake-agent sessions in real temp folders: a git project with four changes (an edited file, a deleted one, a new one
// and a changed binary) and a folder that is not a git project. The server's git reads are Task X7's. Page-level
// stubs (route) only for what a small project cannot produce on demand: more than 200 files, a failed read, a cut
// diff, a file that left the changes, an empty diff, and a session whose folder is not shown (OpenClaw's case).
// Run (after `npm run build`), from the worktree root:
//   node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/changes.mjs
// git runs here only inside folders under the throwaway HOME, with no system or global git config and no hooks, so
// nothing of the owner's is read or run. Nothing here starts a real agent; the probe stops every session it started.
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const SIZES = [[1280, 720], [1470, 956]];
const W = 1470, H = 956;
const NOT_GIT = "Changes appear when this folder is a git project";
const STALE = "Showing what was last known.";
const BINARY = "This is a binary file, so there is no text to show.";
const CUT = "This diff is long, so only its first 256 KB is shown.";
const EMPTY = "There is no text difference to show for this file.";
const MISSING = "That file isn't in this session's changes anymore.";
// The rows' accessible names (changesShared.ts fileRowLabel) for the four changes made below.
const APP = "src/app.js, 2 added, 1 removed";
const APP_AFTER = "src/app.js, 3 added, 1 removed";
const OLD = "old.txt, 0 added, 2 removed";
const LOGO = "logo.bin, line counts unknown";
// Task X7 counts a new text file's lines as added; its removed count may be 0 or left out.
const NOTES_ROW = /^notes\/todo\.txt, 3 added(, 0 removed)?$/;
const json = (route, body, status = 200) => route.fulfill({ status, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
// Chrome logs each refused request (the stubbed 500 and 404) as "Failed to load resource"; anything else is a real error.
const realErrors = (errors) => errors.filter((e) => !/Failed to load resource/.test(e));

export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail, api, HOME }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));
  if (!HOME) {
    fail("harness", "audit.mjs does not pass HOME to probes");
    return;
  }
  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const waitFor = async (fn, ms = 10000) => {
    const end = Date.now() + ms;
    while (Date.now() < end) {
      try { if (await fn()) return true; } catch {}
      await sleep(250);
    }
    return false;
  };

  // The project: committed first, then changed the way an agent would.
  const repo = path.join(HOME, "projects", "changes-app");
  const plain = path.join(HOME, "projects", "plain-notes");
  const gitEnv = { PATH: "/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin", HOME, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0", LC_ALL: "C" };
  const git = (...args) => execFileSync("git", ["-c", "user.name=Agent OS probe", "-c", "user.email=probe@example.invalid", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", ...args], { cwd: repo, env: gitEnv, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] });
  const ten = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => `line ${i + 1}`).join("\n") + "\n";
  mkdirSync(path.join(repo, "src"), { recursive: true });
  mkdirSync(plain, { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(path.join(repo, "src", "app.js"), ten);
  writeFileSync(path.join(repo, "old.txt"), "keep me\nor not\n");
  writeFileSync(path.join(repo, "logo.bin"), Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x00]));
  writeFileSync(path.join(plain, "notes.md"), "not a git project\n");
  git("init", "-q");
  git("add", "-A");
  git("commit", "-q", "-m", "start");
  // +2 −1 in src/app.js, old.txt deleted (−2), a new notes/todo.txt (3 lines), logo.bin changed (binary: no counts).
  writeFileSync(path.join(repo, "src", "app.js"), ten.replace("line 3\n", "line three\n") + "line 11\n");
  rmSync(path.join(repo, "old.txt"));
  mkdirSync(path.join(repo, "notes"));
  writeFileSync(path.join(repo, "notes", "todo.txt"), "one\ntwo\nthree\n");
  writeFileSync(path.join(repo, "logo.bin"), Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x00, 0x03, 0x04, 0x00]));

  const started = [];
  const startViaApi = async (agentId, folder) => {
    const made = await api("POST", "/api/sessions", { agentId, folder });
    const id = made.status < 300 && made.json.id ? made.json.id : "";
    if (id) started.push(id);
    return id;
  };
  const changesOf = async (id) => (await api("GET", `/api/sessions/${id}/changes`)).json;
  // allTextContents never waits, so a missing element reads "" at once instead of holding the probe up.
  const textOf = async (locator) => (await locator.allTextContents()).join(" ").trim();
  const panelOf = (tab) => tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Session details" });
  const sectionOf = (tab) => panelOf(tab).getByRole("region", { name: "Files changed" });
  const rowNamed = (tab, name) => sectionOf(tab).getByRole("button", typeof name === "string" ? { name, exact: true } : { name });
  const rowNames = (tab) => sectionOf(tab).getByRole("button").evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute("aria-label")).join(" | "));
  const headOf = (tab) => textOf(sectionOf(tab).locator(".os-sess-panel__rh"));
  const sideways = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth > document.scrollingElement.clientWidth);
  const focusName = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.getAttribute("aria-label") || document.activeElement?.tagName || "");
  const tokenColor = (tab, token) =>
    tab.evaluate((t) => {
      const el = document.createElement("span");
      el.style.color = `var(${t})`;
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      const color = getComputedStyle(el).color;
      el.remove();
      return color;
    }, token);
  const changesRequests = (tab, id) => {
    const seen = [];
    tab.on("request", (r) => {
      if (new URL(r.url()).pathname === `/api/sessions/${id}/changes`) seen.push(Date.now());
    });
    return seen;
  };

  try {
    const gitId = await startViaApi("claude", repo);
    check(Boolean(gitId), "setup: a Claude Code session in a git project", gitId);
    check(await waitFor(async () => { const c = await changesOf(gitId); return c.git === true && c.total === 4; }, 20000), "setup: the server sees the four changes", JSON.stringify(await changesOf(gitId)));

    // 1. The rows and the read-only diff, at the smallest supported size and at a common laptop size.
    for (const [w, h] of SIZES) {
      const at = `${w}x${h}`;
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, w, h, `sessions&session=${gitId}`);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await sectionOf(tab).getByRole("button").count()) === 4, 10000), `${at}: Files changed lists four files`, await textOf(sectionOf(tab)));
      check(/^Files changed\s*4$/.test(await headOf(tab)), `${at}: the heading reads Files changed, then the count`, await headOf(tab));
      const order = await panelOf(tab).evaluate((el) => [...el.querySelectorAll("section[aria-label]")].map((s) => s.getAttribute("aria-label")));
      check(order.indexOf("Live meter") >= 0 && order.indexOf("Files changed") > order.indexOf("Live meter"), `${at}: Files changed comes after the Live meter`, order.join(", "));
      for (const name of [APP, OLD, LOGO, NOTES_ROW]) check((await rowNamed(tab, name).count()) === 1, `${at}: a row named ${name}`, await rowNames(tab));
      const appText = (await rowNamed(tab, APP).textContent()) || "";
      check(appText.includes("src/") && appText.includes("app.js") && appText.includes("+2") && appText.includes("−1"), `${at}: the row shows the path and +2 −1`, appText);
      check(((await rowNamed(tab, LOGO).textContent()) || "").includes("—"), `${at}: a binary file's counts read —`);
      check((await rowNamed(tab, APP).getAttribute("title")) === "src/app.js", `${at}: the full path is the row's tooltip`);
      const add = await rowNamed(tab, APP).locator(".os-sess-file__add").evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).color);
      const del = await rowNamed(tab, APP).locator(".os-sess-file__del").evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).color);
      check(add === (await tokenColor(tab, "--os-ok")) && del === (await tokenColor(tab, "--os-danger")), `${at}: + is green and − is red, from the tokens`, `${add} ${del}`);
      check(!(await sideways(tab)), `${at}: no sideways scroll`);
      await sectionOf(tab).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
      await shot(tab, "changes", w, h, "panel");

      await rowNamed(tab, APP).click();
      const dialog = tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "app.js" });
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.locator(".os-diff__line--add").count()) >= 2, 10000), `${at}: the diff opens with its added lines`, await textOf(dialog));
      const adds = await dialog.locator(".os-diff__line--add").allTextContents();
      const dels = await dialog.locator(".os-diff__line--del").allTextContents();
      check(adds.includes("+line three") && adds.includes("+line 11"), `${at}: added lines, each with its +`, adds.join(" | "));
      check(dels.includes("-line 3"), `${at}: the removed line, with its -`, dels.join(" | "));
      check((await dialog.locator(".os-diff__line--hunk").count()) >= 1, `${at}: a hunk header`);
      check((await textOf(dialog.locator(".os-diff-view__path"))) === "src/app.js", `${at}: the full path under the title`);
      check(await waitFor(() => tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest('[role="dialog"]'))), 3000), `${at}: the focus is inside the dialog`);
      check(await dialog.evaluate((el) => el.querySelectorAll("textarea, input, [contenteditable]").length === 0 && !el.querySelector("pre")?.isContentEditable), `${at}: read-only: nothing in it can be typed into`);
      const buttons = (await dialog.getByRole("button").allTextContents()).map((t) => t.trim());
      check(buttons.length === 1 && buttons[0] === "Close", `${at}: Close is its only button`, buttons.join(", "));
      const box = await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Close" }).boundingBox();
      check(Boolean(box) && box.y + box.height <= h, `${at}: Close is on screen`, JSON.stringify(box));
      check(!(await sideways(tab)), `${at}: no sideways scroll with the diff open`);
      await shot(tab, "changes", w, h, "diff");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.count()) === 0, 3000), `${at}: Escape closes the diff`);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await focusName(tab)) === APP, 3000), `${at}: the focus goes back to the file's row`, await focusName(tab));

      await rowNamed(tab, LOGO).click();
      const bin = tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "logo.bin" });
      check(await waitFor(async () => await bin.getByText(BINARY, { exact: true }).isVisible(), 8000), `${at}: a binary file says so`, await textOf(bin));
      check((await bin.locator("pre").count()) === 0, `${at}: and shows no diff text`);
      await bin.getByRole("button", { name: "Close" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await focusName(tab)) === LOGO, 3000), `${at}: Close gives the focus back too`, await focusName(tab));
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, `${at}: console clean`, errors.join(" / "));
      await context.close();
    }

    // 2. Refresh: an edit on disk reaches the open panel by itself (the server reads git every 3 s; the panel asks every 3 s).
    {
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, `sessions&session=${gitId}`);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await rowNamed(tab, APP).count()) === 1, 10000), "refresh: setup: the src/app.js row is there", await rowNames(tab));
      appendFileSync(path.join(repo, "src", "app.js"), "line 12\n");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await rowNamed(tab, APP_AFTER).count()) === 1, 15000), "refresh: an edit on disk shows up without a reload", await rowNames(tab));
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "refresh: console clean", errors.join(" / "));
      await context.close();
    }

    // 3. A folder that is not a git project: the spec's line, no count, no rows.
    {
      const plainId = await startViaApi("codex", plain);
      check(Boolean(plainId), "not git: setup: a Codex session in a plain folder", plainId);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await changesOf(plainId)).git === false, 20000), "not git: setup: the server reads it as not a git project", JSON.stringify(await changesOf(plainId)));
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, `sessions&session=${plainId}`);
      check(await waitFor(async () => await sectionOf(tab).getByText(NOT_GIT, { exact: true }).isVisible(), 10000), "not git: the spec's line, word for word", await textOf(sectionOf(tab)));
      check((await sectionOf(tab).locator(".os-sess-panel__hint").count()) === 0, "not git: no count");
      check((await sectionOf(tab).getByRole("button").count()) === 0, "not git: no rows");
      await sectionOf(tab).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
      await shot(tab, "changes", W, H, "not-git");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "not git: console clean", errors.join(" / "));
      await context.close();
      await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${plainId}/stop`);
    }

    // 4. Stubbed answers: more than 200 files, a failed read after a good one, a cut diff, a file that left the
    //    changes, an empty diff.
    {
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, `sessions&session=${gitId}`);
      const changesUrl = (u) => u.pathname === `/api/sessions/${gitId}/changes`;
      const diffUrl = (u) => u.pathname === `/api/sessions/${gitId}/changes/diff`;
      const many = Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, i) => ({ path: `src/generated/file-${String(i + 1).padStart(3, "0")}.ts`, status: "untracked", added: i + 1, removed: 0 }));
      let listMode = "many";
      await tab.route(changesUrl, (route) => (listMode === "many" ? json(route, { git: true, files: many, total: 250, at: new Date().toISOString() }) : json(route, { error: "boom" }, 500)));
      await tab.reload();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await sectionOf(tab).getByRole("button").count()) === 200, 10000), "stubbed: at most 200 rows", await headOf(tab));
      check(/^Files changed\s*250$/.test(await headOf(tab)), "stubbed: the count is all 250", await headOf(tab));
      check(await sectionOf(tab).getByText("Showing 200 of 250 files.", { exact: true }).isVisible(), "stubbed: the line under the list says 200 of 250");
      check(await panelOf(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Stop session" }).isVisible(), "stubbed: Stop session stays in view under a long list");
      check(!(await sideways(tab)), "stubbed: no sideways scroll with 200 rows");
      await shot(tab, "changes", W, H, "capped");
      listMode = "fail";
      check(await waitFor(async () => await sectionOf(tab).getByText(STALE, { exact: true }).isVisible(), 10000), "stubbed: a failed read keeps the list under the stale note");
      check((await sectionOf(tab).getByRole("button").count()) === 200, "stubbed: the rows stay");
      await sectionOf(tab).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
      await shot(tab, "changes", W, H, "stale");
      await tab.unroute(changesUrl);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await sectionOf(tab).getByText(STALE, { exact: true }).count()) === 0 && (await sectionOf(tab).getByRole("button").count()) === 4, 10000), "stubbed: the next good read clears the note and brings the real list back", await rowNames(tab));

      let diffAnswer = { status: 200, body: {} };
      await tab.route(diffUrl, (route) => json(route, diffAnswer.body, diffAnswer.status));
      const openAppDiff = async () => {
        await rowNamed(tab, /^src\/app\.js, /).click();
        return tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "app.js" });
      };
      const longDiff = ["diff --git a/src/app.js b/src/app.js", "--- a/src/app.js", "+++ b/src/app.js", "@@ -1,1 +1,4000 @@", ...Array.from({ length: 4000 }, (_, i) => `+generated line ${i + 1}`)].join("\n");
      diffAnswer = { status: 200, body: { path: "src/app.js", diff: longDiff, binary: false, cut: true } };
      let dialog = await openAppDiff();
      check(await waitFor(async () => await dialog.getByText(CUT, { exact: true }).isVisible(), 8000), "stubbed: a cut diff says so", await textOf(dialog));
      const closeBox = await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Close" }).boundingBox();
      check(Boolean(closeBox) && closeBox.y + closeBox.height <= H, "stubbed: Close stays on screen with a long diff", JSON.stringify(closeBox));
      check(await dialog.locator("pre.os-diff").evaluate((el) => el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight), "stubbed: the long diff scrolls inside its own box");
      await shot(tab, "changes", W, H, "diff-cut");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
      await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.count()) === 0, 3000);

      const asked = changesRequests(tab, gitId);
      diffAnswer = { status: 404, body: { error: "change_missing", message: MISSING } };
      const before = Date.now();
      dialog = await openAppDiff();
      check(await waitFor(async () => await dialog.getByText(MISSING, { exact: true }).isVisible(), 8000), "stubbed: a file that left the changes: the server's sentence", await textOf(dialog));
      check(await waitFor(async () => asked.some((t) => t >= before), 2000), "stubbed: and the list is read again", asked.length);
      await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Close" }).click();
      diffAnswer = { status: 200, body: { path: "src/app.js", diff: "", binary: false, cut: false } };
      dialog = await openAppDiff();
      check(await waitFor(async () => await dialog.getByText(EMPTY, { exact: true }).isVisible(), 8000), "stubbed: an empty diff says there is nothing to show", await textOf(dialog));
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
      await tab.unroute(diffUrl);
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "stubbed: console clean", realErrors(errors).join(" / "));
      await context.close();
    }

    // 5. A session whose folder is not shown (OpenClaw picks its own): no section, and no request for changes.
    {
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, `sessions&session=${gitId}`);
      await tab.route((u) => u.pathname === "/api/sessions", async (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() !== "GET") return route.continue();
        const response = await route.fetch();
        const body = await response.json();
        const sessions = (body.sessions || []).map((x) => (x.id === gitId ? { ...x, folderShown: false } : x));
        return route.fulfill({ response, json: { ...body, sessions } });
      });
      await tab.reload();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await textOf(panelOf(tab).locator("h2"))).includes("Set by OpenClaw"), 10000), "folder not shown: setup: the panel reads Set by OpenClaw", await textOf(panelOf(tab).locator("h2")));
      const asked = changesRequests(tab, gitId);
      await tab.waitForTimeout(7000);
      check((await panelOf(tab).getByRole("region", { name: "Files changed" }).count()) === 0, "folder not shown: no Files changed section");
      check(asked.length === 0, "folder not shown: the panel never asks for its changes", asked.length);
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "folder not shown: console clean", errors.join(" / "));
      await context.close();
    }

    // 6. An ended session: the list as the agent left it, read once and never again every 3 s.
    {
      await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${gitId}/stop`);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await api("GET", `/api/sessions/${gitId}`)).json.status === "exited", 15000), "ended: setup: the git session has ended");
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, `sessions&session=${gitId}`);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await sectionOf(tab).getByRole("button").count()) === 4, 10000), "ended: an ended session still lists what it changed", await rowNames(tab));
      const asked = changesRequests(tab, gitId);
      await tab.waitForTimeout(7000);
      check(asked.length === 0, "ended: read once, then never again", asked.length);
      await sectionOf(tab).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
      await shot(tab, "changes", W, H, "ended");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "ended: console clean", errors.join(" / "));
      await context.close();
    }
  } finally {
    for (const id of started) await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${id}/stop`).catch(() => undefined);
  }
}
```

### Task X8: Hand-off

A Claude Code session gets a "Send to Codex for review" button, and a Codex session gets "Send to Claude Code". One click types a short note into a session of the other agent in the same folder (or the same separate copy): "Please review the changes Claude Code made in this folder:" and one line per changed file from the changes panel (Task X7). Agent OS never presses Enter. The person reads the note in that agent's input line, edits it if they like, and sends it themselves. The caption under the button says so: "Typed for you, not sent".

Agent OS may type into another program's terminal only under the spec's write rules, and `manager.typeInto` is the one place that does it:

- **Bracketed paste on, and not waiting.** The target's mirror must show DECSET ?2004 (bracketed paste, a mode a terminal program turns on to tell pasted text apart from typed keys), and the target must not be waiting or in an approval.
- **A target that fails is not used.** If the open target fails either rule, a new session of that agent opens in the folder, and the text is typed once it shows ?2004. If that does not happen within 60 s (K13), the text is shown with a Copy button.
- **Cleaning.** Every C0 and C1 control character, ESC and DEL are removed from the body, except `\n`. It is cut to 32 KB and wrapped in the paste markers `ESC[200~ … ESC[201~`. Nothing follows the end marker, so no Enter is ever pressed.
- **Not user input.** The write never counts as user input: the activity state, the idle timer and `lastInputAt` stay as they were.
- **Memory only.** The typed text lives in memory only, as the target's `handoff` in the session list, so the target's panel can show how it went. It is never written to meta.json, a log or a recording.

`handoff.js` holds the pure parts (the cleaning, the paste body, the note, the target choice, the send flow). The manager holds the write itself and the wait for a target to get ready. Task X10 reuses `cleanTypedText` and `deliverTyped` for its typed summaries. The Help page gets the prototype's fourth "Lane A" step, the hand-off.

**Words used below (for the owner):**
- **C0, C1:** the two ranges of invisible control characters (codes 0-31 and 128-159). Carriage return, the byte Enter sends, is one of them.
- **ESC:** the control character that starts every terminal command sequence.
- **A stub manager:** a small stand-in object with only the methods a test needs.
- **A probe:** a scripted browser check run by the UI audit harness.

     - `<agent>` is "Claude Code" or "Codex". The note goes into the other agent's input line, not into Agent OS's own UI, but the person reads it there before sending.
   - **The Copy fallback reason (contract):** "<agent> wasn't ready for typed text in time, so here is the text to copy." NEW SENTENCE (Q32). `<agent>` is the target. The page builds it for a target whose `handoff.state` is `copy`, and for a "copy" answer that brings no reason of its own (`reason: null`). It lives only in `src/ui/handoffShared.ts` (`handoffCopyReason`); no server code builds it.
   - **The 400 `invalid_target` message** below exists once, as `handoff.js`'s exported `INVALID_TARGET_MESSAGE`.
   - **The 400 `invalid_target` message (contract Errors):** "Agent OS can hand this only to Claude Code or Codex." NEW SENTENCE (Q32). It reaches a person only through a bug, because the page offers only the two allowed directions.
   - **The Help step (prototype `how-it-works.html:235`, its words):** "A hand-off, like Send to Codex for review, uses the same route. It types a prepared request into the other agent and stops. You press Enter." NEW SENTENCE (Q32).
   - **"Copied"** on the Copy button after a copy NEW SENTENCE (Q32). It is the word `ApiGuidePage.tsx` already shows; it is listed because it appears in a new place.
   - When a new session can't start, the "copy" answer's `reason` is that refusal's own existing sentence. Examples: "Agent OS runs at most 8 sessions at once. Stop one, then try again." and the Look only sentence. No new words.
4. **Rulings and choices applied:**
   - K13: the target is a live session of the other agent in the same real folder; a worktree session matches only the same worktree; the wait is 60 s; the text is at most 32 KB; DEL is removed.
   - R24: X10's typed summaries reuse `cleanTypedText` and `deliverTyped`; this task builds no summary.
   - R28: the Q32 marks above.
   - R30: Critical and Important findings are fixed in this task; Minors are logged as `minor (deferred)`.
   - Global Constraints applied: "PTY writes" (the one new write, never user input, E1 grep), "Files on disk" (hand-off text in memory only), "Signals scope" (only `agent` sessions take typed text), "Copy", "UI rules" (time limit on the request, unmount guards, long text wraps, no sideways scroll, tokens only), "Tests" (fakes only), "Owner rules, workers".
5. **Decisions this task makes** (each is small, and each has a test):
   - a. **"Live" in readyForTyping means running.** The contract's "readyForTyping(id) (live, ?2004 on, not waiting, alert not waiting or approval)" is read as "running": an `agent` session that has not ended. An idle session is the usual target (it waits for its next message). A held session is allowed too: the spec forbids only waiting and approval.
   - b. **The order of checks, and their reasons.** `typeInto` checks in this order: `not_live` (unknown, ended, not an `agent` session) → `waiting` (status waiting, or an alert of kind waiting or approval) → `no_paste_mode`. Empty text after cleaning throws `TypeError`, as the contract does for a caller's bug.
   - c. **When there is no open target.** When no session of the other agent is open in the folder, a new one opens. This is the same path as a target that fails the rules, and the prototype does the same: its Send moves to Codex.
   - d. **Ended sessions can send.** Send works from an ended session too: the changes are read once (X7's "ended: one fresh read"; U7 shows an ended session's list for this reason). Look only does not stop typing into a session that is already open, because typing is not starting an agent. Opening a new one under Look only ends in "copy" with Look only's own sentence.
   - e. **When the new session can't start.** If the new session can't start (the 8-session cap, Look only, the folder policy, a brain error), the answer is "copy" with that refusal's own sentence. Any other error is thrown, and the route answers 500 `internal_error`.
   - f. **A second Send while the first still waits.** While a target's `handoff` is `pending` (a new session still starting), a second Send answers `opening` for that same session. It types nothing more and starts nothing, so two clicks or two windows never open two sessions.
   - g. **How long the `handoff` state lasts.** It is held in memory:
     - `pending` until it becomes `typed` or `copy`;
     - `typed` until the person's first input in that session after it (the caption has done its job then);
     - `copy` until it is replaced or the session ends.
     - An ended session's summary always has `handoff: null` (X1a's `memoryFields` and the contract).
   - h. **After a Send, the page moves.** On "typed" or "opening" the page shows the target's tab and focuses its terminal, so Enter is one key away. The prototype does the same: its hand-off state makes the Codex tab active. On "copy" the page stays, and the text shows in the section.
   - i. **The target's panel shows the typed text.** Claude Code shows a paste longer than three lines or 800 characters as "[Pasted text #1 +N lines]" (agent docs, "Paste large content"). So the target's Hand-off section shows the typed text in a read-only box under the caption: the person can read what pressing Enter will send. R24 wants exactly that for summaries. The section lives in the side panel, which follows the focused pane (U6), so this task adds nothing per pane.
   - j. **A file name stays on its own line.** Control characters inside a file name (a line break, an escape) become "?" in the note.
   - k. **No "and N more" line.** The note lists the files X7 returns (at most 200), and the 32 KB cap applies after that. Adding such a line would be one more new sentence. The receiving agent can run `git status` itself.
   - l. **The Send button sits in its own Hand-off section,** right after Files changed, as U7 asks. It is not inside `SessionChanges`, so U7's component keeps its props.
6. **What a forged or careless text can't do:** an end-marker sequence typed inside the text (`ESC[201~`) loses its ESC, so it can't end the paste early, and a `\r` after it is removed. Test 3 checks that only two ESC characters exist in the whole body (the two markers). Agent OS never logs the text. The agent's own echo of the paste appears in the recording as output, like anything typed that appears on screen (the Help glossary already says so).
7. **The folder-trust rule (owner FYI; "Contract additions requested" 1).** A brand-new Claude Code session in a folder Claude has not trusted yet shows Claude's own trust question, and bracketed paste may already be on. That question takes no typed text, so typing then would lose the note while the panel says "Typed for you, not sent". Tasks X2a and X2b know this state as `trustNeeded`: true until the first hook event or status post. Claude runs the status line at session start once the folder is trusted, so a trusted folder clears it within a second or so.
   - The rule: `typeInto` treats `trustNeeded` as waiting, unless the person's settings switch the Live meter off (`hooksOff.meter` set). In that case trust can't be seen, and only the spec's two rules apply.
   - If the orchestrator declines the rule: delete the one `trustNeeded` line in `typingBlock`, and tests 17 and 18 and probe section 4's `hook Stop` line.
8. **Known limits for E2 (live checks; nothing in this task can test them with fakes):**
   - **The trust screens.** The same trust problem exists for a brand-new Codex session in a folder Codex has not trusted. Codex shows its own trust screen, possibly with ?2004 on, and Agent OS sees no signal for it. E2 should run one hand-off into a fresh Claude Code session and one into a fresh Codex session, each in a folder that agent never opened, and look where the text lands.
   - **How Claude treats a paste.** Claude marks pasted text as coming from elsewhere and is told to follow instructions inside it only where the typed message asks (agent docs, "How Claude treats pasted text"). E2 should check that Claude acts on a note sent as it is.
   - **The Codex review.** S3's Codex check is still blocked on the owner's Codex model setting.
9. **Why the wait listens and also looks.** `whenReadyForTyping` hears the mirror's `onModeChange`, so ?2004 is seen the moment it is turned on. It also looks every 250 ms (`TYPING_CHECK_MS`), because a waiting that resolves, or the first hook that shows Claude's folder trust, sends no mode change. The 60 s limit timer is kept referenced (it settles the wait); the 250 ms timer is not.

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

async function waitFor(predicate, { timeoutMs = 10000, intervalMs = 20 } = {}) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    const value = await predicate();
    if (value) return value;
    await sleep(intervalMs);
  }
  throw new Error("timed out waiting for condition");
}

// Gives other work (what sendTo leaves running) turns until `predicate` holds.
async function until(predicate, tries = 200) {
  for (let i = 0; i < tries; i += 1) {
    if (predicate()) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
  }
  assert.fail("the condition never held");
}

async function withEnv(vars, fn) {
  const previous = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(vars)) previous[key] = process.env[key];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(vars)) {
    if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
    else process.env[key] = String(value);
  }
  try {
    return await fn();
  } finally {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(previous)) {
      if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = value;
    }
  }
}

// A temp HOME (with two project folders and an empty fake-bin folder) and a separate temp AGENT_OS_HOME, both
// canonical paths, and a clean environment: SHELL is the stand-in login shell, PATH the fake bin plus the system
// folders only. Restored after.
async function withSessionEnv(fn) {
  const home = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-handoff-home-")));
  const agentOsHome = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-handoff-data-")));
  const project = path.join(home, "projects", "demo");
  const other = path.join(home, "projects", "other");
  const bin = path.join(home, "fake-bin");
  await mkdir(project, { recursive: true });
  await mkdir(other, { recursive: true });
  await mkdir(bin, { recursive: true });
  const vars = {
    HOME: home,
    USERPROFILE: home,
    AGENT_OS_HOME: agentOsHome,
    AGENT_OS_MANAGED_ROOT: path.join(home, ".agent-os"),
    HERMES_AGENT_OS_HOME: undefined,
    HERMES_HOME: undefined,
    HERMES_AGENT_OS_ENABLE_EXEC: undefined,
    SHELL: FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL,
    PATH: [bin, ...SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS].join(path.delimiter)
  };
  const saved = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(vars)) {
    saved[key] = process.env[key];
    if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
    else process.env[key] = value;
  }
  try {
    assert.equal(os.homedir(), home, "tests must never see the real home folder");
    return await fn({ home, agentOsHome, project, other, bin });
  } finally {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(saved)) {
      if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = value;
    }
    await rm(home, { recursive: true, force: true });
    await rm(agentOsHome, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

test("cleanTypedText: every C0 control but newline, ESC, DEL and every C1 control go; CR and CRLF lose the CR; other text stays", () => {
  assert.equal(cleanTypedText(NASTY), NASTY_CLEAN);
  let controls = "";
  for (let code = 0; code <= 0x1f; code += 1) controls += String.fromCharCode(code);
  controls += "\x7f";
  for (let code = 0x80; code <= 0x9f; code += 1) controls += String.fromCharCode(code);
  assert.equal(cleanTypedText(`a${controls}b`), "a\nb", "only the newline is left of all 65 controls");
  assert.equal(cleanTypedText("one\r\ntwo\rthree\n"), "one\ntwothree\n");
  assert.equal(cleanTypedText(null), "");
  assert.equal(cleanTypedText(undefined), "");
  assert.equal(cleanTypedText(42), "42");
  assert.equal(cleanTypedText("é ü ß 中文 − 🙂"), "é ü ß 中文 − 🙂");
});

test("cleanTypedText: cut to 32 KB of UTF-8 without splitting a character, after the controls are gone", () => {
  assert.equal(TYPED_MAX_BYTES, 32 * 1024);
  assert.equal(Buffer.byteLength(cleanTypedText("a".repeat(TYPED_MAX_BYTES + 10)), "utf8"), TYPED_MAX_BYTES);
  // One byte short of the limit, then a four-byte emoji that would not fit: it is left out whole.
  assert.equal(cleanTypedText(`${"a".repeat(TYPED_MAX_BYTES - 1)}🙂tail`), "a".repeat(TYPED_MAX_BYTES - 1));
  const exact = `${"a".repeat(TYPED_MAX_BYTES - 4)}🙂`;
  assert.equal(cleanTypedText(exact), exact, "exactly 32 KB stays as it is");
  assert.equal(cleanTypedText(`${"\r".repeat(100)}${"b".repeat(TYPED_MAX_BYTES)}`).length, TYPED_MAX_BYTES, "removed controls use none of the budget");
});

test("pasteBody: the cleaned text between the paste markers, no carriage return anywhere, ESC only in the two markers, nothing after the end marker (never Enter)", () => {
  assert.equal(PASTE_START, `${ESC}[200~`);
  assert.equal(PASTE_END, `${ESC}[201~`);
  const body = pasteBody(NASTY);
  assert.equal(body, `${PASTE_START}${NASTY_CLEAN}${PASTE_END}`);
  assert.ok(!body.includes("\r"), "no carriage return");
  assert.ok(body.endsWith(PASTE_END), "the end marker is the last thing written");
  assert.ok(!body.slice(PASTE_START.length, -PASTE_END.length).includes(ESC), "no ESC inside the body: a typed end marker can't end the paste early");
  assert.equal(body.split(ESC).length - 1, 2, "exactly two ESC in all: the markers");
});

// A manager with just what sendTo and deliverTyped use. `ready` holds the ids that pass the write rules now;
// whenReadyForTyping answers `readyLater` (and makes the id ready when true).
function handoffStub({ files = [], live = [], ready = [], createError = null, readyLater = true, fromAgent = "claude" } = {}) {
  const calls = [];
  const handoffs = new Map();
  const readyIds = new Set(ready);
  const sessions = live.map((session) => ({ ...session }));
  const labels = { claude: "Claude Code", codex: "Codex", cursor: "Cursor" };
  const from = { id: FROM_ID, kind: "agent", agentId: fromAgent, agentLabel: labels[fromAgent], folder: FOLDER, status: "idle" };
  const manager = {
    async get(id) {
      calls.push(["get", id]);
      if (id === FROM_ID) return { ...from, handoff: null };
      const found = sessions.find((session) => session.id === id);
      if (found) return { ...found, kind: "agent", handoff: handoffs.get(id) ?? null };
      throw sessionError(404, "unknown_session", "That session doesn't exist anymore.");
    },
    async changes(id) {
      calls.push(["changes", id]);
      return { git: true, files, total: files.length, at: "2026-10-29T09:00:00.000Z" };
    },
    liveAgentSessions(agentId = null) {
      calls.push(["liveAgentSessions", agentId]);
      return sessions.filter((session) => agentId === null || session.agentId === agentId).map((session) => ({ ...session }));
    },
    readyForTyping(id) {
      return readyIds.has(id);
    },
    typeInto(id, text, options = {}) {
      calls.push(["typeInto", id, text, options.fromId ?? null]);
      if (!readyIds.has(id)) return { ok: false, reason: "no_paste_mode" };
      handoffs.set(id, { state: "typed", text, fromId: options.fromId ?? null });
      return { ok: true };
    },
    async create(input) {
      calls.push(["create", input]);
      if (createError) throw createError;
      sessions.push({ id: NEW_ID, agentId: input.agentId, folder: input.folder, status: "starting" });
      return { id: NEW_ID, kind: "agent", agentId: input.agentId, folder: input.folder, status: "starting" };
    },
    async whenReadyForTyping(id, ms) {
      calls.push(["whenReadyForTyping", id, ms]);
      if (readyLater) readyIds.add(id);
      return readyLater;
    },
    setHandoff(id, handoff) {
      calls.push(["setHandoff", id, handoff?.state ?? null]);
      handoffs.set(id, handoff);
    }
  };
  return { manager, calls, handoffs };
}

test("sendTo: an open Codex session in the same folder that passes the write rules gets the note typed once, and nothing new starts", async () => {
  const files = [{ path: "src/App.tsx", status: "modified", added: 4, removed: 1 }];
  const { manager, calls, handoffs } = handoffStub({
    files,
    live: [{ id: CODEX_ID, agentId: "codex", folder: FOLDER, status: "idle" }],
    ready: [CODEX_ID]
  });
  const note = "Please review the changes Claude Code made in this folder:\n- src/App.tsx (+4 −1)";
  assert.deepEqual(await sendTo(manager, FROM_ID, "codex"), { result: "typed", targetId: CODEX_ID, text: note, reason: null });
  assert.deepEqual(calls.filter((call) => call[0] === "typeInto"), [["typeInto", CODEX_ID, note, FROM_ID]]);
  assert.equal(calls.some((call) => call[0] === "create"), false);
  assert.equal(handoffs.get(CODEX_ID).state, "typed");
});

test("sendTo: an open target that fails the write rules is never written to; a new Codex session opens in the folder and gets the note once it is ready (pending first)", async () => {
  const { manager, calls, handoffs } = handoffStub({ live: [{ id: CODEX_ID, agentId: "codex", folder: FOLDER, status: "waiting" }] });
  assert.deepEqual(await sendTo(manager, FROM_ID, "codex"), { result: "opening", targetId: NEW_ID, text: SHORT_NOTE, reason: null });
  assert.equal(calls.some((call) => call[0] === "typeInto" && call[1] === CODEX_ID), false, "the waiting session is never written to");
  assert.deepEqual(calls.find((call) => call[0] === "create"), ["create", { agentId: "codex", folder: FOLDER }]);
  await until(() => handoffs.get(NEW_ID)?.state === "typed");
  const order = calls.filter((call) => call[1] === NEW_ID).map((call) => (call[0] === "setHandoff" ? `setHandoff:${call[2]}` : call[0]));
  assert.deepEqual(order, ["setHandoff:pending", "whenReadyForTyping", "typeInto"]);
  assert.deepEqual(calls.find((call) => call[0] === "whenReadyForTyping"), ["whenReadyForTyping", NEW_ID, HANDOFF_WAIT_MS]);
});

test("sendTo: with no Codex session open, one starts; when it never gets ready, the text ends as copy and nothing is written", async () => {

});

test("sendTo: when the new session can't start, the answer is copy with that refusal's own sentence; any other failure is thrown", async () => {

});

test("sendTo: only Claude Code to Codex and Codex to Claude Code; anything else is 400 invalid_target before a file is listed or anything is written", async () => {
  // Exported once for Task X10's keep-going.js, so the sentence is never written twice.
  assert.equal(INVALID_TARGET_MESSAGE, "Agent OS can hand this only to Claude Code or Codex.");
  const pairs = [["claude", "claude"], ["claude", "hermes"], ["claude", undefined], ["claude", ""], ["codex", "codex"], ["cursor", "claude"], ["cursor", "codex"]];
  for (const [fromAgent, to] of pairs) {
    const { manager, calls } = handoffStub({ fromAgent });
    await assert.rejects(
      sendTo(manager, FROM_ID, to),
      (error) => error.status === 400 && error.code === "invalid_target" && error.message === "Agent OS can hand this only to Claude Code or Codex.",
      `${fromAgent} to ${to}`
    );
    assert.equal(calls.some((call) => ["changes", "typeInto", "create", "setHandoff"].includes(call[0])), false, `${fromAgent} to ${to}`);
  }
  const reverse = handoffStub({ fromAgent: "codex", live: [{ id: CLAUDE_ID, agentId: "claude", folder: FOLDER, status: "idle" }], ready: [CLAUDE_ID] });
  assert.deepEqual(await sendTo(reverse.manager, FROM_ID, "claude"), {
    result: "typed",
    targetId: CLAUDE_ID,
    text: "Please review the latest changes Codex made in this folder.",
    reason: null
  });
  const unknown = handoffStub();
  await assert.rejects(sendTo(unknown.manager, NEW_ID, "codex"), (error) => error.status === 404 && error.code === "unknown_session");
});

  handoffs.set(CODEX_ID, { state: "pending", text: SHORT_NOTE, fromId: FROM_ID });
