```js
test("deliverTyped: pending first, then typed once the target is ready; copy when it never is, or when the write rules refuse at the last moment; the text is cleaned", async () => {
  {
    const { manager, calls, handoffs } = handoffStub({ live: [{ id: CODEX_ID, agentId: "codex", folder: FOLDER, status: "starting" }] });
    assert.equal(await deliverTyped(manager, CODEX_ID, NASTY, { fromId: FROM_ID, waitMs: 1234 }), "typed");
    assert.deepEqual(calls.find((call) => call[0] === "setHandoff"), ["setHandoff", CODEX_ID, "pending"]);
    assert.deepEqual(calls.find((call) => call[0] === "whenReadyForTyping"), ["whenReadyForTyping", CODEX_ID, 1234]);
    assert.deepEqual(calls.find((call) => call[0] === "typeInto"), ["typeInto", CODEX_ID, NASTY_CLEAN, FROM_ID]);
    assert.equal(handoffs.get(CODEX_ID).state, "typed");
  }
  {
    const { manager, handoffs } = handoffStub({ readyLater: false });
    assert.equal(await deliverTyped(manager, CODEX_ID, "hello"), "copy");
    assert.deepEqual(handoffs.get(CODEX_ID), { state: "copy", text: "hello", fromId: null });
  }
  {
    const { manager, calls, handoffs } = handoffStub();
    manager.typeInto = (id) => {
      calls.push(["typeInto", id]);
      return { ok: false, reason: "waiting" };
    };
    assert.equal(await deliverTyped(manager, CODEX_ID, "hello"), "copy");
    assert.equal(calls.filter((call) => call[0] === "typeInto").length, 1, "never a second try");
    assert.equal(handoffs.get(CODEX_ID).state, "copy");
  }
});

// ---- 2. the real manager with injected fakes ---------------------------------------------------------------

const BASE_MODES = Object.freeze({
  altScreen: false,
  bracketedPaste: false,
  mouseTracking: "none",
  mouseEncoding: "default",
  focusReporting: false,
  cursorKeysApp: false,
  kittyFlags: 0
});

function fakePty(pid, options) {
  const dataListeners = new Set();
  const exitListeners = new Set();
  const pty = {
    pid,
    opts: options,
    writes: [],
    write(data) {
      pty.writes.push(data);
    },
    resize() {},
    kill() {},
    pause() {},
    resume() {},
    onData(cb) {
      dataListeners.add(cb);
      return () => dataListeners.delete(cb);
    },
    onExit(cb) {
      exitListeners.add(cb);
      return () => exitListeners.delete(cb);
    },
    emit(data) {
      for (const cb of [...dataListeners]) cb(data);
    },
    exit(exitCode = 0) {
      for (const cb of [...exitListeners]) cb({ exitCode, signal: undefined });
    }
  };
  return pty;
}

// Task X1b's mirror API, faked. setModes() stands for the agent printing DECSET or DECRST; each change reaches the
// onModeChange listeners, and modeListeners counts the ones still subscribed.
function fakeMirror(options) {
  const counted = new Set();
  const modeListeners = new Set();
  let modes = { ...BASE_MODES };
  const mirror = {
    opts: options,
    written: [],
    write(chunk) {
      mirror.written.push(chunk);
    },
    resize() {},
    async snapshot() {
      return { data: mirror.written.join(""), cols: options.cols, rows: options.rows, modes: { ...modes } };
    },
    setWriterAttached() {},
    onCountedOutput(cb) {
      counted.add(cb);
      return () => counted.delete(cb);
    },
    modes() {
      return { ...modes };
    },
    onModeChange(cb) {
      modeListeners.add(cb);
      return () => modeListeners.delete(cb);
    },
    screenText() {
      return "";
    },
    dispose() {},
    setModes(patch) {
      modes = { ...modes, ...patch };
      for (const cb of [...modeListeners]) cb({ ...modes });
    },
    get modeListeners() {
      return modeListeners.size;
    }
  };
  return mirror;
}

function fakeRecorder() {
  return { output() {}, marker() {}, resize() {}, async close() {} };
}

// What buildSessionProfile answers, without a login shell or a file. A Claude agent session given a hook (Task X2a)
// gets the `claude` part, with the hooks-off codes a test asks for (Task X2b).
function fakeProfile(input, { hooksOff = { alerts: null, meter: null } } = {}) {
  const claude =
    input.kind === "agent" && input.agentId === "claude" && input.hook
      ? { hookUrl: `http://127.0.0.1:${input.hook.port}/hooks/sessions/${input.sessionId}`, hooksOff, statusLineFrom: null }
      : null;
  return {
    command: `/fake/bin/${input.agentId}`,
    args: input.kind === "update" ? ["update"] : [],
    cwd: input.folder || os.homedir(),
    env: { TERM: "xterm-256color" },
    agentSessionId: input.agentId === "claude" ? CLAUDE_UUID : null,
    settingsFile: null,
    softStop: null,
    resumeMode: input.kind === "update" ? null : input.agentId === "claude" ? "id" : "fallback",
    folderShown: true,
    notes: [],
    claude
  };
}

// The folder policy's answers for the folders these tests use.
async function fakeCheckFolder(input) {
  const home = await realpath(os.homedir());
  let real;
  try {
    real = await realpath(String(input || ""));
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, code: "missing", message: "That folder doesn't exist." };
  }
  if (!real.startsWith(home + path.sep)) return { ok: false, code: "outside_home", message: "Pick a folder inside your home folder." };
  return { ok: true, path: real, name: path.basename(real) };
}

// Git as Task X7 runs it, answering "not a git project", so the changes poll never starts a real git.
async function notGit() {
  return { code: 128, stdout: "", stderr: "fatal: not a git repository", timedOut: false, ok: false };
}

function handoffWorld({ port = null, hooksOff } = {}) {
  const world = { clock: T0, ptys: [], mirrors: [], nextPid: 52000 };
  world.manager = createSessionManager({
    now: () => world.clock,
    spawn: async (options) => {
      const pty = fakePty(world.nextPid, options);
      world.nextPid += 1;
      world.ptys.push(pty);
      return pty;
    },
    buildProfile: async (input) => fakeProfile(input, { hooksOff }),
    recorderFactory: () => fakeRecorder(),
    mirrorFactory: (options) => {
      const mirror = fakeMirror(options);
      world.mirrors.push(mirror);
      return mirror;
    },
    isExecutionAllowed: async () => true,
    checkFolder: fakeCheckFolder,
    ptyCheck: async () => ({ ok: true, reason: null }),
    detect: async (agentId) => ({ installed: true, path: `/fake/bin/${agentId}` }),
    resolveBrain: async () => null,
    readSettings: async () => ({ claudeFullscreen: false }),
    enforceCap: async () => ({ deleted: [] }),
    killTree: async () => {},
    getPort: () => port,
    runGit: notGit
  });
  return world;
}

// One world per test, inside the temp environment; every fake process is ended and every meta.json written
// before the temp folders go, even when the test failed half way.
async function withWorld(options, fn) {
  await withSessionEnv(async (env) => {
    const world = handoffWorld(options);
    try {
      await fn(world, env);
    } finally {
      for (const pty of world.ptys) pty.exit(0);
      await waitFor(async () => (await world.manager.list({ includeUpdate: true })).every((session) => session.status === "exited")).catch(() => {});
    }
  });
}

// A started session that printed its first output (so it is live), with bracketed paste on unless asked otherwise.
async function liveSession(world, agentId, folder, { paste = true } = {}) {
  const summary = await world.manager.create({ agentId, folder });
  const pty = world.ptys.at(-1);
  const mirror = world.mirrors.at(-1);
  pty.emit("> ");
  if (paste) mirror.setModes({ bracketedPaste: true });
  return { id: summary.id, pty, mirror };
}

test("the manager offers the four hand-off methods, and handoff.js has the contract's limits", () => {
  const manager = createSessionManager();
  for (const name of ["typeInto", "readyForTyping", "whenReadyForTyping", "setHandoff"]) {
    assert.equal(typeof manager[name], "function", name);
  }
  assert.equal(HANDOFF_WAIT_MS, 60 * 1000);
  assert.equal(TYPED_MAX_BYTES, 32 * 1024);
});

test("typeInto: nothing is written before the mirror shows ?2004; then exactly one write, the paste markers around the cleaned text and nothing after; refused again once ?2004 is off", async () => {
  await withWorld({}, async (world, { project }) => {
    const m = world.manager;
    const { id, pty, mirror } = await liveSession(world, "codex", project, { paste: false });
    assert.equal(m.readyForTyping(id), false);
    assert.deepEqual(m.typeInto(id, "too early"), { ok: false, reason: "no_paste_mode" });
    assert.deepEqual(pty.writes, [], "nothing written before ?2004");

    mirror.setModes({ bracketedPaste: true });
    assert.equal(m.readyForTyping(id), true);
    assert.deepEqual(m.typeInto(id, NASTY, { fromId: FROM_ID }), { ok: true });
    assert.deepEqual(pty.writes, [`${PASTE_START}${NASTY_CLEAN}${PASTE_END}`]);
    assert.ok(!pty.writes[0].includes("\r"), "no carriage return, so no Enter");
    assert.ok(!pty.writes[0].slice(PASTE_START.length, -PASTE_END.length).includes(ESC), "no ESC inside the body");

    mirror.setModes({ bracketedPaste: false });
    assert.deepEqual(m.typeInto(id, "too late"), { ok: false, reason: "no_paste_mode" });
    assert.equal(pty.writes.length, 1, "still only the one write");
  });
});

test("typeInto: nothing is written while the target waits or is in an approval, even with ?2004 on; it can be typed into again once that resolves", async () => {
  await withWorld({}, async (world, { project }) => {
    const m = world.manager;
    const { id, pty } = await liveSession(world, "codex", project);
    assert.equal(m.applySignal(id, { kind: "waiting", text: "Approval requested: run the tests", source: "osc" }), true);
    assert.equal((await m.get(id)).status, "waiting");
    assert.equal(m.readyForTyping(id), false);
    assert.deepEqual(m.typeInto(id, "hello"), { ok: false, reason: "waiting" });

    assert.equal(m.applySignal(id, { kind: "resolved", source: "osc" }), true);
    assert.equal(m.applySignal(id, { kind: "approval", text: "Run npm test?", source: "openclaw" }), true);
    assert.deepEqual(m.typeInto(id, "hello"), { ok: false, reason: "waiting" }, "in an approval");
    assert.deepEqual(pty.writes, [], "nothing was written");

    assert.equal(m.applySignal(id, { kind: "resolved", source: "openclaw" }), true);
    assert.equal(m.readyForTyping(id), true);
    assert.deepEqual(m.typeInto(id, "hello"), { ok: true });
    assert.deepEqual(pty.writes, [`${PASTE_START}hello${PASTE_END}`]);
  });
});

test("typeInto: an idle or a held target is typed into, and the write is not user input: idle stays idle (turn done) and held stays held", async () => {
  await withWorld({}, async (world, { project, other }) => {
    const m = world.manager;
    const a = await liveSession(world, "codex", project);
    assert.equal(m.applySignal(a.id, { kind: "turn_done", source: "osc" }), true);
    let summary = await m.get(a.id);
    assert.equal(summary.status, "idle");
    assert.equal(summary.idleBy, "turn_done");
    assert.deepEqual(m.typeInto(a.id, "review please"), { ok: true });
    summary = await m.get(a.id);
    assert.equal(summary.status, "idle", "a hand-off write never wakes the session");
    assert.equal(summary.idleBy, "turn_done");

    const b = await liveSession(world, "claude", other);
    assert.equal(m.setHeld(b.id, { text: "Claude Code's plan limit was reached.", source: "text" }), true);
    assert.equal((await m.get(b.id)).status, "held");
    assert.deepEqual(m.typeInto(b.id, "for later"), { ok: true });
    assert.equal((await m.get(b.id)).status, "held");
  });
});

test("whenReadyForTyping: true as soon as ?2004 shows, true once a waiting target resolves, false at the time limit, false at once when the session ends or is unknown; no mode listener is left behind", async () => {
  await withWorld({}, async (world, { project, other }) => {
    const m = world.manager;
    const a = await liveSession(world, "codex", project, { paste: false });
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    const soon = m.whenReadyForTyping(a.id, 5000);
    setTimeout(() => a.mirror.setModes({ bracketedPaste: true }), 50);
    assert.equal(await soon, true);
    assert.ok(Date.now() - startedAt < 1000, "seen when the mode changes, long before the time limit");
    assert.equal(a.mirror.modeListeners, 0);

    assert.equal(m.applySignal(a.id, { kind: "waiting", text: "Approval requested: x", source: "osc" }), true);
    const afterWaiting = m.whenReadyForTyping(a.id, 5000);
    setTimeout(() => m.applySignal(a.id, { kind: "resolved", source: "osc" }), 50);
    assert.equal(await afterWaiting, true);

    const b = await liveSession(world, "codex", other, { paste: false });
    const t0 = Date.now();
    assert.equal(await m.whenReadyForTyping(b.id, 300), false);
    assert.ok(Date.now() - t0 >= 280, "it waited for the limit");
    assert.equal(b.mirror.modeListeners, 0);

    const gone = m.whenReadyForTyping(b.id, 5000);
    setTimeout(() => b.pty.exit(0), 50);
    const t1 = Date.now();
    assert.equal(await gone, false);
    assert.ok(Date.now() - t1 < 1500, "an ended session ends the wait");
    assert.equal(await m.whenReadyForTyping(NEW_ID, 5000), false, "an unknown id answers false at once");
  });
});

test("handoff in the summary: pending and copy from setHandoff, typed from typeInto with its fromId; a typed one goes at the person's next input; memory only, never in meta.json, null once ended", async () => {
  await withWorld({}, async (world, { agentOsHome, project }) => {
    const m = world.manager;
    const { id, pty } = await liveSession(world, "codex", project);
    assert.equal((await m.get(id)).handoff, null);

    m.setHandoff(id, { state: "pending", text: "note\r\nwith CR", fromId: FROM_ID });
    assert.deepEqual((await m.get(id)).handoff, { state: "pending", text: "note\nwith CR", fromId: FROM_ID, at: new Date(T0).toISOString() });
    m.setHandoff(id, { state: "copy", text: "note", fromId: FROM_ID });
    assert.equal((await m.get(id)).handoff.state, "copy");
    m.setHandoff(id, null);
    assert.equal((await m.get(id)).handoff, null);
    assert.throws(() => m.setHandoff(id, { state: "odd", text: "x" }), TypeError);

    await m.attach(id, { id: "w", send() {}, close() {} });
    assert.equal(m.focus(id, "w"), true);
    world.clock = T0 + 1000;
    assert.equal(m.write(id, "w", "x"), true);
    world.clock = T0 + 2000;
    assert.deepEqual(m.typeInto(id, "please review", { fromId: FROM_ID }), { ok: true });
    assert.deepEqual(
      (await m.get(id)).handoff,
      { state: "typed", text: "please review", fromId: FROM_ID, at: new Date(T0 + 2000).toISOString() },
      "input before the typing does not clear it"
    );
    world.clock = T0 + 3000;
    assert.equal(m.write(id, "w", "\r"), true);
    assert.equal((await m.get(id)).handoff, null, "the person's next input clears a typed one");

    m.setHandoff(id, { state: "copy", text: "secret-ish note", fromId: FROM_ID });
    world.clock = T0 + 4000;
    assert.equal(m.write(id, "w", "y"), true);
    assert.equal((await m.get(id)).handoff.state, "copy", "a copy stays until it is replaced or the session ends");
    assert.deepEqual(m.typeInto(id, "x", { fromId: "not-a-session-id" }), { ok: true });
    assert.equal((await m.get(id)).handoff.fromId, null, "a fromId that is not a session id is dropped");

    pty.exit(0);
    const meta = await waitFor(async () => {
      const raw = await readFile(path.join(agentOsHome, "sessions", id, "meta.json"), "utf8").catch(() => "");
      return raw.includes('"exited"') ? raw : null;
    });
    assert.ok(!meta.includes("handoff"), "no handoff key in meta.json");
    assert.ok(!meta.includes("please review") && !meta.includes("secret-ish"), "no hand-off text on disk");
    assert.equal((await m.get(id)).handoff, null, "an ended session has no hand-off");
  });
});

// ---- 3. real PTY: what a fake agent really receives ---------------------------------------------------------

function ptyEnv(home, bin, log) {
  return {
    PATH: [bin, ...SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS].join(path.delimiter),
    HOME: home,
    USERPROFILE: home,
    SHELL: FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL,
    TERM: "xterm-256color",
    LANG: "en_US.UTF-8",
    FAKE_AGENT_LOG: log
  };
}

// `running` holds the pids this test started and has not seen exit; only those are ever signalled.
function track(running, handle) {
  running.add(handle.pid);
  handle.onExit(() => {
    running.delete(handle.pid);
  });
  return handle;
}

function killLeftovers(running) {
  for (const pid of [...running]) {
    try {
      process.kill(pid, "SIGKILL");
    } catch {
      // already gone
    }
    running.delete(pid);
  }
}

async function readLog(file) {
  const text = await readFile(file, "utf8").catch(() => "");
  return text
    .split("\n")
    .filter(Boolean)
    .flatMap((line) => {
      try {
        return [JSON.parse(line)];
      } catch {
        return [];
      }
    });
}

test("real PTY: a fake Codex gets the hand-off as one bracketed paste, only after it turned ?2004 on, with no carriage return and no ESC in the text and no Enter after it", SKIP_POSIX, async () => {
  await withSessionEnv(async ({ home, agentOsHome, project, bin }) => {
    const running = new Set();
    const log = path.join(home, "fake-agent.log");
    let id = null;
    try {
      await makeFakeAgentBin(bin); // all six names, mode tui
      const manager = createSessionManager({
        isExecutionAllowed: async () => true,
        detect: async () => ({ installed: true, path: path.join(bin, "codex") }),
        resolveBrain: async () => null,
        getPort: () => null,
        runGit: notGit,
        buildProfile: async (input) => ({
          command: path.join(bin, "codex"),
          args: [],
          cwd: input.folder,
          env: ptyEnv(home, bin, log),
          agentSessionId: null,
          settingsFile: null,
          softStop: null,
          resumeMode: "fallback",
          folderShown: true,
          notes: [],
          claude: null
        }),
        spawn: async (options) => track(running, await spawnPty(options))
      });
      id = (await manager.create({ agentId: "codex", folder: project })).id;
      const frames = [];
      await manager.attach(id, { id: "w", send: (frame) => frames.push(frame), close() {} });
      assert.equal(manager.focus(id, "w"), true);
      const screen = () => frames.filter((frame) => frame.t === "out").map((frame) => frame.d).join("");
      await waitFor(() => screen().includes("> "));

      assert.deepEqual(manager.typeInto(id, "too early"), { ok: false, reason: "no_paste_mode" });
      assert.equal(manager.write(id, "w", "paste on\r"), true);
      await waitFor(() => manager.readyForTyping(id));
      assert.deepEqual(manager.typeInto(id, NASTY, { fromId: FROM_ID }), { ok: true });

      const pastes = await waitFor(async () => {
        const found = (await readLog(log)).filter((event) => event.event === "paste");
        return found.length ? found : null;
      });
      assert.equal(pastes.length, 1, "one paste");
      assert.equal(pastes[0].text, NASTY_CLEAN);
      assert.ok(!pastes[0].text.includes("\r"), "no carriage return reached the agent");
      assert.ok(!pastes[0].text.includes(ESC), "no ESC inside the pasted text");
      await sleep(400);
      const events = await readLog(log);
      const at = events.findIndex((event) => event.event === "paste");
      assert.deepEqual(events.slice(at + 1).filter((event) => event.event === "line" || event.event === "key"), [], "nothing after the paste: no Enter, no stray key");
      assert.ok(!events.some((event) => JSON.stringify(event).includes("too early")), "the refused text never reached the agent");

      assert.equal(manager.write(id, "w", "paste off\r"), true);
      await waitFor(() => !manager.readyForTyping(id));
      assert.deepEqual(manager.typeInto(id, "too late"), { ok: false, reason: "no_paste_mode" });
      assert.equal(manager.write(id, "w", "exit 0\r"), true);
      await waitFor(async () => (await manager.get(id)).status === "exited");
    } finally {
      killLeftovers(running);
      if (id) {
        await waitFor(async () => (await readFile(path.join(agentOsHome, "sessions", id, "meta.json"), "utf8").catch(() => "")).includes('"exited"')).catch(
          () => {}
        );
      }
    }
  });
});

// ---- 4. POST /api/sessions/:id/send ------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function withRoute(manager, fn) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use("/api/sessions", requireLocalMode, createSessionsRouter({ manager }));
  const server = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const listening = app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve(listening));
  });
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
  const post = async (url, body) => {
    const response = await fetch(`${base}${url}`, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    const text = await response.text();
    let json = null;
    try {
      json = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      json = null;
    }
    return { status: response.status, json };
  };
  try {
    return await fn(post);
  } finally {
    server.closeAllConnections?.();
    await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve));
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `server/runtime/sessions/handoff.js`** with exactly this content:

```js
// Hand-off (spec "SP4 Session extras", Hand-off; Task X8): Agent OS types a short note into a session of the other
// agent and never presses Enter. "Send to Codex for review" in a Claude Code session and "Send to Claude Code" in a
// Codex session hand the list of files this session changed to a session of the other agent in the same folder (or
// the same separate copy). Task X10 reuses cleanTypedText and deliverTyped for the typed summaries of Codex keep
// going and Cursor's hand-over.
//
// Write rules (spec, Hand-off; the manager enforces them in typeInto, the only place that writes the text):
// - only when the target's mirror shows DECSET ?2004 (bracketed paste) on, and the target is not waiting or in an
//   approval;
// - an open target that fails either rule is not used: a new session of that agent opens instead, and the text is
//   written once it shows ?2004; if that never happens within HANDOFF_WAIT_MS, the text is shown with a Copy button;
// - the body has every C0 and C1 control character, ESC and DEL removed except "\n", is cut to 32 KB, is wrapped in
//   the paste markers, and is never followed by Enter;
// - a hand-off write is never user input (spec, Session activity states).
// The text lives in memory only (the target's `handoff`), never in meta.json, a log or a recording.
import { builderErrorResponse } from "../builders/resolve.js";
import { sessionError } from "./errors.js";

export const TYPED_MAX_BYTES = 32 * 1024;
export const HANDOFF_WAIT_MS = 60 * 1000;
export const PASTE_START = "\x1b[200~";
export const PASTE_END = "\x1b[201~";

// Every C0 control except "\n" (0x0A), DEL, and every C1 control. ESC (0x1B) is a C0 control, so it goes too.
const TYPED_CONTROLS = /[\u0000-\u0009\u000B-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]/g;
// The same set with "\n" too, so a file name stays on its one line of the note.
const LINE_CONTROLS = /[\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]/g;
// Claude Code sends to Codex, and Codex to Claude Code (spec: "a session of the other agent").
const OTHER_AGENT = Object.freeze({ claude: "codex", codex: "claude" });
// Exported because Task X10's keep-going.js answers a wrong target with the same sentence.
export const INVALID_TARGET_MESSAGE = "Agent OS can hand this only to Claude Code or Codex.";

// The longest start of `text` that fits in `maxBytes` of UTF-8, never splitting a character.
function cutUtf8(text, maxBytes) {
  if (Buffer.byteLength(text, "utf8") <= maxBytes) return text;
  let bytes = 0;
  let end = 0;
  for (const ch of text) {
    const size = Buffer.byteLength(ch, "utf8");
    if (bytes + size > maxBytes) break;
    bytes += size;
    end += ch.length;
  }
  return text.slice(0, end);
}

// The body rule: controls go first, then the cut, so removed controls use none of the 32 KB.
export function cleanTypedText(text) {
  return cutUtf8(String(text ?? "").replace(TYPED_CONTROLS, ""), TYPED_MAX_BYTES);
}

// What typeInto writes: the cleaned text between the paste markers, and nothing after the end marker (no Enter).
export function pasteBody(text) {
  return `${PASTE_START}${cleanTypedText(text)}${PASTE_END}`;
}

function lineCount(value) {
  return Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 ? value : 0;
}

function fileLine(file) {
  const name = file.path.replace(LINE_CONTROLS, "?");
  if (file.added == null && file.removed == null) return `- ${name}`;
  return `- ${name} (+${lineCount(file.added)} −${lineCount(file.removed)})`;
}

// The note: one line per changed file (Task X7's list, at most 200), or the shorter note when none is listed.
export function buildReviewNote({ fromLabel, files = [] } = {}) {
  const agent = String(fromLabel ?? "");
  const listed = Array.isArray(files) ? files.filter((file) => file && typeof file.path === "string" && file.path !== "") : [];
  if (!listed.length) return `Please review the latest changes ${agent} made in this folder.`;
  return [`Please review the changes ${agent} made in this folder:`, ...listed.map(fileLine)].join("\n");
}

// K13: a session of `agentId` in exactly this real folder (a separate copy is its own folder, so a worktree session
// matches only that worktree). The list is in the order the sessions started, so the last match is the newest.
export function findHandoffTarget(sessions, { agentId, folder } = {}) {
  if (!Array.isArray(sessions) || typeof folder !== "string" || folder === "") return null;
  let newest = null;
  for (const session of sessions) {
    if (!session || session.agentId !== agentId || session.status === "exited" || session.folder !== folder) continue;
    newest = session;
  }
  return newest;
}

// A refusal with a sentence of its own (a sessionError, or a brain error the routes would answer with its own
// status): its message becomes the reason under the Copy button. null for anything else, which is thrown.
function refusalMessage(error) {
  const sentence = typeof error?.message === "string" && error.message ? error.message : null;
  if (!sentence) return null;
  if (Number.isInteger(error.status) && error.status >= 400 && error.status <= 599 && typeof error.code === "string") return sentence;
  return builderErrorResponse(error) ? sentence : null;
}

// The new-session half of the write rules: the target shows "pending" at once, then "typed" (typeInto records it)
// or "copy" when it never got ready within `waitMs`, or the rules refused at the last moment.
export async function deliverTyped(manager, targetId, text, { fromId = null, waitMs = HANDOFF_WAIT_MS } = {}) {
  const clean = cleanTypedText(text);
  manager.setHandoff(targetId, { state: "pending", text: clean, fromId });
  let ready = false;
  try {
    ready = await manager.whenReadyForTyping(targetId, waitMs);
  } catch {
    ready = false;
  }
  if (ready && manager.typeInto(targetId, clean, { fromId }).ok) return "typed";
  manager.setHandoff(targetId, { state: "copy", text: clean, fromId });
  return "copy";
}

// POST /api/sessions/:id/send. "typed": an open target passed the rules and was written. "opening": a new session
// started and is typed into once ready (its own `handoff` shows the end state). "copy": the new session could not
// start, and `reason` is that refusal's own sentence.
export async function sendTo(manager, fromId, to) {
  if (to !== "claude" && to !== "codex") throw sessionError(400, "invalid_target", INVALID_TARGET_MESSAGE);
  const from = await manager.get(fromId);
  if (from.kind !== "agent" || OTHER_AGENT[from.agentId] !== to) throw sessionError(400, "invalid_target", INVALID_TARGET_MESSAGE);
  let files = [];
  try {
    const changes = await manager.changes(fromId);
    if (changes?.git === true && Array.isArray(changes.files)) files = changes.files;
  } catch {
    // The note without a list is still true ("the latest changes").
    files = [];
  }
  const text = cleanTypedText(buildReviewNote({ fromLabel: from.agentLabel, files }));
  const target = findHandoffTarget(manager.liveAgentSessions(to), { agentId: to, folder: from.folder });
  if (target) {
    // A session already waiting for its text (a Send a moment ago, maybe from another window) gets nothing more.
    const current = await manager.get(target.id).catch(() => null);
    if (current?.handoff?.state === "pending") {
      return { result: "opening", targetId: target.id, text: current.handoff.text, reason: null };
    }
    if (manager.readyForTyping(target.id) && manager.typeInto(target.id, text, { fromId }).ok) {
      return { result: "typed", targetId: target.id, text, reason: null };
    }
  }
  let opened;
  try {
    opened = await manager.create({ agentId: to, folder: from.folder });
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = refusalMessage(error);
    if (reason === null) throw error;
    return { result: "copy", targetId: null, text, reason };
  }
  // Runs on after the answer; deliverTyped never throws (it ends in "typed" or "copy").
  deliverTyped(manager, opened.id, text, { fromId }).catch(() => {});
  return { result: "opening", targetId: opened.id, text, reason: null };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create `src/ui/handoffShared.ts`** with exactly this content:

```ts
// The Hand-off section's rules (spec "SP4 Session extras", Hand-off; Task X8): which Send button a session offers,
// the caption, what a session's own panel says about text handed to it, and what the panel does with the answer to a
// Send. Only type imports, so test/sessions-handoff.test.js loads this file straight from src/.
import type { HandoffResult, SessionSummary } from "../types";

export const HANDOFF_TITLE = "Hand-off";
// The spec's caption, word for word.
export const HANDOFF_CAPTION = "Typed for you, not sent";
// sessionsApi.ts's words for an answer it can't read.
const UNREADABLE = "Agent OS gave an answer that could not be read.";

export interface SendTarget {
  to: "claude" | "codex";
  label: string;
  // The target agent's short name, for the Copy fallback's reason.
  agentLabel: string;
}

// A Claude Code session sends to Codex for review, a Codex session sends to Claude Code; no other session has a Send
// button (Cursor's "Hand to Claude Code or Codex" is Task X10's).
export function sendTargets(session: Pick<SessionSummary, "kind" | "agentId">): SendTarget[] {
  if (session.kind !== "agent") return [];
  if (session.agentId === "claude") return [{ to: "codex", label: "Send to Codex for review", agentLabel: "Codex" }];
  if (session.agentId === "codex") return [{ to: "claude", label: "Send to Claude Code", agentLabel: "Claude Code" }];
  return [];
}

// The Copy fallback's sentence, built here and nowhere else (Task X10's hand-over button imports it too). A server
// "copy" answer brings either a refusal's own sentence or `reason: null`, and the page fills this one in.
export function handoffCopyReason(agentLabel: string): string {
  return `${agentLabel} wasn't ready for typed text in time, so here is the text to copy.`;
}

export type HandoffStatus = { kind: "pending" } | { kind: "typed"; text: string } | { kind: "copy"; text: string; reason: string } | null;

// What a session's own panel says about text handed to it: "…" while Agent OS waits for the agent, the caption and the
// typed text once it is in the agent's input line, or the text to copy when the agent never got ready. Nothing for an
// ended session or anything the server did not send.
export function handoffStatus(session: Pick<SessionSummary, "status" | "agentLabel"> & { handoff?: SessionSummary["handoff"] }): HandoffStatus {
  const handoff = session.handoff;
  if (!handoff || typeof handoff !== "object" || session.status === "exited") return null;
  if (handoff.state === "pending") return { kind: "pending" };
  const text = typeof handoff.text === "string" ? handoff.text : "";
  if (!text) return null;
  if (handoff.state === "typed") return { kind: "typed", text };
  if (handoff.state === "copy") return { kind: "copy", text, reason: handoffCopyReason(session.agentLabel) };
  return null;
}

export type SendOutcome = { open: string } | { copy: { text: string; reason: string } } | { problem: string };

// "typed" and "opening" open the session the text went to; "copy" shows the text with the server's reason (or the
// Copy fallback's own sentence when it sent none). Anything else is an answer the page can't read.
export function sendOutcome(answer: unknown, target: SendTarget): SendOutcome {
  const result = answer && typeof answer === "object" ? (answer as Partial<HandoffResult>) : null;
  if (result && (result.result === "typed" || result.result === "opening") && typeof result.targetId === "string" && result.targetId) {
    return { open: result.targetId };
  }
  if (result && result.result === "copy" && typeof result.text === "string" && result.text) {
    const reason = typeof result.reason === "string" && result.reason ? result.reason : handoffCopyReason(target.agentLabel);
    return { copy: { text: result.text, reason } };
  }
  return { problem: UNREADABLE };
}
```

```js
  // ---- hand-off (SP4) -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  // Why text can't be typed into this session now, or null when it can. Spec "SP4 Session extras", Hand-off, write
  // rules: the target's mirror shows DECSET ?2004 (bracketed paste) on AND the target is not waiting or in an
  // approval. A Claude Code session whose folder trust Agent OS has not seen yet counts as waiting too: Claude's trust
  // question takes no typed text and sends no signal. When the person's Claude settings switch the Live meter off,
  // trust can't be seen, so only the spec's two rules apply.
  function typingBlock(state) {
    if (!state || state.meta.kind !== "agent" || state.exitSeen || !state.handle || !state.mirror) return "not_live";
    const { activity } = state;
    if (activity.status === "exited") return "not_live";
    if (activity.status === "waiting" || TYPING_BLOCKING_ALERTS.has(activity.alert?.kind)) return "waiting";
    if (state.trustNeeded === true && !state.hooksOff?.meter) return "waiting";
    let modes = null;
    try {
      modes = state.mirror.modes();
    } catch {
      modes = null;
    }
    return modes?.bracketedPaste === true ? null : "no_paste_mode";
  }

  function readyForTyping(id) {
    return typingBlock(live.get(id)) === null;
  }

  // Security 6: besides the writer's input and the mirror's query replies, this is the only write into a PTY. The
  // text goes in once, cleaned and between the paste markers (handoff.js), and nothing follows it: no Enter. It is
  // not user input, so the activity state, lastInputAt and the idle timer are left alone. The typed text is kept in
  // memory for the panel (`handoff`), never in meta.json.
  function typeInto(id, text, { fromId = null } = {}) {
    const state = live.get(id);
    const block = typingBlock(state);
    if (block) return { ok: false, reason: block };
    const clean = cleanTypedText(text);
    if (!clean) throw new TypeError("typeInto needs some text to type");
    try {
      state.handle.write(pasteBody(clean));
    } catch {
      return { ok: false, reason: "not_live" };
    }
    state.handoff = { state: "typed", text: clean, fromId: isSessionId(fromId) ? fromId : null, at: iso(now()) };
    return { ok: true };
  }

  // Resolves true as soon as the session takes typed text, false at `timeoutMs` or as soon as the session is gone.
  // ?2004 is seen the moment the mirror reports a mode change; everything else (a waiting that resolves, the first
  // hook that shows Claude's folder trust) at the next check, every TYPING_CHECK_MS.
  function whenReadyForTyping(id, timeoutMs) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let done = false;
      let stopListening = () => {};
      let poll = null;
      let limit = null;
      const finish = (value) => {
        if (done) return;
        done = true;
        clearInterval(poll);
        clearTimeout(limit);
        stopListening();
        resolve(value);
      };
      const check = () => {
        const state = live.get(id);
        if (!state || state.exitSeen || state.activity.status === "exited") finish(false);
        else if (typingBlock(state) === null) finish(true);
      };
      check();
      if (done) return;
      poll = setInterval(check, TYPING_CHECK_MS);
      poll.unref?.();
      // Kept referenced: it is at most `timeoutMs`, and it is what settles the wait.
      limit = setTimeout(() => finish(false), Math.max(0, Number(timeoutMs) || 0));
      try {
        const off = live.get(id).mirror.onModeChange(() => check());
        if (typeof off === "function") stopListening = off;
      } catch {
        // No mode reports: the regular check still sees ?2004.
      }
      if (done) stopListening();
    });
  }

  // Memory only (spec Security 5: nothing typed is kept on disk). null clears it; an ended or unknown session is left
  // alone. The time is this manager's own.
  function setHandoff(id, handoff) {
    const state = live.get(id);
    if (!state || state.exitSeen) return;
    if (handoff === null) {
      state.handoff = null;
      return;
    }
    if (!handoff || !HANDOFF_STATES.has(handoff.state)) throw new TypeError("setHandoff needs a state: pending, typed or copy");
    state.handoff = {
      state: handoff.state,
      text: cleanTypedText(handoff.text),
      fromId: isSessionId(handoff.fromId) ? handoff.fromId : null,
      at: iso(now())
    };
  }

  // What the summary shows as `handoff` (through viewOfState's `memory`): a copy of the memory, or null once the
  // session ended. A typed one goes at the person's first input after it: the caption has done its job then.
  function handoffOf(state) {
    if (!state || state.exitSeen || !state.handoff) return null;
    const { handoff } = state;
    if (handoff.state === "typed" && Number.isFinite(state.lastInputAt) && state.lastInputAt > Date.parse(handoff.at)) return null;
    return { ...handoff };
  }
```

a) Create `src/ui/components/HandoffCopyFallback.tsx` with exactly this content. It is the one copy of the Copy fallback's markup: the Hand-off section renders it, and so does Task X10's `HandOverButton`. Its reason comes from the caller (a refusal's own sentence, or `handoffCopyReason` from `handoffShared.ts`); this file builds no sentence.

```tsx
// The hand-off's Copy fallback (spec "SP4 Session extras", Hand-off: "the text is shown with a Copy button"; Task X8):
// the reason line when there is one, then the text in a read-only box with a Copy button. The Hand-off section shows
// it for a Send answered "copy" and for a session whose handed text never got typed; Task X10's hand-over button shows
// it too. The reason is the caller's (a refusal's own sentence, or handoffCopyReason in handoffShared.ts). HandoffText
// is the box and its Copy button on their own: the Hand-off section also shows typed text with it.
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Check, Copy } from "lucide-react";
import { HANDOFF_TITLE } from "../handoffShared";

// Handed-over text in a read-only box named by the line above it (or by the section's name when there is no such
// line), with a Copy button.
export function HandoffText({ text, labelId }: { text: string; labelId?: string }) {
  const box = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  async function copy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setCopied(true);
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        if (alive.current) setCopied(false);
      }, 2000);
    } catch {
      // No clipboard here: select the text, so ⌘C or Ctrl+C copies it.
      box.current?.focus();
      box.current?.select();
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="os-handoff__box">
      <textarea
        ref={box}
        className="os-handoff__text"
        readOnly
        rows={5}
        value={text}
        aria-labelledby={labelId}
        aria-label={labelId ? undefined : HANDOFF_TITLE}
      />
      <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary os-handoff__copy" onClick={() => void copy()}>
        {copied ? <Check size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> : <Copy size={16} aria-hidden="true" />}
        {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function HandoffCopyFallback({ text, reason }: { text: string; reason: string | null }) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <div className="os-handoff__fallback">
      {reason ? (
        <p id={`${id}-why`} className="os-handoff__why" role="status">
          {reason}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <HandoffText text={text} labelId={reason ? `${id}-why` : undefined} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// The side panel's Hand-off section (spec "SP4 Session extras", Hand-off; Task X8). A Claude Code session offers "Send
// to Codex for review" and a Codex session "Send to Claude Code". The server types a note listing this session's
// changed files into a session of the other agent in the same folder (or the same separate copy), opening one there
// first when none can take it, and never presses Enter; the caption under the button says so. The page then shows

// that text was handed to shows how that went: "…" while Agent OS waits for the agent, the caption and the typed text
// once it is in the agent's input line (Claude Code shows a long paste as a placeholder, so the text is here to read),
// or the text to copy when the agent never got ready.
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Send } from "lucide-react";
import { sendTo, sessionProblem } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { SessionSummary } from "../../types";
import { HANDOFF_CAPTION, HANDOFF_TITLE, handoffStatus, sendOutcome, sendTargets } from "../handoffShared";
import type { SendTarget } from "../handoffShared";
import HandoffCopyFallback, { HandoffText } from "./HandoffCopyFallback";

export default function HandoffSection({ session, onOpenSession }: { session: SessionSummary; onOpenSession: (id: string) => void }) {
  const id = useId();
  const targets = sendTargets(session);
  const status = handoffStatus(session);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState("");
  const [copy, setCopy] = useState<{ text: string; reason: string } | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  async function send(target: SendTarget) {
    setBusy(true);
    setProblem("");
    setCopy(null);
    try {
      const outcome = sendOutcome(await sendTo(session.id, target.to), target);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      if ("open" in outcome) onOpenSession(outcome.open);
      else if ("copy" in outcome) setCopy(outcome.copy);
      else setProblem(outcome.problem);
    } catch (error) {
      if (alive.current) setProblem(sessionProblem(error));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  if (!targets.length && !status) return null;
  return (
    <section className="os-sess-panel__sec os-handoff" aria-label={HANDOFF_TITLE}>
      <div className="os-sess-panel__rh">{HANDOFF_TITLE}</div>
      {status?.kind === "pending" ? (
        <p className="os-handoff__status" role="status" aria-busy="true">
          …
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {status?.kind === "typed" ? (
        <>
          <p id={`${id}-typed`} className="os-handoff__status" role="status">
            {HANDOFF_CAPTION}
          </p>
          <HandoffText text={status.text} labelId={`${id}-typed`} />
        </>
      ) : null}
      {status?.kind === "copy" ? <HandoffCopyFallback text={status.text} reason={status.reason} /> : null}
      {targets.map((target) => (
        <button
          key={target.to}
          type="button"
          className="os-btn os-btn--secondary os-handoff__send"
          onClick={() => void send(target)}
          disabled={busy}
          aria-describedby={`${id}-cap`}
        >
          <Send size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
          {target.label}
        </button>
      ))}
      {targets.length ? (
        <p id={`${id}-cap`} className="os-handoff__cap">
          {HANDOFF_CAPTION}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {problem ? (
        <p className="os-sess-panel__note" role="alert">
          {problem}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {copy ? <HandoffCopyFallback text={copy.text} reason={copy.reason} /> : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

c) Create `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/handoff.mjs` with exactly this content:

```js
// Task X8: the Hand-off section. Send to Codex for review in a Claude Code session and Send to Claude Code in a Codex
// session, the caption "Typed for you, not sent", the note arriving in the other agent's terminal as one bracketed
// paste that is never sent, the page moving to that session with its terminal focused, the Copy fallback, and the
// Help step.
// Run (after `npm run build`), from the worktree root:
//   node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/handoff.mjs
// Real PTY fakes from the harness's fake-bin (test/fakes/tui-agent.mjs): `paste on` turns on bracketed paste (?2004),
// a bracketed paste comes back on screen as PASTE "<text>", and a line ended by Enter would print "you said: <text>".
// `hook Stop` makes the fake Claude Code post one hook event (Task X2a), the sign Agent OS uses that its folder trust
// was accepted. Page-level stubs (route) only for what the fakes can't produce in time: a Send answered "copy", and a
// session whose hand-off ended in "copy" (the real one waits 60 s). The folder is not a git project, so the note is
// the short one. The probe stops every session it started.
import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const W = 1280, H = 720;
const CAPTION = "Typed for you, not sent";
const NOTE_FROM_CLAUDE = "Please review the latest changes Claude Code made in this folder.";
const NOTE_FROM_CODEX = "Please review the latest changes Codex made in this folder.";
const LIMIT_REASON = "Agent OS runs at most 8 sessions at once. Stop one, then try again.";
const CODEX_COPY_REASON = "Codex wasn't ready for typed text in time, so here is the text to copy.";
const HELP_STEP = "A hand-off, like Send to Codex for review, uses the same route. It types a prepared request into the other agent and stops. You press Enter.";
const json = (route, body, status = 200) => route.fulfill({ status, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
// Chrome logs refused requests as "Failed to load resource"; anything else is a real console error.
const realErrors = (errors) => errors.filter((e) => !/Failed to load resource/.test(e));

export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail, api, BASE, HOME }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));
  if (!HOME) {
    fail("harness", "audit.mjs does not pass HOME to probes");
    return;
  }
  const folder = path.join(HOME, "projects", "handoff");
  mkdirSync(folder, { recursive: true });
  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const waitFor = async (fn, ms = 10000) => {
    const end = Date.now() + ms;
    while (Date.now() < end) {
      try { if (await fn()) return true; } catch {}
      await sleep(250);
    }
    return false;
  };
  const termText = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.querySelector(".os-sess-term .xterm-rows")?.textContent || "");
  const sessionParam = (tab) => new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("session") || "";
  const tabFor = (tab, agent) => tab.getByRole("tab", { name: new RegExp(`^${agent} · handoff`) });
  const panel = (tab) => tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Session details" });
  const handoff = (tab) => panel(tab).getByRole("region", { name: "Hand-off" });
  const sideways = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth > document.scrollingElement.clientWidth);
  async function typeLine(tab, text) {
    await tab.locator(".os-sess-term .xterm").first().click();
    await tab.keyboard.type(text);
    await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
  }
  async function stopEverything() {
    const answer = await api("GET", "/api/sessions?kind=all");
    for (const s of answer.json.sessions || []) if (s.status !== "exited") await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${s.id}/stop`);
  }

  let context = null;
  try {
    const codex = await api("POST", "/api/sessions", { agentId: "codex", folder });
    const claude = await api("POST", "/api/sessions", { agentId: "claude", folder });
    check(codex.status === 201 && claude.status === 201, "Codex and Claude Code start in one folder", `${codex.status} ${claude.status}`);
    const codexId = codex.json.id;
    const claudeId = claude.json.id;
    const opened = await openPage(browser, W, H, "sessions");
    context = opened.context;
    const { tab, errors } = opened;
    await context.grantPermissions(["clipboard-read", "clipboard-write"], { origin: BASE });

    // 1. Codex turns on bracketed paste; its panel offers only the other direction.
    await tabFor(tab, "Codex").click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => sessionParam(tab) === codexId, 5000), "the Codex tab opens");
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes("FAKE_ARGV"), 15000), "the Codex fake is on screen");
    await typeLine(tab, "paste on");
    await sleep(500);
    check((await handoff(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Send to Claude Code", exact: true }).count()) === 1, "Codex: Send to Claude Code");
    check((await handoff(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Send to Codex for review", exact: true }).count()) === 0, "Codex: no Send to Codex");

    // 2. Claude Code's panel: the button and the caption.
    await tabFor(tab, "Claude Code").click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => sessionParam(tab) === claudeId, 5000), "the Claude Code tab opens");
    const send = handoff(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Send to Codex for review", exact: true });
    await send.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
    check(await send.isVisible(), "Claude Code: Send to Codex for review");
    check(await handoff(tab).getByText(CAPTION, { exact: true }).isVisible(), "the caption: Typed for you, not sent");
    check((await handoff(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Send to Claude Code", exact: true }).count()) === 0, "Claude Code: no Send to Claude Code");
    check(!(await sideways(tab)), "no sideways scroll (Hand-off section)");
    await shot(tab, "handoff", W, H, "claude-panel");

    // 3. Send: the page moves to Codex with its terminal focused, the note arrives as one paste, nothing is sent.
    await send.click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => sessionParam(tab) === codexId, 10000), "after Send the page shows the Codex session", sessionParam(tab));
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(`PASTE "${NOTE_FROM_CLAUDE}"`), 10000), "Codex got the note as one bracketed paste", (await termText(tab)).slice(-240));
    await sleep(800);
    check(!/you said:/.test(await termText(tab)), "nothing was sent: no Enter after the paste");
    check(await tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest(".xterm"))), "the Codex terminal has the keyboard, so Enter is one key away");
    const typedStatus = handoff(tab).getByRole("status").filter({ hasText: CAPTION });
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await typedStatus.count()) === 1, 8000), "Codex's panel says Typed for you, not sent");
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await handoff(tab).locator("textarea").first().inputValue()) === NOTE_FROM_CLAUDE, 3000), "and shows the typed text to read");
    await shot(tab, "handoff", W, H, "codex-typed");

    // 4. Codex to Claude Code: Claude turns on paste and posts one hook (its folder trust is seen), then gets the note.
    await tabFor(tab, "Claude Code").click();
    await waitFor(async () => sessionParam(tab) === claudeId, 5000);
    await typeLine(tab, "paste on");
    await typeLine(tab, "hook Stop");
    check(await waitFor(async () => /HOOK 204/.test(await termText(tab)), 8000), "the fake Claude Code's hook was answered 204");
    await tabFor(tab, "Codex").click();
    await waitFor(async () => sessionParam(tab) === codexId, 5000);
    await handoff(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Send to Claude Code", exact: true }).click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => sessionParam(tab) === claudeId, 10000), "after Send the page shows the Claude Code session");
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(`PASTE "${NOTE_FROM_CODEX}"`), 10000), "Claude Code got Codex's note as one paste", (await termText(tab)).slice(-240));

    // 5. The Copy fallback (stubbed answer): the server's reason, the text, Copy copies it, the page stays.
    await tab.route("**/api/sessions/*/send", (route) => json(route, { result: "copy", targetId: null, text: NOTE_FROM_CLAUDE, reason: LIMIT_REASON }));
    await handoff(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Send to Codex for review", exact: true }).click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await handoff(tab).getByText(LIMIT_REASON, { exact: true }).count()) === 1, 5000), "copy: the server's reason is shown");
    const copyBox = handoff(tab).locator("textarea").last();
    check((await copyBox.inputValue()) === NOTE_FROM_CLAUDE, "copy: the text is in the box");
    check(await copyBox.evaluate((el) => el.readOnly), "copy: the box is read-only");
    await handoff(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Copy", exact: true }).last().click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await handoff(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Copied", exact: true }).count()) === 1, 3000), "Copy says Copied");
    check((await tab.evaluate(() => navigator.clipboard.readText())) === NOTE_FROM_CLAUDE, "the clipboard holds the text");
    check(sessionParam(tab) === claudeId, "copy: the page stays on this session");
    check(!(await sideways(tab)), "no sideways scroll (copy box)");
    await shot(tab, "handoff", W, H, "copy");
    await tab.unroute("**/api/sessions/*/send");

    // 6. A session whose hand-off ended in copy (stubbed list): its panel says why and shows the text.
    await tab.route((url) => url.pathname === "/api/sessions", async (route) => {
      const response = await route.fetch();
      const body = await response.json();
      for (const s of body.sessions || []) {
        if (s.id === codexId) s.handoff = { state: "copy", text: NOTE_FROM_CLAUDE, fromId: claudeId, at: new Date().toISOString() };
      }
      await route.fulfill({ response, json: body });
    });
    await tabFor(tab, "Codex").click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await handoff(tab).getByText(CODEX_COPY_REASON, { exact: true }).count()) === 1, 12000), "a hand-off that ended in copy: the reason");
    check((await handoff(tab).locator("textarea").first().inputValue()) === NOTE_FROM_CLAUDE, "and its text");
    await shot(tab, "handoff", W, H, "codex-copy");
    check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "console clean", errors.join(" / "));

    // 7. Help: the hand-off step.
    await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=help`);
    await waitFor(async () => ((await tab.locator("h1").first().textContent()) || "").includes("How a session works"), 8000);
    const help = (await tab.locator(".os-help").innerText()) || "";
    check(help.includes(HELP_STEP), "Help: the hand-off step", help.slice(0, 300));
  } finally {
    await context?.close().catch(() => {});
    await stopEverything().catch(() => {});
  }
}
```

### Task X9: Worktree offer: `worktrees.js`, `folderCheck`, separate copy on `agentos/<agent>-<n>`, `copyOf` titles, recent folders, Remove separate copy

Today two agents can open sessions in the same folder and edit the same files at once, and nothing warns about it. The New session dialog (`src/ui/components/NewSessionDialog.tsx`, header line 1: "without the separate-copy offer, which is SP4") sends only `{ agentId, folder }`. `POST /api/sessions` (`server/runtime/sessions/routes.js`) passes only those two to `manager.create`, and the manager (`startNew`) runs the agent in the folder it was given. The folder policy already allows `<AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees/` (D12, `folders.js`), and `store.js` already makes that folder 0700 (`PRIVATE_DIRS`), but nothing ever makes a copy there. A session started in such a folder would show its session id as the folder name (gap G10), and `recentSessionFolders` would offer the copy as a recent folder.

This task builds the spec's "Worktree offer" (spec "SP4 Session extras"; ruling R25; contract choice K14):
- **The folder check.** A new read-only route, `POST /api/sessions/folder-check`, answers three things: which live sessions already use the chosen folder, whether it is a git project, and which branch a separate copy would get. The branch is `agentos/<agent>-<n>`, with the smallest number no local branch of that agent uses.
- **The offer.** When a live session already uses the folder, the dialog shows "Separate copy (new branch agentos/<agent>-<n>)" (recommended, checked first) or "Same folder". A folder that isn't a git project gets only Same folder, with the reason. OpenClaw never gets the offer, because spike S5 did not confirm that it honours a folder (`OPENCLAW_FOLDER_HONOURED` stays `false`).
- **The copy.** `POST /api/sessions` with `copy: true` makes the copy with `git worktree add <AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees/<id> -b agentos/<agent>-<n> HEAD`. It chmods the copy 0700, checks it against the folder policy, and starts the agent there. A start that fails after the copy was made removes the fresh copy and its branch.
- **Names (R25).** meta.json keeps `copyOf` (the folder that was copied). The session's `folderName` is the project's name, so tab titles, the quit question, Runs and Hold to stop all show "Codex · my-app", never an id. The panel shows the branch and "Separate copy of <folder> (a git worktree)". Recent folders give back the project and never list a copy.
- **Removal.** An ended session's panel offers "Remove separate copy", and it asks first. The server refuses while any session still runs in the copy, and while `git status --porcelain` in the copy shows anything. The copy's branch always stays. Afterwards the session is no longer a copy: the panel drops the copy line, the title keeps the project's name, and Resume says why it can't run there.

It owns these spec items: the five "Worktree offer" bullets, the Home dialog's branch text, and the done-when line "the worktree offer works with a temp git repo, with branch names `agentos/<agent>-<n>`". It also owns the worktree part of Security 3 (argv only) and of Security 5 (`worktrees/` 0700).

Its tests run real `git` only inside temp repos under a temp HOME, with no global or system git settings. They never start a real agent, never open a Terminal window, and never touch the owner's repositories.

3. **Decisions this task makes.** The orchestrator can overturn any of them.
   - (a) `FolderCheck.branch` is the branch a separate copy would get for the agent named in the request; that is why the request carries `agentId`. It is null when the folder isn't a git project or the agent can't use a copy.
   - (b) "Uses the chosen folder" means a live `agent` session (of any agent, the same one too) whose real folder equals the chosen folder's real path. A session in a parent or child folder of the same repository does not count.
   - (c) A copy of a folder inside a project (`~/proj/web`) runs the session in the same place inside the copy (`<copy>/web`). That folder is made, empty, when git tracks nothing in it. `copyOf` is the folder the person chose.
   - (d) A session started inside an existing copy without asking for one gets the copy owner's `copyOf`, so it also shows the project's name. Examples: a hand-off target that X8 opens in the copy, or the copy's path typed by hand. A copy made from inside a copy is a copy of the same project.
   - (e) Any ended session that ran in a copy may ask to remove it, and the removal marks every ended session that ran there with `worktreeRemovedAt`. Removal is refused while any session runs or is starting in the copy. While a copy is being removed, nothing may start or resume in it (409 `session_busy`).
   - (f) `git worktree add` runs the project's own hooks, as it does in Terminal (git-lfs fills a copy's files in its post-checkout hook). The add gets 2 minutes, and the client waits 150 s for a copy start. The removal gets 1 minute, and the client waits 75 s.
   - (g) Start session waits for the folder check of the folder and agent on screen (at most the check's 12 s limit), so a quick click never skips the offer. A check that fails or times out offers nothing, and the session starts in the folder as asked. A typed folder is checked 400 ms after typing stops.
   - (h) Each new offer starts on Separate copy (the prototype's behaviour). The choice resets when the folder or the agent changes.
   - (i) Remove separate copy shows only on an ended session's panel. After a removal the button is gone, so the focus goes to the panel's heading.
   - (j) Files that git ignores (installed packages, build output, an ignored `.env` made in the copy) are not "changes that aren't committed", and `git worktree remove` deletes them with the copy. The confirm says so in one line (Note 2).
   - (k) Once its copy was removed, a session is no longer a copy: its summary's `copyOf` is null, so the panel drops the copy line and the Remove button, and shows the branch with the plain branch icon. Its title keeps the project's name, because `folderName` is stored in meta.json. meta.json keeps `copyOf` for recent folders. This keeps the summary's shape exactly as X1a sends it, which several tests pin.
4. **Risks.**
   - A copy writes into the person's repository through git itself: a new branch and a worktree record. That is what `git worktree add` always does, and both stay visible in `git branch` and `git worktree list`.
   - Someone might make a branch with the very same name between the check and the add. They get 409 `worktree_failed` with git's words, and their branch is never deleted: a failed add deletes a branch only when Agent OS itself cut git off.
   - With an `AGENT_OS_HOME` outside HOME, the folder policy refuses every copy (D12 allows worktrees only inside HOME), and the person sees the policy's "Pick a folder inside your home folder.". The default `AGENT_OS_HOME` is inside HOME. See open question 2.
   - The manager tests inject the real `runGit`, so X7's first changes read after each start also runs real `git` (read-only, `--no-optional-locks`) in the test repos. The tests set `changesPollMs` to 60 s, as X7's own tests do, so no timed read follows, and they end every session before the temp folders go.
5. **Open questions for the orchestrator.** The task is written for the first answer to each; the other answer changes it as said.
   - Should a session in a parent or child folder of the same repository count as "using" the folder? First answer: no (decision b). Second answer: compare the `gitTopLevel` of both folders in `folderCheck`.
   - Should a copy refused because `AGENT_OS_HOME` is outside HOME get its own sentence? First answer: no, the policy's sentence stands (rare, custom setups only). Second answer: map `outside_home` for a copy to a new sentence in `makeCopy`.

  ```js
  // The worktree offer (SP4, Task X9): separate copies of a person's git project, made with
  // `git worktree add <AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees/<id> -b agentos/<agent>-<n>` (spec "Worktree offer", ruling R25,
  // contract choice K14), the routes the New session dialog and the session panel call, and the words they show.
  // Real git runs only inside temp repos under a temp HOME, with no global or system git settings. Nothing here starts
  // an agent or a session: the manager's half is in test/sessions-manager.test.js, and the probe
  // .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/worktree.mjs drives the page.
  import assert from "node:assert/strict";
  import { execFileSync, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
  import { existsSync } from "node:fs";
  import { mkdir, mkdtemp, readFile, realpath, rm, stat, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
  import os from "node:os";
  import path from "node:path";
  import { test } from "node:test";
  import express from "express";
  import { requireLocalMode } from "../server/runtime/local-session.js";
  import { sessionError } from "../server/runtime/sessions/errors.js";
  import { runGit } from "../server/runtime/sessions/git.js";
  import { createSessionsRouter } from "../server/runtime/sessions/routes.js";
  import {
    BRANCH_PREFIX,
    branchName,
    copyAllowed,
    copyPlan,
    createWorktree,
    discardFreshWorktree,
    nextBranch,
    removeWorktree,
    worktreeIdOf,
    worktreePath
  } from "../server/runtime/sessions/worktrees.js";
  import * as dialog from "../src/ui/newSession.ts";
  import * as page from "../src/ui/sessionsPageShared.ts";

  const isWindows = process.platform === "win32";
  const HAS_GIT = spawnSync("git", ["--version"], { stdio: "ignore" }).status === 0;
  const GIT_ONLY = { skip: isWindows ? "POSIX paths and modes" : HAS_GIT ? false : "git is not installed here" };
  const SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS = ["/usr/bin", "/bin", "/usr/sbin", "/sbin"];
  const SESSION_A = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa";
  const SESSION_B = "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb";
  const SESSION_C = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc";
  const DIRTY = "The separate copy has changes that aren't committed. Commit or discard them, then try again.";
  const NOT_GIT = "This folder isn't a git project, so Agent OS can't make a separate copy.";
  const IGNORED = "Files that git ignores in the copy, such as installed packages, are deleted with it.";
  const MODE_KEYS = {
    DEMO_PUBLIC: undefined,
    HERMES_AGENT_OS_DEMO_PUBLIC: undefined,
    HERMES_AGENT_OS_REQUIRE_AUTH: undefined,
    HERMES_AGENT_OS_PUBLIC_MODE: undefined
  };

  async function withEnvVars(vars, fn) {
    const saved = {};
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(vars)) {
      saved[key] = process.env[key];
      if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = String(value);
    }
    try {
      return await fn();
    } finally {
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(saved)) {
        if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
        else process.env[key] = value;
      }
    }
  }

  // git with a temp HOME and no system settings, so the owner's own git setup never takes part.
  function gitTestEnv(home) {
    return { PATH: SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS.join(path.delimiter), HOME: home, USERPROFILE: home, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", LANG: "C" };
  }

  function commit(git, cwd, message) {
    git(cwd, "-c", "user.name=Agent OS test", "-c", "user.email=test@example.invalid", "commit", "-q", "-m", message);
  }

  // A temp HOME with Agent OS's folder inside it (as it is by default), a git project with one commit
  // (projects/my-app, with README.md and src/app.js) and a plain folder (projects/notes).
  async function withRepo(fn) {
    const home = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-worktrees-")));
    const agentOsHome = path.join(home, ".agent-os-data");
    const repo = path.join(home, "projects", "my-app");
    const plain = path.join(home, "projects", "notes");
    await mkdir(path.join(repo, "src"), { recursive: true });
    await mkdir(plain, { recursive: true });
    const env = gitTestEnv(home);
    const git = (cwd, ...args) => execFileSync("git", ["-C", cwd, ...args], { env, encoding: "utf8", stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] });
    git(repo, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
    await writeFile(path.join(repo, "README.md"), "hello\n");
    await writeFile(path.join(repo, "src", "app.js"), "console.log('hi');\n");
    git(repo, "add", ".");
    commit(git, repo, "first");
    try {
      return await withEnvVars({ HOME: home, USERPROFILE: home, AGENT_OS_HOME: agentOsHome, HERMES_AGENT_OS_HOME: undefined }, () =>
        fn({ home, agentOsHome, repo, plain, env, git })
      );
    } finally {
      await rm(home, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
  }

  // runGit, recording every argv it is asked for (without the base arguments runGit adds itself).
  function spyRun(calls) {
    return (folder, args, options) => {
      calls.push({ folder, args: [...args] });
      return runGit(folder, args, options);
    };
  }

  // ---- worktrees.js --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  test("worktrees.js: one branch scheme, agentos/<agent>-<n>, and OpenClaw never gets a copy while it picks its own folder", () => {
    assert.equal(BRANCH_PREFIX, "agentos/");
    assert.equal(branchName("codex", 1), "agentos/codex-1");
    assert.equal(branchName("claude", 12), "agentos/claude-12");
    for (const id of ["claude", "codex", "cursor", "hermes"]) assert.equal(copyAllowed(id), true, id);
    assert.equal(copyAllowed("openclaw"), false, "S5 did not confirm that OpenClaw honours a folder");
    assert.equal(copyAllowed("bash"), false);
    assert.throws(() => branchName("bash", 1), TypeError);
    assert.throws(() => branchName("codex", 0), TypeError);
    assert.throws(() => branchName("codex", 1.5), TypeError);
    assert.equal(path.basename(worktreePath(SESSION_A)), SESSION_A);
    assert.equal(path.basename(path.dirname(worktreePath(SESSION_A))), "worktrees");
  });

  test("nextBranch: the smallest number no local agentos/<agent>-<n> branch uses, per agent; null outside a git project", GIT_ONLY, async () => {
    await withRepo(async ({ repo, plain, env, git }) => {
      assert.equal(await nextBranch(repo, "claude", { env }), "agentos/claude-1");
      for (const name of ["agentos/claude-1", "agentos/claude-3", "agentos/claude-01", "agentos/claude-x", "agentos/codex-1", "claude-2"]) {
        git(repo, "branch", name);
      }
      assert.equal(await nextBranch(repo, "claude", { env }), "agentos/claude-2", "the gap at 2 comes first; 01 and x are other names");
      assert.equal(await nextBranch(repo, "codex", { env }), "agentos/codex-2");
      assert.equal(await nextBranch(repo, "cursor", { env }), "agentos/cursor-1");
      assert.equal(await nextBranch(path.join(repo, "src"), "claude", { env }), "agentos/claude-2", "a folder inside the project counts the project's branches");
      assert.equal(await nextBranch(plain, "claude", { env }), null);
      assert.deepEqual(await copyPlan(repo, "hermes", { env }), { git: true, branch: "agentos/hermes-1" });
      assert.deepEqual(await copyPlan(repo, "openclaw", { env }), { git: true, branch: null }, "a git project, but no copy for OpenClaw");
      assert.deepEqual(await copyPlan(plain, "codex", { env }), { git: false, branch: null });
    });
  });

  test("createWorktree: <AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees/<id> (0700) from HEAD on the next branch, and the project keeps its branch and files", GIT_ONLY, async () => {
    await withRepo(async ({ agentOsHome, repo, env, git }) => {

      assert.equal(await readFile(path.join(dir, "README.md"), "utf8"), "hello\n");
      assert.equal((await stat(dir)).mode & 0o777, 0o700);
      assert.equal((await stat(path.join(agentOsHome, "worktrees"))).mode & 0o777, 0o700);
      assert.equal(git(repo, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD").trim(), "main", "the project stays on its branch");

      const sub = await createWorktree({ folder: path.join(repo, "src"), agentId: "claude", sessionId: SESSION_B, env });

      assert.equal(existsSync(made.path), false, "the copy's folder is gone");
      assert.equal(git(repo, "rev-parse", "agentos/codex-1").trim(), work, "the branch stays, with the work committed in the copy");
      assert.ok(!git(repo, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain").includes(SESSION_A), "git no longer lists the copy");

      for (const call of calls) assert.ok(!call.args.includes("--force"), `never --force: git ${call.args.join(" ")}`);
      assert.ok(calls.some((call) => call.args.join(" ") === `worktree remove ${made.path}`), "git removes the copy itself");
      assert.ok(!calls.some((call) => call.args[0] === "branch"), "the branch is never touched");
    });
  });

  test("removeWorktree: a copy whose folder was deleted by hand is only forgotten by git; with the project gone too there is nothing to do", GIT_ONLY, async () => {
    await withRepo(async ({ home, repo, env, git }) => {
      const made = await createWorktree({ folder: repo, agentId: "claude", sessionId: SESSION_A, env });
      await rm(made.path, { recursive: true, force: true });
      await removeWorktree({ path: made.path, copyOf: repo, env });
      assert.ok(!git(repo, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain").includes(SESSION_A), "git forgot the copy");
      assert.match(git(repo, "rev-parse", "--verify", "-q", "refs/heads/agentos/claude-1").trim(), /^[0-9a-f]{40,64}$/, "the branch stays");
      await removeWorktree({ path: made.path, copyOf: path.join(home, "projects", "gone"), env });
    });
  });

  test("discardFreshWorktree: removes a copy the same start just made and its branch (-d, never -D), and never throws", GIT_ONLY, async () => {
    await withRepo(async ({ repo, env, git }) => {
      const made = await createWorktree({ folder: repo, agentId: "cursor", sessionId: SESSION_A, env });
      const calls = [];
      await discardFreshWorktree({ path: made.path, copyOf: repo, branch: made.branch, env, run: spyRun(calls) });
      assert.equal(existsSync(made.path), false);
      assert.equal(git(repo, "for-each-ref", "refs/heads/agentos/"), "", "the fresh branch is gone");
      assert.deepEqual(
        calls.map((call) => call.args),
        [["worktree", "remove", "--force", made.path], ["worktree", "prune"], ["branch", "-d", "agentos/cursor-1"]]
      );

      // A branch whose commits nothing else holds is never deleted: git -d refuses it.
      const again = await createWorktree({ folder: repo, agentId: "cursor", sessionId: SESSION_B, env });
      assert.equal(again.branch, "agentos/cursor-1");
      await writeFile(path.join(again.path, "x.txt"), "x\n");
      git(again.path, "add", "x.txt");
      commit(git, again.path, "kept");
      await discardFreshWorktree({ path: again.path, copyOf: repo, branch: again.branch, env });
      assert.match(git(repo, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)", "refs/heads/agentos/"), /refs\/heads\/agentos\/cursor-1/);

      // Never throws, even when git can't run at all.
      await discardFreshWorktree({ path: worktreePath(SESSION_C), copyOf: repo, branch: "agentos/cursor-9", env: { PATH: "/nonexistent" } });
    });
  });

  // ---- routes ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  async function withApp(manager, fn) {
    const app = express();
    app.use(express.json());
    app.use("/api/sessions", requireLocalMode, createSessionsRouter({ manager }));
    const server = await new Promise((resolve) => {
      const listening = app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve(listening));
    });
    const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
    const api = async (method, url, body) => {
      const response = await fetch(`${base}${url}`, {
        method,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body)
      });
      const text = await response.text();
      let json = null;
      try {
        json = JSON.parse(text);
      } catch {
        json = null;
      }
      return { status: response.status, json };
    };
    try {
      return await fn(api);
    } finally {
      server.closeAllConnections?.();
      await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve));
    }
  }

  const CHECK = { path: "/Users/you/projects/my-app", name: "my-app", git: true, branch: "agentos/codex-1", inUse: [] };

  function routeManager() {
    const calls = [];
    const manager = {
      maxLive: 8,
      async folderCheck(input) {
        calls.push(["folderCheck", input]);
        return CHECK;
      },
      async create(input) {
        calls.push(["create", input]);
        return { id: SESSION_B, agentId: input.agentId };
      },
      async removeWorktree(id) {
        calls.push(["removeWorktree", id]);
        if (id === SESSION_C) throw sessionError(409, "worktree_dirty", DIRTY);
        return { removed: true };
      }
    };
    return { manager, calls };
  }

  test("routes: POST /api/sessions/folder-check, a separate copy only for copy: true, and DELETE /api/sessions/:id/worktree", async () => {
    const { manager, calls } = routeManager();
    await withEnvVars(MODE_KEYS, () =>
      withApp(manager, async (api) => {
        const checked = await api("POST", "/api/sessions/folder-check", { folder: CHECK.path, agentId: "codex", command: "/bin/sh" });
        assert.equal(checked.status, 200);
        assert.deepEqual(checked.json, CHECK);
        assert.deepEqual(calls.at(-1), ["folderCheck", { folder: CHECK.path, agentId: "codex" }], "only the folder and the agent reach the manager");

        const copy = await api("POST", "/api/sessions", { agentId: "codex", folder: CHECK.path, copy: true });
        assert.equal(copy.status, 201);
        assert.deepEqual(calls.at(-1), ["create", { agentId: "codex", folder: CHECK.path, copy: true }]);
        for (const value of ["true", 1, "yes", null, false]) {
          await api("POST", "/api/sessions", { agentId: "codex", folder: CHECK.path, copy: value });
          assert.deepEqual(calls.at(-1), ["create", { agentId: "codex", folder: CHECK.path }], `copy: ${JSON.stringify(value)} is not a yes`);
        }

        const removed = await api("DELETE", `/api/sessions/${SESSION_A}/worktree`);
        assert.equal(removed.status, 200);
        assert.deepEqual(removed.json, { removed: true });
        assert.deepEqual(calls.at(-1), ["removeWorktree", SESSION_A]);
        const dirty = await api("DELETE", `/api/sessions/${SESSION_C}/worktree`);
        assert.equal(dirty.status, 409);
        assert.deepEqual(dirty.json, { error: "worktree_dirty", message: DIRTY });

        const before = calls.length;
        const bad = await api("DELETE", "/api/sessions/not-a-session/worktree");
        assert.equal(bad.status, 404);
        assert.equal(bad.json.error, "unknown_session");
        assert.equal(calls.length, before, "a bad id never reaches the manager");
      })
    );
  });
  ```
