    ```js
    // ---- SP4 Task X9: the worktree offer (separate copies), with real git in a temp repo ----------------------------

    const GIT_ONLY = {
      skip: isWindows
        ? "POSIX paths and modes"
        : spawnSync("git", ["--version"], { stdio: "ignore" }).status === 0
          ? false
          : "git is not installed here"
    };
    const COPY_LIVE = "That session is still running. Stop it first, then remove its separate copy.";
    const COPY_IN_USE = "Another session is still running in this separate copy. Stop it first, then remove the copy.";
    const COPY_REMOVED = "Its separate copy was removed, so this conversation can't be resumed.";
    const COPY_DIRTY = "The separate copy has changes that aren't committed. Commit or discard them, then try again.";

    // git with a temp HOME and no system settings, so the owner's own git setup never takes part.
    function worktreeGitEnv(home) {
      return { PATH: SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS.join(path.delimiter), HOME: home, USERPROFILE: home, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", LANG: "C" };
    }

    function gitInRepo(home, cwd, ...args) {
      return execFileSync("git", ["-C", cwd, ...args], { env: worktreeGitEnv(home), encoding: "utf8", stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] });
    }

    function commitInRepo(home, cwd, message) {
      gitInRepo(home, cwd, "-c", "user.name=Agent OS test", "-c", "user.email=test@example.invalid", "commit", "-q", "-m", message);
    }

    async function makeGitRepo(home, dir) {
      gitInRepo(home, dir, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
      await writeFile(path.join(dir, "README.md"), "hello\n");
      gitInRepo(home, dir, "add", "README.md");
      commitInRepo(home, dir, "first");
    }

    // withSessionEnv keeps AGENT_OS_HOME outside HOME, where the real folder policy refuses its worktrees/ (D12 allows
    // them only inside HOME, as AGENT_OS_HOME is by default; the worktree probe checks that end to end). This stand-in
    // allows the copies and gives fakeCheckFolder's answers for everything else.
    function copyAwareCheckFolder(agentOsHome) {
      const copies = path.join(agentOsHome, "worktrees") + path.sep;
      return async (input) => {
        try {
          const real = await realpath(String(input || ""));
          if (real.startsWith(copies)) return { ok: true, path: real, name: path.basename(real) };
        } catch {
          // fakeCheckFolder answers for a folder that doesn't exist
        }
        return fakeCheckFolder(input);
      };
    }

    // fakeWorld with real git (runGit), a git environment without a login shell (X7's loginEnv), no timed changes read
    // during the test (X7's own tests do the same), and the copies' folder policy.
    function copyWorld(home, agentOsHome, over = {}) {
      return fakeWorld({
        runGit,
        loginEnv: async () => worktreeGitEnv(home),
        changesPollMs: 60000,
        checkFolder: copyAwareCheckFolder(agentOsHome),
        ...over
      });
    }

    test("worktree offer (X9): folderCheck names the live sessions in the folder, says whether it is a git project and which branch a copy would get", GIT_ONLY, async () => {
      await withSessionEnv(async ({ home, agentOsHome, project, other }) => {
        await makeGitRepo(home, project);
        const world = copyWorld(home, agentOsHome);
        assert.equal(typeof world.manager.folderCheck, "function");
        assert.equal(typeof world.manager.removeWorktree, "function");
        assert.deepEqual(await world.manager.folderCheck({ folder: project, agentId: "codex" }), {
          path: project,
          name: "demo",
          git: true,
          branch: "agentos/codex-1",
          inUse: []
        });

        const claude = await world.manager.create({ agentId: "claude", folder: project });
        const busyFolder = await world.manager.folderCheck({ folder: project, agentId: "codex" });
        assert.deepEqual(busyFolder.inUse, [{ id: claude.id, agentLabel: "Claude Code", title: "Claude Code · demo" }]);
        assert.equal(busyFolder.branch, "agentos/codex-1");
        assert.equal(
          (await world.manager.folderCheck({ folder: project, agentId: "claude" })).branch,
          "agentos/claude-1",
          "a second session of the same agent is offered a copy too"
        );
        assert.equal((await world.manager.folderCheck({ folder: project, agentId: "openclaw" })).branch, null, "OpenClaw: never a copy");
        assert.deepEqual(await world.manager.folderCheck({ folder: other, agentId: "codex" }), {
          path: other,
          name: "other",
          git: false,
          branch: null,
          inUse: []
        });
        await assert.rejects(world.manager.folderCheck({ folder: project, agentId: "bash" }), { status: 400, code: "unknown_agent" });
        await assert.rejects(world.manager.folderCheck({ folder: home, agentId: "codex" }), { status: 400, code: "folder_refused" });

        world.ptys[0].exit(0);
        await ended(world, claude.id);
        assert.deepEqual((await world.manager.folderCheck({ folder: project, agentId: "codex" })).inUse, [], "an ended session no longer uses the folder");
      });
    });

    test("worktree offer (X9): Separate copy makes <AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees/<id> (0700) on agentos/<agent>-<n> from HEAD, starts the agent there, and keeps the project's name", GIT_ONLY, async () => {
      await withSessionEnv(async ({ home, agentOsHome, project }) => {
        await makeGitRepo(home, project);
        const head = gitInRepo(home, project, "rev-parse", "HEAD").trim();
        const world = copyWorld(home, agentOsHome);

        assert.equal(codex.branch, "agentos/codex-1");
        assert.equal(codex.copyOf, project);
        assert.equal(claude.copyOf, null);
        assert.equal(world.profileInputs.at(-1).folder, copyDir, "the profile is built for the copy");
        assert.equal(world.ptys.at(-1).opts.cwd, copyDir, "and the agent runs there");
        assert.equal(gitInRepo(home, copyDir, "rev-parse", "HEAD").trim(), head, "the copy branches from HEAD");
        assert.equal(gitInRepo(home, copyDir, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD").trim(), "agentos/codex-1");
        assert.equal(gitInRepo(home, project, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD").trim(), "main", "the project keeps its branch");
        if (!isWindows) assert.equal((await stat(copyDir)).mode & 0o777, 0o700);

        assert.equal(meta.folder, copyDir);
        assert.equal(meta.folderName, "demo");
        assert.equal(meta.branch, "agentos/codex-1");
        assert.equal(meta.copyOf, project);
        assert.equal(meta.worktreeRemovedAt, null);
        assert.equal((await metaOnDisk(agentOsHome, claude.id)).copyOf, null);

        // Two copies asked for at once never get the same number: they are made one after the other.
        const [a, b] = await Promise.all([
          world.manager.create({ agentId: "codex", folder: project, copy: true }),
          world.manager.create({ agentId: "codex", folder: project, copy: true })
        ]);
        assert.deepEqual([a.branch, b.branch].sort(), ["agentos/codex-2", "agentos/codex-3"]);

        for (const pty of world.ptys) pty.exit(0);
        for (const id of [claude.id, codex.id, a.id, b.id]) await ended(world, id);
      });
    });

        await assert.rejects(world.manager.removeWorktree("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"), { status: 404, code: "unknown_session" });
    ```

  ```js
  // Separate copies of a person's git project (spec SP4, "Worktree offer"; ruling R25; contract choice K14). When a
  // live session already uses a folder, the New session dialog offers a second checkout of the project on a new
  // branch, made with `git worktree add <AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees/<session id> -b agentos/<agent>-<n> HEAD` (the
  // folder policy, D12, allows that folder). <n> is the smallest number no local branch agentos/<agent>-<n> uses yet.
  //
  // Every git call goes through runGit (git.js): argv only, never a shell, with a time limit and an environment
  // without Agent OS's own variables (gitEnv). git runs the project's own hooks, as it does in Terminal (git-lfs fills
  // a copy's files that way).
  //
  // Nothing the person made is ever deleted here:
  // - removeWorktree removes a copy only when `git status --porcelain` in it prints nothing, and asks git without
  //   --force, so git checks again itself. The copy's branch always stays in the project.
  // - The one --force is discardFreshWorktree's, for a copy this same start made moments ago and could not use (a
  //   refused folder, a failed spawn), together with the branch made for it, deleted with -d (git refuses -d for a
  //   branch whose commits nothing else holds).
  import { realpath as realpathCallback, promises as fs } from "node:fs";
  import path from "node:path";
  import { promisify } from "node:util";
  import { ensurePrivateDir, runtimePaths } from "../store.js";
  import { isSessionId, sessionError } from "./errors.js";
  import { gitEnv, gitTopLevel, runGit } from "./git.js";
  import { OPENCLAW_FOLDER_HONOURED, SESSION_AGENTS } from "./profiles.js";
  import { cleanAlertText } from "./signals.js";

  // The letter case stored on disk (macOS, Windows), as folders.js compares folders.
  const realpathNative = promisify(realpathCallback.native);

  export const BRANCH_PREFIX = "agentos/";
  // A big project takes a while to check out (git-lfs fills its files in the same step), and removing a copy deletes
  // every file in it.
  export const WORKTREE_ADD_LIMIT_MS = 120 * 1000;
  export const WORKTREE_REMOVE_LIMIT_MS = 60 * 1000;
  // At most this much of git's own words goes into a refusal.
  export const GIT_SAID_MAX = 300;

  const NOT_GIT_MESSAGE = "This folder isn't a git project, so Agent OS can't make a separate copy.";
  const DIRTY_MESSAGE = "The separate copy has changes that aren't committed. Commit or discard them, then try again.";
  const FAILED = {
    add: { code: "worktree_failed", start: "Agent OS couldn't make the separate copy", late: "git took longer than 2 minutes" },
    remove: { code: "worktree_remove_failed", start: "Agent OS couldn't remove the separate copy", late: "git took longer than a minute" }
  };

  function foldCase(value) {
    return process.platform === "darwin" || process.platform === "win32" ? value.toLowerCase() : value;
  }

  async function isFolder(dir) {
    if (typeof dir !== "string" || dir === "") return false;
    try {
      return (await fs.stat(dir)).isDirectory();
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  async function realFolder(dir) {
    try {
      return await realpathNative(dir);
    } catch {
      return path.resolve(dir);
    }
  }

  // git's own words for a refusal: its first "fatal:" or "error:" line, else its last line (control characters
  // removed, at most GIT_SAID_MAX characters).
  function gitFailure(kind, result) {
    const words = FAILED[kind];
    const lines = String(result?.stderr || result?.stdout || "")
      .split(/\r?\n/)
      .map((line) => line.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
    const said = cleanAlertText(lines.find((line) => /^(?:fatal|error):/i.test(line)) || lines.at(-1) || "", GIT_SAID_MAX);
    if (result?.timedOut) return sessionError(409, words.code, `${words.start}: ${words.late}.`);
    if (said) return sessionError(409, words.code, `${words.start}. Git said: ${said}`);
    return sessionError(409, words.code, `${words.start}, and git gave no reason.`);
  }

  // OpenClaw picks its own folder until spike S5 shows that it honours one (S5 was inconclusive), so it never gets a
  // separate copy; every other session agent can.
  export function copyAllowed(agentId) {
    return SESSION_AGENTS.includes(agentId) && (agentId !== "openclaw" || OPENCLAW_FOLDER_HONOURED);
  }

  // One branch scheme everywhere (spec): agentos/<agent>-<n>, <agent> being the session agent's id. A wrong agent or
  // number is a caller's bug.
  export function branchName(agentId, n) {
    if (!SESSION_AGENTS.includes(agentId)) throw new TypeError(`branchName needs one of: ${SESSION_AGENTS.join(", ")}`);
    if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) throw new TypeError("branchName needs a whole number of 1 or more");
    return `${BRANCH_PREFIX}${agentId}-${n}`;
  }

  // Where the copy made for a session lives.
  export function worktreePath(sessionId) {
    return path.join(runtimePaths().worktrees, sessionId);
  }

  // The smallest agentos/<agent>-<n> no local branch uses yet, or null when git can't list the branches (the folder
  // isn't inside a git work tree). Only plain numbers count: agentos/claude-01 is another name than agentos/claude-1.
  export async function nextBranch(folder, agentId, { env, run = runGit } = {}) {
    branchName(agentId, 1);
    const listed = await run(folder, ["for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)", `refs/heads/${BRANCH_PREFIX}`], { env: gitEnv(env ?? {}) });
    if (!listed?.ok) return null;
    const pattern = new RegExp(`^refs/heads/${BRANCH_PREFIX}${agentId}-([1-9][0-9]*)$`);
    const taken = new Set();
    for (const line of String(listed.stdout || "").split("\n")) {
      const found = pattern.exec(line.trim());
      if (found) taken.add(Number(found[1]));
    }
    let n = 1;
    while (taken.has(n)) n += 1;
    return branchName(agentId, n);
  }

  // What the New session dialog needs to offer a copy of `folder` for `agentId`: whether it is a git project, and the
  // branch a separate copy would get (null when that agent can't use a copy).
  export async function copyPlan(folder, agentId, { env, run = runGit } = {}) {
    const top = await gitTopLevel(folder, { env: gitEnv(env ?? {}), run });
    if (!top) return { git: false, branch: null };
    return { git: true, branch: copyAllowed(agentId) ? await nextBranch(folder, agentId, { env, run }) : null };
  }

  // Makes the copy for `sessionId` from the folder's HEAD on the next free branch. Answers { path, folder, branch,
  // copyOf }: `path` is the copy (0700), `folder` the folder the session runs in (the same place inside the copy that
  // `folder` has inside the project; made empty when git tracks nothing there), `copyOf` the folder that was copied.
  // Throws sessionErrors 409 not_git and 409 worktree_failed; a cut-off or refused add leaves nothing behind.
  export async function createWorktree({ folder, agentId, sessionId, env, run = runGit }) {
    if (!isSessionId(sessionId)) throw new TypeError("createWorktree needs a session id");
    const options = { env: gitEnv(env ?? {}) };
    const top = await gitTopLevel(folder, { ...options, run });
    if (!top) throw sessionError(409, "not_git", NOT_GIT_MESSAGE);
    const branch = await nextBranch(folder, agentId, { env, run });
    if (!branch) throw gitFailure("add", null);
    await ensurePrivateDir(runtimePaths().worktrees);
    const dir = worktreePath(sessionId);
    // HEAD as the start point: the copy branches from the commit the folder is on now (K14).
    const added = await run(folder, ["worktree", "add", dir, "-b", branch, "HEAD"], { ...options, timeoutMs: WORKTREE_ADD_LIMIT_MS });
    if (!added?.ok) {
      // An add that Agent OS cut off may have made the branch already; any other failure made none, and a branch of
      // that name someone made in the meantime is never touched.
      await discardFreshWorktree({ path: dir, copyOf: folder, branch: added?.timedOut ? branch : null, env, run });
      throw gitFailure("add", added);
    }
    try {
      if (process.platform !== "win32") await fs.chmod(dir, 0o700);
      const [topReal, folderReal] = await Promise.all([realFolder(top), realFolder(folder)]);
      const inside = path.relative(topReal, folderReal);
      const sub = inside && inside !== ".." && !inside.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) && !path.isAbsolute(inside) ? inside : "";
      const sessionFolder = sub ? path.join(dir, sub) : dir;
      if (sub) await fs.mkdir(sessionFolder, { recursive: true });
      return { path: dir, folder: sessionFolder, branch, copyOf: folder };
    } catch (error) {
      await discardFreshWorktree({ path: dir, copyOf: folder, branch, env, run });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  // Removes a copy this same start made moments ago and could not use, and the branch made for it. Never throws: a
  // start that failed must report its own reason.
  export async function discardFreshWorktree({ path: dir, copyOf, branch = null, env, run = runGit }) {
    const options = { env: gitEnv(env ?? {}) };
    await run(copyOf, ["worktree", "remove", "--force", dir], { ...options, timeoutMs: WORKTREE_REMOVE_LIMIT_MS });
    // Only ever a folder Agent OS made: <AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees/<session id>.
    if (path.dirname(dir) === runtimePaths().worktrees && isSessionId(path.basename(dir))) {
      await fs.rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {});
    }
    await run(copyOf, ["worktree", "prune"], options);
    if (branch) await run(copyOf, ["branch", "-d", branch], options);
  }

  // Removes a session's copy (Remove separate copy). Refuses (409 worktree_dirty) while `git status --porcelain` in
  // the copy prints anything: a change that isn't committed, or a new file git doesn't ignore. git runs from the
  // project while it is still there, else from the copy itself. A copy whose folder was already deleted is only
  // forgotten by git; when the project is gone too, nothing is left to remove. The branch always stays (K14). Files git
  // ignores in the copy (installed packages, build output) go with it, which the confirm says.
  export async function removeWorktree({ path: dir, copyOf, env, run = runGit }) {
    const options = { env: gitEnv(env ?? {}) };
    const copyThere = await isFolder(dir);
    if (copyThere) {
      const status = await run(dir, ["status", "--porcelain"], options);
      if (!status?.ok) throw gitFailure("remove", status);
      if (String(status.stdout || "").trim() !== "") throw sessionError(409, "worktree_dirty", DIRTY_MESSAGE);
    }
    const from = (await isFolder(copyOf)) ? copyOf : copyThere ? dir : null;
    if (!from) return;
    const removed = await run(from, ["worktree", "remove", dir], { ...options, timeoutMs: WORKTREE_REMOVE_LIMIT_MS });
    if (removed?.ok) return;
    if (!(await isFolder(dir))) {
      await run(from, ["worktree", "prune"], options);
      return;
    }
    throw gitFailure("remove", removed);
  }

  // The session whose copy holds `folder` (a real path), or null when the folder isn't inside
  // <AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees/<session id>.
  export async function worktreeIdOf(folder) {
    if (typeof folder !== "string" || !path.isAbsolute(folder)) return null;
    const root = await realFolder(runtimePaths().worktrees);
    const inside = path.relative(foldCase(root), foldCase(folder));
    if (!inside || inside === ".." || inside.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) || path.isAbsolute(inside)) return null;
    const first = inside.split(path.sep)[0];
    return isSessionId(first) ? first : null;
  }
  ```

  ```js
    async function resolveFolder(agentId, kind, folder) {
      if (kind === "agent" && agentId === "openclaw" && !OPENCLAW_FOLDER_HONOURED) return { folder: null, shown: false };
      const checked = await checkFolder(typeof folder === "string" ? folder : "");
      if (!checked?.ok) throw folderRefused(checked);
      return { folder: checked.path, shown: true };
    }

    // The folder policy's refusal (D12), with its own code (decision Q14).
    function folderRefused(checked) {
      return sessionError(400, "folder_refused", checked?.message || "That folder can't be used.", {
        code: checked?.code || "refused"
      });
    }

    // ---- separate copies (spec SP4, Worktree offer) ----

    // The copies being removed right now, by copy id (removeWorktreeOf): nothing may start or resume in one.
    const removingCopies = new Set();
    // Copies are made one at a time, so two starts never pick the same agentos/<agent>-<n>.
    let copyQueue = Promise.resolve();

    // The project a folder inside an existing copy belongs to: the copy's own session's copyOf (R25). A hand-off
    // target opened in the copy, or the copy's path typed by hand, then shows the project's name too.
    async function copyOfFolder(folder) {
      const copyId = await worktreeIdOf(folder);
      if (!copyId) return null;
      const owner = live.get(copyId)?.meta ?? (await readMeta(copyId));
      return typeof owner?.copyOf === "string" && owner.copyOf ? owner.copyOf : null;
    }

    // Makes a start's separate copy. The copy passes the folder policy like any folder (D12 allows
    // <AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees inside HOME); a refusal removes it again. Answers createWorktree's
    // { path, folder, branch, copyOf } with `folder` as the policy's real path and `copyOf` as the project (a copy made
    // from inside a copy is a copy of the same project), plus the git environment for a later clean-up.
    function makeCopy({ folder, agentId, sessionId }) {
      const work = async () => {
        const env = await loginEnv();
        const copyOf = (await copyOfFolder(folder)) ?? folder;
        const made = await createWorktree({ folder, agentId, sessionId, env, run: runGit });
        const checked = await checkFolder(made.folder);
        if (!checked?.ok) {
          await discardFreshWorktree({ path: made.path, copyOf: made.copyOf, branch: made.branch, env, run: runGit });
          throw folderRefused(checked);
        }
        return { ...made, folder: checked.path, copyOf, env };
      };
      const next = copyQueue.then(work, work);
      copyQueue = next.catch(() => {});
      return next;
    }

    // A start that failed after its copy was made: the fresh copy and its branch go (K14). Never throws.
    async function discardCopy(made) {
      await discardFreshWorktree({ path: made.path, copyOf: made.copyOf, branch: made.branch, env: made.env, run: runGit });
    }

    // While a copy is being removed, nothing may start or resume in it.
    async function assertCopyNotRemoving(folder) {
      if (removingCopies.size === 0) return;
      const copyId = await worktreeIdOf(folder);
      if (copyId && removingCopies.has(copyId)) throw sessionError(409, "session_busy", BUSY_MESSAGE);
    }
  ```

  ```js
    // ---- the worktree offer (spec SP4) ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    // The New session dialog's folder check (POST /api/sessions/folder-check): the live agent sessions that already use
    // the folder, whether it is a git project, and the branch a separate copy would get for this agent. Read-only.
    async function folderCheck({ folder, agentId } = {}) {
      if (!SESSION_AGENTS.includes(agentId)) {
        throw sessionError(400, "unknown_agent", "Agent OS can't start a session for that agent.");
      }
      const checked = await checkFolder(typeof folder === "string" ? folder : "");
      if (!checked?.ok) throw folderRefused(checked);
      const inUse = [...live.values()]
        .filter((state) => state.meta.kind === "agent" && state.status !== "exited" && state.meta.folder === checked.path)
        .map((state) => state.meta)
        .sort(byCreated)
        .map((meta) => ({ id: meta.id, agentLabel: meta.agentLabel, title: titleOf(meta) }));
      const plan = await copyPlan(checked.path, agentId, { env: await loginEnv(), run: runGit });
      return { path: checked.path, name: checked.name || path.basename(checked.path), git: plan.git, branch: plan.branch, inUse };
    }

    // Remove separate copy (spec: "asks first and refuses when there are uncommitted changes"; the page asks). Any ended
    // session that ran in the copy may ask. The copy goes only when no session runs or is starting in it and git status
    // in it prints nothing; its branch stays (K14). Every ended session that ran there is marked, so none offers Resume
    // in a folder that is gone.
    async function removeWorktreeOf(id) {
      assertSessionId(id);
      if (busy.has(id)) throw sessionError(409, "session_busy", BUSY_MESSAGE);
      if (isRunning(id)) throw sessionError(409, "session_live", COPY_LIVE_MESSAGE);
      busy.add(id);
      let claimed = null;
      try {
        await finishedExit(id);
        const meta = await readMeta(id);
        if (!meta) throw unknownSession();
        if (meta.status !== "exited") throw sessionError(409, "session_live", COPY_LIVE_MESSAGE);
        const hasCopy = typeof meta.copyOf === "string" && meta.copyOf !== "" && !meta.worktreeRemovedAt;
        const copyId = hasCopy ? await worktreeIdOf(meta.folder) : null;
        if (!copyId) throw sessionError(404, "no_worktree", NO_WORKTREE_MESSAGE);
        if (removingCopies.has(copyId)) throw sessionError(409, "session_busy", BUSY_MESSAGE);
        removingCopies.add(copyId);
        claimed = copyId;
        for (const state of live.values()) {
          if (state.status === "exited" || state.meta.id === id) continue;
          if ((await worktreeIdOf(state.meta.folder)) === copyId) throw sessionError(409, "session_live", COPY_IN_USE_MESSAGE);
        }
        for (const start of openStarts) {
          if (start.folder && (await worktreeIdOf(start.folder)) === copyId) throw sessionError(409, "session_live", COPY_IN_USE_MESSAGE);
        }
        await removeCopyFolder({ path: worktreePath(copyId), copyOf: meta.copyOf, env: await loginEnv(), run: runGit });
        const at = iso(now());
        for (const otherId of await listSessionIds()) {
          if (isRunning(otherId)) continue;
          const other = await readMeta(otherId);
          if (!other || other.worktreeRemovedAt || (await worktreeIdOf(other.folder)) !== copyId) continue;
          other.worktreeRemovedAt = at;
          await writeJson(path.join(sessionDir(otherId), META_FILE), other);
        }
        return { removed: true };
      } finally {
        if (claimed) removingCopies.delete(claimed);
        busy.delete(id);
      }
    }

  ```

    ```ts
    // ---- The worktree offer (spec SP4) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // When a live session already uses the chosen folder, the dialog offers "Separate copy (new branch
    // agentos/<agent>-<n>)" (recommended) or "Same folder". A separate copy is a git worktree on its own branch, which
    // the server makes inside Agent OS's folder. A folder that isn't a git project gets only Same folder. OpenClaw picks
    // its own folder (spike S5 did not confirm that it honours one), so it never gets the offer. The words come from the
    // spec and the prototype's Home dialog; the server's folder check says who uses the folder and names the branch.
    export const SAME_FOLDER_LABEL = "Same folder";
    export const RECOMMENDED = "Recommended";
    export const OVERWRITE_NOTE = "Two agents editing the same files can overwrite each other.";
    export const SAME_FOLDER_NOTE = "Both agents see and change the same files right now. Fine for reading and review.";
    export const NOT_GIT_NOTE = "This folder isn't a git project, so Agent OS can't make a separate copy.";

    export interface WorktreeOffer {
      // "<agent> already has a session in <folder>", or "<agents> already have sessions in <folder>".
      title: string;
      // "Separate copy (new branch agentos/<agent>-<n>)" and its note, or null when no copy can be made.
      copyLabel: string | null;
      copyNote: string | null;
      // NOT_GIT_NOTE for a folder that isn't a git project, else null.
      notGitNote: string | null;
    }

    function joinNames(names: string[]): string {
      if (names.length <= 1) return names.join("");
      return `${names.slice(0, -1).join(", ")} and ${names[names.length - 1]}`;
    }

    // null: no offer (no answer yet, nobody uses the folder, or an agent without a folder).
    export function worktreeOffer(check: FolderCheck | null, agentId: string): WorktreeOffer | null {
      if (!check || !needsFolder(agentId) || !Array.isArray(check.inUse)) return null;
      const names = [
        ...new Set(check.inUse.map((session) => session?.agentLabel).filter((name): name is string => typeof name === "string" && name !== ""))
      ];
      if (names.length === 0) return null;
      const folderName = check.name || check.path;
      const title =
        names.length === 1 ? `${names[0]} already has a session in ${folderName}` : `${joinNames(names)} already have sessions in ${folderName}`;
      const copy = check.git === true && typeof check.branch === "string" && check.branch !== "";
      return {
        title,
        copyLabel: copy ? `Separate copy (new branch ${check.branch})` : null,
        copyNote: copy
          ? `Agent OS makes a second checkout of ${folderName} (a git worktree) on a new branch. Your files stay untouched until you merge it.`
          : null,
        notGitNote: check.git === false ? NOT_GIT_NOTE : null
      };
    }
    ```

    ```ts
    // A session in a separate copy (spec SP4, Worktree offer): the panel names the project it copies, by the project's
    // folder name (the server keeps the copy's own folder out of every title, ruling R25). The server sends copyOf null
    // once the copy was removed, so a removed copy shows neither this line nor Remove separate copy.
    export function copyLine(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "copyOf" | "folderName">): string | null {
      return s.copyOf ? `Separate copy of ${s.folderName || "—"} (a git worktree)` : null;
    }

    // Remove separate copy: only for an ended session in a copy. The server refuses while any session runs in the copy
    // and while the copy has changes that aren't committed; the copy's branch always stays.
    export const REMOVE_COPY_LABEL = "Remove separate copy";
    export const IGNORED_FILES_NOTE = "Files that git ignores in the copy, such as installed packages, are deleted with it.";
    export function canRemoveCopy(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "status" | "copyOf">): boolean {
      return s.status === "exited" && Boolean(s.copyOf);
    }
    export function removeCopyConfirm(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "folderName" | "branch">): { title: string; lines: string[] } {
      const lines = s.branch ? [`Its branch ${s.branch} stays in the project.`, IGNORED_FILES_NOTE] : [IGNORED_FILES_NOTE];
      return { title: `Remove the separate copy of ${s.folderName || "—"}?`, lines };
    }
    ```

  13a. Create `src/ui/components/RemoveCopyButton.tsx` with exactly this content:

  ```tsx
  // "Remove separate copy" (spec SP4, Worktree offer: "Removing a worktree asks first and refuses when there are
  // uncommitted changes"). Shown on an ended session's panel when the session ran in a separate copy that is still
  // there. It asks first; the server refuses while any session still runs in the copy and while the copy has changes
  // that aren't committed, and its sentence shows in the dialog. The copy's branch always stays. After a removal the
  // button is gone, so the focus goes to `focusAfter` (the panel's heading).
  import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
  import type { RefObject } from "react";
  import { Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
  import { removeWorktree, sessionProblem } from "../../sessionsApi";
  import type { SessionSummary } from "../../types";
  import { REMOVE_COPY_LABEL, removeCopyConfirm } from "../sessionsPageShared";
  import { useSessionsList } from "../useSessionsList";
  import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";

  export default function RemoveCopyButton({ session, focusAfter }: { session: SessionSummary; focusAfter?: RefObject<HTMLElement> }) {
    const { refresh } = useSessionsList();
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
    const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const alive = useRef(true);
    const removed = useRef(false);
    useEffect(() => {
      alive.current = true;
      return () => {
        alive.current = false;
      };
    }, []);
    const words = removeCopyConfirm(session);

    async function remove() {
      if (busy) return;
      setBusy(true);
      setProblem(null);
      try {
        await removeWorktree(session.id);
        if (!alive.current) return;
        removed.current = true;
        setOpen(false);
        refresh();
        window.requestAnimationFrame(() => focusAfter?.current?.focus());
      } catch (error) {
        if (!alive.current) return;
        setProblem(sessionProblem(error));
        refresh();
      } finally {
        if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
      }
    }

    return (
      <>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="os-btn os-btn--secondary"
          onClick={() => {
            setProblem(null);
            setOpen(true);
          }}
        >
          <Trash2 size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
          {REMOVE_COPY_LABEL}
        </button>
        {open ? (
          <AgentConfirmModal
            title={words.title}
            confirmLabel={REMOVE_COPY_LABEL}
            danger
            busy={busy}
            giveFocusBack={() => !removed.current}
            onConfirm={() => void remove()}
            onClose={() => {
              if (!busy) setOpen(false);
            }}
          >
            {words.lines.map((line) => (
              <p key={line}>{line}</p>
            ))}
            {problem ? (
              <p className="os-sess__error" role="alert">
                {problem}
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </AgentConfirmModal>
        ) : null}
      </>
    );
  }
  ```

    ```tsx
      // Each new offer starts on the recommended choice (the prototype's).
      const offerKey = copyOffered ? checkKey : "";
      useEffect(() => {
        setWhere("copy");
      }, [offerKey]);
    ```

- [ ] **Step 17: The probe.** Create `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/worktree.mjs` (git-ignored) with exactly this content:

  ```js
  // Task X9: the worktree offer, end to end. The two choices show only when a live session already uses a git folder;
  // "Separate copy (new branch agentos/codex-1)" is checked first, and Start makes a real git worktree in the server's
  // Agent OS folder. The panel shows the branch and "Separate copy of <folder> (a git worktree)". A folder that isn't a
  // git project gets the not-git sentence and no choices. Recent folders never list a copy. Remove separate copy asks
  // first, refuses a copy with changes that aren't committed (the server's sentence in the dialog), removes a clean one,
  // keeps its branch, and Resume then says why it can't.
  // Run (after `npm run build`), from the worktree root:
  //   node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/worktree.mjs
  // Real PTY sessions with the harness's fake agents (fake-bin/) and real git, only in folders under the throwaway HOME
  // (git there sees no global or system settings). Nothing here starts a real agent; every session it started is stopped.
  import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
  import { existsSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
  import path from "node:path";

  const W = 1470, H = 956;
  const OVERWRITE = "Two agents editing the same files can overwrite each other.";
  const COPY_NOTE = "Agent OS makes a second checkout of wt-app (a git worktree) on a new branch. Your files stay untouched until you merge it.";
  const SAME_NOTE = "Both agents see and change the same files right now. Fine for reading and review.";
  const NOT_GIT = "This folder isn't a git project, so Agent OS can't make a separate copy.";
  const DIRTY = "The separate copy has changes that aren't committed. Commit or discard them, then try again.";
  const IGNORED = "Files that git ignores in the copy, such as installed packages, are deleted with it.";
  const COPY_LINE = "Separate copy of wt-app (a git worktree)";
  const COPY_REMOVED = "Its separate copy was removed, so this conversation can't be resumed.";
  // Chrome logs every refused request (the 409 the probe asks for) as "Failed to load resource"; anything else is real.
  const realErrors = (errors) => errors.filter((e) => !/Failed to load resource/.test(e));

  export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail, api, HOME }) {
    const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));
    if (!HOME) {
      fail("harness", "audit.mjs does not pass HOME to probes");
      return;
    }
    const gitEnv = { PATH: "/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin", HOME, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", LANG: "C" };
    const git = (cwd, ...args) => execFileSync("git", ["-C", cwd, ...args], { env: gitEnv, encoding: "utf8", stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] });
    const app = path.join(HOME, "projects", "wt-app");
    const plain = path.join(HOME, "projects", "wt-plain");
    mkdirSync(app, { recursive: true });
    mkdirSync(plain, { recursive: true });
    git(app, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
    writeFileSync(path.join(app, "README.md"), "hello\n");
    git(app, "add", "README.md");
    git(app, "-c", "user.name=Audit", "-c", "user.email=audit@example.invalid", "commit", "-q", "-m", "first");

    const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
    const waitFor = async (fn, ms = 10000) => {
      const end = Date.now() + ms;
      while (Date.now() < end) {
        try { if (await fn()) return true; } catch {}
        await sleep(250);
      }
      return false;
    };
    const dialogNamed = (tab, name) => tab.getByRole("dialog", { name });
    const panelOf = (tab) => tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Session details" });
    const sessionParam = (tab) => new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("session") || "";
    const sideways = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth > document.scrollingElement.clientWidth);
    const copyRadio = (dialog) => dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Separate copy \(new branch agentos\/codex-1\)/ });
    const sameRadio = (dialog) => dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Same folder/ });
    async function openDialog(tab, agent, folder) {
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).first().click();
      const dialog = dialogNamed(tab, "New session");
      await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.getByText("Checking your agents and safety level…").count()) === 0, 15000);
      await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: agent, exact: true }).click();
      await dialog.getByLabel("Folder (full path)").fill(folder);
      return dialog;
    }
    async function stopEverything() {
      const answer = await api("GET", "/api/sessions?kind=all");
      for (const s of answer.json.sessions || []) if (s.status !== "exited") await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${s.id}/stop`);
    }

    try {
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "sessions");
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1000);

      // 1. A git folder no session uses: no offer, and the session starts right there.
      let dialog = await openDialog(tab, "Claude Code", app);
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1200); // past the folder check (400 ms after typing stops)
      check((await sameRadio(dialog).count()) === 0, "a folder no session uses: no Same folder choice");
      check((await dialog.getByText(OVERWRITE).count()) === 0, "and no offer");
      await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Start session" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.count()) === 0, 25000), "Claude Code starts in wt-app");

      // 2. The same folder for Codex: the offer, with Separate copy checked first.
      dialog = await openDialog(tab, "Codex", app);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await copyRadio(dialog).count()) === 1, 10000), "the offer shows: Separate copy (new branch agentos/codex-1)");
      check(await dialog.getByText("Claude Code already has a session in wt-app", { exact: true }).isVisible(), "the offer names the session already there");
      check(await dialog.getByText(OVERWRITE, { exact: true }).isVisible(), "the overwrite note");
      check(await copyRadio(dialog).isChecked(), "Separate copy is checked first (recommended)");
      check(await dialog.getByText("Recommended", { exact: true }).isVisible(), "the Recommended tag");
      check(await dialog.getByText(COPY_NOTE, { exact: true }).isVisible(), "the copy note names the folder");
      check((await sameRadio(dialog).count()) === 1 && !(await sameRadio(dialog).isChecked()), "Same folder is the other choice");
      check(await dialog.getByText(SAME_NOTE, { exact: true }).isVisible(), "the same-folder note");
      check(!(await sideways(tab)), "no sideways scroll with the offer");
      await shot(tab, "worktree", W, H, "offer");
      await tab.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 720 });
      await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
      const box = await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Start session" }).boundingBox();
      check(Boolean(box) && box.y >= 0 && box.y + box.height <= 720, "1280x720: Start session is on screen with the offer", JSON.stringify(box));
      check(!(await sideways(tab)), "1280x720: no sideways scroll with the offer");
      await shot(tab, "worktree", 1280, 720, "offer");
      await tab.setViewportSize({ width: W, height: H });
      // OpenClaw picks its own folder: no folder, so no offer.
      await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: "OpenClaw", exact: true }).click();
      check((await copyRadio(dialog).count()) === 0 && (await dialog.getByText(OVERWRITE).count()) === 0, "OpenClaw: no offer");
      await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: "Codex", exact: true }).click();
      check(
        await waitFor(async () => (await copyRadio(dialog).count()) === 1 && (await copyRadio(dialog).isChecked()), 10000),
        "back on Codex: the offer again, Separate copy checked"
      );
      // Keyboard: the arrow keys move between the two choices.
      await copyRadio(dialog).focus();
      await tab.keyboard.press("ArrowDown");
      check(await sameRadio(dialog).isChecked(), "ArrowDown picks Same folder");
      await tab.keyboard.press("ArrowUp");
      check(await copyRadio(dialog).isChecked(), "ArrowUp picks Separate copy again");
      await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Start session" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.count()) === 0, 40000), "Start session with Separate copy starts Codex");
      const codexId = sessionParam(tab);
      const codex = (await api("GET", `/api/sessions/${codexId}`)).json;
      check(codex.copyOf === app && codex.branch === "agentos/codex-1", "server: the copy of wt-app on agentos/codex-1", JSON.stringify({ copyOf: codex.copyOf, branch: codex.branch }));
      check(
        typeof codex.folder === "string" && codex.folder.startsWith(path.join(HOME, ".agent-os", "worktrees") + path.sep),
        "server: the copy is in Agent OS's worktrees folder",
        codex.folder
      );
      check(existsSync(path.join(codex.folder, "README.md")), "the copy holds the project's files");
      check(git(app, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD").trim() === "main", "the project stays on its own branch");
      const selected = tab.locator('.os-sess-tabs [role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]');
      check(((await selected.textContent()) || "").includes("Codex · wt-app"), "the tab names the project: Codex · wt-app", await selected.textContent());
      check(await panelOf(tab).getByText("agentos/codex-1", { exact: true }).isVisible(), "panel: the branch");
      check(await panelOf(tab).getByText(COPY_LINE, { exact: true }).isVisible(), "panel: the spec's copy line");
      check((await panelOf(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Remove separate copy" }).count()) === 0, "panel: no Remove separate copy while the session runs");
      await shot(tab, "worktree", W, H, "panel-copy");

      // 3. A folder that isn't a git project: the offer says so and has no choices.
      const plainSession = await api("POST", "/api/sessions", { agentId: "claude", folder: plain });
      check(plainSession.status === 201, "Claude Code starts in wt-plain", JSON.stringify(plainSession.json));
      dialog = await openDialog(tab, "Codex", plain);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.getByText(NOT_GIT, { exact: true }).count()) === 1, 10000), "not a git project: the not-git sentence");
      check(await dialog.getByText("Claude Code already has a session in wt-plain", { exact: true }).isVisible(), "and the session already there");
      check((await sameRadio(dialog).count()) === 0 && (await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Separate copy/ }).count()) === 0, "and no choices");
      await shot(tab, "worktree", W, H, "not-git");

      // 4. Recent folders: the project, never a copy.
      const chips = (await dialog.locator(".os-newsess__recent .os-chip").allTextContents()).map((t) => t.trim());
      check(chips.length > 0 && !chips.some((name) => /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-/.test(name)), "recent folders: no copy (no session id as a name)", chips.join());
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
      const folders = (await api("GET", "/api/sessions/folders")).json.folders || [];
      check(
        folders.some((f) => f.path === app) && !folders.some((f) => f.path.includes(`${path.sep}worktrees${path.sep}`)),
        "GET /api/sessions/folders: wt-app, never a copy",
        JSON.stringify(folders.map((f) => f.path))
      );

      // 5. Remove separate copy: only once the session has ended; asks first; refuses uncommitted changes; keeps the branch.
      await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${codexId}/stop`);
      await tab.locator('.os-sess-tabs [role="tab"]', { hasText: "Codex · wt-app" }).first().click();
      const remove = panelOf(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Remove separate copy" });
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await remove.count()) === 1, 20000), "ended: Remove separate copy shows");
      writeFileSync(path.join(codex.folder, "draft.txt"), "not yet\n");
      await remove.click();
      const confirm = dialogNamed(tab, "Remove the separate copy of wt-app?");
      check(await confirm.isVisible(), "the confirm asks first: Remove the separate copy of wt-app?");
      check(await confirm.getByText("Its branch agentos/codex-1 stays in the project.", { exact: true }).isVisible(), "confirm: the branch stays");
      check(await confirm.getByText(IGNORED, { exact: true }).isVisible(), "confirm: what goes with the copy");
      check(await tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest('[role="dialog"]'))), "focus moves into the confirm");
      await confirm.getByRole("button", { name: "Remove separate copy" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await confirm.getByText(DIRTY, { exact: true }).count()) === 1, 15000), "changes that aren't committed: refused with the server's sentence");
      check(existsSync(path.join(codex.folder, "draft.txt")), "and nothing was deleted");
      await shot(tab, "worktree", W, H, "remove-refused");
      rmSync(path.join(codex.folder, "draft.txt"));
      await confirm.getByRole("button", { name: "Remove separate copy" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await confirm.count()) === 0, 15000), "a clean copy: the confirm closes");
      check(await waitFor(async () => !existsSync(codex.folder), 10000), "the copy's folder is gone");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await remove.count()) === 0, 15000), "Remove separate copy is gone");
      check(
        await tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.tagName === "H2" && Boolean(document.activeElement.closest(".os-sess-panel"))),
        "focus lands on the panel's heading"
      );
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await panelOf(tab).getByText(COPY_LINE, { exact: true }).count()) === 0, 15000), "the copy line is gone: no longer a copy");
      check(await panelOf(tab).getByText("agentos/codex-1", { exact: true }).isVisible(), "panel: the branch is still named");
      check(/^[0-9a-f]{40,64}$/.test(git(app, "rev-parse", "--verify", "-q", "refs/heads/agentos/codex-1").trim()), "the branch agentos/codex-1 stays in the project");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await panelOf(tab).getByText(COPY_REMOVED, { exact: true }).count()) === 1, 15000), "Resume conversation says why it can't");
      check(await panelOf(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" }).isDisabled(), "and Resume conversation is off");
      await shot(tab, "worktree", W, H, "removed");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "console clean", errors.join(" / "));
      await context.close();
    } finally {
      await stopEverything();
    }
  }
  ```

### Task X10: Plan ran out, keep going

Today a held session (X1a's `held` status, set by X1b's limit rules) shows only "Plan ran out" on its tab, "Held" and the panel line. Nothing lets the person carry on. The run side already has the logic: `server/runtime/builders/continue.js` works out "Keep going on OpenRouter" for runs (its options, the Anthropic-only rule, the cost estimate), and `RunLimitBanner.tsx` shows it on the Runs page. Sessions have no such thing, `manager.create` and `manager.resume` always use the saved brain (gap G11), and there is no summary source for a session (gap G3).

This task builds the spec's "Plan ran out, keep going" for sessions:

- **Claude Code** (a held session): a banner with "Keep going on OpenRouter" and "Wait for reset". Keep going opens the prototype's confirm dialog ("Keep going on OpenRouter?", the points "Same conversation", "Pay per use" and "Your call", buttons "Cancel" and "Keep going on OpenRouter"). Only after the confirm does the server stop the session and resume it with `claude --resume <uuid>` on the OpenRouter brain, in the same tab, through the brain override of ruling R26. The model and the estimate come from continue.js's own `claudeOpenRouterOption` (exported here, body unchanged), so only an `anthropic/` model can carry the conversation. The key reaches Claude only through the existing apiKeyHelper settings file (the Keychain helper), never its environment or argv. Without a saved key the banner shows continue.js's sentence and a link to Agents → Brain.
- **Codex** (a held session): the same banner, but its confirm dialog says this is a new conversation. After the confirm a new Codex session opens on the OpenRouter brain (`codexBrainArgs`, through the existing profile) in the same folder, and a summary of the held session's last screen (R24) is typed into it under X8's hand-off write rules. It is never sent. The held session stays open (K15).
- **Cursor**: no banner (it has no limit signal). Its Hand-off section (X8) gains a "Hand to Claude Code or Codex" button. After a confirm, the same kind of summary is typed into an open session of that agent in the folder that can take typed text, or into a new session there.
- **Wait for reset**: the session stays Held and shows the reset time. Agent OS sends nothing.
- **Runs**: the Held run's "Wait for reset" text is reworded to "press Keep going after the reset".

Its tests never start a real agent, never reach openrouter.ai and never touch the Keychain. The server half uses a stub session manager, a local stand-in for openrouter.ai's model prices (`AGENT_OS_SETUP_MIRROR`) and the key in its private file (`AGENT_OS_KEYSTORE=file`). The manager half uses `test/sessions-manager.test.js`'s injected fakes. The page half is a logic test plus a probe on the UI audit harness with the TUI-like fake agents. The probe answers the keep-going and hand-over routes itself, so nothing is stopped, started, typed or spent. The real "Keep going on OpenRouter" is E2's spike S2, which spends OpenRouter credit, so it is asked first (R29).

   - NEW SENTENCE (Q32): "Waiting for your plan to reset (about <time>). This run stays Held and nothing carries on by itself: press Keep going after the reset." (Runs rewording; the last phrase is the spec's).
   - NEW SENTENCE (Q32): "Hand to Claude Code or Codex?" (hand-over dialog title, from the spec's button words).
   - NEW SENTENCE (Q32): "Agent OS types a summary of Cursor's last screen into the agent you pick, in this folder: an open session there when it can take typed text, otherwise a new one. It is typed for you, not sent." (hand-over dialog body).
   - Spec words used as they are: "Keep going on OpenRouter", "Wait for reset", "Keep going on OpenRouter?", "Same conversation.", "Pay per use.", "Your call.", "Cancel", "Typed for you, not sent.", "Hand to Claude Code or Codex", "Agents → Brain" (the link), "Resets <time>." (the spec's panel line ends the same way).
   - Existing sentences reused unchanged:
     - "<agent>'s plan limit was reached." (`LIMIT_MESSAGE`);

     - continue.js's reasons, notes and warnings, and its "That way of continuing isn't available." (fallback);
     - the manager's Look only and busy sentences;
     - profiles.js's "This Claude Code conversation can't be resumed.";

     - "Model" (the Live meter's row name).

4. **Decisions this task makes** (the orchestrator can overturn any; each: decision, why, cost if wrong):
   - **X10-a Everything that can refuse is asked before the stop.** For Claude: Look only (the manager's sentence) and `resolveBrain("claude", brainOverride)` (no key, a bad model) run first. Why: otherwise a refusal inside `resume` would leave the person's conversation stopped. Cost: the brain is resolved twice (cheap for OpenRouter: one key-helper check).
   - **X10-b A second press while one runs is 409 `session_busy`** (the manager's sentence), for keep going and the hand-over. Why: two windows or a double press must not stop and resume twice, or open two Codex sessions. Cost: none.
   - **X10-c The typed summary leaves out every line with a plan limit sentence** ("Contract additions requested" 1). Why: typed into the new session's input, "You've hit your usage limit" would sit on its screen, and X1b's Codex rule (still on screen 5 s later, process alive, no counted output) would make the fresh session look held. Cost: the summary loses the limit line, which carries no work.
   - **X10-d Cursor's hand-over** reuses an open session of the chosen agent in the same real folder when it can take typed text right now (`readyForTyping`). Otherwise it opens a new one there on that agent's saved brain (no override). It refuses for an ended Cursor session, which has no screen left. Why: the spec's write rules ("An open target that fails either rule is not used: a new session of that agent opens instead"), and Cursor's plan running out says nothing about the other agent's plan, so nothing pay-per-use is chosen for the person. Cost: a person who wanted OpenRouter for the new session sets it in Agents first.
   - **X10-e Wait for reset lives on the page, per hold** (`waitKey` = session id and `stateSince`). Nothing is saved or scheduled and nothing is sent. "Show my choices" brings the buttons back. Why: the spec says Agent OS sends nothing; this matches RunLimitBanner. Cost: a reload shows the buttons again.
   - **X10-f The banner is drawn per pane** (inside `renderPane`, for that pane's session, as U6 asks). Why: in split view each held pane says so above its own terminal. Cost: none.
   - **X10-g The confirm dialog** keeps the prototype's title, lede, three points and buttons, adds the model and continue.js's estimate (the estimate sentence, its note and its warnings), and drops the untrue cost sentence (Notes 2, R11). The Codex dialog replaces "Same conversation" with the spec's "Typed for you, not sent" point and says the held session stays open. Cost: the dialog is a little longer than the prototype's.
   - **X10-h The Keep going button shows only once the options are known and available.** Otherwise the banner shows continue.js's reason, plus the Agents → Brain link when a key or a model is the problem (a missing key, no Codex model, a non-`anthropic/` Claude model). Why: never offer a button that can only fail. Cost: for the first moment (one GET) only Wait for reset shows.
   - **X10-i A held session that is not on the plan** (an OpenRouter or Local brain) gets no offer, with the sentence in Notes 3. Why: continue.js's run rule. Keeping going would only restart on the same kind of brain. Cost: none.
   - **X10-j `createSessionsRouter` gains `keepGoingDeps`** ("Contract additions requested" 3). Why: route tests then need no network and no key. Production passes nothing.

5. **Risks.**
   - Keeping Claude going restarts its terminal in the same tab (a Stop, then a Resume). The person sees Claude start again on the same conversation.
   - If the resume fails after the stop (the folder was removed, Claude was uninstalled in between), the session is left ended with "Resume conversation" offered, and the server's own sentence shows in the dialog.
   - The estimate needs openrouter.ai for the price. Offline, the dialog says "Agent OS couldn't estimate the cost." and keeping going still works.
   - A held Codex session in a separate copy (X9) opens its new session in that copy's folder, and its title may show the copy's folder name unless X9 marks folders under `<AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees` as copies (open question 6).
   - X8 internals this task leans on: `deliverTyped` with `waitMs: 0` must answer at once (X8's default parameter keeps a `waitMs` of 0 as 0, and its `whenReadyForTyping` checks once before it waits; Step 0 reads both), and `findHandoffTarget` must accept `liveAgentSessions()` entries.

6. **Open question for the orchestrator** (the task is written for the first answer): should a new session started in a folder under `<AGENT_OS_HOME>/worktrees/` (Codex keep going from a separate copy) inherit the held session's `copyOf` and `branch`? First answer: not in X10. X9's rules decide, and the risk stays as stated. The other answer: `keepGoing` passes `copy: false` and the held session's `copyOf` to `create`, which needs a new X9 option.

```js
const LABELS = { claude: "Claude Code", codex: "Codex", cursor: "Cursor" };

// The manager methods keep-going.js uses, recorded in order. A summary whose status is not "exited" is running
// (liveAgentSessions lists it). `ready` holds the ids readyForTyping answers true for.
function stubManager(sessions = [summary()], { screen = "", ready = [], conversation = CLAUDE_CONVERSATION } = {}) {
  const byId = new Map(sessions.map((s) => [s.id, { ...s }]));
  const calls = [];
  return {
    calls,
    async get(id) {
      calls.push(["get", id]);
      const found = byId.get(id);
      if (!found) throw sessionError(404, "unknown_session", "That session doesn't exist anymore.");
      return { ...found };
    },
    liveAgentSessions(agentId = null) {
      return [...byId.values()]
        .filter((s) => s.kind === "agent" && s.status !== "exited" && (agentId === null || s.agentId === agentId))
        .map((s) => ({
          id: s.id,
          agentId: s.agentId,
          agentSessionId: s.agentId === "claude" ? conversation : null,
          folder: s.folder,
          status: s.status,
          alert: s.alert ?? null,
          pid: 4242,
          profile: { command: `/fake/bin/${s.agentId}`, args: [], cwd: s.folder, env: {} }
        }));
    },
    screenText(id) {
      calls.push(["screenText", id]);
      return screen;
    },
    async stop(id, options) {
      calls.push(["stop", id, options]);
      byId.get(id).status = "exited";
      return { ...byId.get(id), note: null };
    },
    async resume(id, options) {
      calls.push(["resume", id, options]);
      byId.get(id).status = "starting";
      return { ...byId.get(id) };
    },
    async create(input) {
      calls.push(["create", input]);
      const made = summary({
        id: NEW_ID,
        agentId: input.agentId,
        agentLabel: LABELS[input.agentId],
        folder: input.folder,
        status: "starting",
        resetAt: null,
        alert: null,
        meter: null
      });
      byId.set(NEW_ID, made);
      return { ...made };
    },
    readyForTyping(id) {
      calls.push(["readyForTyping", id]);
      return ready.includes(id);
    }
  };
}

const named = (manager, ...names) => manager.calls.filter(([name]) => names.includes(name));

// What keep-going.js asks outside the manager. loadBrains, the key helper, the gate, resolveBrain and the typing are
// fakes; the two options are continue.js's real ones (with the price stand-in), so every estimate is continue.js's own.
function fakeDeps(over = {}) {
  const seen = [];
  return {
    seen,
    loadBrains: async () => ({ ...BRAINS }),
    keyHelper: async () => ({ backend: "file", command: process.execPath, args: ["print-key.mjs"] }),
    isExecutionAllowed: async () => true,
    resolveBrain: async (agentId, override) => {
      seen.push(["resolveBrain", agentId, override]);
      return override;
    },
    deliverTyped: async (_manager, targetId, text, options) => {
      seen.push(["deliverTyped", targetId, text, options]);
      return "typed";
    },
    ...over
  };
}

const cursorSession = (over = {}) =>
  summary({ agentId: "cursor", agentLabel: "Cursor", status: "live", resetAt: null, alert: null, meter: null, ...over });

// The real sessions router on a real port, mounted the way server/index.js mounts it, with fake keep-going deps.
async function withKeepGoingApp(manager, deps, fn) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use("/api/sessions", requireLocalMode, createSessionsRouter({ manager, keepGoingDeps: deps }));
  const server = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const listening = app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve(listening));
  });
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
  const api = async (method, url, body) => {
    const response = await fetch(`${base}${url}`, {
      method,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    const text = await response.text();
    let json = null;
    try {
      json = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      json = null;
    }
    return { status: response.status, json };
  };
  try {
    return await fn(api);
  } finally {
    server.closeAllConnections?.();
    await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve));
  }
}

test("summaryHeader: the fixed one-line header of every typed summary (R24)", () => {
  assert.equal(summaryHeader("Codex", "/Users/you/projects/my-app"), "Picking up from Codex. Folder: /Users/you/projects/my-app. Its last screen:");
  assert.equal(SUMMARY_MAX_LINES, 60);
});

test("buildTypedSummary: the header, then the last 60 lines of the screen without the blank rows around them, each at most 500 characters, through the hand-off clean-up", () => {
  const rows = ["", "", "   ", ...Array.from({ length: 80 }, (_, i) => `line ${i + 1}`), "", "", "", ""];
  const text = buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel: "Codex", folder: FOLDER, screenText: rows.join("\n") });
  const lines = text.split("\n");
  assert.equal(lines[0], summaryHeader("Codex", FOLDER));
  assert.deepEqual(lines.slice(1), Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => `line ${i + 21}`));

  // Blank rows inside the screen stay (they were on it); the ones around it go.
  assert.equal(
    buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel: "Codex", folder: FOLDER, screenText: "\n\nfirst\n\nsecond\n\n" }),
    `${summaryHeader("Codex", FOLDER)}\nfirst\n\nsecond`
  );
  // A long row is cut to 500 characters, counted as code points, so an emoji is never split.
  const long = buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel: "Codex", folder: FOLDER, screenText: "😀".repeat(600) });
  assert.equal(Array.from(long.split("\n")[1]).length, 500);
  // Control characters never reach the target: no ESC, no BEL, no carriage return (cleanTypedText).
  const dirty = buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel: "Codex", folder: FOLDER, screenText: "red \x1b[31mtext\x07\r\nnext" });
  assert.equal(/[\x00-\x09\x0b-\x1f\x7f]/.test(dirty), false, JSON.stringify(dirty));
  assert.ok(dirty.endsWith("\nred [31mtext\nnext"), JSON.stringify(dirty));
  // Nothing on the screen: the header alone.
  assert.equal(buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel: "Cursor", folder: FOLDER, screenText: "" }), summaryHeader("Cursor", FOLDER));
});

test("buildTypedSummary: a line with a plan limit sentence is left out, so typing the summary can never make the new session look held (X1b's screen rules)", () => {
  const screen = [
    "› fix the failing test",
    "■ You’ve hit your usage limit. Try again at 3:45 PM.",
    "You've hit your session limit · resets 3:45pm",
    "Usage limit reached",
    "• Ran npm test"
  ].join("\n");
  const text = buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel: "Codex", folder: FOLDER, screenText: screen });
  assert.deepEqual(text.split("\n").slice(1), ["› fix the failing test", "• Ran npm test"]);
  assert.equal(matchScreenLimit("codex", text), null);
  assert.equal(matchScreenLimit("claude", text), null);
});

test("buildTypedSummary: never more than the hand-off's 32 KB, and never a carriage return or ESC", () => {
  const screen = Array.from({ length: 60 }, () => "é".repeat(500)).join("\n");
  const text = buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel: "Codex", folder: FOLDER, screenText: screen });
  const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(text, "utf8");
  assert.ok(bytes <= TYPED_MAX_BYTES, String(bytes));
  assert.ok(bytes > TYPED_MAX_BYTES - 4, `cut at the limit, not far before it (${bytes})`);
  assert.equal(/[\r\x1b]/.test(text), false);
});

test("keepGoingInfo, Claude Code: resume on OpenRouter with continue.js's own option: Claude's default model (or the saved OpenRouter one), the estimate from the Live meter's context tokens, its note and its warning", async () => {
  const manager = stubManager();

  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(info).sort(), [...KEYS].sort());

    agentId: "claude",
    approach: "resume",
    available: true,
    reason: null,
    model: DEFAULT_CLAUDE_MODEL,
    estimateUsd: 0.42,
    estimateTokens: 140000,
    estimateNote: FORK_NOTE,
    warnings: [FORK_WARNING],
    needsKey: false
  });
  assert.ok(manager.calls.every(([name]) => name === "get"), "asking stops, starts and types nothing");

  const saved = await keepGoingInfo(stubManager(), HELD_ID, fakeDeps({ loadBrains: async () => ({ ...BRAINS, claude: { mode: "openrouter", model: CLAUDE_MODEL } }) }));
  assert.deepEqual([saved.available, saved.model, saved.estimateUsd], [true, CLAUDE_MODEL, 0.42]);

  const noMeter = await keepGoingInfo(stubManager([summary({ meter: null })]), HELD_ID, fakeDeps());

});

test("keepGoingInfo and keepGoing answer only for a held Claude Code or Codex agent session: every other session is 409 not_held and nothing runs; an unknown session is 404", async () => {
  const others = [
    summary({ status: "live" }),
    summary({ status: "idle" }),
    summary({ status: "waiting" }),
    summary({ status: "starting" }),
    summary({ status: "exited" }),
    summary({ agentId: "cursor", agentLabel: "Cursor" }),
    summary({ agentId: "hermes", agentLabel: "Hermes", brain: null }),
    summary({ agentId: "openclaw", agentLabel: "OpenClaw", brain: null }),
    summary({ kind: "update", agentId: "hermes", agentLabel: "Hermes", brain: null })
  ];
  for (const other of others) {
    const manager = stubManager([other]);
    for (const call of [() => keepGoingInfo(manager, HELD_ID, fakeDeps()), () => keepGoing(manager, HELD_ID, fakeDeps())]) {
      await assert.rejects(
        call(),
        (error) => error.status === 409 && error.code === "not_held" && error.message === NOT_HELD,
        `${other.kind} ${other.agentId} ${other.status}`
      );
    }
    assert.deepEqual(named(manager, "stop", "resume", "create", "screenText"), [], `${other.agentId} ${other.status}`);
  }
  await assert.rejects(keepGoingInfo(stubManager([]), HELD_ID, fakeDeps()), (error) => error.status === 404 && error.code === "unknown_session");
});

test("keepGoing, Claude Code: Look only or a brain resolveBrain refuses stops nothing; otherwise Agent OS stops the session, then resumes it on the OpenRouter brain in the same tab (K15, R26)", async () => {
  const lookOnly = stubManager();
  await assert.rejects(
    keepGoing(lookOnly, HELD_ID, fakeDeps({ isExecutionAllowed: async () => false })),
    (error) => error.status === 409 && error.code === "execution_gate_off" && error.message === LOOK_ONLY_MESSAGE
  );
  assert.deepEqual(named(lookOnly, "stop", "resume"), []);

  const refused = stubManager();
  const refusing = fakeDeps({
    resolveBrain: async () => {
      throw brainError("openrouter_key_missing", "Agent OS doesn't have your OpenRouter key saved yet.");
    }
  });
  await assert.rejects(keepGoing(refused, HELD_ID, refusing), (error) => error.code === "openrouter_key_missing");
  assert.deepEqual(named(refused, "stop", "resume"), [], "a refusal never leaves the conversation stopped");

  const manager = stubManager();
  const deps = fakeDeps();
  assert.deepEqual(await keepGoing(manager, HELD_ID, deps), { result: "resumed", targetId: HELD_ID });
  const brain = { mode: "openrouter", model: DEFAULT_CLAUDE_MODEL };
  assert.deepEqual(deps.seen, [["resolveBrain", "claude", brain]]);
  assert.deepEqual(named(manager, "stop", "resume", "create"), [
    ["stop", HELD_ID, { by: "stop" }],
    ["resume", HELD_ID, { brainOverride: brain }]
  ]);
});

test("keepGoing: an option that isn't available answers 409 keep_going_unavailable with continue.js's own reason and changes nothing; a second press while one runs answers 409 session_busy", async () => {
  const noKey = stubManager();
  await assert.rejects(
    keepGoing(noKey, HELD_ID, fakeDeps({ keyHelper: async () => null })),
    (error) => error.status === 409 && error.code === "keep_going_unavailable" && error.message === KEY_SENTENCE
  );
  assert.deepEqual(named(noKey, "stop", "resume", "create"), []);

  const manager = stubManager();
  let release;
  const gate = new Promise((resolve) => {
    release = resolve;
  });
  const realStop = manager.stop;
  manager.stop = async (...args) => {
    await gate;
    return realStop(...args);
  };
  const first = keepGoing(manager, HELD_ID, fakeDeps());
  await assert.rejects(
    keepGoing(manager, HELD_ID, fakeDeps()),
    (error) => error.status === 409 && error.code === "session_busy" && error.message === BUSY_MESSAGE
  );
  release();
  assert.deepEqual(await first, { result: "resumed", targetId: HELD_ID });
  assert.equal(named(manager, "resume").length, 1, "one resume only");
  // Once it has ended the guard is gone; the session is no longer held, so the answer is not_held.
  await assert.rejects(keepGoing(manager, HELD_ID, fakeDeps()), (error) => error.code === "not_held");
});

test("keepGoing, Codex: the held session stays open; a new Codex session opens on the OpenRouter brain in the same folder, and the summary of the held screen is typed into it later under the hand-off rules (deliverTyped), never sent", async () => {
  const screen = "› fix the failing test\n• Ran npm test";
  const held = summary({ agentId: "codex", agentLabel: "Codex" });
  const manager = stubManager([held], { screen });
  const deps = fakeDeps();
  assert.deepEqual(await keepGoing(manager, HELD_ID, deps), { result: "opening", targetId: NEW_ID });
  assert.deepEqual(named(manager, "stop", "resume", "create"), [
    ["create", { agentId: "codex", folder: FOLDER, brainOverride: { mode: "openrouter", model: CODEX_MODEL } }]
  ]);
  await tick();
  assert.deepEqual(deps.seen, [
    ["deliverTyped", NEW_ID, buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel: "Codex", folder: FOLDER, screenText: screen }), { fromId: HELD_ID }]
  ]);

  // A typing that fails later never breaks anything (no unhandled rejection).
  const failing = stubManager([held], { screen });
  const broken = fakeDeps({
    deliverTyped: async () => {
      throw new Error("the new session went away");
    }
  });
  assert.equal((await keepGoing(failing, HELD_ID, broken)).result, "opening");
  await tick();
});

test("handOver: only a Cursor agent session (400 hand_over_not_available), only to Claude Code or Codex (400 invalid_target), only while it runs (409 not_live); an unknown session is 404; nothing opens or types", async () => {
  for (const other of [summary(), summary({ agentId: "codex", agentLabel: "Codex", status: "live" }), summary({ kind: "update", agentId: "hermes", agentLabel: "Hermes", status: "live" })]) {
    const manager = stubManager([other]);
    await assert.rejects(
      handOver(manager, HELD_ID, "claude", fakeDeps()),
      (error) => error.status === 400 && error.code === "hand_over_not_available" && error.message === NOT_CURSOR
    );
    assert.deepEqual(named(manager, "create", "readyForTyping", "screenText"), []);
  }
  for (const to of ["cursor", "hermes", "openclaw", "", undefined, null, ["claude"], { toString: () => "claude" }]) {
    const manager = stubManager([cursorSession()]);
    await assert.rejects(
      handOver(manager, HELD_ID, to, fakeDeps()),
      (error) => error.status === 400 && error.code === "invalid_target" && error.message === INVALID_TARGET,
      JSON.stringify(to)
    );
    assert.deepEqual(named(manager, "create", "readyForTyping", "screenText"), []);
  }
  const ended = stubManager([cursorSession({ status: "exited" })]);
  await assert.rejects(
    handOver(ended, HELD_ID, "codex", fakeDeps()),
    (error) => error.status === 409 && error.code === "not_live" && error.message === CURSOR_ENDED
  );
  await assert.rejects(handOver(stubManager([]), HELD_ID, "codex", fakeDeps()), (error) => error.status === 404 && error.code === "unknown_session");
});

test("handOver: an open session of that agent in the same folder that can take typed text gets the summary now (typed); one that can't, or one in another folder, is not used and a new session opens there on its saved brain (opening); a write that fails gives the text to copy with reason null (the page shows X8's Copy fallback sentence)", async () => {
  const screen = "Cursor: You've used all your included requests\n> refactor the parser";
  const text = buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel: "Cursor", folder: FOLDER, screenText: screen });
  const openClaude = summary({ id: OPEN_ID, status: "idle", resetAt: null, alert: null });

  const ready = stubManager([cursorSession(), openClaude], { screen, ready: [OPEN_ID] });
  const typedDeps = fakeDeps();
  assert.deepEqual(await handOver(ready, HELD_ID, "claude", typedDeps), { result: "typed", targetId: OPEN_ID, text, reason: null });
  assert.deepEqual(typedDeps.seen, [["deliverTyped", OPEN_ID, text, { fromId: HELD_ID, waitMs: 0 }]]);
  assert.deepEqual(named(ready, "create"), []);

  const notReady = stubManager([cursorSession(), openClaude], { screen, ready: [] });
  const openingDeps = fakeDeps();
  assert.deepEqual(await handOver(notReady, HELD_ID, "claude", openingDeps), { result: "opening", targetId: NEW_ID, text, reason: null });
  assert.deepEqual(named(notReady, "create"), [["create", { agentId: "claude", folder: FOLDER }]], "its own saved brain: no override");
  await tick();
  assert.deepEqual(openingDeps.seen, [["deliverTyped", NEW_ID, text, { fromId: HELD_ID }]]);

  const elsewhere = stubManager(
    [cursorSession(), summary({ id: OPEN_ID, agentId: "codex", agentLabel: "Codex", status: "live", folder: OTHER, resetAt: null, alert: null })],
    { screen, ready: [OPEN_ID] }
  );
  assert.equal((await handOver(elsewhere, HELD_ID, "codex", fakeDeps())).result, "opening");
  assert.deepEqual(named(elsewhere, "create"), [["create", { agentId: "codex", folder: FOLDER }]]);

  const failed = stubManager([cursorSession(), openClaude], { screen, ready: [OPEN_ID] });
  assert.deepEqual(await handOver(failed, HELD_ID, "claude", fakeDeps({ deliverTyped: async () => "copy" })), {
    result: "copy",
    targetId: null,
    text,
    reason: null
  });
});

test("routes: GET and POST /api/sessions/:id/keep-going and POST /:id/hand-over answer as the contract says; the body never picks the brain or the model (R26); an id that is not a session id is 404 before anything runs", async () => {
  const manager = stubManager();
  await withKeepGoingApp(manager, fakeDeps(), async (api) => {
    const info = await api("GET", `/api/sessions/${HELD_ID}/keep-going`);
    assert.equal(info.status, 200);
    assert.deepEqual([info.json.agentId, info.json.approach, info.json.available, info.json.estimateUsd], ["claude", "resume", true, 0.42]);

    const kept = await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${HELD_ID}/keep-going`, {
      brainOverride: { mode: "openrouter", model: "openai/gpt-5.5" },
      model: "openai/gpt-5.5",
      agentId: "codex"
    });
    assert.equal(kept.status, 200);
    assert.deepEqual(kept.json, { result: "resumed", targetId: HELD_ID });
    assert.deepEqual(named(manager, "resume"), [["resume", HELD_ID, { brainOverride: { mode: "openrouter", model: DEFAULT_CLAUDE_MODEL } }]]);

    const again = await api("GET", `/api/sessions/${HELD_ID}/keep-going`);
    assert.equal(again.status, 409);
    assert.deepEqual(again.json, { error: "not_held", message: NOT_HELD });

    for (const url of ["/api/sessions/not-a-uuid/keep-going", "/api/sessions/NOT/hand-over"]) {
      const method = url.endsWith("hand-over") ? "POST" : "GET";
      const answer = await api(method, url, method === "POST" ? { to: "claude" } : undefined);
      assert.equal(answer.status, 404, url);
      assert.equal(answer.json?.error, "unknown_session", url);
    }
  });

  const cursorManager = stubManager([cursorSession()], { screen: "> hello", ready: [] });
  await withKeepGoingApp(cursorManager, fakeDeps(), async (api) => {
    const bad = await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${HELD_ID}/hand-over`, { to: "hermes" });
    assert.equal(bad.status, 400);
    assert.deepEqual(bad.json, { error: "invalid_target", message: INVALID_TARGET });
    const list = await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${HELD_ID}/hand-over`, ["codex"]);
    assert.equal(list.status, 400);
    assert.equal(list.json.error, "invalid_target");
    const good = await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${HELD_ID}/hand-over`, { to: "codex", folder: "/etc", agentId: "claude", brainOverride: { mode: "openrouter", model: "x/y" } });
    assert.equal(good.status, 200);
    assert.deepEqual(good.json, {
      result: "opening",
      targetId: NEW_ID,
      text: buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel: "Cursor", folder: FOLDER, screenText: "> hello" }),
      reason: null
    });
    assert.deepEqual(named(cursorManager, "create"), [["create", { agentId: "codex", folder: FOLDER }]], "only `to` is read from the body");
  });
});
```
