```js
// "Plan ran out, keep going" for sessions (spec "SP4 Session extras", Plan
// ran out, keep going; rulings R24 and R26; contract choice K15). It is shown
// only for a held session (a limit confirmed under "Limit rule per agent"),
// and nothing here runs before the person pressed the button and confirmed
// in the page.
//
//   Claude Code  stop the held session, then `claude --resume <uuid>` on the
//                OpenRouter brain in the same tab: the same conversation, on
//                an Anthropic model only (continue.js's rule). The key reaches
//                Claude only through the existing apiKeyHelper settings (the
//                Keychain helper), never its environment or command line.
//   Codex        a NEW Codex session on the OpenRouter brain in the same
//                folder (codexBrainArgs, through the profile), with a summary
//                of the held session's last screen typed into it under the
//                hand-off write rules and never sent. The held session stays
//                open; the person stops it.
//   Cursor       no limit signal, so no banner: "Hand to Claude Code or
//                Codex" types the same kind of summary into an open session of
//                that agent in the folder that can take typed text, or into a
//                new one there.
//
// The options and their estimates are continue.js's own. No route takes a
// brain or a model from the page: the model comes from those options (the
// saved OpenRouter model, else Claude's default), and only this file passes
// `brainOverride` to the manager (R26). Nothing here writes into a terminal:
// typed text goes through handoff.js (deliverTyped, then manager.typeInto).
import { loadBrains } from "../builders/brains.js";
import { claudeOpenRouterOption, codexOpenRouterOption } from "../builders/continue.js";
import { resolveBrainForRun } from "../builders/resolve.js";
import { isExecutionEnabled } from "../execution-gate.js";
import { openRouterKeyHelper } from "../secrets/keystore.js";
import { sessionError } from "./errors.js";
import { INVALID_TARGET_MESSAGE, cleanTypedText, deliverTyped, findHandoffTarget } from "./handoff.js";
import { BUSY_MESSAGE, LOOK_ONLY_MESSAGE } from "./manager.js";
import { CLAUDE_SCREEN_LIMIT, CODEX_SCREEN_LIMIT } from "./mirror-signals.js";

export const SUMMARY_MAX_LINES = 60;
export const SUMMARY_LINE_MAX = 500;
export const NOT_HELD_MESSAGE = "Keep going is offered only when the plan ran out.";
export const NOT_ON_PLAN_MESSAGE = "This session isn't using your plan, so there's no plan limit to get past.";
export const HAND_OVER_NOT_AVAILABLE_MESSAGE = "Only a Cursor session is handed over this way.";
export const HAND_OVER_ENDED_MESSAGE = "This Cursor session has ended, so there is no screen to hand over.";
// profiles.js's own words for a Claude Code session with no conversation id.
const NO_CONVERSATION_MESSAGE = "This Claude Code conversation can't be resumed.";
// continue.js's own words, for an option that is unavailable without saying why.
const UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE = "That way of continuing isn't available.";
const KEEP_GOING_AGENTS = new Set(["claude", "codex"]);

// What keep going asks outside the session manager. Tests pass their own.
export const KEEP_GOING_DEFAULTS = Object.freeze({
  loadBrains,
  keyHelper: openRouterKeyHelper,
  claudeOption: claudeOpenRouterOption,
  codexOption: codexOpenRouterOption,
  isExecutionAllowed: isExecutionEnabled,
  resolveBrain: (agentId, override) => resolveBrainForRun(agentId, override, { prepare: true }),
  deliverTyped
});

// Sessions being kept going or handed over right now, so a double press or a
// second window never stops and resumes twice or opens two sessions.
const changing = new Set();

function withDefaults(deps) {
  return { ...KEEP_GOING_DEFAULTS, ...(deps && typeof deps === "object" ? deps : {}) };
}

function isBlank(line) {
  return line.trim() === "";
}

// ---- the typed summary (R24) ------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function summaryHeader(agentLabel, folder) {
  return `Picking up from ${agentLabel}. Folder: ${folder}. Its last screen:`;
}

// The header, then the last SUMMARY_MAX_LINES lines of the screen without the
// blank rows around them, each cut to SUMMARY_LINE_MAX characters, through the
// hand-off clean-up (no control character but "\n", at most 32 KB). A line
// with a plan limit sentence is left out: typed into the new session's input
// it would sit on that screen, and X1b's screen rules would make the fresh
// session look held.
export function buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel, folder, screenText }) {
  const lines = String(screenText ?? "")
    .split("\n")
    .map((line) => line.replace(/\s+$/, ""))
    .filter((line) => !CLAUDE_SCREEN_LIMIT.test(line) && !CODEX_SCREEN_LIMIT.test(line)); // SCREEN READING (spec SP4)
  while (lines.length && isBlank(lines[lines.length - 1])) lines.pop();
  const tail = lines.slice(-SUMMARY_MAX_LINES);
  while (tail.length && isBlank(tail[0])) tail.shift();
  const body = tail.map((line) => Array.from(line).slice(0, SUMMARY_LINE_MAX).join(""));
  return cleanTypedText([summaryHeader(agentLabel, folder), ...body].join("\n"));
}

// The session's screen as the typed summary, read now.
function summaryFor(manager, summary) {
  const screen = manager.screenText(summary.id); // SCREEN READING (spec SP4)
  return buildTypedSummary({ agentLabel: summary.agentLabel, folder: summary.folder, screenText: screen });
}

// Types `text` into a session that is still starting, once it can take typed
// text (deliverTyped records "typed" or "copy" on that session for the page).
// A failure must never reach the process.
function typeLater(use, manager, targetId, text, fromId) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(() => use.deliverTyped(manager, targetId, text, { fromId }))
    .catch(() => {});
}

// ---- what keeping going would do and cost -----------------------------------------------------------

// The held Claude Code or Codex agent session, or 409 not_held. An unknown id
// is get()'s own 404.
async function heldSession(manager, id) {
  const summary = await manager.get(id);
  const live = manager.liveAgentSessions(summary.agentId).find((entry) => entry.id === id) || null;
  if (summary.kind !== "agent" || !KEEP_GOING_AGENTS.has(summary.agentId) || summary.status !== "held" || !live) {
    throw sessionError(409, "not_held", NOT_HELD_MESSAGE);
  }
  return { summary, live };
}

// KeepGoingInfo (the contract's shape, exactly these keys) from a continue.js option.
function infoFrom(agentId, approach, option, reason, hasKey) {
  return {
    agentId,
    approach,
    available: reason === null,
    reason,
    model: typeof option.brain?.model === "string" ? option.brain.model : null,
    estimateUsd: typeof option.estimateUsd === "number" ? option.estimateUsd : null,
    estimateTokens: typeof option.estimateTokens === "number" ? option.estimateTokens : null,
    estimateNote: typeof option.estimateNote === "string" ? option.estimateNote : "",
    warnings: Array.isArray(option.warnings) ? option.warnings.filter((warning) => typeof warning === "string") : [],
    needsKey: !hasKey
  };
}

async function plan(manager, id, use) {
  const { summary, live } = await heldSession(manager, id);
  const [config, helper] = await Promise.all([use.loadBrains(), use.keyHelper()]);
  const hasKey = Boolean(helper);
  const onPlan = (summary.brain?.kind ?? "plan") === "plan";
  if (summary.agentId === "claude") {
    // continue.js's "fork" is a resume of the conversation by its id; a
    // session has one from its start (--session-id).
    const option = await use.claudeOption({
      run: { agentId: "claude", sessionId: live.agentSessionId, usage: { lastInputTokens: summary.meter?.contextTokens ?? null } },
      config,
      handoffTokens: null,
      hasKey
    });
    const reason = !onPlan
      ? NOT_ON_PLAN_MESSAGE
      : !option.available
        ? option.reason || UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE
        : option.approach !== "fork"
          ? NO_CONVERSATION_MESSAGE
          : null;
    return { summary, info: infoFrom("claude", "resume", option, reason, hasKey) };
  }
  const option = await use.codexOption({
    run: { agentId: "codex" },
    config,
    handoffTokens: Math.ceil(summaryFor(manager, summary).length / 4),
    hasKey
  });
  const reason = !onPlan ? NOT_ON_PLAN_MESSAGE : !option.available ? option.reason || UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE : null;
  return { summary, info: infoFrom("codex", "new", option, reason, hasKey) };
}

// GET /api/sessions/:id/keep-going. Asking stops, starts and types nothing.
export async function keepGoingInfo(manager, id, deps) {
  return (await plan(manager, id, withDefaults(deps))).info;
}

// POST /api/sessions/:id/keep-going, after the person confirmed.
export async function keepGoing(manager, id, deps) {
  const use = withDefaults(deps);
  if (changing.has(id)) throw sessionError(409, "session_busy", BUSY_MESSAGE);
  changing.add(id);
  try {
    const { summary, info } = await plan(manager, id, use);
    if (!info.available) throw sessionError(409, "keep_going_unavailable", info.reason);
    const brainOverride = { mode: "openrouter", model: info.model };
    if (info.agentId === "claude") {
      // Everything that can refuse is asked BEFORE the stop, so a refusal
      // never leaves the person's conversation stopped.
      if (!(await use.isExecutionAllowed())) throw sessionError(409, "execution_gate_off", LOOK_ONLY_MESSAGE);
      await use.resolveBrain("claude", brainOverride);
      await manager.stop(id, { by: "stop" });
      await manager.resume(id, { brainOverride });
      return { result: "resumed", targetId: id };
    }
    // Codex: the held session is left as it is (K15). create() asks Look only itself.
    const text = summaryFor(manager, summary);
    const created = await manager.create({ agentId: "codex", folder: summary.folder, brainOverride });
    typeLater(use, manager, created.id, text, id);
    return { result: "opening", targetId: created.id };
  } finally {
    changing.delete(id);
  }
}

// ---- Cursor's hand-over -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// POST /api/sessions/:id/hand-over, after the person confirmed. An open
// session of that agent in the same folder that can take typed text right now
// gets the summary at once; otherwise (none, or one that fails the write
// rules) a new session opens there on that agent's saved brain, and the
// summary is typed once it can take it.
export async function handOver(manager, id, to, deps) {
  const use = withDefaults(deps);
  const summary = await manager.get(id);
  if (summary.kind !== "agent" || summary.agentId !== "cursor") {
    throw sessionError(400, "hand_over_not_available", HAND_OVER_NOT_AVAILABLE_MESSAGE);
  }
  if (to !== "claude" && to !== "codex") throw sessionError(400, "invalid_target", INVALID_TARGET_MESSAGE);
  if (summary.status === "exited") throw sessionError(409, "not_live", HAND_OVER_ENDED_MESSAGE);
  if (changing.has(id)) throw sessionError(409, "session_busy", BUSY_MESSAGE);
  changing.add(id);
  try {
    const text = summaryFor(manager, summary);
    const target = findHandoffTarget(manager.liveAgentSessions(), { agentId: to, folder: summary.folder });
    if (target && manager.readyForTyping(target.id)) {
      const outcome = await use.deliverTyped(manager, target.id, text, { fromId: id, waitMs: 0 });
      if (outcome === "typed") return { result: "typed", targetId: target.id, text, reason: null };
      // The target missed its moment. `reason: null` makes the page show X8's Copy fallback sentence for that agent
      // (handoffCopyReason in src/ui/handoffShared.ts, the only place it is built).
      return { result: "copy", targetId: null, text, reason: null };
    }
    const created = await manager.create({ agentId: to, folder: summary.folder });
    typeLater(use, manager, created.id, text, id);
    return { result: "opening", targetId: created.id, text, reason: null };
  } finally {
    changing.delete(id);
  }
}
```

```js
import { test } from "node:test";
import * as kg from "../src/ui/keepGoingShared.ts";

const read = (file) => readFileSync(new URL(`../${file}`, import.meta.url), "utf8");
const held = (over = {}) => ({
  id: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
  kind: "agent",
  agentId: "claude",
  agentLabel: "Claude Code",
  status: "held",
  stateSince: "2026-10-29T10:00:00.000Z",
  ...over
});
const claudeInfo = (over = {}) => ({
  agentId: "claude",
  approach: "resume",
  available: true,
  reason: null,
  model: "~anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest",
  estimateUsd: 0.42,
  estimateTokens: 140000,
  estimateNote: "Claude reads the whole conversation again without the cache. This is what that first read costs; the new work costs extra.",
  warnings: ["Continuing re-reads the whole conversation at full price, with no cache discount."],
  needsKey: false,
  ...over
});
const codexInfo = (over = {}) => ({
  agentId: "codex",
  approach: "new",
  available: true,
  reason: null,
  model: "openai/gpt-5.6-codex",
  estimateUsd: 0.01,
  estimateTokens: 40,
  estimateNote: "This is what reading the summary costs; the new work costs extra.",
  warnings: ["Codex starts a new session with a summary; it can't pick up the old one on another provider."],
  needsKey: false,
  ...over
});

test("the banner shows only for a held Claude Code or Codex agent session (Cursor, Hermes and OpenClaw are never held)", () => {
  assert.equal(kg.showsLimitBanner(held()), true);
  assert.equal(kg.showsLimitBanner(held({ agentId: "codex", agentLabel: "Codex" })), true);
  for (const status of ["starting", "live", "waiting", "idle", "exited"]) assert.equal(kg.showsLimitBanner(held({ status })), false, status);
  for (const agentId of ["cursor", "hermes", "openclaw"]) assert.equal(kg.showsLimitBanner(held({ agentId })), false, agentId);
  for (const kind of ["update", "setup"]) assert.equal(kg.showsLimitBanner(held({ kind })), false, kind);
});

test("the banner's words: the limit sentence, Resets <time>. only when the time is known, the prototype's line, and the spec's two buttons", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(kg.limitBannerCopy(held(), "2:21 am"), {
    title: "Claude Code's plan limit was reached.",
    resets: "Resets 2:21 am.",
    sub: "Continues the same conversation. OpenRouter is pay-per-use."
  });
  assert.deepEqual(kg.limitBannerCopy(held({ agentId: "codex", agentLabel: "Codex" }), ""), {
    title: "Codex's plan limit was reached.",
    resets: null,
    sub: "OpenRouter is pay-per-use."
  });
  assert.equal(kg.KEEP_GOING_LABEL, "Keep going on OpenRouter");
  assert.equal(kg.WAIT_FOR_RESET_LABEL, "Wait for reset");
  assert.equal(kg.OPTIONS_LOADING, "Working out your options…");
  assert.equal(kg.OPTIONS_FAILED, "Couldn't work out the options.");
  assert.equal(kg.TRY_AGAIN_LABEL, "Try again");
});

test("Wait for reset: the session stays Held with its reset time and Agent OS sends nothing; it lasts for this hold only; Show my choices brings the buttons back", () => {
  assert.equal(kg.sessionWaitingText("2:21 am"), "Waiting for your plan to reset (about 2:21 am). The session stays Held and Agent OS sends nothing.");
  assert.equal(kg.sessionWaitingText(""), "Waiting for your plan to reset. The session stays Held and Agent OS sends nothing.");
  assert.equal(kg.waitKey(held()), kg.waitKey(held()));
  assert.notEqual(kg.waitKey(held()), kg.waitKey(held({ stateSince: "2026-10-29T12:00:00.000Z" })), "a new hold shows the choices again");
  assert.notEqual(kg.waitKey(held()), kg.waitKey(held({ id: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222" })));
  assert.equal(kg.SHOW_CHOICES_LABEL, "Show my choices");
});

test("the confirm dialog for Claude Code: the spec's title, points and buttons, the prototype's words, and continue.js's estimate, note and warnings", () => {
  const copy = kg.keepGoingDialogCopy(claudeInfo(), "Claude Code");
  assert.equal(copy.title, "Keep going on OpenRouter?");
  assert.equal(copy.lede, "Claude Code carries on with this same conversation, using your OpenRouter brain instead of your plan.");
  assert.deepEqual(copy.points.map((point) => point.label), ["Same conversation.", "Pay per use.", "Your call."]);
  assert.deepEqual(copy.points.map((point) => point.text), [
    "Claude Code keeps what it has read and written so far.",
    "OpenRouter charges for each message. About $0.42 just to get started.",
    "Nothing is switched until you press the button below."
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual([copy.confirm, copy.cancel], ["Keep going on OpenRouter", "Cancel"]);
  assert.equal(copy.model, "~anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest");
  assert.equal(copy.note, claudeInfo().estimateNote);
  assert.deepEqual(copy.warnings, claudeInfo().warnings);
  assert.equal(copy.stays, null);
  assert.equal(kg.estimateSentence({ estimateUsd: null }), "Agent OS couldn't estimate the cost.");
  assert.equal(kg.estimateSentence({ estimateUsd: 3 }), "About $3.00 just to get started.");
  assert.equal(kg.keepGoingDialogCopy(claudeInfo({ estimateUsd: null }), "Claude Code").points[1].text, "OpenRouter charges for each message. Agent OS couldn't estimate the cost.");
});

test("the confirm dialog for Codex says it is a new conversation from the summary, typed for you and not sent, and that the held session stays open", () => {
  const copy = kg.keepGoingDialogCopy(codexInfo(), "Codex");
  assert.equal(copy.title, "Keep going on OpenRouter?");
  assert.equal(copy.lede, "This starts a new Codex conversation from a summary of the last screen.");
  assert.deepEqual(copy.points.map((point) => point.label), ["Typed for you, not sent.", "Pay per use.", "Your call."]);
  assert.equal(copy.points[0].text, "You read the summary in the new session and press Enter yourself.");
  assert.equal(copy.points.some((point) => point.label === "Same conversation."), false);
  assert.equal(copy.stays, "This held Codex session stays open. Stop it when you no longer need it.");
  assert.deepEqual([copy.confirm, copy.cancel], ["Keep going on OpenRouter", "Cancel"]);
});

test("not available: the banner shows continue.js's reason, and the Agents → Brain link when the key or the model is the problem", () => {
  assert.equal(kg.BRAIN_LINK_LABEL, "Agents → Brain");
  assert.equal(kg.needsBrainLink(claudeInfo()), false);
  assert.equal(kg.needsBrainLink(claudeInfo({ available: false, needsKey: true, reason: 'Save your OpenRouter key first ("Remember my OpenRouter key").' })), true);
  assert.equal(kg.needsBrainLink(codexInfo({ available: false, model: null, reason: "Choose an OpenRouter model for Codex first (Agents, then Codex, then Brain)." })), true);
  assert.equal(kg.needsBrainLink(claudeInfo({ available: false, model: "openai/gpt-5.5", reason: "Continuing a Claude conversation only works with Claude models. Pick an Anthropic model for Claude Code on OpenRouter." })), true);
  assert.equal(kg.needsBrainLink(claudeInfo({ available: false, reason: "This session isn't using your plan, so there's no plan limit to get past." })), false);
  assert.equal(kg.needsBrainLink(claudeInfo({ available: false, reason: "This Claude Code conversation can't be resumed." })), false);
});

test("Runs: a Held run's Wait for reset says to press Keep going after the reset (the spec's words), and the old sentence and the prototype's 'then carry on' are gone", () => {
  assert.equal(
    kg.runWaitingText("2:21 am"),
    "Waiting for your plan to reset (about 2:21 am). This run stays Held and nothing carries on by itself: press Keep going after the reset."
  );
  assert.equal(kg.runWaitingText(""), "Waiting for your plan to reset. This run stays Held and nothing carries on by itself: press Keep going after the reset.");
  const banner = read("src/ui/components/RunLimitBanner.tsx");
  assert.match(banner, /const waitingText = runWaitingText\(reset\);/);
  assert.equal(banner.includes("After the reset, open this run again to see your choices."), false);
  assert.equal(/then carry on/i.test(banner), false);
});

test("Cursor's hand-over: only for a running Cursor agent session; the spec's button, a confirm with Claude Code or Codex, and what each answer opens or shows", () => {
  const cursor = (over = {}) => held({ agentId: "cursor", agentLabel: "Cursor", status: "live", ...over });
  for (const status of ["starting", "live", "waiting", "idle"]) assert.equal(kg.canHandOver(cursor({ status })), true, status);
  assert.equal(kg.canHandOver(cursor({ status: "exited" })), false);
  assert.equal(kg.canHandOver(held({ status: "live" })), false);
  assert.equal(kg.canHandOver(cursor({ kind: "update" })), false);
  assert.equal(kg.HAND_OVER_LABEL, "Hand to Claude Code or Codex");
  assert.equal(kg.HAND_OVER_TITLE, "Hand to Claude Code or Codex?");
  assert.equal(kg.HAND_OVER_CONFIRM, "Hand over");
  assert.equal(
    kg.HAND_OVER_BODY,
    "Agent OS types a summary of Cursor's last screen into the agent you pick, in this folder: an open session there when it can take typed text, otherwise a new one. It is typed for you, not sent."
  );
  assert.deepEqual(kg.HAND_OVER_TARGETS.map((target) => [target.id, target.label]), [["claude", "Claude Code"], ["codex", "Codex"]]);

  const id = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333";
  assert.deepEqual(kg.handOverOutcome({ result: "typed", targetId: id, text: "x", reason: null }), { open: id, copy: null });
  assert.deepEqual(kg.handOverOutcome({ result: "opening", targetId: id, text: "x", reason: null }), { open: id, copy: null });
  assert.deepEqual(kg.handOverOutcome({ result: "copy", targetId: null, text: "Picking up", reason: "Codex wasn't ready." }), {
    open: null,
    copy: { text: "Picking up", reason: "Codex wasn't ready." }
  });
  assert.deepEqual(kg.handOverOutcome(null), { open: null, copy: null });
  assert.deepEqual(kg.handOverOutcome({ result: "typed", targetId: null }), { open: null, copy: null });
  assert.equal(kg.keptGoingTarget({ result: "opening", targetId: id }, "own-id"), id);
  assert.equal(kg.keptGoingTarget(null, "own-id"), "own-id");
  assert.equal(kg.keptGoingTarget({ result: "resumed", targetId: "" }, "own-id"), "own-id");
});
```

**13c.** Create `src/ui/keepGoingShared.ts` with exactly this content:
```ts
// Plan ran out, keep going (SP4, Task X10): the words and small rules of a held session's banner, its confirm
// dialog, Wait for reset, Cursor's "Hand to Claude Code or Codex", and the Runs page's Held wording.
// `import type` only (decision P14): test/sessions-keep-going-ui-logic.test.js loads this file straight from src/.
// The sentences are the spec's, the prototype's (sessions.html, limitBanner() and keepGoingDialog()) or existing
// ones (RunLimitBanner, continue.js); the new ones are listed in the plan's Task X10 for the owner's review (Q32).
import type { HandoffResult, KeepGoingInfo, KeepGoingResult, SessionSummary } from "../types";

export const KEEP_GOING_LABEL = "Keep going on OpenRouter";
export const WAIT_FOR_RESET_LABEL = "Wait for reset";
export const SHOW_CHOICES_LABEL = "Show my choices";
export const KEEP_GOING_TITLE = "Keep going on OpenRouter?";
export const CANCEL_LABEL = "Cancel";
export const BRAIN_LINK_LABEL = "Agents → Brain";
export const OPTIONS_LOADING = "Working out your options…";
export const OPTIONS_FAILED = "Couldn't work out the options.";
export const TRY_AGAIN_LABEL = "Try again";
export const CODEX_NEW_CONVERSATION = "This starts a new Codex conversation from a summary of the last screen.";
export const HAND_OVER_LABEL = "Hand to Claude Code or Codex";
export const HAND_OVER_TITLE = "Hand to Claude Code or Codex?";
export const HAND_OVER_CONFIRM = "Hand over";
export const HAND_OVER_BODY =
  "Agent OS types a summary of Cursor's last screen into the agent you pick, in this folder: an open session there when it can take typed text, otherwise a new one. It is typed for you, not sent.";

export type HandOverTarget = "claude" | "codex";
export const HAND_OVER_TARGETS: ReadonlyArray<{ id: HandOverTarget; label: string }> = [
  { id: "claude", label: "Claude Code" },
  { id: "codex", label: "Codex" }
];

// Only a held Claude Code or Codex agent session gets the banner: Cursor, Hermes and OpenClaw are never held (spec,
// Limit rule per agent).
export function showsLimitBanner(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "kind" | "agentId" | "status">): boolean {
  return s.kind === "agent" && s.status === "held" && (s.agentId === "claude" || s.agentId === "codex");
}

// "Wait for reset" holds for this hold only: a new hold (another stateSince) shows the choices again.
export function waitKey(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "id" | "stateSince">): string {
  return `${s.id}:${s.stateSince ?? ""}`;
}

export interface LimitBannerCopy {
  title: string;
  resets: string | null;
  sub: string;
}

// `resetText` is the reset time already in words ("2:21 am", "Oct 30, 2:21 am"; formatResetTime), or "".
export function limitBannerCopy(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "agentId" | "agentLabel">, resetText: string): LimitBannerCopy {
  return {
    title: `${s.agentLabel}'s plan limit was reached.`,
    resets: resetText ? `Resets ${resetText}.` : null,
    // Only Claude Code keeps the same conversation; Codex's keep going is a new one (its dialog says so).
    sub: s.agentId === "claude" ? "Continues the same conversation. OpenRouter is pay-per-use." : "OpenRouter is pay-per-use."
  };
}

export function sessionWaitingText(resetText: string): string {
  return `Waiting for your plan to reset${resetText ? ` (about ${resetText})` : ""}. The session stays Held and Agent OS sends nothing.`;
}

// The Runs page's Held run after Wait for reset (spec: Runs stay Held with "press Keep going after the reset").
export function runWaitingText(resetText: string): string {
  return `Waiting for your plan to reset${resetText ? ` (about ${resetText})` : ""}. This run stays Held and nothing carries on by itself: press Keep going after the reset.`;
}

// The Agents → Brain link goes with a reason the person fixes there: no key, no Codex model, or a Claude model on
// OpenRouter that isn't Anthropic's (continue.js's rule).
export function needsBrainLink(info: Pick<KeepGoingInfo, "agentId" | "available" | "needsKey" | "model">): boolean {
  if (info.available) return false;
  if (info.needsKey || info.model === null) return true;
  return info.agentId === "claude" && !/^~?anthropic\//.test(info.model);
}

export function estimateSentence(info: Pick<KeepGoingInfo, "estimateUsd">): string {
  return typeof info.estimateUsd === "number" && Number.isFinite(info.estimateUsd)
    ? `About $${info.estimateUsd.toFixed(2)} just to get started.`
    : "Agent OS couldn't estimate the cost.";
}

export interface KeepGoingPoint {
  key: "same" | "typed" | "pay" | "call";
  label: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface KeepGoingDialogCopy {
  title: string;
  lede: string;
  points: KeepGoingPoint[];
  model: string | null;
  note: string;
  warnings: string[];
  stays: string | null;
  confirm: string;
  cancel: string;
}

// The prototype's keepGoingDialog(): the spec's title, points and buttons. Its cost sentence ("The cost shows as —
// until OpenRouter reports it.") is not used: the Live meter shows Claude's own estimate from the start (ruling
// R11), so continue.js's estimate is shown instead.
export function keepGoingDialogCopy(info: KeepGoingInfo, agentLabel: string): KeepGoingDialogCopy {
  const pay: KeepGoingPoint = { key: "pay", label: "Pay per use.", text: `OpenRouter charges for each message. ${estimateSentence(info)}` };
  const call: KeepGoingPoint = { key: "call", label: "Your call.", text: "Nothing is switched until you press the button below." };
  const shared = { title: KEEP_GOING_TITLE, model: info.model, note: info.estimateNote, warnings: [...info.warnings], confirm: KEEP_GOING_LABEL, cancel: CANCEL_LABEL };
  if (info.approach === "new") {
    return {
      ...shared,
      lede: CODEX_NEW_CONVERSATION,
      points: [{ key: "typed", label: "Typed for you, not sent.", text: "You read the summary in the new session and press Enter yourself." }, pay, call],
      stays: `This held ${agentLabel} session stays open. Stop it when you no longer need it.`
    };
  }
  return {
    ...shared,
    lede: `${agentLabel} carries on with this same conversation, using your OpenRouter brain instead of your plan.`,
    points: [{ key: "same", label: "Same conversation.", text: `${agentLabel} keeps what it has read and written so far.` }, pay, call],
    stays: null
  };
}

// The tab to open after Keep going: Claude Code's own (resumed in place) or Codex's new session.
export function keptGoingTarget(answer: Pick<KeepGoingResult, "targetId"> | null | undefined, sessionId: string): string {
  return answer && typeof answer.targetId === "string" && answer.targetId ? answer.targetId : sessionId;
}

// Cursor has no limit signal, so its hand-over is a button there at any time while the session runs (spec).
export function canHandOver(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "kind" | "agentId" | "status">): boolean {
  return s.kind === "agent" && s.agentId === "cursor" && s.status !== "exited";
}

export interface HandOverOutcome {
  open: string | null;
  copy: { text: string; reason: string | null } | null;
}

// What the page does with the server's answer: open the target's tab ("typed", "opening"), or show the text to copy.
export function handOverOutcome(answer: Partial<HandoffResult> | null | undefined): HandOverOutcome {
  if (!answer || typeof answer !== "object") return { open: null, copy: null };
  if ((answer.result === "typed" || answer.result === "opening") && typeof answer.targetId === "string" && answer.targetId) {
    return { open: answer.targetId, copy: null };
  }
  if (answer.result === "copy" && typeof answer.text === "string") {
    return { open: null, copy: { text: answer.text, reason: typeof answer.reason === "string" ? answer.reason : null } };
  }
  return { open: null, copy: null };
}
```

**15a.** Create `src/ui/components/KeepGoingDialog.tsx` with exactly this content:
```tsx
// The confirm step before a held session keeps going on OpenRouter (spec "SP4 Session extras", Plan ran out, keep
// going; the prototype's keepGoingDialog() in sessions.html): title "Keep going on OpenRouter?", the points "Same
// conversation" (Codex: "Typed for you, not sent", because its keep going is a new conversation), "Pay per use" and
// "Your call", then Cancel and Keep going on OpenRouter. The cost is continue.js's own estimate of what starting
// costs. Nothing starts, and nothing is spent, until the button is pressed.
import { CircleCheck, Gauge, MessageSquare } from "lucide-react";
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import type { KeepGoingInfo } from "../../types";
import { keepGoingDialogCopy } from "../keepGoingShared";
import type { KeepGoingPoint } from "../keepGoingShared";
import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";

const POINT_ICONS: Record<KeepGoingPoint["key"], LucideIcon> = {
  same: MessageSquare,
  typed: MessageSquare,
  pay: Gauge,
  call: CircleCheck
};

export default function KeepGoingDialog({
  info,
  agentLabel,
  busy,
  error,
  onConfirm,
  onClose,
  giveFocusBack
}: {
  info: KeepGoingInfo;
  agentLabel: string;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  giveFocusBack: () => boolean;
}) {
  const copy = keepGoingDialogCopy(info, agentLabel);
  return (
    <AgentConfirmModal
      title={copy.title}
      confirmLabel={copy.confirm}
      cancelLabel={copy.cancel}
      busy={busy}
      onConfirm={onConfirm}
      onClose={onClose}
      giveFocusBack={giveFocusBack}
    >
      <p>{copy.lede}</p>
      <ul className="os-keepgoing__points">
        {copy.points.map((point) => {
          const Icon = POINT_ICONS[point.key];
          return (
            <li key={point.key}>
              <Icon size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>
                <strong>{point.label}</strong> {point.text}
              </span>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
      {copy.model ? (
        <p className="os-keepgoing__model">
          Model <code className="os-mono">{copy.model}</code>
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {copy.note ? <p className="os-keepgoing__note">{copy.note}</p> : null}
      {copy.warnings.length ? (
        <ul className="os-keepgoing__warnings">
          {copy.warnings.map((warning) => (
            <li key={warning}>{warning}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
      {copy.stays ? <p>{copy.stays}</p> : null}
      {error ? (
        <p className="os-sess__error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </AgentConfirmModal>
  );
}
```

**15b.** Create `src/ui/components/SessionLimitBanner.tsx` with exactly this content:
```tsx
// The banner on a held session (spec "SP4 Session extras", Plan ran out, keep going; the prototype's limitBanner() in
// sessions.html): "<agent>'s plan limit was reached. Resets <time>." with "Keep going on OpenRouter" and "Wait for
// reset". Claude Code and Codex only: Cursor, Hermes and OpenClaw are never held. What keeping going would do and cost
// comes from the server (GET /api/sessions/:id/keep-going, continue.js's own options). Keep going first opens the
// confirm dialog (KeepGoingDialog), and only its button asks the server to act. Wait for reset changes only this page:
// the session stays Held, nothing is saved or scheduled, and Agent OS sends nothing (Claude Code's own auto-resume, if
// the person turned it on, still happens inside Claude Code). Drawn inside each pane (renderPane in SessionsPage.tsx),
// for that pane's session.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowLeftRight } from "lucide-react";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import { getKeepGoing, keepGoing, sessionProblem } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { KeepGoingInfo, SessionSummary } from "../../types";
import { formatResetTime } from "../builderShared";
import {
  BRAIN_LINK_LABEL,
  KEEP_GOING_LABEL,
  OPTIONS_FAILED,
  OPTIONS_LOADING,
  SHOW_CHOICES_LABEL,
  TRY_AGAIN_LABEL,
  WAIT_FOR_RESET_LABEL,
  keptGoingTarget,
  limitBannerCopy,
  needsBrainLink,
  sessionWaitingText,
  showsLimitBanner,
  waitKey
} from "../keepGoingShared";
import { askToFocusNextSession } from "../newSession";
import { useSessionsList } from "../useSessionsList";
import Banner from "./Banner";
import KeepGoingDialog from "./KeepGoingDialog";
import StatusMark from "./StatusMark";

export default function SessionLimitBanner({ session }: { session: SessionSummary }) {
  const shown = showsLimitBanner(session);
  const hold = waitKey(session);
  const { refresh } = useSessionsList();
  const [info, setInfo] = useState<KeepGoingInfo | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const [waitingFor, setWaitingFor] = useState("");
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const reads = useRef(0);
  // True once Keep going was done: the dialog then does not hand the focus back to a button that is going away.
  const actedOn = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // One read per hold. An answer for an earlier session or hold that arrives late is dropped.
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const read = ++reads.current;
    setFailed(false);
    try {
      const next = await getKeepGoing(session.id);
      if (alive.current && read === reads.current) setInfo(next);
    } catch {
      if (alive.current && read === reads.current) setFailed(true);
    }
  }, [session.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setInfo(null);
    setFailed(false);
    setAsking(false);
    setError("");
    if (shown) void load();
    else reads.current += 1;
  }, [hold, shown, load]);

  if (!shown) return null;

  async function confirm() {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const answer = await keepGoing(session.id);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      actedOn.current = true;
      setAsking(false);
      // Claude Code resumes in this same tab; Codex's new session opens in its own. Either way its terminal takes the keys.
      askToFocusNextSession();
      navigateTo("sessions", { session: keptGoingTarget(answer, session.id) });
      refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setError(sessionProblem(err));
      void load();
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const reset = formatResetTime(session.resetAt);
  const copy = limitBannerCopy(session, reset);
  const waiting = waitingFor === hold;
  const actions = waiting ? (
    <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => setWaitingFor("")}>
      {SHOW_CHOICES_LABEL}
    </button>
  ) : (
    <>
      {info?.available ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="os-btn os-btn--secondary"
          onClick={() => {
            actedOn.current = false;
            setError("");
            setAsking(true);
          }}
        >
          <ArrowLeftRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
          {KEEP_GOING_LABEL}
        </button>
      ) : null}
      <button
        type="button"
        className="os-btn os-btn--ghost"
        onClick={() => {
          setAsking(false);
          setWaitingFor(hold);
        }}
      >
        {WAIT_FOR_RESET_LABEL}
      </button>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <div className="os-sess-limit">
      <Banner tone="warn" title={copy.title} actions={actions}>
        {waiting ? (
          <p className="os-sess-limit__line">{sessionWaitingText(reset)}</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            {copy.resets ? <p className="os-sess-limit__line">{copy.resets}</p> : null}
            <p className="os-sess-limit__sub">{copy.sub}</p>
            {info === null && !failed ? <p className="os-sess-limit__note">{OPTIONS_LOADING}</p> : null}
            {failed ? (
              <p className="os-sess-limit__note" role="alert">
                <StatusMark kind="error" /> {OPTIONS_FAILED}{" "}
                <button type="button" className="os-sess-limit__link" onClick={() => void load()}>
                  {TRY_AGAIN_LABEL}
                </button>
              </p>
            ) : null}
            {info && !info.available ? (
              <p className="os-sess-limit__note">
                <StatusMark kind="unknown" label="note" /> {info.reason}
                {needsBrainLink(info) ? (
                  <>
                    {" "}
                    <button type="button" className="os-sess-limit__link" onClick={() => navigateTo("agents", { agent: info.agentId })}>
                      {BRAIN_LINK_LABEL}
                    </button>
                  </>
                ) : null}
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
      </Banner>
      {asking && info?.available ? (
        <KeepGoingDialog
          info={info}
          agentLabel={session.agentLabel}
          busy={busy}
          error={error}
          onConfirm={() => void confirm()}
          onClose={() => {
            if (!busy) setAsking(false);
          }}
          giveFocusBack={() => !actedOn.current}
        />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**15c.** Create `src/ui/components/HandOverButton.tsx` with exactly this content:
```tsx
// Cursor's "Hand to Claude Code or Codex" (spec "SP4 Session extras", Plan ran out, keep going): Cursor sends no limit
// signal, so this is a button in its Hand-off section, there at any time while the session runs. After the confirm,
// the server types a summary of Cursor's last screen into an open Claude Code or Codex session in this folder that can
// take typed text, or into a new one there (hand-off write rules; never sent). The answer opens that session's tab, or
// shows the text to copy with the reason (X8's Copy fallback). A "copy" answer with no reason of its own means the
// agent missed its moment, so this file fills in X8's sentence for the chosen agent (handoffCopyReason).
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import { handOver, sessionProblem } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { SessionSummary } from "../../types";
import { handoffCopyReason } from "../handoffShared";
import {
  HAND_OVER_BODY,
  HAND_OVER_CONFIRM,
  HAND_OVER_LABEL,
  HAND_OVER_TARGETS,
  HAND_OVER_TITLE,
  canHandOver,
  handOverOutcome
} from "../keepGoingShared";
import type { HandOverOutcome, HandOverTarget } from "../keepGoingShared";
import { askToFocusNextSession } from "../newSession";
import { useSessionsList } from "../useSessionsList";
import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";
import HandoffCopyFallback from "./HandoffCopyFallback";

// The chosen agent's short name ("Claude Code" or "Codex"), for X8's Copy fallback sentence.
function targetLabel(to: HandOverTarget): string {
  return HAND_OVER_TARGETS.find((target) => target.id === to)?.label ?? to;
}

export default function HandOverButton({ session }: { session: SessionSummary }) {
  const { refresh } = useSessionsList();
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState(false);
  const [to, setTo] = useState<HandOverTarget>("claude");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [copy, setCopy] = useState<HandOverOutcome["copy"]>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  // True once a session was opened: the dialog then leaves the focus to that session's terminal.
  const opened = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setAsking(false);
    setError("");
    setCopy(null);
  }, [session.id]);

  if (!canHandOver(session)) return null;

  async function confirm() {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const outcome = handOverOutcome(await handOver(session.id, to));
      if (!alive.current) return;
      opened.current = outcome.open !== null;
      setAsking(false);
      setCopy(outcome.copy ? { text: outcome.copy.text, reason: outcome.copy.reason ?? handoffCopyReason(targetLabel(to)) } : null);
      if (outcome.open) {
        askToFocusNextSession();
        navigateTo("sessions", { session: outcome.open });
      }
      refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(sessionProblem(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="os-handover">
      <button
        type="button"
        className="os-btn os-btn--secondary os-handover__open"
        onClick={() => {
          opened.current = false;
          setError("");
          setCopy(null);
          setAsking(true);
        }}
      >
        {HAND_OVER_LABEL}
      </button>
      {copy ? <HandoffCopyFallback text={copy.text} reason={copy.reason} /> : null}
      {asking ? (
        <AgentConfirmModal
          title={HAND_OVER_TITLE}
          confirmLabel={HAND_OVER_CONFIRM}
          busy={busy}
          onConfirm={() => void confirm()}
          onClose={() => {
            if (!busy) setAsking(false);
          }}
          giveFocusBack={() => !opened.current}
        >
          <p>{HAND_OVER_BODY}</p>
          <fieldset className="os-handover__choices" aria-label={HAND_OVER_LABEL}>
            {HAND_OVER_TARGETS.map((target) => (
              <label key={target.id} className="os-handover__choice">
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name={`os-handover-${session.id}`}
                  value={target.id}
                  checked={to === target.id}
                  onChange={() => setTo(target.id)}
                />
                {target.label}
              </label>
            ))}
          </fieldset>
          {error ? (
            <p className="os-sess__error" role="alert">
              {error}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </AgentConfirmModal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 17: The probe.** Create `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/keepgoing.mjs` (git-ignored, never committed) with exactly this content:

```js
// Task X10: Plan ran out, keep going. The held session's banner ("Keep going on OpenRouter" / "Wait for reset"), the
// confirm dialog's words, Cancel sending nothing, the Codex dialog's new-conversation line and the jump to the new tab,
// the missing-key line with its Agents → Brain link, and Cursor's "Hand to Claude Code or Codex" with its Copy fallback.
// Run (after `npm run build`), from the worktree root:
//   node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/keepgoing.mjs
// Real fake sessions (test/fakes/tui-agent.mjs through the harness's fake-bin) give the tabs and the terminals. Held is
// made on the page only: the list answer is changed to say held (the server's limit rules and keep going are tested in
// test/sessions-mirror-signals.test.js and test/sessions-keep-going.test.js), and the probe answers the keep-going and
// hand-over routes itself, so the server stops, resumes, starts and types nothing, and nothing is ever spent. The probe
// stops every session it started.
import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const W = 1470, H = 956;
const json = (route, body, status = 200) => route.fulfill({ status, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
// Chrome logs refused or stubbed requests as "Failed to load resource"; anything else is a real console error.
const realErrors = (errors) => errors.filter((e) => !/Failed to load resource/.test(e));
const KEY_SENTENCE = 'Save your OpenRouter key first ("Remember my OpenRouter key").';
const CLAUDE_INFO = {
  agentId: "claude", approach: "resume", available: true, reason: null, model: "~anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest",
  estimateUsd: 0.42, estimateTokens: 140000,
  estimateNote: "Claude reads the whole conversation again without the cache. This is what that first read costs; the new work costs extra.",
  warnings: ["Continuing re-reads the whole conversation at full price, with no cache discount."], needsKey: false
};
const CODEX_INFO = {
  agentId: "codex", approach: "new", available: true, reason: null, model: "openai/gpt-5.6-codex", estimateUsd: 0.01,
  estimateTokens: 40, estimateNote: "This is what reading the summary costs; the new work costs extra.",
  warnings: ["Codex starts a new session with a summary; it can't pick up the old one on another provider."], needsKey: false
};
const NO_KEY_INFO = { ...CLAUDE_INFO, available: false, reason: KEY_SENTENCE, needsKey: true };
const COPY_REASON = "Codex wasn't ready for typed text in time, so here is the text to copy.";

export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail, api, BASE, HOME }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));
  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const waitFor = async (fn, ms = 10000) => {
    const end = Date.now() + ms;
    while (Date.now() < end) {
      try { if (await fn()) return true; } catch {}
      await sleep(200);
    }
    return false;
  };
  if (!HOME) {
    fail("harness", "audit.mjs does not pass HOME to probes");
    return;
  }
  const folders = ["kg-claude", "kg-codex", "kg-cursor"].map((name) => path.join(HOME, "projects", name));
  for (const dir of folders) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const started = [];
  try {
    for (const [agentId, folder] of [["claude", folders[0]], ["codex", folders[1]], ["cursor", folders[2]]]) {
      const answer = await api("POST", "/api/sessions", { agentId, folder });
      check(answer.status === 201, `a fake ${agentId} session starts`, answer.status);
      started.push(answer.json?.id);
    }
    const [claudeId, codexId, cursorId] = started;
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, `sessions&session=${claudeId}`);

    // Held, on the page only: the list says so for the Claude and Codex sessions, with a reset two hours ahead.
    const resetAt = new Date(Date.now() + 2 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
    await tab.route((u) => u.pathname === "/api/sessions", async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() !== "GET") return route.continue();
      const response = await route.fetch();
      const body = await response.json();
      const sessions = (body.sessions || []).map((s) =>
        (s.id === claudeId || s.id === codexId) && s.status !== "exited"
          ? { ...s, status: "held", resetAt, alert: { kind: "limit", text: `${s.agentLabel}'s plan limit was reached.`, at: new Date().toISOString() } }
          : s
      );
      return route.fulfill({ response, json: { ...body, sessions } });
    });
    const posts = [];
    let claudeInfo = CLAUDE_INFO;
    await tab.route((u) => /^\/api\/sessions\/[^/]+\/keep-going$/.test(u.pathname), (route) => {
      const id = new URL(route.request().url()).pathname.split("/")[3];
      if (route.request().method() === "GET") return json(route, id === codexId ? CODEX_INFO : claudeInfo);
      posts.push({ id, body: route.request().postData() });
      return json(route, id === codexId ? { result: "opening", targetId: cursorId } : { result: "resumed", targetId: id });
    });
    await tab.reload();

    // 1. The banner on the held Claude Code session.
    const banner = tab.locator(".os-sess-limit");
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await banner.count()) === 1 && (await banner.isVisible()), 15000), "held Claude Code: the banner shows");
    const btext = (await banner.innerText()) || "";
    check(btext.includes("Claude Code's plan limit was reached."), "banner: the limit sentence", btext);
    check(/Resets \d{1,2}:\d{2} (am|pm)\./.test(btext), "banner: the reset time", btext);
    check(btext.includes("Continues the same conversation. OpenRouter is pay-per-use."), "banner: the prototype's line", btext);
    const keep = banner.getByRole("button", { name: "Keep going on OpenRouter" });
    const wait = banner.getByRole("button", { name: "Wait for reset" });
    check(await waitFor(() => keep.isVisible(), 5000) && (await wait.isVisible()), "banner: Keep going on OpenRouter and Wait for reset");
    const order = await tab.evaluate(() => {
      const pane = document.querySelector(".os-sess-pane");
      const b = pane?.querySelector(".os-sess-limit");
      const t = pane?.querySelector(".os-sess-term");
      return Boolean(b && t && b.compareDocumentPosition(t) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING);
    });
    check(order, "banner: inside the pane, above the terminal");
    await shot(tab, "keepgoing", W, H, "banner");

    // 2. The confirm dialog: the spec's title, points and buttons; Cancel sends nothing and gives the focus back.
    await keep.click();
    const dialog = tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Keep going on OpenRouter?" });
    check(await dialog.isVisible(), "confirm: titled Keep going on OpenRouter?");
    const dtext = (await dialog.innerText()) || "";
    for (const words of ["Same conversation.", "Pay per use.", "Your call.", "About $0.42 just to get started.", "Nothing is switched until you press the button below.", "~anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest"]) {
      check(dtext.includes(words), `confirm: ${words}`, dtext.slice(0, 300));
    }
    check(!dtext.includes("—"), "confirm: no dash promising a cost later (R11)", dtext.slice(0, 300));
    check((await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).isVisible()) && (await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Keep going on OpenRouter" }).isVisible()), "confirm: Cancel and Keep going on OpenRouter");
    check(await tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest('[role="dialog"]'))), "confirm: the keyboard is inside the dialog");
    await shot(tab, "keepgoing", W, H, "confirm");
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
    check((await dialog.count()) === 0 && posts.length === 0, "Cancel closes it and sends nothing", posts.length);
    check(await tab.evaluate(() => (document.activeElement?.textContent || "").includes("Keep going on OpenRouter")), "Cancel gives the focus back to Keep going");

    await keep.click();
    await tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Keep going on OpenRouter?" }).getByRole("button", { name: "Keep going on OpenRouter" }).click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => posts.length === 1 && (await tab.getByRole("dialog").count()) === 0, 5000), "confirm: one request, then the dialog closes", JSON.stringify(posts));
    check(posts[0]?.id === claudeId && (posts[0]?.body === "{}" || !posts[0]?.body), "the request names this session and carries no brain", JSON.stringify(posts[0]));

    // 3. Wait for reset: the reset time, nothing sent, Show my choices.
    await wait.click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => /Waiting for your plan to reset \(about .+\)\. The session stays Held and Agent OS sends nothing\./.test((await banner.innerText()) || ""), 3000), "Wait for reset: the reset time, and nothing is sent");
    check(posts.length === 1, "Wait for reset sends nothing", posts.length);
    check((await banner.getByRole("button", { name: "Keep going on OpenRouter" }).count()) === 0, "Wait for reset: the choices step aside");
    await shot(tab, "keepgoing", W, H, "waiting");
    await banner.getByRole("button", { name: "Show my choices" }).click();
    check(await waitFor(() => keep.isVisible(), 3000), "Show my choices brings them back");

    // 4. 1280×720: the main action is on screen and nothing scrolls sideways.
    await tab.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 720 });
    await sleep(400);
    check(!(await tab.evaluate(() => document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth > document.scrollingElement.clientWidth)), "1280×720: no sideways scroll");
    const box = await keep.boundingBox();
    check(Boolean(box) && box.y >= 0 && box.y + box.height <= 720 && box.x + box.width <= 1280, "1280×720: Keep going is on screen", JSON.stringify(box));
    await shot(tab, "keepgoing", 1280, 720, "banner");
    await tab.setViewportSize({ width: W, height: H });

    // 5. No saved key: continue.js's sentence, no Keep going, and the Agents → Brain link.
    claudeInfo = NO_KEY_INFO;
    await tab.reload();
    check(await waitFor(async () => ((await banner.innerText()) || "").includes(KEY_SENTENCE), 15000), "no key: continue.js's sentence");
    check((await banner.getByRole("button", { name: "Keep going on OpenRouter" }).count()) === 0, "no key: no Keep going button");
    const link = banner.getByRole("button", { name: "Agents → Brain" });
    check(await link.isVisible(), "no key: the Agents → Brain link");
    await shot(tab, "keepgoing", W, H, "no-key");
    await link.click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => /[?&]page=agents/.test(tab.url()) && /[?&]agent=claude/.test(tab.url()), 3000), "the link opens Agents on Claude Code", tab.url());
    claudeInfo = CLAUDE_INFO;

    // 6. Codex: a new conversation from the summary, and its tab opens after the confirm.
    await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=sessions&session=${codexId}`);
    check(await waitFor(async () => ((await banner.innerText()) || "").includes("Codex's plan limit was reached."), 15000), "held Codex: the banner");
    check(!((await banner.innerText()) || "").includes("Continues the same conversation"), "Codex banner: no same-conversation promise");
    await banner.getByRole("button", { name: "Keep going on OpenRouter" }).click();
    const codexDialog = tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Keep going on OpenRouter?" });
    const ctext = (await codexDialog.innerText()) || "";
    check(ctext.includes("This starts a new Codex conversation from a summary of the last screen."), "Codex confirm: a new conversation from the summary");
    check(!ctext.includes("Same conversation."), "Codex confirm: no Same conversation point");
    check(ctext.includes("Typed for you, not sent."), "Codex confirm: typed for you, not sent");
    check(ctext.includes("This held Codex session stays open. Stop it when you no longer need it."), "Codex confirm: the held session stays open");
    await shot(tab, "keepgoing", W, H, "confirm-codex");
    await codexDialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Keep going on OpenRouter" }).click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("session") === cursorId, 5000), "Codex: the new session's tab opens", tab.url());

    // 7. Cursor: no banner; the hand-over button in its Hand-off section, its confirm, and the Copy fallback.
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await banner.count()) === 0, 5000), "a live Cursor session has no banner");
    const panel = tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Session details" });
    const handOverButton = panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Hand to Claude Code or Codex" });
    check(await waitFor(() => handOverButton.isVisible(), 10000), "Cursor: Hand to Claude Code or Codex in its Hand-off section");
    const handOvers = [];
    await tab.route((u) => /\/api\/sessions\/[^/]+\/hand-over$/.test(u.pathname), (route) => {
      handOvers.push(route.request().postDataJSON());
      // reason null, as the server answers when the target missed its moment: the page fills in X8's sentence.
      return json(route, { result: "copy", targetId: null, text: "Picking up from Cursor. Folder: kg-cursor. Its last screen:\n> refactor the parser", reason: null });
    });
    await handOverButton.click();
    const handDialog = tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Hand to Claude Code or Codex?" });
    check(await handDialog.isVisible(), "hand-over confirm: titled");
    check((await handDialog.getByRole("radio", { name: "Claude Code" }).isVisible()) && (await handDialog.getByRole("radio", { name: "Codex" }).isVisible()), "hand-over confirm: Claude Code or Codex");
    check(((await handDialog.innerText()) || "").includes("It is typed for you, not sent."), "hand-over confirm: typed, not sent");
    await handDialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
    check(handOvers.length === 0, "hand-over: Cancel sends nothing", handOvers.length);
    await handOverButton.click();
    await handDialog.getByRole("radio", { name: "Codex" }).check();
    await shot(tab, "keepgoing", W, H, "hand-over");
    await handDialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Hand over" }).click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => handOvers.length === 1 && handOvers[0]?.to === "codex", 5000), "Hand over sends { to: codex } once", JSON.stringify(handOvers));
    check(Object.keys(handOvers[0] || {}).join(",") === "to", "the hand-over body holds only `to`", JSON.stringify(handOvers[0]));
    check(await waitFor(async () => ((await panel.innerText()) || "").includes(COPY_REASON), 5000), "copy answer: X8's Copy fallback sentence for Codex shows");
    check(await panel.getByRole("button", { name: /^Copy/ }).first().isVisible(), "copy answer: a Copy button");
    await shot(tab, "keepgoing", W, H, "hand-over-copy");

    check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "console clean", errors.join(" / "));
    await context.close();
  } finally {
    for (const id of started) if (id) await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${id}/stop`);
  }
}
```

### Task U11: Recordings replay (player, speeds, timeline, idle gaps, removed output, moments, Resume, Open live session, Delete)

Today Runs → Session recordings lists every recording with "Resume conversation" or "Open live session" and the SP3 note "Replay arrives in a later update" (`src/ui/components/SessionRecordings.tsx:270,274`, `src/ui/recordingsShared.ts:33` at `548786d`). The server already streams one recording as asciicast v2 (`GET /api/sessions/:id/recording`, `routes.js:296-301`) and deletes one (`DELETE /api/sessions/:id/recording`, `routes.js:303-308`, 409 `recording_live` while live). Task X1a keeps the markers in meta.json and answers `GET /api/sessions/:id/markers`; X2a adds the label-only "prompt" marker, X1a the "permission" marker (its alert text), X7 the "files" marker (path and +/−). This task builds the replay on top of that:

1. **The player** (`src/ui/components/ReplayPlayer.tsx`, logic in `src/ui/replayShared.ts`): the asciicast plays in a read-only xterm at 1×, 10× or 30×; a timeline with the moments as pins and a "Moments in this recording" list; idle gaps over 30 s skipped while playing and drawn hatched ("Idle, skipped while playing"); the true wall-clock length, with the span whose output a rotation removed drawn and marked "[earlier output removed]".
2. **The header**: "Resume conversation" with the prototype's confirm ("Resume this conversation?"), "Open live session" instead while the session runs, and "Delete recording" with a confirm, switched off while the session runs. The SP3 note "Replay arrives in a later update" is removed.
3. **The server**: Delete recording now goes through a new `manager.deleteRecording(id)`, which removes the recording's moments (meta.json `markers`) together with its files, under the session's busy guard. The cast route and the markers route are used as they are. One end-to-end test proves the spec's "fake agents produce the recording markers" with the real manager, hooks router, recorder and changes poll.

How it works, in plain words: a row's new "Replay" button opens `?page=runs&tab=recordings&replay=<id>`, which shows the replay in place of the list (like a run's console). The page reads the whole recording as text and its moments, works out the timeline once (`buildTimeline`), and then a playhead (in recording seconds) moves every 100 ms by the time passed times the speed, jumping over idle gaps and the removed span at once. The terminal shows "everything up to the playhead": going forward writes only the new output; going back resets the screen and writes everything again, through xterm's write queue (never a resize inside a write callback, the SP3 rule in `terminalShared.ts`). The terminal has the recording's own size; its font shrinks (13 px down to 6 px) so the whole screen fits the box. It takes no keys and sends nothing anywhere.

Its tests never start a real agent: the logic test is pure (plus `@xterm/headless` for the drawing steps and a fake `fetch` for the two requests), the manager test uses SP3's injected fakes, the end-to-end test runs W1's TUI-like fake `claude` in a real PTY with a profile the test builds, and the probe drives the fake on the UI audit harness's throwaway server.

4. **Decisions this task makes** (the orchestrator can overturn any; each: decision, why, cost if wrong):
   - **U11-a The replay opens in place of the list** (`?page=runs&tab=recordings&replay=<id>`), with a "Session recordings" back button that returns to the list with that row marked and focused (the existing `?highlight=` behaviour). Why: the prototype's replay is a view inside Runs with a back link; the address keeps it across a reload. Cost: none.
   - **U11-b Rows keep SP3's "Resume conversation" / "Open live session" and gain "Replay"**; an update recording offers Replay only. The prototype's rows show Replay only, but the spec calls the header button "the same button that SP3 ships on ... recording rows". Cost: the actions column grows from 232 px to 304 px.
   - **U11-c The replay header's Resume uses the prototype's confirm ("Resume this conversation?"); a row keeps SP3's ("Resume <title>?").** Why: the spec ties the prototype's confirm to the replay header, and the SP3 probe and the Sessions page's ended tab use SP3's words. Cost: two dialog titles for one action; the owner can ask at E1 to use one everywhere.
   - **U11-d Delete goes through `manager.deleteRecording`, which also empties meta.json `markers`.** Why: the moments are part of the recording (a deleted recording's permission texts and file paths should go too), and a Resume afterwards starts a new recording that must not show the old moments; the manager's busy guard keeps Resume and Dismiss from writing meta.json between the two steps. A failed `markers` write after the files went is logged in one line and the delete still answers `{ ok: true }` (the leftover moments are older than any new recording, so `buildTimeline` leaves them out). The 1 GB cap (recorder.js) still removes files only, for the same reason. Cost: one manager method; the route test's stub gains it.
   - **U11-e Timeline.** The true length of an ended session is the larger of its last event and `endedAt` minus the header's start (the row's Length); a live recording ends at its last event ("so far"). Idle is a gap longer than 30 s between output events (also from the start, or from the end of the removed span, to the first output, and from the last output to the end); resize and marker events are not output. Removed is 0 to the rotation marker's time. Moment time is the marker's `at` minus the header's whole-second start, so it can be up to one second late; a moment before 0 (from an earlier, deleted recording) is left out, one after the end sits at the end.
   - **U11-f Playing.** Default 10× (the prototype). Every 100 ms the playhead moves by the real time passed times the speed, through output only; idle and removed spans cost nothing. Play at the end starts again from the first second still recorded; the replay opens there, paused. A hidden window does not move the playhead. Seeking back resets the screen with RIS through the write queue and redraws from the start (a 50 MB recording can take a few seconds to redraw).
   - **U11-g Moments.** A click on a moment shows the screen one second after it (prototype `pos = t + 1`), where its own output has landed; playing state is kept. The list's buttons are named "<label>, <time>" (files: "<label>, <files>, <time>").
   - **U11-h The replay terminal**: the recording's own columns and rows (header, then "r" events), font fitted 6-13 px to the box (a 300-column recording at 6 px scrolls inside its box, never the page); DOM renderer only (no WebGL in the replay); read-only: `disableStdin`, no `onData`/`onBinary` handler (xterm's own query replies go nowhere), OSC 8 links do nothing (`linkHandler.activate` is a no-op, so xterm never asks the browser to confirm), no clipboard or web-links add-on; the terminal's text box leaves the tab order.
   - **U11-i A live recording's replay** covers what was recorded when it opened ("Still recording. ..."); it is not read again while open. When the session ends meanwhile, the header switches to Resume and Delete within one list poll (5 s), and the timeline stays as read.
   - **U11-j A failed markers read does not stop the replay**: it plays with "The moments of this recording couldn't be read." A failed or unreadable cast shows the reason with "Try again".
   - **U11-k After a delete** the page goes back to the list and the Session recordings tab takes the keyboard (the Delete button and the replay are gone); the dialog does not hand the keyboard back.
   - **U11-l "Open recording" on an ended Sessions tab** still lands on the highlighted row (SP3 behaviour, pinned by the sp3-pages probe), where Replay is one click away. Cost: one more click than opening the replay directly.
   - **U11-m The end-to-end markers test** is its own file, `test/sessions-recording-markers.test.js`, because it needs the hooks router, the real recorder and real git together (the contract lists only the logic test for U11).
5. **Risks.** The whole recording (up to two 25 MB segments) is read into memory and parsed once; seeking back redraws it all. The end-to-end test depends on X2a's fake `hook` command and X7's changes poll; a change in their names fails it loudly (Step 0 checks them first). The test edits a tracked file and waits for `PostToolUse`'s quick refresh (300 ms) or the 3 s poll (it waits up to 15 s). The replay's xterm is a second terminal in the page only while the replay is open (the Sessions page is not mounted then).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing logic test.** Create `test/sessions-replay-logic.test.js` with exactly this content:

```js
// Runs → Session recordings → Replay (spec SP4 "Recordings in Runs"; Task U11): the pure logic in
// src/ui/replayShared.ts (the cast read, the timeline with its true wall-clock length, its idle gaps and its removed
// span, the moments from meta.json's markers, the playhead, the steps that draw the screen, the words), the two new
// client requests in src/sessionsApi.ts (the recording as text with its own time limit, the markers), and the wiring
// the Runs page depends on. replayShared.ts has `import type` only, so Node loads it straight from src/ (decision
// P14). sessionsApi.ts imports its neighbours without a file extension (the Vite way), so a resolve hook adds .ts
// first, as test/sessions-api.test.js does. The page itself is checked by the replay probe of the UI audit.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { registerHooks } from "node:module";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import xtermHeadless from "@xterm/headless";
import { ROTATION_MARKER as RECORDER_ROTATION_MARKER } from "../server/runtime/sessions/recorder.js";

registerHooks({
  resolve(specifier, context, nextResolve) {
    if (/^\.\.?\//.test(specifier) && !/\.[a-z]+$/.test(specifier) && context.parentURL) {
      for (const extension of [".ts", ".tsx"]) {
        const url = new URL(specifier + extension, context.parentURL);
        if (existsSync(fileURLToPath(url))) return { url: url.href, shortCircuit: true };
      }
    }
    return nextResolve(specifier, context);
  }
});

const replay = await import("../src/ui/replayShared.ts");
const rec = await import("../src/ui/recordingsShared.ts");
const ss = await import("../src/ui/sessionsShared.ts");
const api = await import("../src/sessionsApi.ts");
const { ApiError } = await import("../src/api.ts");
// @xterm/headless is a CommonJS bundle: its classes sit on the default export.
const { Terminal: HeadlessTerminal } = xtermHeadless;

// A recording's header start (whole seconds, as recorder.js writes it) and times on its clock.
const T0 = 1_760_000_000;
const ID = "3f2c9a7e-1b4d-4c8e-9f00-0123456789ab";
const iso = (seconds) => new Date((T0 + seconds) * 1000).toISOString();
const header = (over = {}) => ({ version: 2, width: 100, height: 24, timestamp: T0, ...over });
const castText = (events, head = header()) => `${[head, ...events].map((line) => JSON.stringify(line)).join("\n")}\n`;
const cast = (events, head) => replay.parseCast(castText(events, head));
const source = (file) => readFileSync(new URL(`../src/${file}`, import.meta.url), "utf8");

function screenLines(t) {
  const buffer = t.buffer.active;
  const lines = [];
  for (let y = 0; y < t.rows; y += 1) lines.push(buffer.getLine(buffer.baseY + y)?.translateToString(true) ?? "");
  return lines;
}

// The screen a straight play from the start to `index` gives, on a fresh headless terminal.
async function screenAt(c, index) {
  const t = new HeadlessTerminal({ cols: c.width, rows: c.height, logLevel: "off" });
  try {
    await replay.runReplaySteps(t, replay.replaySteps(c, 0, index));
    return { lines: screenLines(t), cols: t.cols, rows: t.rows };
  } finally {
    t.dispose();
  }
}

test("parseCast: an asciicast v2 header and its events; a torn or odd line is skipped, a time never goes back, anything else is no cast", () => {
  const text =
    castText([[0.5, "o", "hello\r\n"], [1.25, "r", "90x30"], [1, "o", "late"], [2, "m", "--- resumed ---"], [3, "i", "typed"], [4, "o", 7], "junk", [5, "o", "end"]]) +
    '[6,"o","tor';
  assert.deepEqual(replay.parseCast(text), {
    width: 100,
    height: 24,
    timestamp: T0,
    events: [[0.5, "o", "hello\r\n"], [1.25, "r", "90x30"], [1.25, "o", "late"], [2, "m", "--- resumed ---"], [5, "o", "end"]]
  });
  for (const bad of [
    null,
    "",
    "not json\n",
    `${JSON.stringify({ version: 1, width: 80, height: 24, timestamp: T0 })}\n`,
    `${JSON.stringify({ version: 2, width: 80, height: 24 })}\n`,
    `${JSON.stringify([0, "o", "x"])}\n`
  ]) {
    assert.equal(replay.parseCast(bad), null, JSON.stringify(bad));
  }
  assert.deepEqual(replay.parseCast(castText([], header({ width: 5000, height: 0 }))), { width: 80, height: 24, timestamp: T0, events: [] }, "an odd size falls back to 80 × 24");
});

test("buildTimeline: the true wall-clock length runs to the session's end; gaps over 30 s without output are idle (exactly 30 s is not); a live recording ends at its last event", () => {
  const c = cast([[1, "o", "a"], [5, "o", "b"], [40, "o", "c"], [70, "o", "d"]]);
  const ended = replay.buildTimeline(c, [], { endAt: iso(150) });
  assert.equal(ended.wallSeconds, 150);
  assert.equal(ended.removedSeconds, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(ended.segments, [
    { from: 0, to: 5, kind: "play" },
    { from: 5, to: 40, kind: "idle" },
    { from: 40, to: 70, kind: "play" },
    { from: 70, to: 150, kind: "idle" }
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(ended.moments, []);
  const live = replay.buildTimeline(c, []);
  assert.equal(live.wallSeconds, 70);
  assert.deepEqual(live.segments.at(-1), { from: 40, to: 70, kind: "play" });
  assert.equal(replay.buildTimeline(c, [], { endAt: iso(60) }).wallSeconds, 70, "an end before the last event (a clock change) never cuts output off");
  assert.equal(replay.buildTimeline(c, [], { endAt: "not a time" }).wallSeconds, 70);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.buildTimeline(c, [], { endAt: iso(150), idleSkipS: 40 }).segments, [
    { from: 0, to: 70, kind: "play" },
    { from: 70, to: 150, kind: "idle" }
  ]);
  assert.equal(replay.IDLE_SKIP_S, 30);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.buildTimeline(cast([]), []), { wallSeconds: 0, removedSeconds: 0, segments: [], moments: [] });
});

test("buildTimeline: output removed at a rotation is a span from 0 to the rotation marker, drawn but never played; a resize or a marker is not output", () => {
```
