```js
test("moments: the markers on the recording's clock, sorted, with their words; a prompt keeps no text (R23); files show path and +/−; markers from before this recording began are left out; one after its end sits at the end", () => {
  const c = cast([[1, "o", "a"], [12, "o", "b"]]);
  const answer = {
    markers: [
      { at: iso(10), type: "files", files: [{ path: "src/app.ts", added: 12, removed: 3 }, { path: "logo.png", added: null, removed: null }], more: 2 },
      { at: iso(2), type: "prompt", text: "a prompt that must never show" },
      { at: iso(3), type: "permission", text: "Wants to use Bash" },
      { at: iso(-60), type: "permission", text: "from a deleted recording" },
      { at: iso(25), type: "permission", text: "Has a question for you" },
      { at: "yesterday", type: "prompt" },
      { at: iso(4), type: "shell" },
      "junk"
    ]
  };
  const { moments, wallSeconds } = replay.buildTimeline(c, answer, { endAt: iso(20) });
  assert.equal(wallSeconds, 20);
  assert.deepEqual(moments, [
    { t: 2, type: "prompt", word: "Prompt", label: "Prompt", detail: "" },
    { t: 3, type: "permission", word: "Permission asked", label: "Permission asked: Wants to use Bash", detail: "Wants to use Bash" },
    { t: 10, type: "files", word: "Files changed", label: "Files changed: 4", detail: "src/app.ts (+12 −3), logo.png, and 2 more" },
    { t: 20, type: "permission", word: "Permission asked", label: "Permission asked: Has a question for you", detail: "Has a question for you" }
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.buildTimeline(c, answer.markers, { endAt: iso(20) }).moments, moments, "a bare list is read the same way");
  assert.deepEqual(replay.readMarkers(null), []);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.readMarkers({ markers: "x" }), []);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.readMarkers([{ at: iso(2), type: "prompt", text: "secret" }]), [{ at: iso(2), type: "prompt" }]);
  assert.equal(replay.fileWords({ path: "a.md", added: 0, removed: 5 }), "a.md (+0 −5)");
  assert.equal(replay.fileWords({ path: "b.bin", added: null, removed: null }), "b.bin");
  assert.deepEqual(replay.MOMENT_WORDS, { prompt: "Prompt", permission: "Permission asked", files: "Files changed" });
  assert.equal(replay.momentName(moments[0]), "Prompt, 2 s");
  assert.equal(replay.momentName(moments[1]), "Permission asked: Wants to use Bash, 3 s");
  assert.equal(replay.momentName(moments[2]), "Files changed: 4, src/app.ts (+12 −3), logo.png, and 2 more, 10 s");
});

test("advance: playing moves through output at the speed given, jumps over idle gaps and the removed span at once, and stops at the end", () => {
  const { segments } = replay.buildTimeline(cast([[1, "o", "a"], [5, "o", "b"], [40, "o", "c"], [70, "o", "d"]]), [], { endAt: iso(150) });
  assert.equal(replay.advance(segments, 0, 2), 2);
  assert.equal(replay.advance(segments, 4, 2), 41, "one second of output, the idle gap skipped, then one more");
  assert.equal(replay.advance(segments, 10, 0), 40, "a playhead left inside an idle gap goes to its end");
  assert.equal(replay.advance(segments, 60, 100), 150, "the trailing idle gap is skipped to the end");
  assert.equal(replay.advance(segments, 150, 1), 150);
  assert.equal(replay.advance(segments, 3, -5), 3, "no time, no move");
  const removed = replay.buildTimeline(cast([[40, "m", "[earlier output removed]"], [41, "o", "x"]]), []).segments;
  assert.equal(replay.advance(removed, 0, 0.5), 40.5, "playing from the start begins where output is still recorded");
  // 30× for 0.1 s is 3 s of the recording: a two-minute idle gap costs nothing.
  const gap = replay.buildTimeline(cast([[40.5, "o", "a"], [45, "o", "b"], [165, "o", "c"], [170, "o", "d"]]), [], { endAt: iso(190) }).segments;
  assert.equal(replay.advance(gap, 44, 3), 167);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.REPLAY_SPEEDS, [1, 10, 30]);
  assert.equal(replay.DEFAULT_SPEED, 10);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.REPLAY_SPEEDS.map(replay.speedLabel), ["1×", "10×", "30×"]);
});

test("eventIndexAt and replaySteps: the events up to a time; forward steps join output and split at resizes; going back starts again from a clean screen at the recording's size", () => {
  const c = cast([[0.5, "o", "a"], [1, "o", "b"], [1.5, "r", "90x30"], [2, "o", "c"], [2.5, "m", "x"], [3, "r", "bad"], [4, "o", "d"]]);
  assert.deepEqual([0, 0.5, 1.49, 2.5, 99].map((at) => replay.eventIndexAt(c.events, at)), [0, 1, 2, 5, 7]);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.replaySteps(c, 0, 7), [{ kind: "write", data: "ab" }, { kind: "resize", cols: 90, rows: 30 }, { kind: "write", data: "cd" }]);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.replaySteps(c, 2, 4), [{ kind: "resize", cols: 90, rows: 30 }, { kind: "write", data: "c" }]);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.replaySteps(c, 5, 2), [{ kind: "reset" }, { kind: "resize", cols: 100, rows: 24 }, { kind: "write", data: "ab" }]);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.replaySteps(c, 3, 3), []);
  assert.deepEqual(replay.replaySteps(c, 0, 99), replay.replaySteps(c, 0, 7), "an index past the end means the end");
  assert.deepEqual(replay.parseSize("120x32"), { cols: 120, rows: 32 });
  for (const bad of ["0x24", "120x", "x", "5000x10", "12 x 3"]) assert.equal(replay.parseSize(bad), null, bad);
});

test("runReplaySteps on a real (headless) xterm: playing in pieces, seeking back and forth, gives the screen a straight play to that time gives; a stopped replay draws nothing more", async () => {
  const c = cast([
    [0.1, "o", "\x1b[31mred\x1b[0m line one\r\n"],
    [0.2, "o", "line two\r\n"],
    [0.3, "r", "60x10"],
    [0.4, "o", "line three\r\n"],
    [0.5, "o", "\x1b[2J\x1b[Hcleared\r\n"]
  ]);
  const t = new HeadlessTerminal({ cols: c.width, rows: c.height, logLevel: "off" });
  try {
    let shown = 0;
    for (const at of [0.15, 0.35, 0.1, 0.45, 1, 0]) {
      const index = replay.eventIndexAt(c.events, at);
      await replay.runReplaySteps(t, replay.replaySteps(c, shown, index));
      shown = index;
      assert.deepEqual({ lines: screenLines(t), cols: t.cols, rows: t.rows }, await screenAt(c, index), `at ${at} s`);
    }
  } finally {
    t.dispose();
  }
  const early = await screenAt(c, replay.eventIndexAt(c.events, 0.15));
  assert.equal(early.lines[0], "red line one");
  assert.equal(early.lines[1], "");
  const stopped = new HeadlessTerminal({ cols: 100, rows: 24, logLevel: "off" });
  try {
    await replay.runReplaySteps(stopped, replay.replaySteps(c, 0, 5), () => true);
    assert.ok(screenLines(stopped).every((line) => line === ""), "nothing was drawn");
    assert.equal(stopped.cols, 100, "and nothing was resized");
  } finally {
    stopped.dispose();
  }
});

test("clockWords, timelinePercent, currentMoment and fitFontSize", () => {
  assert.deepEqual([0, 59.9, 60, 190, 3725, NaN, -5].map(replay.clockWords), ["0 s", "59 s", "1 m 00 s", "3 m 10 s", "1 h 02 m 05 s", "0 s", "0 s"]);
  assert.equal(replay.timelinePercent(95, 190), 50);
  assert.equal(replay.timelinePercent(1, 0), 0);
  assert.equal(replay.timelinePercent(-1, 10), 0);
  assert.equal(replay.timelinePercent(20, 10), 100);
  const moments = [2, 3, 10].map((t) => ({ t, type: "prompt", word: "Prompt", label: "Prompt", detail: "" }));
  assert.deepEqual([1, 3, 9.9, 10, 100].map((pos) => replay.currentMoment(moments, pos)), [-1, 1, 1, 2, 2]);
  assert.equal(replay.currentMoment([], 5), -1);
  // JetBrains Mono's cell is 0.6 em wide and a row 1.2 em tall: the largest whole size up to 13 px that fits both ways.
  assert.equal(replay.fitFontSize({ boxWidth: 1000, boxHeight: 600, cols: 80, rows: 24 }), 13);
  assert.equal(replay.fitFontSize({ boxWidth: 640, boxHeight: 348, cols: 120, rows: 32 }), 8);
  assert.equal(replay.fitFontSize({ boxWidth: 1000, boxHeight: 100, cols: 80, rows: 24 }), 6, "never below 6 px (the box then scrolls inside itself)");
  assert.equal(replay.fitFontSize({ boxWidth: 0, boxHeight: 300, cols: 80, rows: 24 }), 13, "a box not laid out yet keeps the normal size");
  assert.equal(replay.REPLAY_FONT_MIN, 6);
  assert.equal(replay.CELL_WIDTH_EM, 0.6);
});

test("the words: spec sentences word for word, the prototype's Resume confirm with SP3's fallback warning, the Delete confirm, the side notes; no em dash, no promise", () => {
  assert.equal(replay.IDLE_WORDS, "Idle, skipped while playing");
  assert.equal(replay.MOMENTS_TITLE, "Moments in this recording");
  const plain = replay.replayResumeCopy({ agent: "Claude Code", folder: "~/projects/my-app", fallback: false });
  assert.deepEqual(plain, {
    title: "Resume this conversation?",
    body: [
      "Agent OS opens a new terminal in ~/projects/my-app and starts Claude Code with its own resume feature.",
      "Agent OS does not paste the old text back in and does not press Enter for you. The recording continues after a marker."
    ],
    warning: null,
    cancel: "Cancel",
    confirm: "Resume conversation"
  });
  const fallback = replay.replayResumeCopy({ agent: "Codex", folder: "~/projects/api", fallback: true });
  const sp3 = ss.resumeConfirmCopy({ kind: "agent", agentId: "codex", agentLabel: "Codex", folderName: "api", folderShown: true, resume: { available: true, reason: null, fallback: true } });
  assert.equal(fallback.warning, sp3.warning, "the same fallback warning as SP3's dialog");
  assert.ok(sp3.body.endsWith("The recording continues after a marker."), "the same last sentence as SP3's dialog");
  assert.equal(
    replay.replayResumeCopy({ agent: "OpenClaw", folder: null, fallback: false }).body[0],
    "Agent OS opens a new terminal and starts OpenClaw with its own resume feature."
  );
  assert.deepEqual(replay.deleteConfirmCopy({ kind: "agent", dismissed: false }), {
    title: "Delete this recording?",
    body: [
      "Agent OS deletes what this session's terminal showed, and its moments, from this computer. This can't be undone.",
      "The session's tab stays on the Sessions page, and so does its Resume conversation."
    ],
    confirm: "Delete recording"
  });
  assert.equal(
    replay.deleteConfirmCopy({ kind: "agent", dismissed: true }).body[1],
    "You dismissed this session's tab, so after this Agent OS no longer lists the session anywhere."
  );
  assert.equal(replay.deleteConfirmCopy({ kind: "update", dismissed: false }).body.length, 1);
  assert.equal(replay.liveNote(75), "Still recording. This replay covers the first 1 m 15 s. To see the rest, open the live session.");
  assert.equal(replay.endedNote("Hermes"), "Resume conversation starts Hermes again with its own resume feature. Agent OS does not copy the text.");
  const recorder = readFileSync(new URL("../server/runtime/sessions/recorder.js", import.meta.url), "utf8");
  assert.ok(recorder.includes(`"${replay.DELETE_WHILE_LIVE}"`), "the switched-off Delete says what the server says");
  assert.ok(recorder.includes(`"${replay.RECORDING_GONE}"`), "a replay whose recording is gone says what the server says");
  const all = [
    replay.IDLE_WORDS, replay.MOMENTS_TITLE, replay.REPLAY_CAPTION, replay.NO_MOMENTS, replay.MOMENTS_UNREADABLE, replay.CAST_UNREADABLE,
    ...Object.values(replay.MOMENT_WORDS), plain.title, ...plain.body,
    ...replay.deleteConfirmCopy({ kind: "agent", dismissed: true }).body, replay.liveNote(1), replay.endedNote("Codex")
  ].join("\n");
  assert.doesNotMatch(all, /—/, "no em dash");
  assert.doesNotMatch(all, /later update|coming soon|SP5/i, "no promise");
});

test("Delete: which refusals shut the dialog's button, and the words for a delete that failed or got no answer", () => {
  const refused = (code, detail = "") => new ApiError(code, detail, 409);
  for (const code of ["recording_live", "recording_missing", "unknown_session"]) assert.equal(replay.isFinalDeleteRefusal(refused(code)), true, code);
  for (const error of [refused("session_busy"), new Error("recording_live"), null, "recording_live"]) {
    assert.equal(replay.isFinalDeleteRefusal(error), false, String(error));
  }
  assert.equal(
    replay.deleteProblem(refused("recording_live", "That session is still running. Stop it first, then delete its recording."), false),
    "That session is still running. Stop it first, then delete its recording."
  );
  assert.equal(replay.deleteProblem(refused("internal_error"), false), "Agent OS couldn't delete this recording. Try again.");
  assert.equal(
    replay.deleteProblem(new Error("Agent OS did not answer in time."), true),
    "Agent OS didn't answer, so the recording may or may not be deleted. The list shows it only while it is still there."
  );
  assert.equal(
    replay.deleteProblem(new SyntaxError("Unexpected token"), false),
    "Agent OS answered, but the answer couldn't be read. The list shows the recording only while it is still there."
  );
});

test("fetchRecording: the recording as text, with its own time limit; a refusal is an ApiError with the server's sentence; a sign-out locks the app; a closed replay stops the download", async (t) => {
  const real = { fetch: globalThis.fetch, window: globalThis.window };
  const events = [];
  globalThis.window = { dispatchEvent: (event) => events.push(event.type) };
  try {
    const text = castText([[0.5, "o", "hi"]]);
    const calls = [];
    globalThis.fetch = async (url, options) => {
      calls.push({ url: String(url), options });
      return {
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        statusText: "OK",
        text: async () => text,
        json: async () => {
          throw new SyntaxError("not JSON");
        }
      };
    };
    assert.equal(await api.fetchRecording(ID), text, "the asciicast text as it came, never read as JSON");
    assert.equal(calls[0].url, `/api/sessions/${ID}/recording`);
    assert.equal(calls[0].options.credentials, "same-origin");
    assert.ok(calls[0].options.signal instanceof AbortSignal);

    globalThis.fetch = async () => ({
      ok: false,
      status: 404,
      statusText: "Not Found",
      json: async () => ({ error: "recording_missing", message: "That recording doesn't exist anymore." })
    });
    await assert.rejects(
      api.fetchRecording(ID),
      (error) => error instanceof ApiError && error.message === "recording_missing" && error.status === 404 && error.detail === "That recording doesn't exist anymore."
    );

    globalThis.fetch = async () => ({ ok: false, status: 401, statusText: "Unauthorized", json: async () => ({ error: "session_required" }) });
    await assert.rejects(api.fetchRecording(ID), (error) => error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 401);
    assert.deepEqual(events, ["agentos:locked"]);

    let aborted = 0;
    globalThis.fetch = (_url, options) =>
      new Promise((_resolve, reject) => {
        options.signal.addEventListener("abort", () => {
          aborted += 1;
          reject(new DOMException("The operation was aborted.", "AbortError"));
        });
      });
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const closing = api.fetchRecording(ID, { signal: controller.signal });
    controller.abort();
    await assert.rejects(closing, (error) => error.name === "AbortError", "a replay that closed is not a time-out");
    assert.equal(aborted, 1);

    t.mock.timers.enable({ apis: ["setTimeout"] });
    const slow = api.fetchRecording(ID);
    t.mock.timers.tick(api.SESSION_LIMITS_MS.recording);
    await assert.rejects(slow, (error) => error.message === "Agent OS did not answer in time.");
    assert.equal(aborted, 2, "the download itself is stopped at the time limit");
    assert.equal(api.SESSION_LIMITS_MS.recording, 60000);
  } finally {
    globalThis.fetch = real.fetch;
    if (real.window === undefined) delete globalThis.window;
    else globalThis.window = real.window;
  }
});

test("getMarkers: GET /api/sessions/:id/markers with its own time limit; a refusal is an ApiError", async () => {
  const real = globalThis.fetch;

});

test("Runs wiring: the SP3 replay note is gone everywhere; ?replay= is kept; every row opens its replay; Delete is a danger confirm, off while the session runs; the replay terminal sends nothing and opens nothing", () => {
  assert.equal("REPLAY_LATER" in rec, false);
  const srcRoot = fileURLToPath(new URL("../src/", import.meta.url));

  }
  assert.match(source("nav.ts"), /"highlight", "replay"\]/, "navigateTo keeps ?replay=");
  assert.match(source("pages/RunsPage.tsx"), /queryParam\("replay"\)/);
  const page = source("ui/components/SessionRecordings.tsx");
  assert.match(page, /navigateTo\("runs", \{ tab: "recordings", replay: row\.sessionId \}\)/, "every row opens its replay");
  assert.match(page, /title=\{deleteCopy\.title\}[\s\S]{0,400}?danger/, "Delete asks first, as a danger action");
  assert.equal(page.split("deleteRecording(").length - 1, 1, "the only delete call is the confirmed one");
  assert.ok(page.indexOf("deleteRecording(") > page.indexOf("async function confirmDelete"), "and it sits inside confirmDelete");
  const player = source("ui/components/ReplayPlayer.tsx");
  assert.match(player, /disabled=\{live\}/, "Delete recording is off while the session runs");
  assert.match(player, /disableStdin: true/);
  assert.match(player, /activate: \(\) => undefined/, "an OSC 8 link in a recording opens nothing");
  for (const forbidden of ["onData", "onBinary", "WebLinksAddon", "ClipboardAddon", "WebglAddon", "window.confirm", "localStorage"]) {
    assert.equal(player.includes(forbidden), false, `the replay terminal has no ${forbidden}`);
  }
});
```

```js
import { createSessionManager } from "../server/runtime/sessions/manager.js";
import { spawnPty } from "../server/runtime/sessions/pty-host.js";
import { createSessionsRouter } from "../server/runtime/sessions/routes.js";
import { buildTimeline, parseCast } from "../src/ui/replayShared.ts";
import { FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL, makeFakeAgentBin } from "./helpers/fake-agents.js";

const isWindows = process.platform === "win32";
// Node's own folder is left out on purpose: it can hold real agents.
const SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS = ["/usr/bin", "/bin", "/usr/sbin", "/sbin"];
const CLAUDE_UUID = "0b5f1e9a-3c2d-4e8f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b";
const SECRET_PROMPT = "a prompt only the agent may see 7f3a";

async function withEnv(vars, fn) {
  const saved = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(vars)) saved[key] = process.env[key];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(vars)) {
    if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
    else process.env[key] = value;
  }
  try {
    return await fn();
  } finally {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(saved)) {
      if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = value;
    }
  }
}

async function waitFor(predicate, { timeoutMs = 10000, intervalMs = 25 } = {}) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (await predicate()) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, intervalMs));
  }
  throw new Error("timed out waiting for condition");
}

// The pids this test started and has not seen exit (the system may give an exited pid to another process).
function track(running, handle) {
  running.add(handle.pid);
  handle.onExit(() => {
    running.delete(handle.pid);
  });
  return handle;
}

function killLeftovers(running) {
  for (const pid of [...running]) {
    try {
      process.kill(pid, "SIGKILL");
    } catch {
      // already gone
    }
    running.delete(pid);
  }
}

test(
  "fake agents produce the recording markers: a prompt (label only), a permission asked with its text and the files changed with +/−; the replay reads them on the recording's own clock; Delete recording takes them with it",
  { skip: isWindows ? "the fake agents are POSIX shell shims" : false },
  async () => {
    // Real paths: on macOS os.tmpdir() sits behind a symlink, and the folder policy compares real paths.
    const home = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-markers-home-")));
    const agentOsHome = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-markers-data-")));
    const bin = path.join(home, "fake-bin");
    const folder = path.join(home, "projects", "replay-app");
    const running = new Set();
    let server = null;
    let manager = null;
    let id = null;
    try {
      await mkdir(folder, { recursive: true });
      await mkdir(bin, { recursive: true });
      await makeFakeAgentBin(bin); // all six names, mode tui
      // A real git repository with one tracked file (real git runs only inside temp folders).
      const git = (...args) =>
        execFileSync(
          "git",
          ["-C", folder, "-c", "user.name=Agent OS test", "-c", "user.email=test@example.invalid", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "-c", "init.defaultBranch=main", ...args],
          { env: { PATH: SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS.join(path.delimiter), HOME: home, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", LC_ALL: "C" }, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] }
        );
      git("init", "-q");
      await writeFile(path.join(folder, "notes.md"), "one\n");
      git("add", "notes.md");
      git("commit", "-q", "-m", "start");

      await withEnv(
        {
          HOME: home,
          USERPROFILE: home,
          AGENT_OS_HOME: agentOsHome,
          AGENT_OS_MANAGED_ROOT: path.join(home, ".agent-os"),
          HERMES_AGENT_OS_HOME: undefined,
          HERMES_HOME: undefined,
          HERMES_AGENT_OS_ENABLE_EXEC: undefined,
          AGENT_OS_PACKAGED: undefined,
          SHELL: FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL,
          PATH: [bin, ...SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS].join(path.delimiter)
        },
        async () => {
          assert.equal(os.homedir(), home, "tests must never see the real home folder");
          const app = express();
          server = await new Promise((resolve) => {
            const listening = app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve(listening));
          });
          const port = server.address().port;
          const profileInputs = [];
          manager = createSessionManager({
            isExecutionAllowed: async () => true,
            detect: async () => ({ installed: true, path: path.join(bin, "claude") }),
            resolveBrain: async () => null,
            getPort: () => port,
            buildProfile: async (input) => {
              profileInputs.push(input);
              return {
                command: path.join(bin, "claude"),
                args: ["--session-id", CLAUDE_UUID],
                cwd: input.folder,
                env: {
                  PATH: [bin, ...SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS].join(path.delimiter),
                  HOME: home,
                  USERPROFILE: home,
                  SHELL: FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL,
                  TERM: "xterm-256color",
                  LANG: "en_US.UTF-8",
                  ...(input.hook
                    ? {
                        AGENT_OS_HOOK_URL: `http://127.0.0.1:${input.hook.port}/hooks/sessions/${input.sessionId}`,
                        AGENT_OS_HOOK_TOKEN: input.hook.token
                      }
                    : {})
                },
                agentSessionId: CLAUDE_UUID,
                settingsFile: null,
                softStop: "claude-bg",
                resumeMode: "id",
                folderShown: true,
                notes: [],
                claude: null
              };
            },
            spawn: async (options) => track(running, await spawnPty(options))
          });
          // As server/index.js mounts them: the hooks router before any JSON parser.
          app.use("/hooks", createHooksRouter({ manager, isLocal: () => true }));
          app.use(express.json());
          app.use("/api/sessions", createSessionsRouter({ manager }));
          const http = async (method, url) => {
            const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}${url}`, { method });
            const text = await response.text();
            let json = null;
            try {
              json = JSON.parse(text);
            } catch {
              json = null;
            }
            return { status: response.status, text, json };
          };

          ({ id } = await manager.create({ agentId: "claude", folder }));
          assert.equal(profileInputs[0].hook?.port, port, "the manager gives a Claude Code agent session its hook address (Task X2a)");
          const frames = [];

          await waitFor(() => screen().includes("FAKE_ARGV"));
          // The first changes read is the baseline: it never makes a marker (K12).
          await waitFor(async () => (await manager.changes(id)).at !== null, { timeoutMs: 15000 });

          type(`hook UserPromptSubmit ${JSON.stringify({ prompt: SECRET_PROMPT })}`);
          await waitFor(() => answered() === 1);
          await waitFor(async () => (await manager.markers(id)).length === 1);
          type(`hook PermissionRequest ${JSON.stringify({ tool_name: "Bash" })}`);
          await waitFor(() => answered() === 2);
          await waitFor(async () => (await manager.markers(id)).length === 2);
          await writeFile(path.join(folder, "notes.md"), "one\ntwo\nthree\n");
          type(`hook PostToolUse ${JSON.stringify({ tool_name: "Edit" })}`);
          await waitFor(async () => (await manager.markers(id)).length === 3, { timeoutMs: 15000 });
          type("exit 0");
          await waitFor(async () => !manager.isLive(id));

          await waitFor(async () => JSON.parse(await readFile(metaFile, "utf8")).status === "exited");
          const meta = JSON.parse(await readFile(metaFile, "utf8"));

          const markers = await http("GET", `/api/sessions/${id}/markers`);
          assert.equal(markers.status, 200, markers.text);
          assert.deepEqual(markers.json.markers.map((marker) => marker.type), ["prompt", "permission", "files"]);
          assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(markers.json.markers[0]).sort(), ["at", "type"], "a prompt marker is label only (R23)");
          assert.equal(markers.json.markers[1].text, "Wants to use Bash");
          assert.deepEqual(markers.json.markers[2].files, [{ path: "notes.md", added: 2, removed: 0 }]);
          assert.equal(markers.json.markers[2].more, 0);
          assert.deepEqual(meta.markers, markers.json.markers, "an ended session's markers are read from meta.json");
          assert.equal(JSON.stringify(meta).includes(SECRET_PROMPT), false, "the prompt's text is stored nowhere in meta.json");

          const recording = await http("GET", `/api/sessions/${id}/recording`);
          assert.equal(recording.status, 200);
          const cast = parseCast(recording.text);
          assert.ok(cast, "the recording reads as an asciicast");
          const timeline = buildTimeline(cast, markers.json, { endAt: meta.endedAt });
          assert.deepEqual(timeline.moments.map((moment) => moment.label), ["Prompt", "Permission asked: Wants to use Bash", "Files changed: 1"]);
          assert.deepEqual(timeline.moments.map((moment) => moment.detail), ["", "Wants to use Bash", "notes.md (+2 −0)"]);
          for (const moment of timeline.moments) {
            assert.ok(moment.t >= 0 && moment.t <= timeline.wallSeconds, `${moment.label} at ${moment.t} s lies on the timeline (0 to ${timeline.wallSeconds} s)`);
          }
          assert.ok(timeline.moments[0].t <= timeline.moments[1].t && timeline.moments[1].t <= timeline.moments[2].t, "in the order they happened");
          // The permission moment sits where the fake's answer to that hook is in the recording (header times are whole seconds).
          const hookAnswers = cast.events.filter((event) => event[1] === "o" && event[2].includes("HOOK 204")).map((event) => event[0]);
          assert.ok(hookAnswers.length >= 2, "both answers are in the recording");
          assert.ok(Math.abs(timeline.moments[1].t - hookAnswers[1]) < 2, `permission moment ${timeline.moments[1].t} s, answer on screen ${hookAnswers[1]} s`);
          assert.equal(timeline.segments[0].from, 0);
          assert.equal(timeline.segments.at(-1).to, timeline.wallSeconds);
          for (let i = 1; i < timeline.segments.length; i += 1) assert.equal(timeline.segments[i].from, timeline.segments[i - 1].to, "the segments cover the whole length");

          const deleted = await http("DELETE", `/api/sessions/${id}/recording`);
          assert.equal(deleted.status, 200, deleted.text);
          assert.deepEqual(deleted.json, { ok: true });
          assert.deepEqual((await http("GET", `/api/sessions/${id}/markers`)).json, { markers: [] }, "the moments went with the recording");
          const gone = await http("GET", `/api/sessions/${id}/recording`);
          assert.equal(gone.status, 404);
          assert.equal(gone.json.error, "recording_missing");
          assert.equal((await manager.get(id)).resume.available, true, "the session and its Resume stay");

    } finally {
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create `src/ui/replayShared.ts`** with exactly this content:

```ts
// Runs → Session recordings → one recording's replay (spec SP4 "Recordings in Runs"; Task U11): the pure logic.
// ReplayPlayer.tsx plays the recording (asciicast v2, as recorder.js writes it) in a read-only xterm. This file reads
// the cast, builds its timeline (the true wall-clock length, idle gaps over 30 s that playing skips and the timeline
// draws hatched, and the span whose output a rotation removed, marked "[earlier output removed]"), turns meta.json's
// markers into the moments, moves the playhead and lists the steps that draw the screen at a time. `import type` only,
// so test/sessions-replay-logic.test.js loads it straight from src/ (decision P14).
import type { SessionMarker } from "../types";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Constants and words
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Spec: speed 1× / 10× / 30×. The prototype starts at 10× (runs.html, `speed = 10`).
export const REPLAY_SPEEDS = [1, 10, 30] as const;
export type ReplaySpeed = (typeof REPLAY_SPEEDS)[number];
export const DEFAULT_SPEED: ReplaySpeed = 10;
// Spec: idle gaps over 30 s are skipped while playing.
export const IDLE_SKIP_S = 30;
// How often the playhead moves while playing (the prototype's 100 ms).
export const TICK_MS = 100;
// A moment's own output lands around its marker (the hook fires as the prompt or the question is drawn), so a click
// on a moment shows the screen one second after it (prototype: `pos = t + 1`).
export const MOMENT_LEAD_S = 1;
// recorder.js's ROTATION_MARKER (copied: this file imports nothing at run time; the test checks they agree).
export const ROTATION_MARKER = "[earlier output removed]";

// Spec words, word for word.
export const IDLE_WORDS = "Idle, skipped while playing";
export const REMOVED_WORDS = ROTATION_MARKER;
export const MOMENTS_TITLE = "Moments in this recording";
// recorder.js's own refusal (RECORDING_LIVE), shown next to the Delete button it switches off.
export const DELETE_WHILE_LIVE = "That session is still running. Stop it first, then delete its recording.";
// recorder.js's RECORDING_MISSING: a replay asked for a recording the list no longer has.
export const RECORDING_GONE = "That recording doesn't exist anymore.";
// NEW SENTENCE (Q32), each one.
export const REPLAY_CAPTION = "A replay plays back what was on screen. It never runs anything again.";
export const NO_MOMENTS = "No moments were marked in this recording.";
export const MOMENTS_UNREADABLE = "The moments of this recording couldn't be read.";
export const CAST_UNREADABLE = "This recording can't be played back: its file couldn't be read.";

export function speedLabel(speed: number): string {
  return `${speed}×`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The cast
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type CastEventType = "o" | "m" | "r";
export type CastEvent = readonly [number, CastEventType, string];
export interface ParsedCast {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  // Whole seconds (Unix time) when the recording began. Event times count from it, across resumes and rotations.
  timestamp: number;
  // Never decreasing in time.
  events: CastEvent[];
}

const SIZE_MAX = 1000;

function cells(value: unknown, fallback: number): number {
  const n = Number(value);
  return Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 && n <= SIZE_MAX ? n : fallback;
}

// The recording as the route streams it: one header line, then one event per line. A line that does not read (the
// half-written last line of a live recording) or an event of another type is skipped; a time that goes back is held
// at the one before. null when the first line is not an asciicast v2 header.
export function parseCast(text: unknown): ParsedCast | null {
  if (typeof text !== "string" || !text) return null;
  const lines = text.split("\n");
  let header: unknown;
  try {
    header = JSON.parse(lines[0]);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (!header || typeof header !== "object" || Array.isArray(header)) return null;
  const h = header as Record<string, unknown>;
  const timestamp = h.timestamp;
  if (h.version !== 2 || typeof timestamp !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(timestamp)) return null;
  const events: CastEvent[] = [];
  let last = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
    if (!lines[i]) continue;
    let event: unknown;
    try {
      event = JSON.parse(lines[i]);
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(event) || event.length < 3) continue;
    const [at, type, data] = event as unknown[];
    if (typeof at !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(at) || at < 0 || typeof data !== "string") continue;
    const kind: CastEventType | null = type === "o" ? "o" : type === "m" ? "m" : type === "r" ? "r" : null;
    if (!kind) continue;
    last = Math.max(last, at);
    events.push([last, kind, data]);
  }
  return { width: cells(h.width, 80), height: cells(h.height, 24), timestamp, events };
}

// "<cols>x<rows>" of a resize event, or null.
export function parseSize(data: string): { cols: number; rows: number } | null {
  const match = /^(\d{1,4})x(\d{1,4})$/.exec(data);
  if (!match) return null;
  const cols = cells(match[1], 0);
  const rows = cells(match[2], 0);
  return cols && rows ? { cols, rows } : null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Markers and moments
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

type MarkerFile = { path: string; added: number | null; removed: number | null };

function count(value: unknown): number | null {
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : null;
}

function readFiles(value: unknown): MarkerFile[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  const files: MarkerFile[] = [];
  for (const item of value) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object") continue;
    const f = item as Record<string, unknown>;
    const filePath = f.path;
    if (typeof filePath !== "string" || !filePath) continue;
    files.push({ path: filePath, added: count(f.added), removed: count(f.removed) });
  }
  return files;
}

// The markers route's answer ({ markers: [...] }) or a bare list, checked: an entry without a readable time or of a
// type the replay does not know is dropped. A prompt marker keeps no text even if one came (R23).
export function readMarkers(answer: unknown): SessionMarker[] {
  const list: unknown[] = Array.isArray(answer)
    ? answer
    : answer && typeof answer === "object" && Array.isArray((answer as { markers?: unknown }).markers)
      ? (answer as { markers: unknown[] }).markers
      : [];
  const out: SessionMarker[] = [];
  for (const item of list) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object") continue;
    const m = item as Record<string, unknown>;
    const at = m.at;
    if (typeof at !== "string" || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(at))) continue;
    if (m.type === "prompt") out.push({ at, type: "prompt" });
    else if (m.type === "permission") out.push({ at, type: "permission", text: typeof m.text === "string" ? m.text : "" });
    else if (m.type === "files") out.push({ at, type: "files", files: readFiles(m.files), more: count(m.more) ?? 0 });
  }
  return out;
}

export type MomentType = SessionMarker["type"];
export interface ReplayMoment {
  // Seconds on the recording's clock.
  t: number;
  type: MomentType;
  // The timeline key's word: "Prompt", "Permission asked", "Files changed".
  word: string;
  // "Prompt", "Permission asked: <text>", "Files changed: <n>".
  label: string;
  // The small line under the word: the question's text, or the files with +/− ("" for a prompt, R23).
  detail: string;
}

// NEW SENTENCE (Q32): the timeline key's words (the prototype's).
export const MOMENT_WORDS: Readonly<Record<MomentType, string>> = { prompt: "Prompt", permission: "Permission asked", files: "Files changed" };

// "<path> (+<added> −<removed>)", or the path alone when git gave no counts (a binary file).
export function fileWords(file: MarkerFile): string {
  return typeof file.added === "number" && typeof file.removed === "number" ? `${file.path} (+${file.added} −${file.removed})` : file.path;
}

function momentOf(marker: SessionMarker): Omit<ReplayMoment, "t"> {
  if (marker.type === "permission") {
    const text = marker.text.trim();
    return { type: "permission", word: MOMENT_WORDS.permission, label: text ? `${MOMENT_WORDS.permission}: ${text}` : MOMENT_WORDS.permission, detail: text };
  }
  if (marker.type === "files") {
    const shown = marker.files.map(fileWords).join(", ");
    const detail = marker.more > 0 ? `${shown ? `${shown}, and ` : ""}${marker.more} more` : shown;
    return { type: "files", word: MOMENT_WORDS.files, label: `${MOMENT_WORDS.files}: ${marker.files.length + marker.more}`, detail };
  }
  return { type: "prompt", word: MOMENT_WORDS.prompt, label: MOMENT_WORDS.prompt, detail: "" };
}

// A moment's accessible name: "<label>, <time>"; a files moment also names its files.
export function momentName(moment: ReplayMoment): string {
  return [moment.label, moment.type === "files" ? moment.detail : "", clockWords(moment.t)].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The timeline
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type SegmentKind = "play" | "idle" | "removed";
export interface TimelineSegment {
  from: number;
  to: number;
  kind: SegmentKind;
}
export interface ReplayTimeline {
  // The true wall-clock length, in seconds from the recording's start.
  wallSeconds: number;
  // Where output is still recorded from (0 when nothing was removed).
  removedSeconds: number;
  // From 0 to wallSeconds, end to end, neighbours of the same kind joined.
  segments: TimelineSegment[];
  // Sorted by time.
  moments: ReplayMoment[];
}

// `endAt` is an ended session's end (ISO): its timeline runs to it, as the row's Length does. A live recording ends at
// its last event. Idle is a stretch longer than `idleSkipS` with no output (resize and marker events are not output);
// removed is 0 to the rotation marker, which the route keeps only at the start of what is still recorded. A marker
// before 0 belongs to an earlier recording of the same session (deleted, or removed by the 1 GB cap, before a Resume
// started this one) and is left out; one after the end sits at the end.
export function buildTimeline(
  cast: ParsedCast,
  markers: unknown,
  { idleSkipS = IDLE_SKIP_S, endAt = null }: { idleSkipS?: number; endAt?: string | null } = {}
): ReplayTimeline {
  const startMs = cast.timestamp * 1000;
  const events = cast.events;
  const lastEvent = events.length ? events[events.length - 1][0] : 0;
  const endMs = typeof endAt === "string" ? Date.parse(endAt) : NaN;
  const wallSeconds = Math.max(0, lastEvent, Number.isFinite(endMs) ? (endMs - startMs) / 1000 : 0);
  let removedSeconds = 0;
  for (const [t, type, data] of events) {
    if (type === "m" && data === ROTATION_MARKER) {
      removedSeconds = t;
      break;
    }
  }
  const segments: TimelineSegment[] = [];
  const push = (from: number, to: number, kind: SegmentKind) => {
    if (!(to > from)) return;
    const prev = segments[segments.length - 1];
    if (prev && prev.kind === kind && prev.to === from) prev.to = to;
    else segments.push({ from, to, kind });
  };
  const gapKind = (gap: number): SegmentKind => (gap > idleSkipS ? "idle" : "play");
  push(0, removedSeconds, "removed");
  let at = removedSeconds;
  for (const [t, type] of events) {
    if (type !== "o" || t < removedSeconds) continue;
    push(at, t, gapKind(t - at));
    at = t;
  }
  push(at, wallSeconds, gapKind(wallSeconds - at));
  const moments: ReplayMoment[] = [];
  for (const marker of readMarkers(markers)) {
    const t = (Date.parse(marker.at) - startMs) / 1000;
    if (!(t >= 0)) continue;
    moments.push({ t: Math.min(t, wallSeconds), ...momentOf(marker) });
  }
  moments.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
  return { wallSeconds, removedSeconds, segments, moments };
}

// The playhead after `seconds` of the recording have played from `pos`: play segments use the time up, idle and
// removed ones are jumped at once (spec: idle gaps are skipped while playing). Stops at the end.
export function advance(segments: readonly TimelineSegment[], pos: number, seconds: number): number {
  let at = Number.isFinite(pos) ? Math.max(0, pos) : 0;
  let left = Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0 ? seconds : 0;
  for (const segment of segments) {
    if (segment.to <= at) continue;
    if (segment.kind !== "play") {
      at = segment.to;
      continue;
    }
    const from = Math.max(at, segment.from);
    const room = segment.to - from;
    if (left <= room) return from + left;
    left -= room;
    at = segment.to;
  }
  return at;
}

// How many events have happened by `pos` (times are never decreasing, so a binary search).
export function eventIndexAt(events: readonly CastEvent[], pos: number): number {
  let lo = 0;
  let hi = events.length;
  while (lo < hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
    if (events[mid][0] <= pos) lo = mid + 1;
    else hi = mid;
  }
  return lo;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Drawing the screen
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type ReplayStep = { kind: "reset" } | { kind: "resize"; cols: number; rows: number } | { kind: "write"; data: string };

// From a screen showing the first `from` events to one showing the first `to`. Forward: the new output, joined, split
// where the recording was resized. Back: a full reset at the recording's first size, then everything again.
export function replaySteps(cast: ParsedCast, from: number, to: number): ReplayStep[] {
  const end = Math.max(0, Math.min(to, cast.events.length));
  let start = Math.max(0, Math.min(from, cast.events.length));
  const steps: ReplayStep[] = [];
  if (end < start) {
    steps.push({ kind: "reset" }, { kind: "resize", cols: cast.width, rows: cast.height });
    start = 0;
  }
  let text = "";
  const flush = () => {
    if (text) {
      steps.push({ kind: "write", data: text });
      text = "";
    }
  };
  for (let i = start; i < end; i += 1) {
    const [, type, data] = cast.events[i];
    if (type === "o") text += data;
    else if (type === "r") {
      const size = parseSize(data);
      if (size) {
        flush();
        steps.push({ kind: "resize", cols: size.cols, rows: size.rows });
      }
    }
  }
  flush();
  return steps;
}

// The parts of an xterm terminal the replay drives: the page's Terminal, or @xterm/headless's in the tests.
export interface ReplayTerminal {
  write(data: string, callback?: () => void): void;
  resize(cols: number, rows: number): void;
}

// Draws the steps in order. Each write waits until xterm has read it, and a resize happens only between writes, never
// inside a write callback (terminalShared.ts restoreScreen says why); an empty write is never sent (writeParsed says
// why). `stopped()` is asked before each step: a replay that closed draws nothing more.
export async function runReplaySteps(t: ReplayTerminal, steps: readonly ReplayStep[], stopped: () => boolean = () => false): Promise<void> {
  for (const step of steps) {
    if (stopped()) return;
    if (step.kind === "resize") {
      t.resize(step.cols, step.rows);
      continue;
    }
    const data = step.kind === "reset" ? "\x1bc" : step.data;
    if (data) await new Promise<void>((resolve) => t.write(data, resolve));
  }
}

// JetBrains Mono's cell is 0.6 em wide; xterm's row is lineHeight em tall.
export const CELL_WIDTH_EM = 0.6;
export const REPLAY_FONT_MIN = 6;

// The largest whole font size up to `max` at which the recording's columns and rows fit the box, never below 6 px
// (a very wide recording then scrolls inside its box, never the page). A box not laid out yet keeps `max`.
export function fitFontSize({
  boxWidth,
  boxHeight,
  cols,
  rows,
  max = 13,
  lineHeight = 1.2
}: {
  boxWidth: number;
  boxHeight: number;
  cols: number;
  rows: number;
  max?: number;
  lineHeight?: number;
}): number {
  if (!(boxWidth > 0) || !(boxHeight > 0) || !(cols > 0) || !(rows > 0)) return max;
  const fits = Math.min(boxWidth / (cols * CELL_WIDTH_EM), boxHeight / (rows * lineHeight));
  return Math.max(REPLAY_FONT_MIN, Math.min(max, Math.floor(fits)));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Small helpers for the page
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function timelinePercent(t: number, wallSeconds: number): number {
  if (!(wallSeconds > 0) || !Number.isFinite(t)) return 0;
  return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (t / wallSeconds) * 100));
}

// The index of the last moment at or before the playhead, or -1.
export function currentMoment(moments: readonly ReplayMoment[], pos: number): number {
  let current = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < moments.length; i += 1) {
    if (moments[i].t <= pos) current = i;
    else break;
  }
  return current;
}

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

// "12 s", "4 m 16 s", "1 h 02 m 05 s" (the prototype's clock words, with hours for long recordings).
export function clockWords(seconds: number): string {
  const s = Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0 ? Math.floor(seconds) : 0;
  if (s < 60) return `${s} s`;
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  if (m < 60) return `${m} m ${pad(s % 60)} s`;
  return `${Math.floor(m / 60)} h ${pad(m % 60)} m ${pad(s % 60)} s`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The dialogs and notes
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface ReplayResumeCopy {
  title: string;
  body: string[];
  warning: string | null;
  cancel: string;
  confirm: string;
}

// The replay header's Resume confirm (spec: the prototype's, runs.html "Resume this conversation?"), with SP3's
// fallback warning and its last sentence (sessionsShared.ts resumeConfirmCopy). `folder` is null where Agent OS does not
// show one (OpenClaw).
export function replayResumeCopy({ agent, folder, fallback }: { agent: string; folder: string | null; fallback: boolean }): ReplayResumeCopy {
  const where = folder ? ` in ${folder}` : "";
  return {
    title: "Resume this conversation?",
    body: [
      `Agent OS opens a new terminal${where} and starts ${agent} with its own resume feature.`,
      "Agent OS does not paste the old text back in and does not press Enter for you. The recording continues after a marker."
    ],
    warning: fallback ? `This resumes the most recent ${agent} conversation in this folder, which may be one you started outside Agent OS.` : null,
    cancel: "Cancel",
    confirm: "Resume conversation"
  };
}

// The Delete recording confirm. After a delete, Runs no longer lists the session (it has no recording), so a session
// whose tab was dismissed is then shown nowhere; the words say so.
export function deleteConfirmCopy({ kind, dismissed }: { kind: "agent" | "update"; dismissed: boolean }): { title: string; body: string[]; confirm: string } {
  const body = ["Agent OS deletes what this session's terminal showed, and its moments, from this computer. This can't be undone."];
  if (kind === "agent") {
    body.push(
      dismissed
        ? "You dismissed this session's tab, so after this Agent OS no longer lists the session anywhere."
        : "The session's tab stays on the Sessions page, and so does its Resume conversation."
    );
  }
  return { title: "Delete this recording?", body, confirm: "Delete recording" };
}

export function liveNote(seconds: number): string {
  return `Still recording. This replay covers the first ${clockWords(seconds)}. To see the rest, open the live session.`;
}

export function endedNote(agent: string): string {
  return `Resume conversation starts ${agent} again with its own resume feature. Agent OS does not copy the text.`;
}

const FINAL_DELETE_REFUSALS = new Set(["recording_live", "recording_missing", "unknown_session"]);

// A Delete the server refused in a way another try cannot change as things stand: the dialog then shuts its Delete
// button and keeps the server's sentence. An Error is Agent OS's own answer when it is named "ApiError" (src/api.ts).
export function isFinalDeleteRefusal(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof Error && error.name === "ApiError" && FINAL_DELETE_REFUSALS.has(error.message);
}

// The words for a Delete that did not work: the server's own sentence, or what is known when no readable answer came
// (it may have happened; the list, read again, shows the truth).
export function deleteProblem(error: unknown, gotNoAnswer: boolean): string {
  if (error instanceof Error && error.name === "ApiError") {
    const detail = String((error as Error & { detail?: unknown }).detail || "").trim();
    return detail || "Agent OS couldn't delete this recording. Try again.";
  }
  return gotNoAnswer
    ? "Agent OS didn't answer, so the recording may or may not be deleted. The list shows it only while it is still there."
    : "Agent OS answered, but the answer couldn't be read. The list shows the recording only while it is still there.";
}
```

```ts
// A recording's moments for its replay (Task X1a's route): { markers }, from meta.json, or from memory while the
// session runs.
export function getMarkers(sessionId: string): Promise<{ markers: SessionMarker[] }> {
  return withTimeout(request<{ markers: SessionMarker[] }>(sessionPath(sessionId, "/markers")), SESSION_LIMITS_MS.markers);
}

// The recording itself, as the asciicast text GET /api/sessions/:id/recording streams (request() reads JSON only).
// The download is stopped at its time limit, or when `signal` aborts (the replay closed), so a big recording never
// keeps coming for nobody. A refusal is an ApiError, made the way request() makes one (a 401 session_required locks
// the app).
export async function fetchRecording(sessionId: string, { signal }: { signal?: AbortSignal } = {}): Promise<string> {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const stop = () => controller.abort();
  if (signal?.aborted) stop();
  else signal?.addEventListener("abort", stop, { once: true });
  const timer = setTimeout(stop, SESSION_LIMITS_MS.recording);
  try {
    const response = await fetch(sessionPath(sessionId, "/recording"), { credentials: "same-origin", signal: controller.signal });
    if (!response.ok) {
      const body = await response.json().catch(() => null);
      if (response.status === 401 && body?.error === "session_required") window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("agentos:locked"));
      throw new ApiError(body?.error || `${response.status} ${response.statusText}`, typeof body?.message === "string" ? body.message : "", response.status);
    }
    return await response.text();
  } catch (error) {
    // Stopped by the time limit, not by the caller: the words every other request uses.
    if (controller.signal.aborted && !signal?.aborted) throw new Error(TIMEOUT_WORDS);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    signal?.removeEventListener("abort", stop);
  }
}
```
