```tsx
import StatusWord from "./StatusWord";

const MOMENT_ICONS: Record<MomentType, LucideIcon> = { prompt: Send, permission: CircleHelp, files: FileText };

function readToken(name: string): string {
  return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name);
}

// The box's room for the terminal: its size less its padding (the spacing tokens change with the laptop density).
function innerSize(box: HTMLElement): { width: number; height: number } {
  const style = getComputedStyle(box);
  const padX = parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) + parseFloat(style.paddingRight);
  const padY = parseFloat(style.paddingTop) + parseFloat(style.paddingBottom);
  return { width: box.clientWidth - (padX || 0), height: box.clientHeight - (padY || 0) };
}

type Loaded =
  | { state: "loading" }
  | { state: "ok"; cast: ParsedCast; timeline: ReplayTimeline; momentsRead: boolean }
  | { state: "error"; message: string };

// The timeline's hatched idle gaps and its removed span. Drawn again only when the recording changes.
const TrackMarks = memo(function TrackMarks({ timeline }: { timeline: ReplayTimeline }) {
  return (
    <>
      {timeline.segments.map((segment) =>
        segment.kind === "play" ? null : (
          <span
            key={`${segment.kind}-${segment.from}`}
            className={segment.kind === "idle" ? "os-replay__idle" : "os-replay__removed"}
            title={segment.kind === "idle" ? IDLE_WORDS : REMOVED_WORDS}
            style={{
              left: `${timelinePercent(segment.from, timeline.wallSeconds)}%`,
              width: `${timelinePercent(segment.to - segment.from, timeline.wallSeconds)}%`
            }}
          />
        )
      )}
    </>
  );
});

// One pin per moment, on two lanes (prototype). Mouse shortcuts only: out of the tab order and hidden from assistive
// technology, because the moments list next to the player offers the same moments as buttons (a session keeps up to
// 500, decision K20).
const Pins = memo(function Pins({
  moments,
  wallSeconds,
  current,
  onPick
}: {
  moments: ReplayMoment[];
  wallSeconds: number;
  current: number;
  onPick: (moment: ReplayMoment) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      {moments.map((moment, i) => {
        const Icon = MOMENT_ICONS[moment.type];
        const lane = String(i % 2);
        const left = `${timelinePercent(moment.t, wallSeconds)}%`;
        return (
          <span key={`${moment.t}-${i}`}>
            <span className="os-replay__stem" data-lane={lane} style={{ left }} />
            <button
              type="button"
              className="os-replay__pin"
              data-kind={moment.type}
              data-lane={lane}
              style={{ left }}
              tabIndex={-1}
              aria-hidden="true"
              aria-current={i === current ? "true" : undefined}
              title={momentName(moment)}
              onClick={() => onPick(moment)}
            >
              <Icon size={12} aria-hidden="true" />
            </button>
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
});

// "Moments in this recording": the keyboard's way to the moments. The current one says aria-current; later ones are dim.
const MomentList = memo(function MomentList({
  moments,
  current,
  onPick
}: {
  moments: ReplayMoment[];
  current: number;
  onPick: (moment: ReplayMoment) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="os-replay__moments">
      {moments.map((moment, i) => {
        const Icon = MOMENT_ICONS[moment.type];
        return (
          <button
            key={`${moment.t}-${i}`}
            type="button"
            className={`os-replay__moment${i > current ? " is-future" : ""}`}
            data-kind={moment.type}
            aria-current={i === current ? "true" : undefined}
            aria-label={momentName(moment)}
            onClick={() => onPick(moment)}
          >
            <Icon size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
            <span className="os-replay__what">
              {moment.word}
              {moment.detail ? <small>{moment.detail}</small> : null}
            </span>
            <span className="os-mono">{clockWords(moment.t)}</span>
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
});

export default function ReplayPlayer({
  row,
  session,
  action,
  live,
  onResume,
  onOpenLive,
  onDelete
}: {
  row: RecordingRow;
  session: SessionSummary | undefined;
  action: RowAction;
  live: boolean;
  onResume: () => void;
  onOpenLive: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
}) {
  const titleId = useId();
  const speedId = useId();
  const deleteWhyId = useId();
  const resumeWhyId = useId();
  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const hostRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const termRef = useRef<Terminal | null>(null);
  const fitRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
  // How many events the screen shows, counting the steps still queued for it.
  const shownRef = useRef(0);
  const queueRef = useRef<Promise<void>>(Promise.resolve());
  const posRef = useRef(0);
  // Read once per load: a session that ends while its replay is open keeps the timeline it was read with.
  const endAtRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  endAtRef.current = live ? null : row.endedAt;
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState<Loaded>({ state: "loading" });
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const [pos, setPos] = useState(0);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState<ReplaySpeed>(DEFAULT_SPEED);
  const cast = loaded.state === "ok" ? loaded.cast : null;
  const timeline = loaded.state === "ok" ? loaded.timeline : null;

  // The replay takes the keyboard when it opens (the Replay button that opened it is gone).
  useEffect(() => {
    titleRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, []);

  // The recording and its moments, read together. A replay that closes stops the download.
  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    let current = true;
    setLoaded({ state: "loading" });
    setPlaying(false);
    void (async () => {
      const [castRead, markersRead] = await Promise.allSettled([fetchRecording(row.sessionId, { signal: controller.signal }), getMarkers(row.sessionId)]);
      if (!current) return;
      if (castRead.status === "rejected") {
        setLoaded({ state: "error", message: sessionProblem(castRead.reason) });
        return;
      }
      const parsed = parseCast(castRead.value);
      if (!parsed) {
        setLoaded({ state: "error", message: CAST_UNREADABLE });
        return;
      }
      const markers = markersRead.status === "fulfilled" ? markersRead.value : [];
      setLoaded({
        state: "ok",
        cast: parsed,
        // An ended session's timeline runs to its end; a live one's to what was recorded when the replay opened.
        timeline: buildTimeline(parsed, markers, { endAt: endAtRef.current }),
        momentsRead: markersRead.status === "fulfilled"
      });
    })();
    return () => {
      current = false;
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [row.sessionId, attempt]);

  // Brings the screen to the events up to `at`: forward, only the new events; back, a clean screen and everything
  // again. The steps run one after another through one queue; a closed terminal draws nothing more.
  const draw = useCallback(
    (at: number) => {
      const t = termRef.current;
      if (!t || !cast) return;
      const index = eventIndexAt(cast.events, at);
      const steps = replaySteps(cast, shownRef.current, index);
      shownRef.current = index;
      if (steps.length === 0) return;
      const resized = steps.some((step) => step.kind !== "write");
      queueRef.current = queueRef.current
        .then(() => runReplaySteps(t, steps, () => termRef.current !== t))
        .then(() => {
          if (resized && termRef.current === t) fitRef.current?.();
        })
        .catch(() => undefined);
    },
    [cast]
  );

  const moveTo = useCallback(
    (at: number) => {
      if (!timeline) return;
      const next = Math.min(Math.max(at, 0), timeline.wallSeconds);
      posRef.current = next;
      setPos(next);
      draw(next);
    },
    [timeline, draw]
  );

  // The read-only terminal, at the recording's own size; its font shrinks (13 px down to 6 px) so the whole screen
  // fits the box. The DOM renderer only, no add-on that reaches out (links, clipboard), and no input handler at all.
  useEffect(() => {
    const host = hostRef.current;
    const box = boxRef.current;
    if (!cast || !timeline || !host || !box) return undefined;
    const t = new Terminal({
      cols: cast.width,
      rows: cast.height,
      allowProposedApi: true,
      disableStdin: true,
      cursorBlink: false,
      fontFamily: readToken("--os-font-mono").trim() || "monospace",
      fontSize: TERMINAL_FONT_SIZE,
      lineHeight: TERMINAL_LINE_HEIGHT,
      scrollback: TERMINAL_SCROLLBACK,
      theme: terminalTheme(readToken),
      // An OSC 8 link in the recording opens nothing (xterm's own default would ask the browser, then open it).
      linkHandler: { activate: () => undefined, allowNonHttpProtocols: false }
    });
    t.loadAddon(new Unicode11Addon());
    t.unicode.activeVersion = "11";
    t.open(host);
    // The keyboard goes past the terminal's own text box: nothing can be typed into a replay.
    t.textarea?.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
    termRef.current = t;
    shownRef.current = 0;
    const fit = () => {
      if (termRef.current !== t) return;
      const room = innerSize(box);
      const size = fitFontSize({ boxWidth: room.width, boxHeight: room.height, cols: t.cols, rows: t.rows, max: TERMINAL_FONT_SIZE, lineHeight: TERMINAL_LINE_HEIGHT });
      if (t.options.fontSize !== size) t.options.fontSize = size;
    };
    fitRef.current = fit;
    fit();
    const watch = new ResizeObserver(() => fit());
    watch.observe(box);
    // It opens at the first second still recorded, paused.
    const start = timeline.removedSeconds;
    posRef.current = start;
    setPos(start);
    const index = eventIndexAt(cast.events, start);
    const steps = replaySteps(cast, 0, index);
    shownRef.current = index;
    queueRef.current = runReplaySteps(t, steps, () => termRef.current !== t).catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      watch.disconnect();
      fitRef.current = null;
      termRef.current = null;
      t.dispose();
    };
  }, [cast, timeline]);

  // Playing: every TICK_MS the playhead moves by the time passed times the speed, through output only (idle gaps and
  // the removed span are jumped at once), and stops at the end. A hidden window does not race ahead.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing || !timeline) return undefined;
    let last = performance.now();
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      const nowMs = performance.now();
      const passed = ((nowMs - last) / 1000) * speed;
      last = nowMs;
      if (document.hidden) return;
      const next = advance(timeline.segments, posRef.current, passed);
      moveTo(next);
      if (next >= timeline.wallSeconds) setPlaying(false);
    }, TICK_MS);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [playing, speed, timeline, moveTo]);

  function togglePlay() {
    if (!timeline) return;
    if (playing) {
      setPlaying(false);
      return;
    }
    // At the end, Play starts again from the first second still recorded.
    if (posRef.current >= timeline.wallSeconds) moveTo(timeline.removedSeconds);
    setPlaying(true);
  }

  // A moment: the screen one second after it (MOMENT_LEAD_S), where its own output has landed.
  const pick = useCallback((moment: ReplayMoment) => moveTo(moment.t + MOMENT_LEAD_S), [moveTo]);

  const title = sessionTitle(row);
  const agent = row.agentLabel || row.agentId || "Agent";
  const firstStart = recordedAt(row);
  const current = timeline ? currentMoment(timeline.moments, pos) : -1;
  const note = !timeline ? null : live ? liveNote(timeline.wallSeconds) : action.kind === "resume" && action.available ? endedNote(agent) : null;
  const rangeMax = timeline ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(timeline.wallSeconds)) : 1;
  const hasIdle = timeline ? timeline.segments.some((segment) => segment.kind === "idle") : false;

  return (
    <section className="os-replay" aria-labelledby={titleId}>
      <header className="os-replay__head">
        <div className="os-replay__intro">
          <h2 id={titleId} ref={titleRef} tabIndex={-1} className="os-replay__title os-trunc" title={title}>
            {title}
          </h2>
          <p className="os-replay__facts">
            {live ? <StatusWord state="live" label="Recording" /> : <StatusWord state="ready" label="Saved" />}
            <span className="os-replay__sep" aria-hidden="true" />
            {row.kind === "update" ? (
              <span>Agent update</span>
            ) : !row.folderShown ? (
              <span>Folder set by OpenClaw</span>
            ) : (
              <span>
                Folder <span className="os-mono">{collapseHomePath(row.folder) || "—"}</span>
              </span>
            )}
            {session?.branch ? (
              <>
                <span className="os-replay__sep" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span>
                  Branch <span className="os-mono">{session.branch}</span>
                </span>
              </>
            ) : null}
            <span className="os-replay__sep" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>Recorded {firstStart ? <TimeAgo since={firstStart} /> : "—"}</span>
            <span className="os-replay__sep" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>
              True length <span className="os-mono">{timeline ? clockWords(timeline.wallSeconds) : "…"}</span>
              {live ? " so far" : ""}
            </span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="os-replay__acts">
          <div className="os-replay__btns">
            {action.kind === "open" ? (
              <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" onClick={onOpenLive}>
                <SquareTerminal size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
                Open live session
              </button>
            ) : null}
            {action.kind === "resume" ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="os-btn os-btn--primary"
                disabled={!action.available || !session}
                aria-describedby={action.available ? undefined : resumeWhyId}
                onClick={onResume}
              >
                <History size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
                Resume conversation
              </button>
            ) : null}
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" disabled={live} aria-describedby={live ? deleteWhyId : undefined} onClick={onDelete}>
              <Trash2 size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
              Delete recording
            </button>
          </div>
          {action.kind === "resume" && !action.available ? (
            <p id={resumeWhyId} className="os-replay__why">
              {action.reason}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          {live ? (
            <p id={deleteWhyId} className="os-replay__why">
              {DELETE_WHILE_LIVE}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </header>

      {loaded.state === "loading" ? (
        <p className="os-replay__status">
          <StatusWord state="loading" />
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {loaded.state === "error" ? (
        <div className="os-replay__status">
          <Banner
            tone="danger"
            actions={
              <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => setAttempt((n) => n + 1)}>
                Try again
              </button>
            }
          >
            {loaded.message}
          </Banner>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {loaded.state === "ok" && timeline ? (
        <div className="os-replay__body">
          <div className="os-replay__main">
            <div className="os-replay__screen" ref={boxRef} role="region" aria-label="Replayed terminal screen">
              <div className="os-replay__term" ref={hostRef} />
              {pos < timeline.removedSeconds ? <p className="os-replay__gone-note">{REMOVED_WORDS}</p> : null}
            </div>
            <p className="os-replay__cap">
              <SquareTerminal size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
              {REPLAY_CAPTION}
            </p>

            <div className="os-replay__ctl">
              <div className="os-replay__ctl-top">
                <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary os-replay__play" aria-label={playing ? "Pause" : "Play"} onClick={togglePlay}>
                  {playing ? <Pause size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> : <Play size={18} aria-hidden="true" />}
                </button>
                <p className="os-replay__clock">
                  <span className="os-replay__now os-mono">{clockWords(pos)}</span>
                  <span className="os-replay__of">
                    of <span className="os-mono">{clockWords(timeline.wallSeconds)}</span> true length
                  </span>
                </p>
                <div className="os-replay__speed">
                  <span id={speedId}>Speed</span>
                  <div className="os-replay__seg" role="group" aria-labelledby={speedId}>
                    {REPLAY_SPEEDS.map((choice) => (
                      <button key={choice} type="button" aria-pressed={speed === choice} onClick={() => setSpeed(choice)}>
                        {speedLabel(choice)}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={`os-replay__scrub${playing ? " is-playing" : ""}`}>
                <Pins moments={timeline.moments} wallSeconds={timeline.wallSeconds} current={current} onPick={pick} />
                <div className="os-replay__track">
                  <TrackMarks timeline={timeline} />
                  <span className="os-replay__fill" style={{ width: `${timelinePercent(pos, timeline.wallSeconds)}%` }} />
                </div>
                <input
                  className="os-replay__range"
                  type="range"
                  min={0}
                  max={rangeMax}
                  step={1}
                  value={Math.min(Math.floor(pos), rangeMax)}
                  aria-label="Replay position"
                  aria-valuetext={`${clockWords(pos)} of ${clockWords(timeline.wallSeconds)}`}
                  onChange={(event) => moveTo(Number(event.currentTarget.value))}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="os-replay__ends" aria-hidden="true">
                <span>0 s</span>
                <span>{clockWords(timeline.wallSeconds)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="os-replay__legend" role="group" aria-label="Timeline key">
                <span>
                  <Send size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
                  {MOMENT_WORDS.prompt}
                </span>
                <span className="is-attn">
                  <CircleHelp size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
                  {MOMENT_WORDS.permission}
                </span>
                <span>
                  <FileText size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
                  {MOMENT_WORDS.files}
                </span>
                {hasIdle ? (
                  <span>
                    <i className="os-replay__hatch" aria-hidden="true" />
                    {IDLE_WORDS}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
                {timeline.removedSeconds > 0 ? (
                  <span>
                    <i className="os-replay__gone" aria-hidden="true" />
                    {REMOVED_WORDS}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <aside className="os-replay__side" aria-label={MOMENTS_TITLE}>
            <h3 className="os-replay__side-title">{MOMENTS_TITLE}</h3>
            {timeline.moments.length > 0 ? (
              <MomentList moments={timeline.moments} current={current} onPick={pick} />
            ) : (
              <p className="os-replay__empty">{loaded.momentsRead ? NO_MOMENTS : MOMENTS_UNREADABLE}</p>
            )}
            {note ? (
              <p className="os-replay__note">
                <Info size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
                <span>{note}</span>
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </aside>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Rewrite `src/ui/components/SessionRecordings.tsx`** with exactly this content (the list, `useRecordings` and `confirmResume` are SP3's, unchanged; the new parts are the row's Replay button, the replay branch, the Resume dialog's words by origin and the Delete dialog):

```tsx
// Runs → Session recordings: every recorded session, newest first (GET /api/recordings), joined with the shared
// sessions list for Resume. Every row offers "Replay" (Task U11), which shows that recording's replay here in place of
// the list (?replay=<session id>, ReplayPlayer.tsx). A live row also offers "Open live session"; an ended one "Resume
// conversation" (or says why it can't). An update recording ("<agent> update") is never resumed, so it offers Replay
// only. "Open recording" on an ended Sessions tab lands here with that row highlighted (?highlight=<session id>; the
// row also says aria-current), and the row takes keyboard focus once; leaving a replay marks its row the same way. A
// resumed session is one recording: Recorded is when it first started and Length covers all its parts
// (recordingsShared.ts). Resume asks first: from a row with SP3's words (resumeConfirmCopy), from the replay header
// with the prototype's "Resume this conversation?" (replayResumeCopy, spec SP4). A Resume the server refuses as
// impossible (session_live, not_resumable) shuts the dialog's Resume button and keeps the server's own sentence.
// Delete recording (replay header only, off while the session runs) asks first too, and a refusal another try can't
// change (recording_live, recording_missing, unknown_session) shuts its button the same way. listRecordings,
// resumeSession and deleteRecording carry their own time limits (sessionsApi.ts, SESSION_LIMITS_MS). Where sessions do
// not run (the public demo, a shared server) the route answers 404 not_available: the tab says so once and stops
// asking, instead of "isn't responding".
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { CircleDot, History, Play, SquareTerminal } from "lucide-react";
import { ApiError } from "../../api";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import { deleteRecording, listRecordings, resumeSession, sessionGotNoAnswer } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { SessionSummary } from "../../types";
import { collapseHomePath } from "../agentsShared";
import { askToFocusNextSession, createdSessionId } from "../newSession";
import { CAP_NOTE, EMPTY_BODY, EMPTY_TITLE, isRecording, readRecordings, recordedAt, recordingLength, rowAction } from "../recordingsShared";
import type { RecordingRow, RecordingsBody } from "../recordingsShared";
import { RECORDING_GONE, deleteConfirmCopy, deleteProblem, isFinalDeleteRefusal, replayResumeCopy } from "../replayShared";
import { isImpossibleResume, resumeConfirmCopy, sessionTitle } from "../sessionsShared";
import { actionProblem, isLookOnlyRefusal } from "../sessionsPageShared";
import { useSessionsList } from "../useSessionsList";
import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";
import Banner from "./Banner";
import EmptyState from "./EmptyState";
import ReplayPlayer from "./ReplayPlayer";
import { TimeAgo } from "./RelativeTime";
import StatusWord from "./StatusWord";
import { tabDomId } from "./Tabs";
import { useInterval } from "./useInterval";

export type RecordingsState =
  | { state: "loading" }
  | { state: "ok"; data: RecordingsBody; stale: boolean }
  | { state: "error" }
  | { state: "unavailable" };

// The answer outside local mode (requireLocalMode, Task S8): sessions and their recordings do not exist here.
function notAvailable(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 404 && error.message === "not_available";
}

// The list, read while the tab is open: every 5 s and one read at a time. After a good read, a failed one keeps the
// rows under a warning (SP2 lessons). A not_available answer is final: nothing is asked again.
export function useRecordings(active: boolean): { value: RecordingsState; reload: () => void } {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<RecordingsState>({ state: "loading" });
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const busy = useRef(false);
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (busy.current) return;
    busy.current = true;
    try {
      const body = readRecordings(await listRecordings());
      if (!body) throw new Error("not a list");
      if (alive.current) setValue({ state: "ok", data: body, stale: false });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      if (notAvailable(error)) setValue({ state: "unavailable" });
      else setValue((prev) => (prev.state === "ok" ? { ...prev, stale: true } : { state: "error" }));
    } finally {
      busy.current = false;
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);
  const asking = active && value.state !== "unavailable";
  useEffect(() => {
    if (asking) void load();
  }, [asking, load]);
  useInterval(() => void load(), asking ? 5000 : null);
  return { value, reload: () => void load() };
}

function whereWords(row: RecordingRow): string {
  if (row.kind === "update") return "Agent update";
  if (!row.folderShown) return "Folder set by OpenClaw";
  return collapseHomePath(row.folder) || "—";
}

// The Resume dialog's words: SP3's from a row, the prototype's from the replay header (spec SP4, "Recordings in Runs").
function resumeWords(session: SessionSummary, from: "row" | "replay"): { title: string; body: string[]; warning: string | null } {
  if (from === "replay") {
    return replayResumeCopy({
      agent: session.agentLabel || session.agentId || "Agent",
      folder: session.folderShown === false ? null : collapseHomePath(session.folder) || null,
      fallback: session.resume?.fallback === true
    });
  }
  const copy = resumeConfirmCopy(session);
  return { title: copy.title, body: [copy.body], warning: copy.warning };
}

export default function SessionRecordings({
  value,
  highlight,
  replay = "",
  onReload,
  onCloseReplay
}: {
  value: RecordingsState;
  highlight: string;
  // The session id whose replay is shown in place of the list ("" for the list).
  replay?: string;
  onReload: () => void;
  onCloseReplay?: () => void;
}) {
  const sessionsList = useSessionsList();
  const sessionsState: "loading" | "ok" | "error" = sessionsList.available ? sessionsList.source.state : "ok";
  const sessions: SessionSummary[] =
    sessionsList.source.state === "ok" && Array.isArray(sessionsList.source.data.sessions) ? sessionsList.source.data.sessions : [];
  const byId = new Map(sessions.map((session) => [session.id, session]));
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  // `blocked`: the server refused the Resume as impossible (isImpossibleResume), so pressing it again cannot work.
  const [resuming, setResuming] = useState<{ session: SessionSummary; busy: boolean; error: string; toSafety: boolean; blocked: boolean } | null>(null);
  // Where Resume was pressed (a row or the replay header): the dialog's words follow it.
  const [resumeFrom, setResumeFrom] = useState<"row" | "replay">("row");
  // Delete recording, from the replay header. `blocked`: a refusal another try cannot change (isFinalDeleteRefusal).
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<{ row: RecordingRow; busy: boolean; error: string; blocked: boolean } | null>(null);
  // True once a delete worked: its dialog then leaves the keyboard alone (the Delete button goes away with the replay).
  const deleted = useRef(false);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const highlighted = useRef("");
  const anyLive = value.state === "ok" && value.data.rows.some((row) => row.live);
  useInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), anyLive ? 1000 : null);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // The row asked for comes into view and takes focus, once per request.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!highlight || highlighted.current === highlight || value.state !== "ok") return;
    const row = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-recording="${CSS.escape(highlight)}"]`);
    if (!row) return;
    highlighted.current = highlight;
    row.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
    row.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [highlight, value]);

  // The keyboard was on the dialog's main button when the server refused in a way another try can't change, and that
  // button is now shut: it goes to Cancel, so it neither falls to the page behind the dialog nor sits on a button that
  // does nothing.
  const blocked = resuming?.blocked === true || deleting?.blocked === true;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (blocked) document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".os-modal__actions .os-btn--ghost")?.focus();
  }, [blocked]);

  async function confirmResume() {
    if (!resuming || resuming.busy || resuming.blocked) return;
    const { session } = resuming;
    setResuming({ session, busy: true, error: "", toSafety: false, blocked: false });
    try {
      const resumed = await resumeSession(session.id);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      // An answer that is not a session (`null`, say) is an answer that could not be read, like a body that is not
      // JSON (a SyntaxError, which sessionGotNoAnswer counts as an answer). Nothing is acted on before this check.
      if (createdSessionId(resumed) === null) throw new SyntaxError("Agent OS answered with something that is not a session.");
      sessionsList.refresh();
      // The Resume button is gone after this: the session's terminal takes the keyboard on the Sessions page.
      askToFocusNextSession();
      navigateTo("sessions", { session: session.id });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setResuming({
        session,
        busy: false,
        error: actionProblem(error, "resume", sessionGotNoAnswer(error)),
        toSafety: isLookOnlyRefusal(error),
        blocked: isImpossibleResume(error)
      });
      // The conversation may have started although nothing readable came back: read both lists again.
      sessionsList.refresh();
      onReload();
    }
  }

  async function confirmDelete() {
    if (!deleting || deleting.busy || deleting.blocked) return;
    const { row } = deleting;
    setDeleting({ row, busy: true, error: "", blocked: false });
    try {
      await deleteRecording(row.sessionId);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      deleted.current = true;
      setDeleting(null);
      onReload();
      // Back to the list; its tab takes the keyboard (the Delete button and the replay are gone).
      navigateTo("runs", { tab: "recordings" });
      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => document.getElementById(tabDomId("runs", "recordings"))?.focus());
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setDeleting({ row, busy: false, error: deleteProblem(error, sessionGotNoAnswer(error)), blocked: isFinalDeleteRefusal(error) });
      // The delete may have happened although no readable answer came: read the list again.
      onReload();
    }
  }

  if (value.state === "loading") {
    return (
      <p className="os-runs-rec__status">
        <StatusWord state="loading" />
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (value.state === "unavailable") {
    // The Sessions page's own words for the same answer (Task U3).
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon={CircleDot}
        title="Session recordings aren't available here"
        body="Sessions run only when Agent OS runs on your own computer, not in the public demo or on a shared server."
      />
    );
  }
  if (value.state === "error") {
    return (
      <Banner
        tone="danger"
        title="Agent OS isn't responding"
        actions={
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={onReload}>
            Try again
          </button>
        }
      >
        The recordings can&apos;t be listed right now. This page tries again every few seconds.
      </Banner>
    );
  }

  const { rows, removedByCap } = value.data;
  const copy = resuming ? resumeWords(resuming.session, resumeFrom) : null;
  const deleteCopy = deleting
    ? deleteConfirmCopy({ kind: deleting.row.kind, dismissed: byId.get(deleting.row.sessionId)?.dismissed === true })
    : null;
  const replayRow = replay ? rows.find((row) => row.sessionId === replay) : undefined;
  const replaySession = replayRow ? byId.get(replayRow.sessionId) : undefined;
  const replayAction = replayRow ? rowAction(replayRow, replaySession, sessionsState) : null;
  return (
    <div className="os-runs-rec__wrap">
      {value.stale ? (
        <Banner tone="warn" title="Can't reach Agent OS">
          This is the last list it got. It keeps trying, and this page updates by itself when Agent OS is back.
        </Banner>
      ) : null}
      {replay ? (
        replayRow && replayAction ? (
          <ReplayPlayer
            key={replayRow.sessionId}
            row={replayRow}
            session={replaySession}
            action={replayAction}
            live={isRecording(replayRow, replayAction)}
            onResume={() => {
              if (!replaySession) return;
              setResumeFrom("replay");
              setResuming({ session: replaySession, busy: false, error: "", toSafety: false, blocked: false });
            }}
            onOpenLive={() => navigateTo("sessions", { session: replayRow.sessionId })}
            onDelete={() => {
              deleted.current = false;
              setDeleting({ row: replayRow, busy: false, error: "", blocked: false });
            }}
          />
        ) : (
          <Banner
            tone="warn"
            actions={
              onCloseReplay ? (
                <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={onCloseReplay}>
                  Session recordings
                </button>
              ) : undefined
            }
          >
            {RECORDING_GONE}
          </Banner>
        )
      ) : (
        <>
          {removedByCap > 0 ? <Banner tone="info">{CAP_NOTE}</Banner> : null}
          {rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState icon={CircleDot} title={EMPTY_TITLE} body={EMPTY_BODY} />
          ) : (
            <div className="os-table os-runs-rec" role="table" aria-label="Session recordings">
              <div className="os-table__head" role="row">
                <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">
                  Recording
                </span>
                <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">
                  State
                </span>
                <span className="os-table__cell os-runs-rec__len" role="columnheader">
                  Length
                </span>
                <span className="os-table__cell os-runs-rec__when" role="columnheader">
                  Recorded
                </span>
                <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">
                  <span className="os-visually-hidden">Actions</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              {rows.map((row) => {
                const session = byId.get(row.sessionId);
                const action = rowAction(row, session, sessionsState);
                const length = recordingLength(row, now);
                const lit = row.sessionId === highlight;
                const title = sessionTitle(row);
                const where = whereWords(row);
                return (
                  <div
                    key={row.sessionId}
                    className={`os-table__row os-runs-rec__row${lit ? " is-highlighted" : ""}`}
                    role="row"
                    data-recording={row.sessionId}
                    aria-current={lit ? "true" : undefined}
                    tabIndex={lit ? -1 : undefined}
                  >
                    <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
                      <span className="os-table__title os-trunc" title={title}>
                        {title}
                      </span>
                      <span className="os-table__sub os-trunc" title={where}>
                        {where}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
                      {isRecording(row, action) ? <StatusWord state="live" label="Recording" /> : <StatusWord state="ready" label="Saved" />}
                    </div>
                    <div className="os-table__cell os-runs-rec__len" role="cell">
                      <span className="os-mono">{length.value}</span>
                      {length.soFar ? <span className="os-runs-rec__sofar">so far</span> : null}
                    </div>
                    <div className="os-table__cell os-runs-rec__when" role="cell">
                      {recordedAt(row) ? <TimeAgo since={recordedAt(row)} /> : "—"}
                    </div>
                    <div className="os-table__cell os-runs-rec__acts" role="cell">
                      <div className="os-runs-rec__btns">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="os-btn os-btn--secondary"
                          onClick={() => navigateTo("runs", { tab: "recordings", replay: row.sessionId })}
                        >
                          <Play size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
                          Replay
                        </button>
                        {action.kind === "open" ? (
                          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => navigateTo("sessions", { session: row.sessionId })}>
                            <SquareTerminal size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
                            Open live session
                          </button>
                        ) : null}
                        {action.kind === "resume" ? (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="os-btn os-btn--secondary"
                            disabled={!action.available || !session}
                            aria-describedby={action.available ? undefined : `os-rec-note-${row.sessionId}`}
                            onClick={() => {
                              if (!session) return;
                              setResumeFrom("row");
                              setResuming({ session, busy: false, error: "", toSafety: false, blocked: false });
                            }}
                          >
                            <History size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
                            Resume conversation
                          </button>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                      {action.kind === "resume" && !action.available ? (
                        <span id={`os-rec-note-${row.sessionId}`} className="os-runs-rec__note">
                          {action.reason}
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {resuming && copy ? (
        <AgentConfirmModal
          title={copy.title}
          confirmLabel="Resume conversation"
          busy={resuming.busy}
          confirmDisabled={resuming.blocked}
          onConfirm={() => void confirmResume()}
          onClose={() => {
            if (!resuming.busy) setResuming(null);
          }}
        >
          {copy.body.map((line) => (
            <p key={line}>{line}</p>
          ))}
          {copy.warning ? <Banner tone="warn">{copy.warning}</Banner> : null}
          {resuming.error ? (
            <p className="os-newrun__error" role="alert">
              {resuming.error}{" "}
              {resuming.toSafety ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="os-newrun__link"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setResuming(null);
                    navigateTo("safety");
                  }}
                >
                  Open Safety
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </AgentConfirmModal>
      ) : null}

      {deleting && deleteCopy ? (
        <AgentConfirmModal
          title={deleteCopy.title}
          confirmLabel={deleteCopy.confirm}
          danger
          busy={deleting.busy}
          confirmDisabled={deleting.blocked}
          giveFocusBack={() => !deleted.current}
          onConfirm={() => void confirmDelete()}
          onClose={() => {
            if (!deleting.busy) setDeleting(null);
          }}
        >
          {deleteCopy.body.map((line) => (
            <p key={line}>{line}</p>
          ))}
          {deleting.error ? (
            <p className="os-newrun__error" role="alert">
              {deleting.error}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </AgentConfirmModal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```css
.os-shell .os-replay__pin[data-lane="0"] {

}
.os-shell .os-replay__pin[data-lane="1"] {
  top: 32px;
}
.os-shell .os-replay__pin[data-kind="permission"] {
  border-color: var(--os-warn-line);
  color: var(--os-warn);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .os-shell .os-replay__pin:hover {
    background: var(--os-surface-3);
    border-color: var(--os-text-2);
    color: var(--os-text-1);
  }
}
.os-shell .os-replay__pin[aria-current="true"] {
  background: var(--os-surface-3);
  border-color: var(--os-text-1);
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-shell .os-replay__pin[data-kind="permission"][aria-current="true"] {
  border-color: var(--os-warn);
  color: var(--os-warn);
}
.os-replay__stem {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  margin-left: -0.5px;
  background: var(--os-line-2);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.os-replay__stem[data-lane="0"] {
  top: 22px;
  height: 36px;
}
.os-replay__stem[data-lane="1"] {
  top: 54px;
  height: 4px;
}
.os-replay__track {
  position: relative;
  height: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: var(--os-line-2);
}
.os-replay__idle,
.os-replay__removed {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.os-replay__idle {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--os-line-3);
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--os-bg-0) 0 3px, transparent 3px 7px);
}
.os-replay__removed {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--os-line-3);
  background: var(--os-surface-1);
}
.os-replay__fill {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  background: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-replay__scrub.is-playing .os-replay__fill {
  background: var(--os-accent);
}
.os-replay__range {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -5px;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 20px;
  margin: 0;
  background: transparent;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.os-replay__range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
  height: 20px;
  background: transparent;
}
.os-replay__range::-moz-range-track {
  height: 20px;
  background: transparent;
}
.os-replay__range::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  margin-top: 2px;
  border: 3px solid var(--os-bg-0);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--os-text-1);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--os-line-3);
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
}
.os-replay__range::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border: 3px solid var(--os-bg-0);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--os-text-1);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--os-line-3);
}
.os-replay__range:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--os-accent);
  outline-offset: 4px;
  border-radius: var(--os-r-sm);
}
.os-replay__ends {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-4);
  font-family: var(--os-font-mono);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-11);
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-replay__legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2) var(--os-sp-5);
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-3);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-replay__legend > span {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);
}
.os-replay__legend svg {
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-replay__legend .is-attn svg {
  color: var(--os-warn);
}
.os-replay__hatch,
.os-replay__gone {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 22px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.os-replay__hatch {
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--os-bg-0) 0 3px, transparent 3px 7px), var(--os-line-2);
}
.os-replay__gone {
  border: 1px solid var(--os-line-3);
  background: var(--os-surface-1);
}
.os-replay__side {
  min-width: 0;
}
.os-replay__side-title {
  margin: 0 0 var(--os-sp-2);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-16);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.os-replay__moments {
  max-height: 420px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.os-shell .os-replay__moment {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  column-gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 6px var(--os-sp-2) 6px var(--os-sp-1);
  border: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--os-line-1);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--os-dur-quick) var(--os-ease-out);
}
.os-shell .os-replay__moment:first-child {
  border-top: 0;
}
.os-replay__moment svg {
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-replay__moment[data-kind="permission"] svg {
  color: var(--os-warn);
}
.os-replay__what {
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-14);
  font-weight: 520;
  line-height: 1.3;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.os-replay__what small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 1px;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  font-weight: 450;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-replay__moment .os-mono {
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .os-shell .os-replay__moment:hover {
    background: var(--os-surface-1);
  }
}
.os-shell .os-replay__moment:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--os-accent);
  outline-offset: -2px;
}
.os-shell .os-replay__moment[aria-current="true"] {
  background: var(--os-surface-2);
}
.os-replay__moment[aria-current="true"] .os-replay__what {
  font-weight: 620;
}
.os-replay__moment.is-future .os-replay__what,
.os-replay__moment.is-future .os-mono {
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-replay__empty {
  margin: var(--os-sp-2) 0 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-replay__note {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  margin: var(--os-sp-6) 0 0;
  padding-top: var(--os-sp-4);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--os-line-1);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-replay__note svg {
  flex: none;
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .os-replay__body {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .os-replay__acts {
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .os-replay__btns {
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }
  .os-replay__why {
    text-align: left;
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 15: Create the probe and update the SP3 recordings probe** (both git-ignored, never committed).

**15a.** Create `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/replay.mjs` with exactly this content:

```js
// Task U11: Runs → Session recordings → Replay (spec SP4 "Recordings in Runs"). A real Claude Code session of W1's
// TUI-like fake makes a recording with real moments (its `hook` command posts UserPromptSubmit and PermissionRequest to
// the session's own hook address, Task X2a): its row offers Replay and Open live session; its replay shows the moments
// and plays the output, offers Open live session and a switched-off Delete while it runs, then Resume conversation (the
// prototype's confirm) and Delete recording (its confirm, a refusal that shuts the button, then the delete itself) once
// it ended. Page-level stubs (route) only for what the fakes cannot make in a probe's time: a recording with a
// two-minute idle gap, a removed first part and an end after its last output (its row, its cast and its moments), and
// one refused delete. Nothing here starts a real agent, and the probe stops the session it started.
// Run (after `npm run build`), from the worktree root:
//   node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/replay.mjs
import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const W = 1470, H = 956;
const FAKE_ID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555";
const LIVE_REFUSAL = "That session is still running. Stop it first, then delete its recording.";
// Chrome logs every refused request (the stubbed 409) as "Failed to load resource"; anything else is a real error.
const realErrors = (errors) => errors.filter((e) => !/Failed to load resource/.test(e));

// The stubbed recording: began an hour ago; its first 40 s were removed at a rotation; output at 40.5-45 s, then
// nothing for two minutes, then output at 165-170 s; the session ended at 190 s. Three moments.
function stubbedRecording(home) {
  const start = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) - 3600;
  const at = (s) => new Date((start + s) * 1000).toISOString();
  const lines = [
    { version: 2, width: 100, height: 24, timestamp: start },
    [40, "m", "[earlier output removed]"],
    [40.5, "o", "before the gap\r\n"],
    [44, "o", "Allow Bash? (y/n)\r\n"],
    [45, "o", "working\r\n"],
    [165, "o", "after the gap\r\n"],
    [170, "o", "done\r\n"]
  ];
  return {
    cast: `${lines.map((line) => JSON.stringify(line)).join("\n")}\n`,
    markers: [
      { at: at(41), type: "prompt" },
      { at: at(44), type: "permission", text: "Wants to use Bash" },
      { at: at(168), type: "files", files: [{ path: "src/app.ts", added: 12, removed: 3 }], more: 2 }
    ],
    row: {
      sessionId: FAKE_ID, kind: "agent", agentId: "codex", agentLabel: "Codex", folder: path.join(home, "projects", "api"), folderName: "api",
      folderShown: true, startedAt: at(0), firstStartedAt: at(0), endedAt: at(190), bytes: 4096, live: false
    }
  };
}

export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail, api, BASE, HOME }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));
  if (!HOME) {
    fail("harness", "audit.mjs does not pass HOME to probes");
    return;
  }
  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const waitFor = async (fn, ms = 10000) => {
    const end = Date.now() + ms;
    while (Date.now() < end) {
      try { if (await fn()) return true; } catch {}
      await sleep(100);
    }
    return false;
  };
  const visible = (locator, ms = 8000) => waitFor(() => locator.isVisible(), ms);
  const textOf = async (locator) => (await locator.textContent({ timeout: 1000 }).catch(() => "")) || "";
  const urlParam = (tab, name) => new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get(name) || "";
  const sideways = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth > document.scrollingElement.clientWidth);
  const sessTerm = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.querySelector(".os-sess-term .xterm-rows")?.textContent || "");
  const replayTerm = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.querySelector(".os-replay__screen .xterm-rows")?.textContent || "");
  const clock = async (tab) => (await textOf(tab.locator(".os-replay__now"))).trim();
  const seconds = (words) => {
    const m = /^(?:(\d+) h )?(?:(\d+) m )?(\d+) s$/.exec(words);
    return m ? Number(m[1] || 0) * 3600 + Number(m[2] || 0) * 60 + Number(m[3]) : NaN;
  };
  const focusedText = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.textContent?.trim() || "");
  const playButton = (tab) => tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Play", exact: true });
  const project = path.join(HOME, "projects", "replay-app");
  mkdirSync(project, { recursive: true });
  let id = null;
  try {
    // 1. Setup: a real Claude Code session (the fake) with a prompt and a permission asked, still live.
    const created = await api("POST", "/api/sessions", { agentId: "claude", folder: project });
    check(created.status === 201 && /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(created.json.id || ""), "setup: a Claude Code session (the fake) starts", JSON.stringify(created.json).slice(0, 200));
    id = created.json.id;
    {
      const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, `sessions&session=${id}`);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await sessTerm(tab)).includes("FAKE_ARGV"), 15000), "setup: its terminal is on screen");
      await tab.locator(".os-sess-term .xterm").click();
      for (const line of ['hook UserPromptSubmit {"prompt":"probe prompt"}', 'hook PermissionRequest {"tool_name":"Bash"}', "print replay-probe-line"]) {
        await tab.keyboard.type(line);
        await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
        await sleep(300);
      }
      check(await waitFor(async () => ((await sessTerm(tab)).match(/HOOK 204/g) || []).length >= 2, 10000), "setup: both hook posts were answered 204 (Task X2a)", (await sessTerm(tab)).slice(-200));
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await sessTerm(tab)).includes("replay-probe-line"), 8000), "setup: the printed line is on screen");
      check(await waitFor(async () => ((await api("GET", `/api/sessions/${id}/markers`)).json.markers || []).length >= 2, 8000), "setup: two moments are stored (a prompt and a permission asked)");
      await context.close();
    }

    // 2. The live recording: Replay on its row, the replay with Open live session, Delete off, the moments, Play.
    {
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "runs&tab=recordings");
      const row = tab.locator(".os-runs-rec__row", { hasText: "Claude Code · replay-app" });
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await row.count()) === 1, 10000), "the live recording is listed");
      check(!/later update/i.test(await textOf(tab.locator(".os-runs-rec"))), "no SP3 replay note on the list");
      check(await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Replay" }).isVisible(), "a live row offers Replay");
      check(await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Open live session" }).isVisible(), "and still Open live session");
      check(!(await sideways(tab)), "list with Replay buttons: no sideways scroll");
      await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Replay" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => urlParam(tab, "replay") === id), "Replay puts ?replay=<id> in the address");
      const head = tab.locator(".os-replay__head");
      check(await visible(head), "the replay opens in place of the list");
      check((await textOf(head.locator("h2"))).trim() === "Claude Code · replay-app", "its title is the session's", await textOf(head.locator("h2")));
      check(await waitFor(() => tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.tagName === "H2")), "and its title takes the keyboard");
      check(/Recording/.test(await textOf(head)) && /so far/.test(await textOf(head)), "it says Recording and the length so far", await textOf(head));
      check(await head.getByRole("button", { name: "Open live session" }).isVisible(), "a live recording offers Open live session");
      check((await head.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" }).count()) === 0, "and no Resume");
      check(await head.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete recording" }).isDisabled(), "Delete recording is off while the session runs");
      check(await head.getByText(LIVE_REFUSAL).isVisible(), "and says why, in the server's words");
      const side = tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Moments in this recording" });
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await side.getByRole("button").count()) >= 2, 10000), "the moments list shows the two moments");
      const sideText = await textOf(side);
      check(/Prompt/.test(sideText) && /Permission asked/.test(sideText) && /Wants to use Bash/.test(sideText), "a prompt and a permission asked with its text", sideText);
      check(!sideText.includes("probe prompt"), "the prompt's text is never shown (R23)");
      check(/Still recording/.test(sideText), "the live note");
      const speed = tab.getByRole("group", { name: "Speed" });
      check((await speed.getByRole("button", { name: "10×" }).getAttribute("aria-pressed")) === "true", "10× is the speed it starts at");
      await playButton(tab).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await replayTerm(tab)).includes("replay-probe-line"), 15000), "Play draws the recorded output in the replay terminal", (await replayTerm(tab)).slice(-200));
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await playButton(tab).count()) === 1, 15000), "at the end it stops by itself (Play again)");
      const permission = side.getByRole("button", { name: /^Permission asked: Wants to use Bash, / });
      await permission.click();
      check((await permission.getAttribute("aria-current")) === "true", "clicking a moment makes it the current one");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await replayTerm(tab)).includes("HOOK 204")), "and shows the screen at that moment");
      check(!(await sideways(tab)), "replay (live): no sideways scroll");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "console clean (live replay)", errors.join(" / "));
      await shot(tab, "replay", W, H, "replay-live");
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Session recordings" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => urlParam(tab, "replay") === "" && urlParam(tab, "highlight") === id), "Session recordings goes back and marks the row");
      check(await waitFor(() => tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.classList.contains("is-highlighted")))), "and the row takes the keyboard");
      await context.close();
    }

    // 3. Ended: Resume conversation with the prototype's confirm; Delete recording with its confirm.
    {
      const stopped = await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${id}/stop`);
      check(stopped.status === 200, "setup: the session is stopped", JSON.stringify(stopped.json).slice(0, 200));
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, `runs&tab=recordings&replay=${id}`);
      const head = tab.locator(".os-replay__head");
      const resume = head.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" });
      check(await waitFor(async () => await resume.isEnabled(), 12000), "once ended: Resume conversation in the header");
      check(/Saved/.test(await textOf(head)) && !/so far/.test(await textOf(head)), "it says Saved and its true length", await textOf(head));
      const del = head.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete recording" });
      check(await del.isEnabled(), "and Delete recording can be pressed");
      check(/Resume conversation starts Claude Code again/.test(await textOf(tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Moments in this recording" }))), "the ended note");
      await resume.click();
      const confirm = tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Resume this conversation?" });
      check(await visible(confirm), "Resume asks first, with the prototype's title");
      const confirmText = await textOf(confirm);
      check(/opens a new terminal in .*replay-app and starts Claude Code with its own resume feature/.test(confirmText), "it says where and how it resumes", confirmText);
      check(/does not paste the old text back in and does not press Enter for you/.test(confirmText), "and that nothing is pasted or sent");
      check((await confirm.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).isVisible()) && (await confirm.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" }).isVisible()), "Cancel and Resume conversation");
      await confirm.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await confirm.count()) === 0, 3000), "Cancel closes it");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await focusedText(tab)) === "Resume conversation"), "and the keyboard is back on Resume conversation", await focusedText(tab));

      // A refusal another try can't change (stubbed: the session started again meanwhile).
      const deleteCall = (u) => u.pathname === `/api/sessions/${id}/recording`;
      await tab.route(deleteCall, async (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() === "DELETE") {
          return route.fulfill({ status: 409, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify({ error: "recording_live", message: LIVE_REFUSAL }) });
        }
        const res = await route.fetch();
        return route.fulfill({ response: res });
      });
      await del.click();
      const ask = tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Delete this recording?" });
      check(await visible(ask), "Delete recording asks first");
      const askText = await textOf(ask);
      check(/can't be undone/.test(askText) && /tab stays on the Sessions page/.test(askText), "it says what goes and what stays", askText);
      await ask.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete recording" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await textOf(ask)).includes(LIVE_REFUSAL), 5000), "a refusal keeps the server's sentence");
      check(await waitFor(async () => await ask.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete recording" }).isDisabled(), 3000), "and shuts the dialog's Delete button");
      check(await waitFor(() => tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest('[role="dialog"]')))), "the keyboard stays in the dialog");
      await ask.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
      await tab.unroute(deleteCall);

      // The delete itself.
      await del.click();
      await ask.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete recording" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => urlParam(tab, "replay") === "", 8000), "after the delete the page goes back to the list");
      check(await waitFor(() => tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.getAttribute("role") === "tab")), "and the Session recordings tab takes the keyboard");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await tab.locator(".os-runs-rec__row", { hasText: "Claude Code · replay-app" }).count()) === 0, 8000), "the row is gone");
      const list = await api("GET", "/api/recordings");
      check(!(list.json.recordings || []).some((r) => r.sessionId === id), "the server lists it no more");
      const markers = await api("GET", `/api/sessions/${id}/markers`);
      check(markers.status === 200 && (markers.json.markers || []).length === 0, "and its moments went with it", JSON.stringify(markers.json));
      const session = await api("GET", `/api/sessions/${id}`);
      check(session.status === 200 && session.json.resume?.available === true, "the session and its Resume stay", JSON.stringify(session.json.resume));
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "console clean (ended replay)", errors.join(" / "));
      await context.close();
    }

    // 4. What the fakes can't make in a probe's time: an idle gap, removed output, a true length past the last output.
    for (const [w, h] of [[W, H], [1280, 720]]) {
      const stub = stubbedRecording(HOME);
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, w, h, "runs&tab=recordings");
      await tab.route((u) => u.pathname === "/api/recordings", async (route) => {
        const res = await route.fetch();
        const body = await res.json();
        return route.fulfill({ response: res, json: { ...body, recordings: [stub.row, ...(body.recordings || [])] } });
      });
      await tab.route((u) => u.pathname === `/api/sessions/${FAKE_ID}/recording`, (route) =>
        route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: "application/x-asciicast", body: stub.cast })
      );
      await tab.route((u) => u.pathname === `/api/sessions/${FAKE_ID}/markers`, (route) =>
        route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify({ markers: stub.markers }) })
      );
      await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=runs&tab=recordings&replay=${FAKE_ID}`);
      const head = tab.locator(".os-replay__head");
      check(await waitFor(async () => /Codex · api/.test(await textOf(head)), 10000), `@${w} the stubbed recording's replay opens`);
      check(
        await waitFor(async () => /of 3 m 10 s true length/.test(await textOf(tab.locator(".os-replay__clock"))), 8000),
        `@${w} the true length runs to the session's end (3 m 10 s)`,
        await textOf(tab.locator(".os-replay__clock"))
      );
      const playBox = await playButton(tab).boundingBox();
      check(playBox && playBox.y + playBox.height <= h, `@${w} Play is on screen without scrolling`, JSON.stringify(playBox));
      check(!(await sideways(tab)), `@${w} replay: no sideways scroll`);
      if (w !== W) {
        await shot(tab, "replay", w, h, "replay-stubbed");
        check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, `@${w} console clean (stubbed replay)`, errors.join(" / "));
        await context.close();
        continue;
      }
      const legendText = await textOf(tab.getByRole("group", { name: "Timeline key" }));
      check(/Idle, skipped while playing/.test(legendText) && /\[earlier output removed\]/.test(legendText), "the key names the hatched idle gap and the removed output", legendText);
      const idle = tab.locator(".os-replay__idle");
      check((await idle.count()) === 1 && (await idle.getAttribute("title")) === "Idle, skipped while playing", "one idle gap, drawn hatched, with the spec's words");
      const idleWidth = await idle.evaluate((el) => parseFloat(el.style.width));
      check(Math.round(idleWidth) === 63, "it spans the two minutes without output (45 s to 165 s of 190 s)", idleWidth);
      const removed = tab.locator(".os-replay__removed");
      const removedWidth = await removed.evaluate((el) => parseFloat(el.style.width));
      check((await removed.count()) === 1 && Math.round(removedWidth) === 21, "the removed span is the first 40 s of 190 s", removedWidth);
      check((await removed.getAttribute("title")) === "[earlier output removed]", "marked [earlier output removed]");
      const pins = tab.locator(".os-replay__pin");
      check((await pins.count()) === 3, "three pins on the timeline");
      check((await pins.first().getAttribute("tabindex")) === "-1" && (await pins.first().getAttribute("aria-hidden")) === "true", "pins are mouse shortcuts; the moments list is the keyboard's way");
      const side = tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Moments in this recording" });
      const items = side.getByRole("button");
      check((await items.count()) === 3, "three moments in the list");
      check(/src\/app\.ts \(\+12 −3\), and 2 more/.test(await textOf(side)), "files changed shows each path with +/− and how many more", await textOf(side));
      check((await items.nth(2).getAttribute("aria-label")) === "Files changed: 3, src/app.ts (+12 −3), and 2 more, 2 m 48 s", "a moment's name says what and when", await items.nth(2).getAttribute("aria-label"));
      check(await head.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" }).isDisabled(), "a session Agent OS no longer lists can't be resumed");
      check(/This session can't be resumed\./.test(await textOf(head)), "and the header says why");
      const range = tab.getByRole("slider", { name: "Replay position" });
      await range.focus();
      await tab.keyboard.press("Home");
      check(await waitFor(async () => await tab.locator(".os-replay__gone-note").isVisible(), 3000), "at 0 s the screen says [earlier output removed]");
      const speed = tab.getByRole("group", { name: "Speed" });
      await speed.getByRole("button", { name: "1×" }).click();
      check((await speed.getByRole("button", { name: "1×" }).getAttribute("aria-pressed")) === "true" && (await speed.getByRole("button", { name: "10×" }).getAttribute("aria-pressed")) === "false", "1× is pressed, and only it");
      await side.getByRole("button", { name: /^Permission asked: Wants to use Bash, / }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await clock(tab)) === "45 s", 3000), "a moment shows the screen one second after it (44 s → 45 s)", await clock(tab));
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await replayTerm(tab)).includes("Allow Bash?"), 3000), "and the screen as it was then");
      const t0 = Date.now();
      await playButton(tab).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await replayTerm(tab)).includes("after the gap"), 6000), "at 1× the two-minute idle gap is skipped while playing");
      check(Date.now() - t0 < 6000 && seconds(await clock(tab)) >= 165, "in seconds, not minutes; the clock is past the gap", await clock(tab));
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Pause", exact: true }).click();
      await speed.getByRole("button", { name: "30×" }).click();
      await range.focus();
      await tab.keyboard.press("Home");
      await playButton(tab).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await clock(tab)) === "3 m 10 s" && (await playButton(tab).count()) === 1, 6000), "at 30× it plays to the end and stops", await clock(tab));
      check(!(await tab.locator(".os-replay__gone-note").isVisible()), "past the removed span the note is gone");
      check((await replayTerm(tab)).includes("done"), "and the last output is on screen");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, `@${w} console clean (stubbed replay)`, errors.join(" / "));
      await shot(tab, "replay", w, h, "replay-stubbed");
      await context.close();
    }
  } finally {
    // Leave nothing running, even when a section above threw.
    if (id) await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${id}/stop`).catch(() => undefined);
  }
  const left = await api("GET", "/api/sessions?kind=all");
  check((left.json.sessions || []).every((x) => x.status === "exited"), "the probe leaves no session running", JSON.stringify((left.json.sessions || []).map((x) => x.status)));
}
```

### Task E1: SP4 verification (orchestrator)

This is the last check before SP4 goes to the owner's Mac for its live checks (Task E2). It runs after U11, the last building task. It does five things, in this order:
1. **The Minor sweep** (ruling R30): it fixes every `minor (deferred)` finding from the per-task reviews in one batch, or rules it an accepted limit.
2. **One guard test**, `test/sessions-sp4-safety.test.js`. It turns the safety searches the spec asks for into a test that stays in the suite: no new PTY write except the hand-off, the hook token for Claude Code only, no allow-always, no Hermes hook helper, every screen read labelled, the hooks router never answering with a body, and no CLI handed `process.env`. A Sonnet 5.5 worker writes it test first, from the exact code below.
3. **Everything the earlier tasks built, run together:**
   - the full suite under the no-real-agents watcher;
   - `tsc` and the page build, the server bundle with the statusLine wrapper, and the portable test;
   - `cargo test` with the notification crate;
   - the shape and safety searches over the final tree, one ledger line per Global Constraint;
   - the word-for-word copy check;
   - a map from each SP4 "done when" item (in its D1 wording) and each Security item to a test that passed;
   - every audit harness mode and every probe (SP4's seven, plus the SP3 and plan-brains ones).
4. **The whole-branch review, then the hands-on walkthrough** of the built app with fake agents (the PACING order).
5. **One message to the owner that does not wait for an answer.** It carries the screenshots and every NEW SENTENCE (Q32) (R28). Then E1 pushes the branch, opens the pull request, watches CI and reports.

A check that fails goes back to the task that owns it. E1 writes no product code itself: the Minor sweep and the guard test are written by workers, and E1 reviews and commits them.

What it owns:
- the spec's "SP4 done when" items, in the wording Task D1 gave them, as far as tests, builds, probes and the fake-agent walkthrough can show them (the live checks S1, S2, S4, S5 and S7 are Task E2's);
- the SP4 parts of Security 1 to 6, each with a named, passing test;
- the plan's Review Focus 1 to 5, each with its named test;
- R28 (the owner's copy review) and R30 (the Minor sweep).

What the owner does in E1: nothing he has to do. He gets one message (Step 21) that does not hold the work up, and every `git push` shows him a prompt (Step 22), after E1 has said in chat what is being pushed. His sign-in clicks, anything that spends money (S2 is Task E2's, and it asks first, R29) and the release stay his.

The rule for this task (the orchestrator does it; workers only write what Steps 1 to 6 hand them):
- It never starts a real agent and never runs an agent's CLI (`claude`, `codex`, `agent`, `cursor-agent`, `hermes`, `openclaw`).
- Every server it starts has:
  - a throwaway HOME and the fake login shell;
  - a PATH of only the fake bin plus `/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin`;
  - `AGENT_OS_KEYSTORE=file`, so the owner's Keychain is never touched.
- It never reads `.env` files, `~/.tauri/agent-os.key`, or anything under `~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, `~/.cursor`, `~/.openclaw` or `~/.hermes`, and never touches `/Applications`.
- It never signals, inspects or kills a process it did not start.
- Real `git` runs only inside the throwaway repo, with `HOME` pointed at the throwaway HOME, so none of the owner's git settings or hooks run.

The live walkthrough (Steps 16 to 18) uses fakes only. Under the AUTONOMY ruling it runs without asking:
- Step 0 records the owner's state;
- Step 18 compares it with the state after the walkthrough and puts back what E1 changed.

Depends on: Tasks D1, X1a, X1b, X2a, X2b, X3, X4, U5, U6, X7, U7, X8, X9, X10 and U11, each with its `Task <id>: complete (...)` line in the SP4 ledger. Task E2 starts only after this task's line `Task E1: complete (passed, ...)`.

- Create (test, written first): `test/sessions-sp4-safety.test.js`, 8 tests (Step 2).
- Modify: only the files the Minor sweep's brief lists (Step 1). Each is a file an earlier SP4 task created or changed, and each fix is one of that task's logged Minors. The brief names every file and line before the worker starts.
