```js
const { APPROVALS_CALL_LIMIT_MS, matchApprovalSession, parsePendingApprovals } = await load("server/runtime/sessions/openclaw-approvals.js");

const AOS = process.env.AGENT_OS_HOME;
const SPIKE_DIR = process.env.LIVE_SPIKE_DIR || path.join(process.env.HOME, "agent-os-spike-sp4");
const SHAPES_FILE = path.join(ROOT, ".superpowers", "sp4-live", process.env.LIVE_SHAPES || "live-shapes.json");
const SESSION_ID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
const CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;
const FALLBACKS = { claude: claudeFallbackPaths, hermes: hermesFallbackPaths, openclaw: openclawFallbackPaths };
const HERMES_GET_KEYS = new Set(["display.bell_on_prompt", "display.bell_on_complete", "approvals.mode"]);
const HERMES_SET_KEYS = new Set(["display.bell_on_prompt", "display.bell_on_complete"]);
// H3's never list, for the argv read (an exact flag, or any bypass or dangerous flag).
const NEVER_FLAGS = ["--bare", "--disable-slash-commands", "--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", "--accept-hooks", "--yolo", "--trust", "--no-alt-screen", "--tui"];

const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
const mode = argv.shift();
const options = { save: true, label: null, expectRoot: null, session: null, only: null, word: null };
const positional = [];
for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i += 1) {
  const arg = argv[i];
  if (arg === "--no-save") options.save = false;
  else if (arg === "--label") options.label = argv[++i];
  else if (arg === "--expect-root") options.expectRoot = argv[++i];
  else if (arg === "--session") options.session = argv[++i];
  else if (arg === "--only") options.only = String(argv[++i] ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean);
  else if (arg === "--word") options.word = argv[++i];
  else positional.push(arg);
}

async function readJson(file) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(await readFile(file, "utf8"));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
const binary = (name) => resolveBinary(name, FALLBACKS[name]());
const versionOf = (text) => /\d+\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?/.exec(String(text ?? ""))?.[0] ?? null;
const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
async function modeOf(file) {
  try {
    return ((await stat(file)).mode & 0o777).toString(8);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

let loginEnv = null;
// The environment a session gets (H2): the person's login shell, without Agent OS's own names.
// Kept in memory only, never printed.
async function sessionLikeEnv() {
  if (!loginEnv) {
    const { env } = await resolveLoginShellEnv({ shell: process.env.SHELL });
    loginEnv = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(env).filter(([name]) => !name.startsWith("AGENT_OS_")));
  }
  return loginEnv;
}

async function selectSession(selector) {
  const root = path.join(AOS, "sessions");
  if (typeof selector === "string" && selector.startsWith("latest:")) {
    const agent = selector.slice("latest:".length);
    let best = null;
    for (const id of await readdir(root).catch(() => [])) {
      if (!SESSION_ID.test(id)) continue;
      const meta = await readJson(path.join(root, id, "meta.json"));
      if (!meta || meta.kind !== "agent" || meta.agentId !== agent) continue;
      const at = Date.parse(meta.startedAt ?? meta.createdAt ?? "") || 0;
      if (!best || at > best.at) best = { id, meta, at };
    }
    if (!best) throw new Error(`no ${agent} session in this Agent OS folder`);
    return { id: best.id, dir: path.join(root, best.id), meta: best.meta };
  }
  if (typeof selector !== "string" || !SESSION_ID.test(selector)) throw new Error("a session is needed: latest:<agent> or a session id");
  const meta = await readJson(path.join(root, selector, "meta.json"));
  if (!meta) throw new Error("that session has no meta.json here");
  return { id: selector, dir: path.join(root, selector), meta };
}

async function processes() {
  const result = await runCli("/bin/ps", ["-axo", "pid=,ppid=,command="], { env: { PATH: "/usr/bin:/bin" }, maxChars: 4000000 });
  return parsePs(result.stdout);
}

// The Claude Code process of one Agent OS session, found by its Claude session id (in its argv as
// --session-id or --resume), never by name.
async function claudeProcessOf(agentSessionId) {
  if (typeof agentSessionId !== "string" || !agentSessionId) return null;
  return (await processes()).find((entry) => isClaudeCommand(entry.command) && entry.command.includes(agentSessionId)) ?? null;
}

const BINARIES = {
  money: () => options.only ?? ["claude", "hermes", "openclaw"],
  agents: () => ["claude"],
  approvals: () => ["openclaw"],
  "openclaw-exec": () => ["openclaw"],
  "hermes-get": () => ["hermes"],
  "hermes-set": () => ["hermes"]
};

async function refuseOutside(root) {
  const real = realpathSync(root);
  for (const name of BINARIES[mode]?.() ?? []) {
    const found = await binary(name);
    if (!found) continue;
    const at = realpathSync(found);
    if (at !== real && !at.startsWith(real + path.sep)) return `Refused: ${name} would run from outside ${root}`;
  }
  return null;
}

async function moneyMode() {
  const want = options.only ?? ["claude", "hermes", "openclaw"];
  const out = {};
  if (want.includes("claude")) {
    const detected = await ADAPTERS.claude.detect({ refresh: true });
    const status = detected.installed ? await signInStatus("claude") : { status: null, method: null };
    const info = { installed: Boolean(detected.installed), version: versionOf(detected.version), status: shownWord(status.status), method: shownWord(status.method) };
    out.claude = { ...info, billing: billingOf("claude", info) };
  }
  for (const agent of ["hermes", "openclaw"]) {
    if (!want.includes(agent)) continue;
    const detected = await ADAPTERS[agent].detect({ refresh: true });
    const model = detected.installed ? await readAgentModel(agent, detected) : {};
    const info = { installed: Boolean(detected.installed), version: versionOf(detected.version), provider: shownWord(model.provider), known: model.known !== false };
    if (agent === "openclaw") info.plan = shownWord(model.plan);
    out[agent] = { ...info, billing: billingOf(agent, info) };
  }
  for (const value of Object.values(out)) value.askFirst = askFirst(value.billing);
  return out;
}

async function agentsMode() {
  const claude = await binary("claude");
  if (!claude) return { failed: "Claude Code was not found" };
  const env = await sessionLikeEnv();
  const before = await processes();
  const started = Date.now();
  const limit = new AbortController();
  const cut = setTimeout(() => limit.abort(), CLAUDE_AGENTS_CALL_LIMIT_MS);
  // The poller's call (X2b): argv only, the session's environment and folder, cut at 5 s.
  const result = await runCli(claude, ["agents", "--json"], { env, cwd: SPIKE_DIR, signal: limit.signal });
  clearTimeout(cut);
  const ms = Date.now() - started;
  await wait(3000); // a process the call left behind is still there 3 s later
  const diff = processDiff(before, await processes());
  let parsed = null;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(result.stdout);
  } catch {
    parsed = null;
  }
  const answer = {
    exit: result.code,
    aborted: result.aborted,
    ms,
    json: parsed !== null,
    shape: parsed === null ? null : shapeOf(parsed, { show: AGENTS_SHOW }),
    stdout: parsed === null ? textStats(result.stdout) : null,
    processes: diff,
    verdict: supervisorVerdict(diff),
    pollOn: CLAUDE_AGENTS_POLL_ON
  };
  if (options.session) {
    const session = await selectSession(options.session);
    const found = await claudeProcessOf(session.meta.agentSessionId);
    const mapped = mapClaudeAgents(result.stdout, [{ id: session.id, agentSessionId: session.meta.agentSessionId ?? null, pid: found?.pid ?? null }]);
    answer.session = {
      pidFound: Boolean(found),
      mapped: mapped.length
        ? mapped.map((entry) => ({ matched: true, status: shownWord(entry.status), waitingFor: entry.waitingFor === null ? null : shownWord(entry.waitingFor) ?? "<hidden>" }))
        : [{ matched: false }]
    };
  }
  return answer;
}

async function approvalsMode() {
  const openclaw = await binary("openclaw");
  if (!openclaw) return { failed: "OpenClaw was not found" };
  const env = withSiblingNodePath(openclaw, await sessionLikeEnv());
  const started = Date.now();
  const limit = new AbortController();
  const cut = setTimeout(() => limit.abort(), APPROVALS_CALL_LIMIT_MS);
  // X3's call: argv only, never --url or --token, cut at 10 s; stderr is counted, never shown.
  const result = await runCli(openclaw, ["approvals", "pending", "--json"], { env, cwd: process.env.HOME, signal: limit.signal, captureStderr: true });
  clearTimeout(cut);
  let parsed = null;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(result.stdout);
  } catch {
    parsed = null;
  }
  const own = options.session ? (await selectSession(options.session)).id : null;
  const raw = Array.isArray(parsed?.approvals) ? parsed.approvals : null;
  return {
    exit: result.code,
    aborted: result.aborted,
    ms: Date.now() - started,
    json: parsed !== null,
    topKeys: parsed && typeof parsed === "object" ? Object.keys(parsed).map(safeKey) : null,
    shape: parsed === null ? null : shapeOf(parsed, { show: APPROVALS_SHOW }),
    stdout: parsed === null ? textStats(result.stdout) : null,
    stderr: textStats(result.stderr),
    entries: raw ? raw.length : null,
    cards: parsePendingApprovals(result.stdout).length,
    perEntry: (raw ?? []).map((entry) => ({
      kind: shownWord(entry?.kind),
      id: approvalIdShape(entry?.id),
      sessionKey: sessionKeyShape(entry?.sessionKey, own),
      matched: own ? matchApprovalSession(entry?.sessionKey, [{ id: own }]) === own : null,
      lifetimeS: typeof entry?.expiresAtMs === "number" && typeof entry?.createdAtMs === "number" ? Math.round((entry.expiresAtMs - entry.createdAtMs) / 1000) : null,
      summary: textStats(entry?.summary)
    }))
  };
}

async function openclawExecMode() {
  const openclaw = await binary("openclaw");
  if (!openclaw) return { failed: "OpenClaw was not found" };
  const result = await runCommand(openclaw, ["config", "get", "tools.exec.mode"], CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MS, { env: await sessionLikeEnv() });
  const value = result.ok ? parseConfigText(result.stdout) : null;
  return { exit: result.code, ok: result.ok, mode: value === null ? null : shownWord(String(value)) ?? "<value>" };
}

async function hermesGetMode(key) {
  if (!HERMES_GET_KEYS.has(key)) return { failed: `hermes-get reads only ${[...HERMES_GET_KEYS].join(", ")}` };
  const hermes = await binary("hermes");
  if (!hermes) return { failed: "Hermes was not found" };
  const result = await runCommand(hermes, ["config", "get", key], CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MS, { env: await sessionLikeEnv() });
  const value = result.ok ? parseConfigText(result.stdout) : null;
  return { key, exit: result.code, ok: result.ok, value: value === null ? null : shownWord(String(value)) ?? "<value>" };
}

async function hermesSetMode(key, value) {
  if (!HERMES_SET_KEYS.has(key) || !["true", "false"].includes(value)) {
    return { failed: "hermes-set changes only display.bell_on_prompt or display.bell_on_complete, to true or false" };
  }
  const hermes = await binary("hermes");
  if (!hermes) return { failed: "Hermes was not found" };
  const result = await runCommand(hermes, ["config", "set", key, value], CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MS, { env: await sessionLikeEnv() });
  return { key, value, exit: result.code, ok: result.ok, output: textStats(`${result.stdout ?? ""}\n${result.stderr ?? ""}`) };
}

async function settingsMode(selector) {
  const session = await selectSession(selector);
  const settings = await readJson(path.join(session.dir, "claude-settings.json"));
  const helper = await readJson(path.join(session.dir, "statusline.json"));
  return {
    agent: shownWord(session.meta.agentId),
    settings: settingsShape(settings, { sessionId: session.id }),
    helperConfig: helper ? { version: helper.version ?? null, hasCommand: typeof helper.command === "string" && helper.command.length > 0 } : null,
    modes: {
      settingsFile: await modeOf(path.join(session.dir, "claude-settings.json")),
      folder: await modeOf(session.dir),
      wrapperScript: await modeOf(path.join(session.dir, "statusline.mjs")),
      wrapperConfig: await modeOf(path.join(session.dir, "statusline.json"))
    }
  };
}

async function metaMode(selector) {
  const { meta } = await selectSession(selector);
  return {
    kind: shownWord(meta.kind),
    agentId: shownWord(meta.agentId),
    status: shownWord(meta.status),
    endedBy: meta.endedBy === null || meta.endedBy === undefined ? null : shownWord(meta.endedBy),
    resumes: Array.isArray(meta.resumes) ? meta.resumes.length : typeof meta.resumes === "number" ? meta.resumes : null,
    brain: meta.brain ? shownWord(meta.brain.kind) : null,
    agentSessionId: hash6(meta.agentSessionId),
    resumeMode: shownWord(meta.resumeMode),

  };
}

async function argvMode(selector) {
  const session = await selectSession(selector);
  const found = await claudeProcessOf(session.meta.agentSessionId);
  if (!found) return { found: false };
  const flags = [...new Set(found.command.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(1).filter((word) => /^--[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,40}$/.test(word)))].sort();
  return {
    found: true,
    flags,
    forbidden: flags.filter((flag) => NEVER_FLAGS.includes(flag) || /dangerous|bypass/.test(flag)),
    secretLike: textStats(found.command).secretLike
  };
}

function runShell(command, input, cwd) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const started = Date.now();
    const child = spawn("/bin/sh", ["-c", command], { cwd, env: { ...process.env, COLUMNS: "120", LINES: "40" }, stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "ignore"] });
    const chunks = [];
    const timer = setTimeout(() => child.kill("SIGKILL"), 10000);
    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));
    child.on("error", () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      resolve({ code: null, stdout: Buffer.alloc(0), ms: Date.now() - started });
    });
    child.on("close", (code) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      resolve({ code, stdout: Buffer.concat(chunks), ms: Date.now() - started });
    });
    child.stdin.on("error", () => {});
    child.stdin.end(input);
  });
}

// A statusLine JSON in the documented shape (agent-facts 1.4), with made-up values.
function sampleStatusLine(folder) {
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  return {
    hook_event_name: "Status",
    session_id: randomUUID(),
    transcript_path: path.join(AOS, "no-transcript.jsonl"),
    cwd: folder,
    model: { id: "claude-opus-5-5", display_name: "Opus 5.5" },
    workspace: { current_dir: folder, project_dir: folder },
    version: "2.1.292",
    output_style: { name: "default" },
    cost: { total_cost_usd: 0.42, total_duration_ms: 65000, total_api_duration_ms: 12000, total_lines_added: 3, total_lines_removed: 1 },
    context_window: {
      total_input_tokens: 12000,
      total_output_tokens: 800,
      context_window_size: 200000,
      used_percentage: 6,
      remaining_percentage: 94,
      current_usage: { input_tokens: 1200, output_tokens: 80, cache_creation_input_tokens: 400, cache_read_input_tokens: 10000 }
    },
    rate_limits: { five_hour: { used_percentage: 12, resets_at: now + 3600 }, seven_day: { used_percentage: 30, resets_at: now + 86400 } }
  };
}

// H6: the same stdin through the person's own command and through Agent OS's statusLine command
// (the wrapper). Runs the person's command twice around the wrapper, so a status line that changes
// between runs (a clock) shows as userStable: false instead of a false difference. The process
// environment is run.sh's (no AGENT_OS_HOOK_URL), so the wrapper posts nothing.
async function wrapperMode(selector) {
  const session = await selectSession(selector);
  const settings = await readJson(path.join(session.dir, "claude-settings.json"));
  const helper = await readJson(path.join(session.dir, "statusline.json"));
  const wrapperCommand = settings?.statusLine?.command;
  if (typeof wrapperCommand !== "string") return { failed: "claude-settings.json has no statusLine command" };
  const cwd = typeof session.meta.folder === "string" ? session.meta.folder : SPIKE_DIR;
  const input = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(sampleStatusLine(cwd)));
  if (typeof helper?.command !== "string" || helper.command === "") {
    const alone = await runShell(wrapperCommand, input, cwd);
    return { userCommand: false, wrapperBytes: alone.stdout.length, wrapperExit: alone.code, printsNothing: alone.stdout.length === 0 && alone.code === 0 };
  }
  const first = await runShell(helper.command, input, cwd);
  const wrapped = await runShell(wrapperCommand, input, cwd);
  const second = await runShell(helper.command, input, cwd);
  const sameAs = (run) => run.code === wrapped.code && run.stdout.equals(wrapped.stdout);
  return {
    userCommand: true,
    same: sameAs(first) || sameAs(second),
    userStable: first.stdout.equals(second.stdout),
    bytesUser: first.stdout.length,
    bytesWrapper: wrapped.stdout.length,
    exitUser: first.code,
    exitWrapper: wrapped.code,
    msWrapper: wrapped.ms,
    secretLikeInOutput: textStats(wrapped.stdout.toString("utf8")).secretLike
  };
}

async function castMode(selector) {
  const session = await selectSession(selector);
  const parts = [];
  for (const name of [PREV_CAST_FILE, CAST_FILE]) {
    try {
      parts.push(await readFile(path.join(session.dir, name), "utf8"));
    } catch {
      // a segment that is not there
    }
  }
  if (!parts.length) return { failed: "this session has no recording yet" };
  const text = parts.join("\n");
  const answer = { agent: shownWord(session.meta.agentId), ...castControls(text) };
  if (options.word) answer.words = { [options.word]: castWordCount(text, options.word) };
  return answer;
}

async function alertsMode(file) {
  const text = await readFile(file, "utf8").catch(() => null);
  if (text === null) return { failed: "the server log could not be read" };
  const shapes = text
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((line) => alertLineShape(line, ALERT_LINE_PREFIX))
    .filter(Boolean);
  const count = (key) =>
    shapes.reduce((totals, shape) => {
      const name = key(shape);
      totals[name] = (totals[name] ?? 0) + 1;
      return totals;
    }, {});
  return {
    lines: shapes.length,
    byAgentAndKind: count((shape) => `${shape.agent} ${shape.kind}`),
    texts: count((shape) => String(shape.text)),
    keysSeen: [...new Set(shapes.flatMap((shape) => shape.keys ?? []))]
  };
}

async function tapMode(file) {
  const text = await readFile(file, "utf8").catch(() => null);
  if (text === null) return { failed: "the tap file could not be read" };
  const entries = text
    .split("\n")
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((line) => {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(line);
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    })
    .filter(Boolean);
  return tapSummary(entries);
}

const MODES = {
  money: () => moneyMode(),
  agents: () => agentsMode(),
  approvals: () => approvalsMode(),
  "openclaw-exec": () => openclawExecMode(),
  "hermes-get": () => hermesGetMode(positional[0]),
  "hermes-set": () => hermesSetMode(positional[0], positional[1]),
  settings: () => settingsMode(positional[0]),
  meta: () => metaMode(positional[0]),
  argv: () => argvMode(positional[0]),
  wrapper: () => wrapperMode(positional[0]),
  cast: () => castMode(positional[0]),
  alerts: () => alertsMode(positional[0]),
  "tap-shapes": () => tapMode(positional[0])
};

let answer;
if (!MODES[mode]) {
  answer = { failed: `unknown mode; one of ${Object.keys(MODES).join(", ")}` };
} else {
  const refused = options.expectRoot ? await refuseOutside(options.expectRoot) : null;
  if (refused) {
    console.log(refused);
    process.exit(2);
  }
  try {
    answer = await MODES[mode]();
  } catch (error) {
    // Only this file's own messages are shown; a file system error shows its code, not its path.
    answer = { failed: error?.code ? `could not read (${error.code})` : String(error?.message ?? error).slice(0, 200) };
  }
}
const label = options.label ?? mode;
if (options.save && !answer.failed) {
  const all = (await readJson(SHAPES_FILE)) ?? {};
  all[label] = { at: new Date().toISOString(), ...answer };
  await writeFile(SHAPES_FILE, `${JSON.stringify(all, null, 2)}\n`);
}
console.log(JSON.stringify({ mode, label, answer }, null, 2));
process.exit(answer.failed ? 1 : 0);
```

(b) Create `.superpowers/sp4-live/tap.mjs`:

```js
// Task E2 (git-ignored, never committed): a stand-in hook endpoint for spike S1. The practice
// folder's own Claude settings (.claude/settings.local.json, written in Step 7) send Claude Code's
// hook events here as well as to Agent OS. It answers every request 204 with an empty body (no
// decision, H5), never keeps a body, and writes one line per request with the body's shape
// (shape.mjs hookShape) and what Agent OS's own mapHookEvent (hooks.js, Task X2a) makes of it.
// Bodies over 256 KB are counted and dropped, as Agent OS does (R5).
// Usage: node tap.mjs <port | 0> <out.jsonl>; prints TAP_READY:<port>.
import { appendFileSync } from "node:fs";
import http from "node:http";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { hookShape, mappedShape } from "./shape.mjs";

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "..");
const { mapHookEvent } = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(ROOT, "server/runtime/sessions/hooks.js")).href);
const LIMIT = 256 * 1024;
const [portArg, out] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!out) {
  console.error("usage: node tap.mjs <port | 0> <out.jsonl>");
  process.exit(2);
}
const started = Date.now();
const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  req.on("data", (chunk) => {
    size += chunk.length;
    if (size <= LIMIT) chunks.push(chunk);
  });
  req.on("error", () => {});
  req.on("end", () => {
    res.writeHead(204, { "Cache-Control": "no-store" });
    res.end();
    const entry = { t: Date.now() - started, method: req.method === "POST" ? "POST" : "<other>", bytes: size };
    if (size > LIMIT) {
      entry.dropped = true;
    } else {
      let body = null;
      try {
        body = JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8"));
      } catch {
        entry.unparsed = true;
      }
      if (body !== null) {
        Object.assign(entry, hookShape(body));
        try {
          entry.mapped = mappedShape(mapHookEvent(body));
        } catch {
          entry.mapped = { failed: true };
        }
      }
    }
    try {
      appendFileSync(out, `${JSON.stringify(entry)}\n`);
    } catch {
      // the check reads what it can
    }
  });
});
server.listen(Number(portArg) || 0, "127.0.0.1", () => console.log(`TAP_READY:${server.address().port}`));
for (const signal of ["SIGTERM", "SIGINT"]) process.on(signal, () => server.close(() => process.exit(0)));
```

```js
  { hook_event_name: "StopFailure", session_id: CLAUDE_CONVERSATION, error: "rate_limit", error_details: "429 Too Many Requests", last_assistant_message: PLANTED.prompt },
  { hook_event_name: "PermissionRequest", session_id: CLAUDE_CONVERSATION, tool_name: "mcp__plugin_secret_server__read", tool_input: { path: PLANTED.path } },
  { hook_event_name: "PostToolUse", session_id: CLAUDE_CONVERSATION, tool_name: "Write", tool_input: { file_path: PLANTED.path, content: "x".repeat(300 * 1024) } }
];
for (const body of bodies) {
  const reply = await postHook({ port, sessionId: IDS.claude, token: "fixture-token", body });
  if (reply.status !== 204) throw new Error(`the tap answered ${reply.status}`);
}
for (let i = 0; i < 40; i += 1) {
  if ((await readFile(tapFile, "utf8")).split("\n").filter(Boolean).length >= bodies.length) break;
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
}
tap.kill("SIGTERM");
console.log(`fixtures ready: ${bodies.length} hook bodies sent to the tap`);
```

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Task E2 (git-ignored, never committed): runs live.mjs the way the desktop app's server runs agent
# commands, as Task E3's run.sh did: a clean environment (nothing from this terminal: no
# CLAUDECODE markers, no keys, no HERMES_HOME of its own), the PATH the desktop shell gives its
# server (server_path_env in desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs), AGENT_OS_LAUNCH_PATH, and HOME as the
# working folder. LIVE_PATH, LIVE_AOS, LIVE_SPIKE_DIR and LIVE_SHAPES override the PATH, the
# throwaway Agent OS folder, the practice folder and the shapes file (dry-run.sh uses them).
set -eu
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
NODE_BIN="${NODE_BIN:-$(command -v node)}"
cd "$HOME"
exec env -i HOME="$HOME" USER="${USER:-}" LOGNAME="${LOGNAME:-}" SHELL="${SHELL:-/bin/zsh}" TMPDIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" \
  PATH="${LIVE_PATH:-/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.agent-os/node/bin:$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$HOME/.volta/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin}" \
  AGENT_OS_LAUNCH_PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin \
  AGENT_OS_HOME="${LIVE_AOS:-/private/tmp/sp4-live/aos}" \
  LIVE_SPIKE_DIR="${LIVE_SPIKE_DIR:-$HOME/agent-os-spike-sp4}" \
  LIVE_SHAPES="${LIVE_SHAPES:-live-shapes.json}" \
  "$NODE_BIN" "$ROOT/.superpowers/sp4-live/live.mjs" "$@"
```

```bash
#!/bin/sh
# Task E2, spike S2 only: makes this Claude Code session look as if its plan ran out, with the two
# different signals SP4's limit rule needs. Run inside the session with Claude Code's bash mode:
#   ! sh forge-limit.sh hook    posts a StopFailure hook with error rate_limit (the session's own token)
#   ! sh forge-limit.sh text    prints Claude Code's limit sentence on the screen
# Both are hints: one alone never holds a session, and every action after it needs a click and a
# confirm (spec "Hook events are hints").
case "$1" in
  hook)
    curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HOOK %{http_code}\n' --max-time 3 -X POST \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENT_OS_HOOK_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      --data '{"hook_event_name":"StopFailure","error":"rate_limit"}' "$AGENT_OS_HOOK_URL" ;;
  text)
    printf '%s\n' "You've hit your session limit · resets RESET_TIME" ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: sh forge-limit.sh hook|text"; exit 2 ;;
esac
SH
RESET="$(date -v+3H '+%l:%M%p' | tr -d ' ' | tr 'AMP' 'amp')"

grep -c "resets [0-9]*:[0-9][0-9][ap]m" "$SPK/forge-limit.sh"; git -C "$SPK" status --short | wc -l
```

(e) **The pane helpers** (read-only; paste once per page load with `javascript_tool`; they print states, kinds and Agent OS's own sentences, never ids, alert text outside those sentences, or approval summaries):

```js
window.__e2 = (() => {
  const KNOWN = [/^May need you$/, /^Has a question for you$/, /^Has a plan for you to approve$/, /^Waiting for you$/, /^Wants to use [A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,40}$/, /^(Claude Code|Codex)'s plan limit was reached\.$/, /^Claude needs your permission to use [A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,40}$/, /^Claude is waiting for your input$/];
  const known = (t) => (typeof t !== "string" ? t ?? null : t === "" || KNOWN.some((r) => r.test(t)) ? t : t.startsWith("Wants to use mcp__") ? "Wants to use <mcp tool>" : / asks for input$/.test(t) ? "<server> asks for input" : "<text>");
  const kind = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined ? null : typeof v);
  const win = (w) => (w ? { usedPercent: kind(w.usedPercent), resetsAt: kind(w.resetsAt) } : null);
  const view = (s) => ({
    agent: s.agentId, status: s.status, alerts: s.alerts, idleBy: s.idleBy, resetAt: s.resetAt ? "set" : null, trustNeeded: s.trustNeeded, hooksOff: s.hooksOff,
    brain: s.brain ? s.brain.kind : null,
    alert: s.alert ? { kind: s.alert.kind, text: s.alert.kind === "approval" ? "<summary>" : known(s.alert.text) } : null,
    meter: s.meter ? { model: s.meter.model, contextPercent: kind(s.meter.contextPercent), contextTokens: kind(s.meter.contextTokens), plan: win(s.meter.plan), weekly: win(s.meter.weekly), costUsd: kind(s.meter.costUsd) } : null,
    handoff: s.handoff ? s.handoff.state : null
  });
  const live = async (agentId) => {
    const { sessions } = await fetch("/api/sessions?live=1").then((r) => r.json());
    return sessions.filter((s) => s.kind === "agent" && s.status !== "exited" && (!agentId || s.agentId === agentId));
  };
  return {
    async sessions(agentId) { return (await live(agentId)).map(view); },
    async markers(agentId) {
      const [s] = await live(agentId);
      if (!s) return "no live session";
      const { markers } = await fetch(`/api/sessions/${s.id}/markers`).then((r) => r.json());
      const byType = {};
      for (const m of markers) byType[m.type] = (byType[m.type] ?? 0) + 1;
      return { count: markers.length, byType, permissionTexts: [...new Set(markers.filter((m) => m.type === "permission").map((m) => known(m.text)))].sort(), promptKeys: [...new Set(markers.filter((m) => m.type === "prompt").map((m) => Object.keys(m).sort().join(",")))], files: markers.filter((m) => m.type === "files").map((m) => m.files.length + m.more) };
    },
    async keepGoing(agentId = "claude") {
      const [s] = await live(agentId);
      if (!s) return "no live session";
      const i = await fetch(`/api/sessions/${s.id}/keep-going`).then((r) => r.json());
      return { agentId: i.agentId, approach: i.approach, available: i.available, reason: i.reason, model: i.model, estimateUsd: i.estimateUsd, estimateTokens: i.estimateTokens, estimateNote: i.estimateNote, warnings: i.warnings, needsKey: i.needsKey };
    },
    async approvals() {
      const a = await fetch("/api/sessions/approvals").then((r) => r.json());
      return { count: a.approvals.length, kinds: a.approvals.map((c) => c.kind), matched: a.approvals.map((c) => c.sessionId !== null), error: a.error ? "<poll-failed note>" : null };
    },
    async probe(agentId) {
      const [s] = await live(agentId);
      if (!s) return "no live session";
      window.__probe?.close();
      window.__frames = [];
      const started = Date.now();
      const ws = new WebSocket(`ws://${location.host}/api/sessions/${s.id}/attach`);
      window.__probe = ws;
      ws.onmessage = (e) => {
        const f = JSON.parse(e.data);
        if (f.t === "out") ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: "ack", seq: f.seq }));
        else if (f.t === "alert") window.__frames.push({ s: Math.round((Date.now() - started) / 1000), t: "alert", kind: f.kind, text: f.kind === "approval" ? "<summary>" : known(f.text) });
        else if (f.t === "state") window.__frames.push({ s: Math.round((Date.now() - started) / 1000), t: "state", status: f.status, resetAt: f.resetAt ? "set" : undefined });
      };
      return "probe open";
    },
    frames() { return window.__frames ?? []; }
  };
})();
"helpers ready";
```

The probe socket is a read-only viewer: it never sends `{t:"focus"}`, so it never takes the keys, and it acks every output frame, so it is never closed as too far behind (SP3's E2 probe, with SP4's frames).

What counts as a difference:
- a field Agent OS reads that is missing, renamed, of another type, or carries other words live (for example a PermissionRequest without `tool_name`, a StopFailure `error` word for a plan limit other than `rate_limit` or `billing_error`, a `status` word the poller does not know, an approval id that fails the id rule): a follow-up changes the reader and its fake, with a test built from the live shape (fake values only);
- the fake answers in a shape the real program never prints, in a field Agent OS reads: a follow-up changes the fake;
- a field only live (or only in the fake) that Agent OS never reads: listed under "Fakes left as they are" in the results with the reason, and reported to the owner in E2's report, where he may ask for a follow-up (non-blocking, as R28's batch is);
- anything in Note 9's list goes to the owner first, with the finding and a proposed spec sentence, before any code.

Severity (R30): a break of H1-H6 or a security item (`same: false` with `userStable: true`, a key in argv or in the settings file, a hook reply that is a decision, a forbidden flag) is Critical; a missed or wrong alert, state or match is Important; a fake-only difference is Minor. Critical and Important follow-ups are done before E2 closes; Minor ones too when they touch a field Agent OS reads.

## Minor review notes (not yet applied)

Findings of the plan review. All are minor, and none is applied to the text above yet. File names such as `task-E2.md` and their line numbers refer to the task briefs in the scratchpad's `sp4/` folder, which became the task sections of this plan. "Contract addition <n>" and "item <n>" refer to the merged items tagged `(<task> #<n>)` in "Shared names and shapes". Lines marked *Assembly note* were added when this plan was assembled and are not part of the findings. One assembly change was made: in Task U7's probe, the constant for the `notes/todo.txt` row is named `NOTES_ROW` (two lines), so that the plan's placeholder grep stays clean; it behaves the same.

1. **E2** (lens: coverage)
   - Problem: E2 Note 8 says "Agent OS being down while Claude runs (H5, tested in X2a)". X2a has no such test. Its tests pin the settings side: 3 s timeouts, no `timeout` on SessionEnd, no `onFailure`, and 204 within 50 ms. The "fails fast and the agent continues unchanged" half of H5 is Claude Code's own behaviour, and neither a test nor a live check covers it. The only Agent-OS-down test is X2b's Review Focus 5, which covers the statusLine wrapper.
   - Fix: File task-E2.md, Note 8: replace "Agent OS being down while Claude runs (H5, tested in X2a)" with "Agent OS being down while Claude runs (H5: X2a pins the settings side, with 3 s event timeouts, Claude's own 1.5 s on SessionEnd and no onFailure, so Claude's default is to continue; X2b Review Focus 5 covers the wrapper with Agent OS down; Claude's own fail-fast on a refused connection is not checked live)".
2. **E2** (lens: coverage)
   - Problem: E2 Step 9(f) expects "`byType.prompt` equals the number of prompts typed so far (5)". Steps 9(c) to 9(e) type four prompts: the ls prompt, the AskUserQuestion prompt, the plan prompt and the README edit prompt. Answering a choice or pressing Esc is not a prompt. Claude also fires UserPromptSubmit for scheduled tasks and subagent reports (agent-facts 1.3), so a fixed number is fragile and can produce a false R23 or X2a finding.
   - Fix: File task-E2.md, Step 9(f): replace "`byType.prompt` equals the number of prompts typed so far (5)" with "`byType.prompt` equals the number of UserPromptSubmit events the tap recorded for this session so far (4 when only the prompts of (c) to (e) were sent)". Compare it with `run.sh tap-shapes` from (i).
3. **E1** (lens: coverage)
   - Problem: Some walkthrough and live-check click sequences skip UI steps that the building tasks add. U5 asks for a confirm before every approval answer (`approvalConfirm`: "Allow this once?" / "Deny this?"). E1 Step 16 ("click "Allow once": the card shows ...", "click "Deny"") and E2 Step 12(b)/(c) ("Click "Deny" on the card. The card leaves...", "click "Allow once": the command runs") never mention it. X10-h shows no "Keep going on OpenRouter" button while no key is saved, yet E1 Step 17 says "press "Keep going on OpenRouter": with no saved key ... the banner points to Agents → Brain". Steps that cannot be carried out as written lead to wrong walkthrough or E2 ledger lines.
   - Fix: task-E1.md Step 16 (OpenClaw approvals) and task-E2.md Step 12(b)/(c): after each card click, add "then confirm in the dialog ("Allow this once?" / "Deny this?"); before the confirm, `approvals-resolve` is still 0". This also checks the hint rule "every banner action needs the user's click plus a confirm dialog". task-E1.md Step 17 (Keep going, words only): replace "press "Keep going on OpenRouter": with no saved key (the file keystore is empty) the banner points to Agents → Brain" with "with no saved key (the file keystore is empty) the banner shows no Keep going button (X10-h), only continue.js's 'Save your OpenRouter key first' sentence and the Agents → Brain link".
4. **X2b** (lens: consistency)

Yet X2b still carries a conditional Step 7 and a conditional Files entry for server/runtime/sessions/hooks.js. Its Step 0 also accepts '0 or 1' for that count.
